PCY:Wall of Vipers.f:
What wall can never be climbed, but is always scaled?
—Nakaya riddle

VIS:Fallen Askari.f: In troubled times, there are few greater sorrows than a wayward savior.

ODY:Afflict.f: When one of the Patriarch's champions displeased him, he would only shake his finger. That was enough.

MIR:Nocturnal Raid.f:
"The finest offering of night is not stealth but daring."
—Tetlok, Breathstealer

UDS:Bubbling Beebles.f:
"Chancellor Rayne canceled the annual beeble roast. I should have married a crueler woman."
—Barrin

SOK:Celestial Kirin.f: All bow at its visitation—some in awe, some in honor, some in fear.

NEM:Belbe's Armor.f: It protects her from the ravages of Phyrexia and the savages of Rath.

UDS:Slinking Skirge.f: Davvol encouraged the skirges; they made excellent sentries and were quite edible if properly seasoned.

POR:Spined Wurm.f: It has more teeth than fit in its mouth.

BOK:Floodbringer.f: "Such a small thing, a drop of water . . . And yet enough of them together can flood a field, cleanse a mire, or choke a forest."

ODY:Refresh.f:
Death is a moth that dances toward our inner flame. The brightest fire can singe its wings.
—Nantuko teaching

PTK:Lady Zhurong, Warrior Queen.f:
"A man, and such a fool! I, a woman, will fight them for you."
—Lady Zhurong to her husband Meng Huo, before leading an army against the Shu

MMQ:Mercadian Atlas.f: One may as well chart the clouds as try to map Mercadia.

ICE:Thermokarst.f:
"Finally we understand the lesson of our home: loss begets renewal."
—Kolbjörn, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

ICE:Elvish Healer.f:
"The Kjeldorans keep the Orcs at bay and we train their healers. Most human bargains aren't as fair."
—Laina of the Elvish Council

BOK:Mirror Gallery.f: Only in mirrors do heroes find their equal.

MIR:Dread Specter.f:
Whatever follows life is incurable.
—Zhalfirin aphorism

DST:Ur-Golem's Eye.f: It still stares accusingly at Memnarch, though millennia have passed since he separated the eye from its body.

UDS:Tormented Angel.f: Falling from heaven is not as painful as surviving the impact.

HML:Faerie Noble.f:
"Faeries talk all in riddles and tricky bits, 'cept the Nobles. Now, *there's* some straight talkers."
—Joskun, An-Havva Constable

5DN:Fleshgrafter.f: Necrogen enflames certain emotional centers in the Morioks' brains: hate, aggression, and especially greed.

2ED:Granite Gargoyle.f:
"While most overworlders fortunately don't realize this, Gargoyles can be most delicious, providing you have the appropriate tools to carve them."
—The Underworld Cookbook, by Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar

TMP:Armored Pegasus.f:
"I always charge a little extra to take on a pegasus. They fly like eagles, kick like mules, and hide like hermits."
—Tahli *en*-Dal, bounty hunter

USG:Humble.f:
"It is not your place to rule, Radiant. It may not even be mine."
—Serra

MMQ:Tiger Claws.f: Cho-Arrim martial artists emulate the beasts of their home.

TOR:Chainer's Edict.f: The pits have their own form of mercy.

CHK:Ember-Fist Zubera.f: When the Honden of Infinite Rage shattered, its attendants swarmed Kamigawa to sow mortal destruction.

TMP:Canyon Wildcat.f: "Relative of yours?" Ertai teased. Mirri simply sneered.

CHK:Pull Under.f:
"Although nowhere on Kamigawa was safe during the war, the Takenuma Swamp was the most horrifying. The rotting bamboo itself rebelled against its mortal inhabitants, pulling them into unmarked graves."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

VIS:Viashino Sandstalker.f:
"Some believe Sandstalkers to be illusions; those with scars know better."
—*Zhalfirin Guide to the Desert*

USG:Bravado.f:
"We drive the dragons from our home. Why should we fear you?"
—Fire Eye, viashino bey

SCG:Gilded Light.f: "Whoever survives the first blow lives to land the second."

WTH:Timid Drake.f:
"I sneezed, and it bolted."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

PTK:Trained Jackal.f: To taunt a man into action, call him a coward. To insult him beyond forgiveness, call him a jackal.

DST:Echoing Ruin.f: A single misstep unleashes an avalanche of ruin.

HML:Feroz's Ban.f:
"Without the protection of Feroz's Ban, I fear the Homelands are lost."
—Daria

PLS:Planeswalker's Mirth.f:
"I enjoy a good joke as much as the next guy."
—Commodore Guff

PCY:Samite Sanctuary.f:
Our war is against suffering, not against those who cause it.
—Samite creed

DST:Scavenging Scarab.f: The beetles feed not on the flesh of corpses but on the metal, grinding out the iron and steel to add to their own bulky shells.

PTK:Taoist Mystic.f: By appearing in places miles apart at the same time, Zuo Ci exhibited the mystic's ability to "shrink the land."

MIR:Meddle.f:
"Shadimir was as surprised as he was relieved when the blow turned aside."
—Afari, *Tales*

EXO:Cataclysm.f: The *Weatherlight* dragged the *Predator* behind it, the cradle hauling the casket.

MIR:Savage Twister.f:
"Frozen, we watched the funnel pluck up three of the goats—pook! pook! pook!—before we ran for the wadi."
—*Travelogue of Najat*

ULG:Urza's Blueprints.f: From concept to paper to reality.

WTH:Redwood Treefolk.f:
"In the heart of Llanowar the magic is so strong that trees cannot stay rooted."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

CHK:Villainous Ogre.f:
"The war saw the ogres emerge from their caves, reeking of blood, with the power of oni in their veins."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

ALL:Royal Herbalist.f:
"Just as an Herbalist heals a wound, so must we heal the rift between Balduvia and Kjeldor."
—King Darien of Kjeldor

MRD:Slith Ascendant.f: Instinctively drawn to the light of its "mother-sun," each slith follows that sun's path around Mirrodin.

P02:Chorus of Woe.f: When nightstalkers sing, nothing in creation sleeps.

MMQ:Henge Guardian.f: Like so many Thran relics, the wurm engine kept operating long after its creators were gone.

DST:Leonin Battlemage.f: The strongest of the pride are measured not by the steel in their hands but by the steel in their souls.

JUD:Arcane Teachings.f: Dwarves may teach at the speed of stone, but their results are solid.

ALL:Deadly Insect.f:
"There is no time for pain when this beast leaves its terrible sting."
—Jaeuhl Carthalion, Juniper Order Advocate

INV:Teferi's Care.f:
"If I do nothing else, I will protect my people."
—Teferi

SOK:Secretkeeper.f: It is all the things that humanity was not meant to know.

MMQ:Pangosaur.f: Only Rushwood is vast enough to swallow this creature whole.

DST:Roaring Slagwurm.f: Wurms compete for nesting grounds near the Radix. The young who hatch closest have the best chance for survival.

VIS:Infantry Veteran.f:
"The true dishonor for a soldier is surviving the war."
—Telim'Tor

5DN:Plasma Elemental.f:
"I watched a ship sail right through it. I thought it was harmless . . . until I saw what it had done to the crew."
—Bruenna, Neurok leader

TMP:Winged Sliver.f:
"Everything around here has cut a deal with gravity."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

DST:Magnetic Flux.f: After the researcher's astonishing success, his assistants spent six hours finding a way to return the specimens safely to the ground.

APC:Dwarven Patrol.f: Dwarves never worry about who watches their backs.

FEM:Initiates of the Ebon Hand.f: Ebon leaders soon realized that non-human races often had special talents that could be exploited.

POR:Fleet-Footed Monk.f: "Hesitation is for the faithless. My belief lends me speed."

TMP:Rootwalla.f: If you try to sneak up on a rootwalla, you'll suddenly find yourself dealing with twice the lizard.

MRD:Leveler.f: Once a century, the levelers rip through every corner of Mirrodin, obeying the commands of an unseen master.

FEM:Farrel's Zealot.f: After the fall of Trokair, Farrel and his followers formally broke their ties with the rest of Icatia.

INV:Rewards of Diversity.f:
"Everything is in place. Nothing can happen that isn't part of my plan."
—Urza

PTK:Shu Cavalry.f: In establishing the Shu kingdom, Liu Bei's forces fought against Ma Chao at Chengdu. Eventually, Ma Chao surrendered and became one of Liu Bei's Tiger Generals.

2ED:Wall of Swords.f: Just as the evil ones approached to slay Justina, she cast a great spell, imbuing her weapons with her own life force. Thus she fulfilled the prophecy: "In the death of your savior will you find salvation."

PLS:Meteor Crater.f: Legend has it that meteor craters are haunted by the ghosts of those who died on impact.

JUD:Spellgorger Barbarian.f: The epidemic insanity had a lasting effect on certain barbarians—but no one noticed.

ODY:Springing Tiger.f: The ground trembled in a violent purr.

USG:Pariah.f: "It is *not* sad," Radiant chided the lesser angel. "It is right. Every society must have its outcasts."

ODY:Shadowblood Egg.f:
"Does your passion for power consume your soul?"
—Watnik, master glassblower

WTH:Fatal Blow.f:
"What is crueler? To let a wound of the heart fester, or to simply cut it out?"
—Crovax

LGN:Timberwatch Elf.f: Even through the Mirari's voice, the elves still hear the call of their kinship.

POR:Raise Dead.f: The earth cannot hold that which magic commands.

ICE:Gorilla Pack.f:
"We learned this at a dear price: once you cross the great river, get through the Yavimaya forest at top speed."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

SOK:Path of Anger's Flame.f:
"Walking the path of the kami only leaves you with singed feet."
—Soratami saying

INV:Tectonic Instability.f:
"Think of the problems we'll face if you uproot entire continents," said Urza.
"I have," replied Teferi, "but the alternative is worse."

BOK:Nezumi Shadow-Watcher.f:
"The Okiba Gang! Night-cursed thieves and assassins! I've had enough of their meddling! Triple the guard!"
—Marrow-Gnawer

HML:Mesa Falcon.f:
"Pretty Falcon, friend to Soraya. Will you send her my greetings?"
—Gemma, Willow Priestess

INV:Ordered Migration.f: "Birds reach all parts of the world," said Barrin. "They will make excellent scouts."

EXO:Mage il-Vec.f: Living below a flowstone foundry produces a disproportionate number of fire mages among the *il*.

TOR:Frantic Purification.f: By definition, madness ends in one of two ways: clarity . . . or death.

USG:Lingering Mirage.f: Birds frozen in flight. Sea turned to glass. Tolaria hidden in a mirror.

ULG:Giant Cockroach.f: If the sun ever hit the swamp, where would these scurry to?

BOK:Split-Tail Miko.f: "I wish there were no use for those with my talents. I wish that I could walk Kamigawa forgotten and unneeded, with no war wounds to heal and no broken bones to mend."

POR:Lizard Warrior.f: Don't let its appearance frighten you. Let its claws and teeth do that.

WTH:Mischievous Poltergeist.f:
"The past is a ghost that haunts you from the moment it exists until the moment you don't."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

HML:Samite Alchemist.f:
"The wisest of Aysen dwell not in the Abbey, but in the laboratory."
—Taysir

HML:Funeral March.f:
"This party is such fun—but it's a shame to mourn just one."
—Irini Sengir

ODY:Millikin.f: The toymaker frowned in bewilderment. None of his creations had ever sneezed before.

NEM:Ensnare.f: Rootwater has become as dangerous to its denizens as to its enemies.

ONS:Snarling Undorak.f: Most creatures in the Krosan Forest feared the Mirari's power. A few fed upon it.

MMQ:Henge of Ramos.f:
It is the hub. We are the wheel.
—Dryad saying

SOK:Choice of Damnations.f:
"Life is a series of choices between bad and worse."
—Toshiro Umezawa

DST:Nourish.f: Gelfruit grows abundantly wherever Sylvok druids live, as if the Tangle knows that humans are not as hardy as the beasts or as nimble as the elves.

MMQ:Snake Pit.f:
If the ground is smooth, the way will be rough.
—Deepwood saying

USG:Redeem.f:
"That they are saved from death is immaterial. What is important is that they know the source of their benefaction."
—Radiant, archangel

VIS:Chronatog.f: For the chronatog, there is no meal like the present.

ULG:Erase.f: Perception is more pleasing than truth.

USG:Acridian.f: The elves of Argoth were trained to ride these creatures, even when their mounts traveled upside-down.

ONS:Aether Charge.f: "Is it just me, or does that meteor have teeth?"

PTK:Barbarian General.f:
"Barbarian tribes with their rulers are inferior to Chinese states without them."
—Confucius, *The Analects* (trans. Lau)

DST:Echoing Calm.f: A single light unleashes a hail of cleansing.

5DN:Myr Servitor.f: The Krark Clan enjoys pulling them apart just to watch them reassemble one another.

ICE:Fyndhorn Brownie.f:
"I've been insulted by drunks in a hundred inns, but never as skillfully or annoyingly as by those blasted Brownies."
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox

EXO:Treasure Hunter.f:
"What separates junk from treasure is imagination."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

STH:Crystalline Sliver.f: Bred as living shields, these slivers have proven unruly—they know they cannot be caught.

ULG:Beast of Burden.f: "If it is meant to be nothing but a machine," Karn finally asked Jhoira, "why did Urza build it to be like me?"

WTH:Dingus Staff.f:
"A sharp conscience is the weapon of the soul."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

HML:Labyrinth Minotaur.f:
"Legend says they got a treasure cave, but it don't say where to find it."
—Zeki, Reef Pirate

LEG:Aerathi Berserker.f: Ærathi children who show promise are left to survive for a year in the wilderness. Those who return are shown the way of the Berserker.

SOK:Cut the Earthly Bond.f:
"The more kami that passed through the veil that separated them from our world, the weaker that veil became, threatening to tear into tatters at the slightest pressure."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

UDS:Hulking Ogre.f:
"The Keldons' ogre campaign provided more body parts than my meager facility could properly use."
—Gatha, Tolarian renegade

ATQ:Colossus of Sardia.f: From the Sardian mountains wakes ancient doom: Warrior born from a rocky womb.

MMQ:Customs Depot.f: A bribe is always faster than filling out paperwork.

INV:Scarred Puma.f: It's not eager to lose the *other* eye.

USG:Bereavement.f:
"Grief is as useless as love."
—Gix, Yawgmoth praetor

TOR:Hydromorph Gull.f:
"The only kind of water that should fly through the air is rain."
—Kamahl, pit fighter

PCY:Despoil.f: Nothing could grow where the vile smoke had been, and no one could breathe it and live.

MIR:Cadaverous Knight.f:
Grieve for the soul in death dishonored.
—Shadow Guild saying

PTK:Yellow Scarves General.f: Zhang Jue, leader of the Yellow Scarves rebellion, was a Taoist master and tutored his soldiers in those arts.

TMP:Blood Frenzy.f:
"When Torahn bellows, none survive—not even the warrior whose horns he rides."
—Talruum adage

PTK:Ghostly Visit.f: Cao Cao was haunted to death by the ghosts of the empresses and other high courtiers he had murdered.

INV:Slinking Serpent.f: It winds its way through undergrowth as easily as it swims through shallows.

VIS:Rowen.f:
"I've dreamt of a second harvest but fear I will not see it."
—Asmira, Holy Avenger

HML:Carapace.f:
"The tougher to crack, the sweeter the snack."
—Kakra, Sea Troll

ALL:Soldevi Sage.f:
"To hide the truth is more than folly—it is fatal."
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic

ATQ:Dragon Engine.f: Those who believed the city of Kroog would never fall to Mishra's forces severely underestimated the might of his war machines.

VIS:Dwarven Vigilantes.f: Some dwarves can only be pushed so far.

LEG:Revelation.f: "Many are in high place, and of renown: but mysteries are revealed unto the meek." —Ecclesiastes 3:19

USG:Viashino Sandswimmer.f: Few swim in a place of such thirst.

INV:Samite Archer.f: "I can preserve ten lives by taking one."

ICE:Glacial Wall.f:
"We are farther west than any could have imagined possible, but I still wish to press on. Unfortunately, huge walls of ice block further travel. We can't believe they are natural."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

UDS:Temporal Adept.f:
"Of course she's at the head of her class. All her classmates have disappeared."
—Gatha, Tolarian renegade

VIS:Raging Gorilla.f:
"Every temper tantrum makes another angry gorilla."
—Femeref children's myth

PTK:Lu Bu, Master-at-Arms.f: "Dong Zhuo's man, Lu Bu, warrior without peer, / Far surpassed the champions of his sphere."

5DN:Suntouched Myr.f: As the fifth sun joins the other four, new abilities awaken in the creatures of Mirrodin.

LEG:Hunding Gjornersen.f: "You would never guess, at the terrifying sight of the man, that Hunding was as charming a companion as one could wish for."

CHK:Kiku, Night's Flower.f:
"A wanderer has told me of an assassin in the Takenuma Swamp who uses her dark arts to animate her enemies' shadows against them. A wild tale, but it explains much."
—Diary of Azusa

LEG:Dream Coat.f:
"Adopt the character of the twisting octopus, which takes on the appearance of the nearby rock. Now follow in this direction, now turn a different hue."
—Theognis, *Elegies 1, 215*

ALL:Martyrdom.f:
"The only true immortality is in dying for a cause."
—Halvor Arensson, Kjeldoran Priest

ODY:Pianna, Nomad Captain.f: Some find inspiration in their swords. Others find it in their leaders.

MRD:Vulshok Battlemaster.f: "I could demonstrate how the leonin sunsplicer works, but then you'd be too dead to buy one."

STH:Leap.f: Mirri leapt quickly and silently. The guard died likewise.

ICE:Snow Hound.f:
"If you're starving, eat your horses, your dead, or yourself—but *never* eat your dog."
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox

VIS:Natural Order.f: . . . but the price of Mangara's freedom was Asmira's life.

LEG:Devouring Deep.f: "Full fathom five thy father lies;/ Of his bones are coral made;/ Those are pearls that were his eyes;/ Nothing of him that doth fade,/ But doth suffer a sea-change/ Into something rich and strange." —William Shakespeare, *The Tempest*

HML:Hungry Mist.f:
"All things must eat, after all. Even the air can hunger."
—Gemma, Willow Priestess

MIR:Unseen Walker.f:
"To pass through the jungle: silence, courtesy, ferocity, as the occasion demands."
—Kamau, "Proper Passage"

MIR:Abyssal Hunter.f: Some smiles show cheer; some merely show teeth.

BOK:Toils of Night and Day.f:
"The war sent Kamigawa into turmoil. Here it was spring and there winter. For some, time stood still, while for others, moments flashed past like minnows in a pond."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

MRD:Mind's Eye.f: "Ideas drift like petals on the wind. I have only to lift my face to the breeze."

ULG:Anthroplasm.f: I never metamorphosis I didn't like.

ODY:Aven Cloudchaser.f:
"At the Reapportionment, Eagle begged to be human. The Ancestor granted half that prayer."
—Nomad myth

NEM:Volrath the Fallen.f: "I stepped out. I did not step down."

P02:Razorclaw Bear.f:
One razorclaw is three bears too many.
—Elvish saying

2ED:Scathe Zombies.f: "They groaned, they stirred, they all uprose,/ Nor spake, nor moved their eyes;/ It had been strange, even in a dream,/ To have seen those dead men rise."/ —Samuel Coleridge, "The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

MRD:Iron Myr.f: The goblins didn't think of the myr at all, which allowed the myr to observe everywhere unhindered.

ODY:Auramancer.f: Beauty stirs the memory like a sweet perfume excites the air.

PLS:Aura Blast.f: "None of your history books mention me?" laughed Daria. "They will now."

FEM:Elven Fortress.f:
"The size of the obvious Fortress walls often misled foes. Actually, the Elves enchanted the forest itself to provide the first line of defense with tangling vines and stinging thorns."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. III*

USG:Fertile Ground.f: The forest was too lush for the brothers to despoil—almost.

LEG:Mountain Yeti.f: The Yeti's single greatest asset is its unnerving ability to blend in with its surroundings.

TMP:Tradewind Rider.f: It is said that the wind will blow the world past if you wait long enough.

MRD:Necrogen Spellbomb.f:
"Forget that which was never known."
—Spellbomb inscription

MIR:Phyrexian Vault.f:
"The secrets of Phyrexia are expensive. You will pay in brass and bone, steel and sinew."
—Kaervek

MMQ:Nightwind Glider.f: Once you learn to float on the shadows, you'll never fear them again.

HML:Feast of the Unicorn.f:
"Some delicacies are not to be savored, save by the callous."
—Baron Sengir

UDS:Capashen Templar.f: Their shields are Benalia's outermost battlements.

MIR:Kaervek's Hex.f:
"If the curse does not strike you dead, question your soul."
—Kaervek

SCG:Final Punishment.f: The pain of a lifetime—every scrape, illness, and bruise—condensed into a single moment.

ATQ:Shatterstorm.f: Chains of leaping fire and sizzling lightning laid waste the artificers' handiwork, sparing not a single device.

JUD:Dwarven Scorcher.f: Barbarians invented the blaze of glory. Dwarves perfected it.

EXO:Theft of Dreams.f:
"Volrath stole everything there was of me."
—Takara

5DN:Auriok Salvagers.f: "Memnarch or the vedalken salvage most of the large machines, leaving us only scraps. Scraps are enough."

WTH:Fit of Rage.f:
"Anger is fleeting; remorse is eternal."
—Karn, silver golem

CHK:Hisoka's Defiance.f: "With every passing day, the kami shape our world to suit their will. I, for one, would not see them succeed."

VIS:Vampiric Tutor.f:
"I write upon clean white parchment with a sharp quill and the blood of my students, divining their secrets."
—Shauku, Endbringer

MIR:Kaervek's Torch.f:
The pulsing heat of the midday Sun burns in the Lion's eye.
—Stone inscription, source unknown

POR:Anaconda.f: Something soft bumped against the rowboat, then was gone.

DST:Geth's Grimoire.f: The book shrieks horribly until its cover is opened, granting the spirit inside a moment's rest from the painful stirrings of the book's contents.

MIR:Ether Well.f: "Whoa—my tail will *never* fit through that hole!"

ODY:Rotting Giant.f: Wracked with rot, it wrecks and ruins.

PCY:Rhystic Deluge.f:
"I'll rain down on you with the power of magic itself. Then we'll see who prevails."
—Alexi, zephyr mage

ICE:Bone Shaman.f:
Rattle me bones as I cross the floor
And the bones in your grave will rattle no more.

JUD:Serene Sunset.f: The armies paused, silent, as the warriors reflected on the sunsets of their youth.

EXO:Furnace Brood.f: Furnace air crackles with magmatic cackles.

PLS:Lord of the Undead.f:
"I confer with Death itself. What could you possibly do to injure me?"
—Lord Dralnu

P02:Sylvan Yeti.f: The deeper the wood, the greater its strength.

MIR:Reparations.f: "Sorry I burned down your village. Here's some gold."

ALL:Awesome Presence.f:
"I shape my weapons from the fears of my enemies."
—Chaeska, Keeper of Tresserhorn

ONS:Airborne Aid.f:
"We help our Southern Order comrades as much as we can. But the Cabal's insidious influence spreads, dividing our forces and leaving new arrivals to fend for themselves."
—Commander Eesha

ULG:Tethered Skirge.f: It bites the hand that leads it.

TMP:Overrun.f:
"You want to know your enemy? Look at your feet while you trample him."
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

PCY:Pygmy Razorback.f: As a rite of passage, Kipamu youths taunt razorbacks with long sticks . . . then flee.

MRD:Lifespark Spellbomb.f:
"Awaken that which was never asleep."
—Spellbomb inscription

PTK:Volunteer Militia.f: After making the Peach Garden Oath, the three brothers raised an army of 500 youths to fight the Yellow Scarves rebellion.

EXO:Onslaught.f: The last thing to go through the mogg's mind was its teeth.

ODY:Krosan Avenger.f: She'd have a fearsome reputation if she left any survivors.

MMQ:Liability.f: Gerrard realized that the helpless woman they'd rescued from Rath was nothing of the sort.

ULG:Ring of Gix.f: Not every cage is made of bars.

ONS:Syphon Mind.f: When tempers run high, it's easy to lose your head.

MMQ:Wave of Reckoning.f: Inner conflict can defeat a soldier more quickly than any army.

TMP:Eladamri, Lord of Leaves.f:
"We have been patient. We have planned our attack. We are ready . . . *now*."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

VIS:Wand of Denial.f: You'll never miss what you never had.

USG:Serra Zealot.f:
"The humans are useful in their way, but they must be commanded as the builder commands the stone. Be soft with them, and they will become soft."
—Radiant, archangel

PCY:Mana Vapors.f: The scent of magic can rob you of your senses, blinding you to the world.

BOK:Ire of Kaminari.f:
"Thunder broke the brittle silence over the Araba. A surge of raw energy lifted the soldier's body into the air and briefly, in the heart of the flash, he saw the face of a god."
—*Great Battles of Kamigawa*

ICE:Adarkar Unicorn.f:
"There is no nobler creature in all of Terisiare."
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox

TMP:Rolling Thunder.f: "Such rage," thought Vhati, gazing up at the thunderhead from the *Predator*. "It is Greven's mind manifest."

STH:Wall of Razors.f:
"In this blessed structure let the very walls baptize themselves in the blood of intruders."
—Stronghold architect, journal

MMQ:Kyren Glider.f: Mercadia's Kyren goblins are the opposite of Dominarian goblins: they're smart and cowardly.

WTH:Striped Bears.f:
"The bear is never cautious—which is why it wasn't born a human."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

UDS:Wake of Destruction.f:
Land charred black, rivers boiled,
Crops and wells alike despoiled, Mountains leveled, forests felled—
Footprints of the beasts of Keld.

ICE:Folk of the Pines.f:
"Our friends of the forest take many forms, yet all serve the will of Freyalise."
—Laina of the Elvish Council

ONS:Graxiplon.f:
"Attempts to revive this ancient species have not been entirely successful, but results indicate potential for future development."
—Riptide Project researcher

FEM:Basal Thrull.f:
Initially bred for sacrifice, the Thrulls eventually turned on their masters, the Order of the Ebon Hand, with gruesome results.
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. II*

NEM:Chieftain en-Dal.f: The clearest commands are practical examples.

MMQ:Kyren Negotiations.f: Kyren goblins always speak in questions and never allow wrong answers.

CHK:Nezumi Ronin.f:
"Some nezumi became as skilled in the samurai arts as the humans and kitsune. Yet no lord would have them, so they sold their swords to the highest bidder."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

PTK:Council of Advisors.f: Sun Quan's long and successful rule in the years 199 to 251 was due to his ability to choose and foster talented advisors and generals.

HML:Cemetery Gate.f:
"It keeps some out, yes. It also keeps others in!"
—Grandmother Sengir

TMP:Verdigris.f:
"Only the most sophisticated inventions can survive nature's unsophisticated motivations."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

USG:Arc Lightning.f: Rainclouds don't last long in Shiv, but that doesn't stop the lightning.

WTH:Bubble Matrix.f:
"This device was commisioned by a king who desired peace. Unfortunately, the royal artificer was also the king's jester."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

5DN:Iron-Barb Hellion.f: When you feel a rumble in the ground, hold perfectly still. One sound will bring the hellion.

MIR:Breathstealer.f:
"As a child, I slept with a cloth over my face, to hide from the spirits that might pull the air from my lungs."
—Mosi, Femeref weaver

2ED:Juggernaut.f: We had taken refuge in a small cave, thinking the entrance was too narrow for it to follow. To our horror, its gigantic head smashed into the mountainside, ripping itself a new entrance.

NEM:Shrieking Mogg.f: You have to admire its enthusiasm.

BOK:Takeno's Cavalry.f: At night he perfected his aim, shooting spiderwebs by starlight.

INV:Plague Spores.f:
"Breathe deep, Dominaria. Breathe deep and die."
—Tsabo Tavoc, Phyrexian general

WTH:Foriysian Brigade.f:
"A double-edged sword lets you cut down your enemies with the backswing as well."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

HML:Sengir Autocrat.f:
"A thankless job, and a death sentence besides."
—Eron the Relentless

MIR:Healing Salve.f:
"The Femeref look only to the Sun for healing; they have never truly understood life's cycle."
—Kifimbo, Shadow Guildmage

2ED:Timber Wolves.f: Though many think of Wolves as solitary predators, they are actually extremely social animals. During a hunt they often call to each other, which can be quite unsettling for their prey.

2ED:Mons's Goblin Raiders.f: The intricate dynamics of Rundvelt Goblin affairs are often confused with anarchy. The chaos, however, is the chaos of a thundercloud, and direction will sporadically and violently appear. Pashalik Mons and his raiders are the thunderhead that leads in the storm.

MMQ:Cornered Market.f:
Don't step on the livelihood of other vendors, or they may step on you.
—Mercadian saying

ULG:Phyrexian Defiler.f:
"The third stage of the illness: muscle aches and persistent cough."
—Phyrexian progress notes

DST:Stand Together.f: Strange times make for strange allies.

INV:Mana Maze.f:
"Those who know only one path to victory can never hope to triumph."
—The Blind Seer

ULG:Multani, Maro-Sorcerer.f:
"To make peace with the forest, make peace with me."
—Multani, to Urza

MRD:Myr Adapter.f:
"The simplest way to plan ahead is merely to be ready for everything."
—Pontifex, elder researcher

SOK:Skull Collector.f: "Your blood I'll use. Your skull I'll keep."

HML:Joven.f:
"Joven, you're almost as good a thief as I. But Eron hates you even more."
—Chandler

PLS:Heroic Defiance.f:
"Wear courage as your armor. Wield honor as your blade."
—Gerrard

JUD:Epic Struggle.f:
"If our foes will not listen to words, perhaps hooves and claws will make them take notice."
—Seton, centaur druid

ODY:Frenetic Ogre.f: The best thing about ogres is that they never try to sneak up on you.

APC:Whirlpool Rider.f: Where the wind meets the water, change is inevitable.

P02:Raiding Nightstalker.f:
"Our steeds need food, water, stabling. Theirs just need prey."
—Restela, Alaborn marshal

PTK:Ambition's Cost.f:
"When you give offense to heaven, to whom can you pray?"
—Cao Cao, quoting Confucius

2ED:Ironclaw Orcs.f: Generations of genetic weeding have given rise to the deviously cowardly Ironclaw clan. To say that Orcs in general are vicious, depraved, and ignoble does not do justice to the Ironclaw.

MMQ:Saprazzan Heir.f: Within the walls of the floating city, Saprazzan wealth is like Saprazzan water: abundant, free-flowing, and accessible to all.

5DN:Loxodon Stalwart.f: Long ago, the Auriok attempted peace with the loxodons. The leonin attempted war. Neither succeeded.

SCG:Divergent Growth.f: Nature has forgotten its own rules.

HML:Willow Faerie.f:
"Swift as the wind and harder to catch—that's the Faeries for you."
—Daria

APC:Death Grasp.f: Yawgmoth's greatest joy came from watching one hero defeat another.

VIS:Death Watch.f:
"Watch death wait / Wait, death, watch / Steal breath swiftly / but steal life slowly."
—Suq'Ata dirge

MMQ:Midnight Ritual.f: Bury old friends deeply, lest they return bearing worms.

MMQ:Ramosian Captain.f: The Cho-Arrim believe in leading by example.

ONS:Gustcloak Savior.f:
"Our death-arrows flew in high arcs towards the aven. And then . . . nothing."
—Coliseum guard

LEG:Barktooth Warbeard.f: He is devious and cunning, in both appearance and deed. Beware the Warbeard, for this brute bites as well as he barks!

ONS:Words of Worship.f:
"The faithful don't succumb to terror, nor are they ruled by passion. They adhere to order, for order is life."
—*Volume I, The Book of Faith*

MRD:Tower of Eons.f: Its etchings tell the ur-golems' stories of an entity able to force life into a lifeless plane.

STH:Heartstone.f:
"Finding a true heartstone is even harder than finding a true heart."
—Hanna

ONS:Kamahl's Summons.f: As Krosa unleashed the peace in Kamahl, he unleashed the fury in Krosa.

USG:Gamble.f: When you've got nothing, you might as well trade it for something else.

ONS:Prowling Pangolin.f: It's always hungry, yet easily sated.

SCG:Consumptive Goo.f: Silent as fog and relentless as plague, it is wet, creeping death.

MRD:Moriok Scavenger.f: Many go to Mephidross in search of lost riches. Most end up as part of the cache.

USG:Intrepid Hero.f: "We each have our own strengths, Radiant," Serra said with a sly smile. "If all of my people were like this one, who would carry your scrolls?"

USG:Unworthy Dead.f:
"Great Yawgmoth moves across the seas of shard and bone and rust. We exalt him in life, in death, and in between."
—*Phyrexian Scriptures*

PTK:Lady Sun.f: Sister to Sun Quan and wife to Liu Bei, Lady Sun often felt her loyalty to both tested.

P02:Barbtooth Wurm.f: In its lair lies a carpet of bones.

SCG:Faces of the Past.f: The ties that bind can also strangle.

ICE:Lost Order of Jarkeld.f:
"Let us remember brave Jarkeld and his troops, who perished in the Adarkar Wastes so long ago."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran Priest

DRK:Tormod's Crypt.f: The dark opening seemed to breathe the cold, damp air of the dead earth in a steady rhythm.

2ED:Elvish Archers.f: I tell you, there was so many arrows flying about you couldn't hardly see the sun. So I says to young Angus, "Well, at least now we're fighting in the shade!"

DST:Myr Landshaper.f: One thing the myr can't do is enjoy the scenery.

EXO:Merfolk Looter.f: In the depths of Rootwater, salvage and sewage differ only in texture.

PCY:Vitalizing Wind.f:
"The fifth wind of ascension is Exalter, fulfilling Keld's destiny."
—*Keld Triumphant*

MIR:Shadowbane.f: Light creates shadow; light destroys shadow. Such is the transience of darkness.

EXO:Convalescence.f: Selenia had hurt Mirri terribly, but injuries of the flesh could be treated. The wounds she had torn in Crovax's soul would never close.

ALL:Kjeldoran Escort.f:
"We willingly trade with Kjeldor, but the peace we build must come from both our lands."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

ATQ:Rakalite.f: Urza was the first to understand that the war would not be lost for lack of power, but for lack of troops.

MIR:Stupor.f:
There are medicines for all afflictions but idleness.
—Suq'Ata saying

MRD:Thirst for Knowledge.f: Lymph, the fluid essence of blinkmoths, is prized by wizards for the rush of intellect it provides.

MRD:Blinkmoth Urn.f: The vedalken embed such urns in their living artifact creations.

MIR:Blind Fury.f:
"Tell me . . . have you ever sung the Song of Blood?"
—Purraj of Urborg

5DN:Clock of Omens.f: Those near the clock don't hear it anymore, but their every movement is in time with its ticking.

ICE:Deflection.f:
Up and down,
over and through,
back around—
the joke's on you.

CHK:Rend Spirit.f:
"The battle at Ganzan Pass was a testament to human endurance. The untrained and frightened group escaped three legions of kami, leaving more than their share of slain foes in their wake."
—*Great Battles of Kamigawa*

ODY:Crystal Quarry.f:
"How tragic that greed eclipses beauty."
—Seton, centaur druid

LGN:Ridgetop Raptor.f:
"The Skirk Ridge has many wonderful things to discover—like escape routes."
—Foothill guide

VIS:Uktabi Orangutan.f:
"Is it true that the apes wear furs of gold when they marry?"
—Rana, Suq'Ata market fool

ONS:Crowd Favorites.f:
"The rabble likes them. Make sure they win, then book them for tomorrow."
—Cabal Patriarch

INV:Whip Silk.f: Llanowar forges weapons of steel. Yavimaya grows her weapons within.

SOK:Akki Underling.f:
"I lost my hounds in the war and thus found myself employing akki as servants. I found their training to be remarkably similar."
—Kensuke, houndmaster

PLS:Shifting Sky.f:
Master the sky and you rule everything beneath it.
—Metathran saying

DST:Nim Abomination.f: It is one of the oldest nim, steeped so long in the Dross that it has lost all vestiges of humanity.

ATQ:Millstone.f: More than one mage was driven insane by the sound of the Millstone relentlessly grinding away.

INV:Cremate.f: Death's embrace need not be cold.

BOK:Reduce to Dreams.f:
"This world is a dream. We cling to our toys like children, but sooner or later we must learn to live without them."
—Sensei Hisoka

DRK:Marsh Viper.f: "All we had left were their black and bloated bodies." —Maeveen O'Donagh, *Memoirs of a Soldier*

ONS:Wirewood Elf.f: "The land belongs to nature as far as our eyes can see. The higher we climb, the more we can see."

ODY:Patron Wizard.f: "The best way to teach is by example."

TMP:Screeching Harpy.f:
"They are called 'fowl' for a reason."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

PCY:Noxious Field.f: Ultimately, it became a three-way battle: the land attacked both armies.

MMQ:Scandalmonger.f: Silence costs extra. Breaking it costs extra still.

VIS:Dark Privilege.f:
"As you breathe your last, understand why I accept such forbidden gifts."
—Purraj of Urborg

LEG:Greed.f: "There is no calamity greater than lavish desires./ There is no greater guilt than discontentment./ And there is no greater disaster than greed." —*Tao Tê Ching 46*

MIR:Wave Elemental.f:
"Consider the wave: how weak the mother yet how strong the child."
—Tywanna, Shaper Guildmage

ULG:Shivan Phoenix.f: To strike down the phoenix is to slash at the flame.

DST:Wand of the Elements.f: It gives legs to the earth and wings to the sky.

ARN:Moorish Cavalry.f: Members of the elite Moorish Cavalry are very particular about their mounts, choosing only those whose bloodlines have been pure for generations.

PCY:Keldon Arsonist.f:
"Fields can be replanted. Settlements can be rebuilt. Burn it all."
—Latulla, Keldon overseer

STH:Spined Wurm.f:
"As it moved, the wurm's spines gathered up bits of flowstone, which took the shapes of dead villagers' heads. Each head spoke a single sound, but if taken together, they said, 'Alas for the living.'"
—Dal myth of the wurm

PTK:Young Wei Recruits.f:
"To send the common people to war untrained is to throw them away."
—Confucius, *The Analects* (trans. Lau)

JUD:Chastise.f:
"Why do we pray to the Ancestor? Because She listens."
—Mystic elder

WTH:Shattered Crypt.f:
"You must be mad to want one such as I aboard the *Weatherlight*. But I would be mad to remain here with my rotting family. I accept."
—Crovax

INV:Restock.f:
"We hid such stockpiles all over Rath. We should continue that practice here."
—Lin Sivvi

PTK:Shu Elite Companions.f: Throughout the three kingdoms, important generals were often guarded by small groups of expert soldiers known as "elite companions."

5DN:Nim Grotesque.f: In the swirling mists, you could walk right up to one and not know until its teeth are in your throat.

INV:Galina's Knight.f: "Are they on our side?" asked Sisay. "If they kill Phyrexians they are," replied Gerrard.

TOR:Arrogant Wurm.f: It's hard to be humble when the whole world is bite size.

CHK:Lure.f: Jukai Forest was known for its secrets, which drew in many wayfarers and wizards. But it was those same secrets that kept most of those seekers from ever being heard from again.

TMP:Giant Crab.f: During the giant crabs' mating season, Skyshroud nights are filled with the clatter of their skirmishes.

PTK:Ravages of War.f:
"Thorn bushes spring up wherever the army has passed. Lean years follow in the wake of a great war."
—Lao Tzu, *Tao Te Ching* (trans. Feng and English)

SOK:Plow Through Reito.f: The paths of the kami crisscrossed Kamigawa like scars left by a maddened surgeon.

PCY:Plague Fiend.f: As the strange plague ravaged Jamuraa, the fiends multiplied.

TMP:Lightning Elemental.f: A lightning elemental once killed an entire tribe of merfolk—simply by going for a swim.

MMQ:Ancestral Mask.f: The masks, like the ancient trees they're grown from, lend strength to the dryads.

MIR:Mire Shade.f:
"We realized the bog had not given up a soul but had come to claim a new one."
—Scout Ekemet, final journal

CHK:Kodama of the South Tree.f:
"The monks of the South Tree had always reveled beneath their kodama's friendly gaze. During the Kami War, this gaze became fierce and full of hate."
—"Poem of the Five Trees"

UDS:Goblin Masons.f: "Goblins build with true zeal—and anything else within arm's reach."

SOK:Promise of Bunrei.f: "I am not afraid to die today nor afraid of what death will bring."

WTH:Abeyance.f:
"I'm too modest a wizard to reveal the full extent of my abilities."
—Ertai, wizard adept

MIR:Thirst.f: The first of the Thousand Deaths.

POR:Merfolk of the Pearl Trident.f: Are merfolk humans with fins, or are humans merfolk with feet?

EXO:Dauthi Cutthroat.f: In their twisted logic, to empty the shadow world is to escape it.

ATQ:Damping Field.f: Eventually, mages learned to harness the power of natural damping fields and use it for their own ends.

ODY:Still Life.f: The centaurs' simple magic can undo a basilisk's gaze, but only for a short time.

USG:Greater Good.f:
"We have more sprouts than they have hands."
—Gamelen, Citanul elder

5DN:Relic Barrier.f: Its transmissions are the word of Memnarch. It speaks, and metal bows.

ALL:Balduvian War-Makers.f:
"Those mewling Barbarians will cower before my righteous steel!"
—General Varchild

APC:Spectral Lynx.f: A shadowy version of its corporeal cousin, this lynx hunts souls, not meals.

PLS:Planar Overlay.f: The Phyrexians don't want to conquer Dominaria. They want to remake it.

5DN:Dawn's Reflection.f: Only Sylvok magic could truly capture the perfection of a Mirrodin sunrise.

ULG:Ghitu Fire-Eater.f:
"They are called 'Mi'uto,' which means 'one use.'"
—Jhoira, artificer

DST:Grimclaw Bats.f: Even on a world of metal, there are those who thirst for blood.

MIR:Subterranean Spirit.f:
"Air hot with sulfur. / Earth heaves beneath me. / Could it be the mountain / ate something bad?"
—Dwarven mining song

NEM:Fog Patch.f: Realizing they weren't getting past the fog, the elves did the only thing they could do: wait.

LGN:Essence Sliver.f: The slivers would survive, even at the expense of every other creature on Otaria.

DST:Oxidize.f:
"Ashes to ashes, rust to rust."
—Viridian shaman

INV:Heroes' Reunion.f:
"You helped save my people from a Phyrexian fate. Did you think I wouldn't return the favor?"
—Eladamri, to Gerrard

ATQ:Mishra's Workshop.f: Though he eventually came to despise Tocasia, Mishra listened well to her lessons on clarity of purpose. Unlike his brother, he focused his mind on a single goal.

EXO:Standing Troops.f: The less you have, the harder you fight for it.

TMP:Thalakos Seer.f:
"You see our world when you shut your eyes so tightly that tiny shapes float before them."
—Lyna, to Ertai

FEM:Order of Leitbur.f:
"Trained to battle the followers of Tourach, the Order of Leitbur was not as successful in later conflicts with Orcish and Goblin raiders."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. I*

DST:Last Word.f: "Someday, someone will best me. But it won't be today, and it won't be you."

LGN:Flamewave Invoker.f: The Mirari burns in his heart.

5DN:Rain of Rust.f: On Mirrodin, mages who call upon the power of rust are shunned by their people and often turn mercenary to survive.

INV:Benalish Heralds.f: The detailed dispatch could be summarized in four words: "Time is running out."

ALL:Fevered Strength.f:
"The burst of strength brought on by this plague should not be mistaken for a sign of renewed health."
—Kolbjörn, High Honored Druid

ICE:Essence Flare.f: Never underestimate the power of the soul unleashed.

PLS:Quirion Explorer.f:
Fight with a friend at your back, steel in your hands, and magic in your veins.
—Quirion creed

MMQ:Sailmonger.f: Clients who cheat the sailmonger make an impact on the rest.

MRD:Mass Hysteria.f: The sooner you see the whites of their eyes, the sooner you'll spill the red of their blood.

ALL:School of the Unseen.f: After the terrible retribution visited upon Lat-Nam, this school of mages chose to hide from the eyes of the world.

ULG:Viashino Heretic.f: "The past is buried for good reason."

ONS:Death Match.f: The Cabal breeds many things for the pit fights, but it never breeds compassion.

APC:Bloodfire Kavu.f: Heart of fire, blood of lava, teeth of stone.

STH:Dream Prowler.f:
"To think that some find sleep a restful state."
—Volrath

USG:Steam Blast.f: The viashino knew of the cracked pipes but deliberately left them unmended to bolster the rig's defenses.

MMQ:Mercadia's Downfall.f: With an explosion that shook the foundation of the city, the *Weatherlight* burst from the underground hangar.

MMQ:Overtaker.f: "It's no challenge to master a Mercadian."

USG:Serra's Embrace.f:
"Lifted beyond herself, for that battle Brindri was an angel of light and fury."
—*Song of All*, canto 524

JUD:Silver Seraph.f: A symbol of hope for hopeless times.

ALL:Benthic Explorers.f: The rising oceans brought new lakes—and new terrors—to Terisiare. The Explorers found their ancient enemies spawning everywhere.

POR:Fruition.f: Come to these woods and suffer no pain; you've burdens to lose and new life to gain.

MRD:Spikeshot Goblin.f: The path of a goblin shaman is a journey through a thousand ways of hurting people.

MIR:Fallow Earth.f:
". . . and when the farmer awoke the next morning, all the seeds from his field were once again in their sacks."
—Afari, *Tales*

PCY:Mirror Strike.f:
"Enemies can be your weapons or your shields. Simply show them which they are."
—*The Teachings of Zho*

ULG:Scrapheap.f: Junk heaps have rats, but scrapheaps have goblins.

ICE:Icequake.f:
"When the earth shakes, and their animals are swallowed up by the ground, perhaps they will think twice before attacking again."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

MRD:Slith Predator.f: Born amid the molten metal of the Great Furnace, the slith have more than adapted to the perils of a metal world.

ODY:Soulcatcher.f:
"Holy couriers guide aven spirits up to the home of the Ancestor."
—Mystic elder

STH:Smite.f:
"You've got your childhood wish at last. Now you get to die."
—Gerrard, to Volrath

ICE:Blinking Spirit.f:
"Don't look at it! Maybe it'll go away!"
—Ib Halfheart, Goblin Tactician

ATQ:Artifact Blast.f: The first line of defense against Urza and Mishra, the Artifact Blast achieved widespread fame until an unlucky mage discovered it was useless on the devices the brothers had already created.

ONS:Kamahl, Fist of Krosa.f: "My mind has changed. My strength has not."

ICE:Zuran Spellcaster.f:
"A mage must be precise as well as potent; cautious, as well as clever."
—Zur the Enchanter

VIS:Time and Tide.f:
"Time may heal all wounds, but what heals time?"
—Teferi

PLS:Radiant Kavu.f: When angered or frightened, it protects itself with a burst of blinding light.

FEM:Thorn Thallid.f:
"I don't know which is worse, getting hit with those darts or having to watch them grow back."
—Orcish Soldier

VIS:Pillar Tombs of Aku.f:
"Aku, City of Hidden Graves / Aku, City of Lost Kings / Aku, welcome me."
—Pillar tomb inscription

INV:Firescreamer.f: In the dark, it's nearly invisible—until it exhales.

MIR:Alarum.f:
"One timely cry of warning can save nine of surprise."
—Sidar Jabari

PTK:Sage's Knowledge.f:
"Those who know do not talk. Those who talk do not know."
—Lao Tzu, *Tao Te Ching*
(trans. Feng and English)

INV:Frenzied Tilling.f:
"Beneath her scars, Dominaria's beauty yet shines."
—Multani, maro-sorcerer

HML:Abbey Matron.f:
"The Matrons are kindly souls, but don't ask one for an ale."
—Halina, Dwarven Trader

ONS:Sparksmith.f: "If it didn't hurt, how would I know it worked?"

USG:Viashino Runner.f:
"It moved this way, an' that way, an' then before I could stick it, it jumped over my head an' was gone."
—Jula, goblin raider

ARN:Wyluli Wolf.f: "When one wolf calls, others follow. Who wants to fight creatures that eat scorpions?" —Maimun al-Wyluli, *Diary*

CHK:Azami, Lady of Scrolls.f:
"Choices belong to those with the luxuries of time and distance. We have neither. I recommend we proceed with the plan to destroy all shrines of the kami."
—Lady Azami, letter to Sensei Hisoka

PCY:Denying Wind.f:
"The third wind of ascension is Eliminator, clearing Keld's path to victory."
—*Keld Triumphant*

FEM:Icatian Skirmishers.f: Skirmishers engaged raiders before they could reach the towns. Although these units typically suffered huge losses, they never lacked volunteers.

DST:Crazed Goblin.f: Because fighting is easier than figuring out what else to do.

STH:Mogg Bombers.f: Behind every great mogg bomber is another mogg with a shovel and a basket.

TMP:Tranquility.f:
"Peace will come, but whether born of harmony or entropy I cannot say."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

LGN:Glintwing Invoker.f: The Mirari flares in his mind.

EXO:Fugue.f: "My ship . . . ," Sisay mumbled. "Intact," Gerrard reassured her, "which is more than I can say for you, my friend." Sisay laughed despite the pain.

MIR:Mtenda Griffin.f:
"Unlike Zhalfir, the griffin needs no council to keep harmony among its parts."
—Asmira, Holy Avenger

MIR:Karoo Meerkat.f:
"Be like the meerkat, my daughters: ever vigilant, true to your own, and wary of strangers."
—Nabil Alamat, Suq'Ata merchant

PCY:Hollow Warrior.f: Though it moves like a living thing, anyone can tell it lacks a soul—not to mention mercy.

EXO:Mirozel.f: The mirozels are the only stars in Rath's opaque skies.

ODY:Cease-Fire.f: When the crimson fades from the magical embers, a final wisp of smoke will rise. Soon after, hostilities will begin anew.

PCY:Soul Charmer.f: She seeks the warmth of the living.

MMQ:Ramosian Sky Marshal.f: The Cho-Arrim fell from the sky onto Mercadia City like a vengeful rain.

UDS:Capashen Standard.f: Benalia has no need for peacocks to serve as symbols of vanity. The Capashens strut more proudly than any bird.

CHK:Nezumi Cutthroat.f:
"These nezumi, they disgust me. The things they will do for money no other thinking creature would consider. This, of course, makes them useful beyond words."
—Meloku the Clouded Mirror

ODY:Stalking Bloodsucker.f: The pits feed both its thirst for combat and its thirst for blood.

UDS:Rapid Decay.f: The grave robbers arrived the day after the burial. They were a day too late.

ULG:Eviscerator.f: It roamed the time bubble like a captured animal. Kerrick knew he must soon find a way to unleash it on Tolaria or destroy it.

ODY:Pardic Firecat.f:
"I've heard of putting the cat out, but this isn't what I had in mind."
—Nomad sentry

STH:Warrior en-Kor.f: Only a matter as vital as destroying Volrath could bring together the reclusive Kor people.

JUD:Nantuko Tracer.f:
Your past is a map to where you will go.
—Nantuko teaching

HML:Castle Sengir.f: Where hope has no champion, evil rules all.

POR:Charging Bandits.f: The fear in their victims' eyes is their most cherished reward.

ALL:Shield Sphere.f:
"My Soldiers know that they need never fear for their protection."
—King Darien of Kjeldor

WTH:Abyssal Gatekeeper.f:
"There are two ways for me to pass this gate. One involves you remaining conscious."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

ODY:Face of Fear.f:
"It's only frightened five people to death. Not my best work."
—Braids, dementia summoner

STH:Tortured Existence.f:
"There are terrors lurking in the unseen corners of us all."
—Crovax

MMQ:Skulking Fugitive.f: In the Cateran guild, being caught is a capital offense.

MIR:Spatial Binding.f:
Time is the one shackle you can't break.
—Zhalfirin aphorism

PLS:Meddling Mage.f: Meddling mages chant so loudly that no one can get a spell in edgewise.

MMQ:Coastal Piracy.f: "I don't like to think of myself as a pirate. I'm more like a stimulator of the local economy."

TMP:Goblin Bombardment.f: One mogg to aim the catapult, one mogg to steer the rock.

ALL:Reprisal.f:
"The meek shall fight as one, and they shall overcome even the greatest of foes."
—Halvor Arensson, Kjeldoran Priest

MMQ:Task Force.f: They are the reflection of Rushwood's glow on the edge of a wooden sword.

PCY:Brutal Suppression.f:
"They no longer care about their own suffering. Show them something worse."
—Latulla, Keldon overseer

MMQ:Flaming Sword.f:
"It's not Talruum crystal, but I must admit—it gets the job done."
—Tahngarth

P02:Wind Sail.f: It pays to be at home both on the sea *and* in the sky.

EXO:Sphere of Resistance.f: A sphere pushes equally in all directions.

APC:Putrid Warrior.f: "I do not like it," said Grizzlegom, "but I will take every soldier I can get."

ODY:Squirrel Mob.f: An army of squirrels is still an army.

MRD:Necrogen Mists.f: Mephidross filled with roars of fury and wails of despair as the leonin fought to keep their memories from being pulled into the mists.

PTK:Return to Battle.f: "Swallowing his eye, the valiant Xiahou Dun fought on; / But Cao Cao's vanguard, its commander wounded, could not hold out for long."

DRK:Exorcist.f: Though they often bore little greater charm than the demons they battled, exorcists were always welcome in Scarwood.

MMQ:Ogre Taskmaster.f: He doesn't have to be smart—his masters only ever give him one command.

LEG:Winds of Change.f: "'Tis the set of sails, and not the gales,/ Which tells us the way to go." —Ella Wheeler Wilcox

INV:Yavimaya Kavu.f: Kavu hunt prey in packs—one kavu hunts a pack of prey.

MMQ:Snuff Out.f: Squee watched his Kyren cousins fall with a mixture of sympathy and relief.

FEM:Armor Thrull.f:
"Except for a bare spot at the base of their skulls, Armor Thrulls bear interlocking plates and spikes with the strength of steel. Their design is almost artistic."
—Endrek Sahr, "Thrulls"

LEG:Cosmic Horror.f: "Then flashed the living lightning from her eyes,/ And screams of horror rend th' affrighted skies." —Alexander Pope, *The Rape of the Lock*

TMP:Segmented Wurm.f:
"If only we could so easily leave behind those parts of ourselves that pain us."
—Crovax

CHK:Rag Dealer.f:
"After General Takeno found the Oathkeeper amidst the bamboo marshes, more scavengers braved the swamp's nezumi, oni, and kami in hopes of glory."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

SCG:Daru Spiritualist.f: He lifts the spirits of his people so they may descend in wrath upon their foes.

STH:Conviction.f: It was not the minotaur's shoulders but his soul that bore the heaviest weight.

ULG:Frantic Search.f: Motivation was high in the academy once students realized flunking their exams could kill them.

PLS:Terminate.f: Like his mother before him, Darigaaz gave his life defending Dominaria from the tyranny of self-styled "gods."

ULG:Wing Snare.f:
"Argoth's doom rained from a clear sky. Yavimaya will not share that fate."
—Multani, maro-sorcerer

DST:Spire Golem.f: The longer it soars above the shimmering swirls of the Quicksilver Sea, the more it adopts their unpredictability.

2ED:Serra Angel.f: Born with wings of light and a sword of faith, this heavenly incarnation embodies both fury and purity.

NEM:Lightbringer.f:
One thought opens a thousand eyes. One sun brings a thousand dawns.
—Lightbringer creed

POR:Vampiric Feast.f: It's not always gold the thief is after.

MIR:Torrent of Lava.f: The mountain's voice shouts us all down.

2ED:Goblin King.f: To become king of the Goblins, one must assassinate the previous king. Thus, only the most foolish seek positions of leadership.

POR:Touch of Brilliance.f: Acting on one good idea is better than hoarding all the world's knowledge.

TMP:Barbed Sliver.f: Spans of spines leapt from one sliver to the next, forming a deadly hedge around the *Weatherlight*.

5DN:Reversal of Fortune.f: "Why learn hundreds of spells when you can learn only one and use it to steal hundreds?"

5DN:Gemstone Array.f: Outside, it reflects the suns' light. Inside, it harvests the suns' power.

HML:Soraya the Falconer.f:
"Soraya speaks with the hunters of the air, as do all of her family line."
—Autumn Willow

DST:Scrounge.f: When leonin settlers abandon their homes to the nim, items of value are often left behind.

2ED:Fungusaur.f: Rather than sheltering her young, the female Fungusaur often injures her own offspring, thereby ensuring their rapid growth.

LGN:Keeneye Aven.f: "I have no need of a map. The very continent itself guides my way."

SOK:Twincast.f: Sometimes you have to search for inspiration, and sometimes it's right there in front of you.

PCY:Excavation.f:
"There are secrets out there begging to be rediscovered. We just need to look in the right places."
—Teferi, planeswalker

PTK:Zodiac Ox.f: ". . . Cao's abdication changed the face of all; / No mighty battles marked the Southland's fall. . . ."

BOK:Frost Ogre.f: Mountain ogres allowed blizzards to sheathe them in ice, both to reinforce their armor and to hide their pungent musk from potential prey.

ODY:Epicenter.f: Sometimes destruction is Dominaria's way of rebuilding. Sometimes it's not.

INV:Strength of Unity.f: All Dominarians agreed on one thing: they would not go down without a fight.

USG:Imaginary Pet.f: "It followed me home. Can I keep it?"

ATQ:Reconstruction.f: Tedious research made the Sages of the College of Lat-Nam adept in repairing broken artifacts.

USG:Voltaic Key.f: The key did not work on a single lock, yet it opened many doors.

DRK:Coal Golem.f: "Three such creatures stood burning at the crest of the hill. Only seconds later, the Fireball struck our front line." —Lydia, Countess Brellis

USG:Darkest Hour.f:
"Yawgmoth spent eons wrapping Phyrexians in human skin. They are the sleeper agents, and they are everywhere."
—Xantcha, to Urza

ODY:Cephalid Looter.f: "Amazing, isn't it, what humans will throw away when they're drowning?"

DST:Pteron Ghost.f: Defending to the death isn't always enough.

INV:Trench Wurm.f:
"Their arrival marks the end of Yawgmoth's subtlety."
—Urza

WTH:Fledgling Djinn.f:
"The young can be quite dangerous. Trust me, I should know."
—Ertai, wizard adept

SOK:Ideas Unbound.f: The apprentice stared in puzzlement. "But Master, you finished writing those spells just yesterday. Don't you remember?" The jushi's heart froze.

ONS:Mana Echoes.f: When the ground is saturated with mana, even the lightest footstep can bring it to the surface.

STH:Mogg Flunkies.f: They'll attack whatever's in front of them—as long as you tell them where that is.

CHK:Painwracker Oni.f:
"Blood flows. Blood calls. Blood devours all and only blood remains."
—Ogre chant

MIR:Dark Ritual.f:
"The ceremony ended with a voice from the shadows, a voice with vast, ominous power."
—Kifimbo, Shadow Guildmage

WTH:Rogue Elephant.f:
"When are trees like grass?"
—*The One Thousand Questions*

ONS:Ixidor's Will.f: "Some dreams should not come to be."

ICE:Reality Twist.f:
"Nothing is as it seems."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

INV:Scouting Trek.f:
"I have chosen my path. Who will walk it with me?"
—Eladamri

CHK:Waking Nightmare.f:
"Once each year, the oni and other evil spirits paraded through villages to disturb mortals' sleep. During the war, this parade became a nightly event."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

MMQ:Close Quarters.f: The Mercadians' ineptitude in close combat sometimes accidentally pays off.

MIR:Barbed-Back Wurm.f:
"The Mwonvuli Jungle has given the darkness teeth for tearing the gift of life from the weak."
—Jolrael

LEG:Kobold Taskmaster.f: The Taskmaster knows that there is no cure for the common Kobold.

MMQ:Intimidation.f: "If they move, kill them. In fact, kill one now to make sure the other understands."

WTH:Fallow Wurm.f:
The wurm's wake
—Elvish expression meaning "ruined crops"

ODY:Mystic Zealot.f: Nomad youths aspire to one of two roles in the tribe: priest or warrior. Their secret dream is to become both.

ATQ:Obelisk of Undoing.f: The Battle of Tomakul taught Urza not to rely on fickle reinforcements.

WTH:Heat Stroke.f:
"Stroke of heat or stroke of blade. Choose your fate, traitor."
—Maraxus of Keld, to Starke

MIR:Flare.f:
"In the forest, fires light the sky as black clouds unfold their weight."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

CHK:Mana Seism.f:
"It is the nature of humanity not to worry about tomorrow, especially when there's a good chance they won't live to see the end of today."
—Kiku, Night's Flower

USG:Anaconda.f: If you're smaller than the anaconda, it considers you food. If you're larger than the anaconda, it considers you a lot of food.

FEM:Goblin Grenade.f:
"Without their massive numbers, the Goblins could never have launched such a successful offensive."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. VI*

TOR:Pardic Arsonist.f: Otaria's epidemic of insanity didn't affect certain barbarians—but no one noticed.

BOK:Psychic Spear.f:
"The wizards of Takenuma Swamp faced the horrors of humanity every day. It's no wonder they fared so well against the kami."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

LEG:Quarum Trench Gnomes.f:
"O Great Captain, all is lost. They tunneled, they burrowed, they trenched. They sapped the strength of our defenses."
—Sorgus, *Chronicles of the Quarum Plains*

NEM:Pack Hunt.f: The one you see is just a diversion.

P02:Talas Researcher.f:
From time, knowledge.
From knowledge, power.

EXO:High Ground.f: In war, as in society, position is everything.

INV:Well-Laid Plans.f: "I knew this day would come," said Urza. Looking at the destruction, Barrin sighed, "You don't have to revel in it."

UDS:Voice of Duty.f:
"Next to Law is Duty, and Duty must be obeyed. If the frame of Duty is broken, none shall weave life's fabric."
—*Song of All*, canto 167

ONS:Centaur Glade.f: The Mirari called to the centaurs, and all who heard it were forever changed.

PCY:Barbed Field.f: Wherever they went, the Keldons transformed the land into a weapon.

JUD:Burning Wish.f: She wished for a weapon, but not for the skill to wield it.

PCY:Fault Riders.f: They turn geological upheaval into tactical advantage.

CHK:Meloku the Clouded Mirror.f: He loved his cities in the clouds. When he traveled to the lands below, he brought many reminders of his home.

STH:Evacuation.f: The first step of every exodus is from the blood and the fire onto the trail.

TMP:Gallantry.f: "Forgive me," Mirri whispered. "I thought you a burden, and you saved my life." Hanna quietly accepted the apology.

USG:Rain of Filth.f:
"When I say it rained, it was not small drops, but a thick, greasy drool pouring from the heavens."
—Urza, journal

JUD:Jeska, Warrior Adept.f: "My brother and I both come from Balthor's forge. Kamahl has a temper of fire. I have a temper of steel."

MIR:Bone Harvest.f:
"Only fools believe they will face my armies but once."
—Kaervek

ONS:Disciple of Grace.f: Dread was as foreign to her as the landscape ahead.

USG:Bull Hippo.f:
"How could you not hear it approach? It's a hippo!"
—Argivian commander

ODY:Tireless Tribe.f: "We've survived starvation, dwarf attacks, and heatstroke. Why should a little sandstorm bother us?"

ICE:Hot Springs.f: Warmth is life; heat is peace.

FEM:Dwarven Armorer.f:
"The few remaining pieces from this period suggest the Dwarves eventually made weapons and armor out of everything, even children's toys."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

ICE:Wrath of Marit Lage.f: Dread Marit Lage lies dreaming, not dead.

ULG:Knighthood.f:
"He has returned. He who brought the dark ones. He who poisoned our paradise. How shall we greet him? With swift and certain death!"
—Radiant, archangel

UDS:Colos Yearling.f: A steed grows with its rider.

VIS:Rainbow Efreet.f:
"A beauty made more so by its fleeting visitations."
—Teferi

TMP:Sudden Impact.f: The *Predator* roared like an unruly beast, and the *Weatherlight* suddenly listed. "No!" screamed Hanna.

SOK:Bounteous Kirin.f: Even the most benevolent and life-giving of kami joined the war against the mortal world, but only with heavy and sorrowful hearts.

DST:Tel-Jilad Outrider.f: "When the levelers come again, we shall be ready for them."

APC:Urborg Elf.f: The elves of Urborg are as deadly and capricious as the swamp itself.

MRD:Brown Ouphe.f: In a strange twist of fate, one of the most annoying creatures in the multiverse was brought to the place where it could cause the most damage.

PCY:Shield Dancer.f: The harder your strike, the stronger her defense.

USG:Disenchant.f:
"Let Phyrexia breed evil in the darkness; my holy light will reveal its taint."
—Serra

ICE:Regeneration.f:
"Faith in Freyalise has given me the gift, not the curse, of unprecedented longevity."
—Laina of the Elvish Council

ICE:Burnt Offering.f:
"My foes serve me twice: in dying, and in death."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

FEM:Orcish Veteran.f: Orcs are not exactly known for their valor—although most Orcs have seen countless battles, only a handful have actually fought in them.

CHK:Glimpse of Nature.f: Dosan sat in repose for many hours. He made no motion, no sound at all. And as he sat, nature revealed itself to him.

POR:Willow Dryad.f: Some think that dryads are the dreams of trees.

DST:Dross Golem.f: The longer it skulks through the corrosive gases of Mephidross, the more it adopts their thirst for death.

TMP:Insight.f:
"We can fight with you or against you. After my day, I'd prefer the former."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

SOK:Kuro's Taken.f: Simple bargains are the most tempting, and oni bargains are the simplest of all: eternal life for eternal service.

CHK:Joyous Respite.f:
"I have been gifted by the kami with long life. So far, they have not seen fit to withdraw their gift. There may yet be a way to stop the killing without more blood, human or kami, being spilled."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

APC:Diversionary Tactics.f: "It's the oldest trick in the book," said Guff. "And I ought to know—I wrote it."

TMP:Dismiss.f:
"There is nothing you can do that I cannot simply deny."
—Ertai, wizard adept

ICE:Diabolic Vision.f:
"I have seen the true path. I will not warm myself by the fire—I will become the flame."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

ARN:Dancing Scimitar.f: Bobbing merrily from opponent to opponent, the scimitar began adding playful little flourishes to its strokes; it even turned a couple of somersaults.

MMQ:Armistice.f:
We all must profit for peace to last.
—Mercadian saying

5DN:Shattered Dreams.f: Victims are lucky if they remember ever having had what was lost.

MMQ:Moonlit Wake.f:
"As long as Rushwood glows, no life is ever truly lost."
—Ta-Karnst, Cho-Arrim healer

ONS:Voice of the Woods.f: The ritual of making draws upon the elves' memories and pasts. And elves have long memories and ancient pasts.

USG:Treefolk Seedlings.f: The year that the brothers landed on Argoth, the trees produced five times as many seeds as normal.

UDS:Chime of Night.f: Many sent to serve Davvol carried such instruments, as if to remind him who their true masters were.

ICE:Icy Manipulator.f:
"The scavengers who first found it called it the 'Bone Crank.' Not a bad name, I'd say."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

MMQ:Crag Saurian.f: It follows the strongest leader—the one with the longest whip.

ICE:Soldevi Machinist.f:
"Perhaps this time the power of the artificers shall be used wisely."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

EXO:Raging Goblin.f: Volrath has bred them to fear only him. Are they charging into battle, or merely fleeing his wrath?

JUD:Mental Note.f: Some minds are more open than others.

ATQ:Gate to Phyrexia.f: "The warm rain of grease on my face immediately made it clear I had entered Phyrexia." —Jarsyl, *Diary*

MIR:Bone Mask.f:
"The protection offered comes at a price. How numerous are your kin?"
—Purraj of Urborg

LGN:Shifting Sliver.f: Once the last few slivers the Riptide Project controlled were dead, there was nothing to keep the island from being completely overrun.

FEM:Elvish Scout.f:
"Even for Elves, they were stealthy little twerps. They'd taken our measure before we'd even seen them."
—Marshall Volnikov

INV:Alloy Golem.f:
"We turned old weapons into new warriors."
—Jhoira, master artificer

SCG:Zealous Inquisitor.f: "I only return what rightly belongs to another."

APC:Zombie Boa.f: It doesn't need to feed, but still it hungers.

ODY:Mossfire Egg.f:
"Can you feel your instincts overwhelm your reason?"
—Watnik, master glassblower

ONS:Nantuko Husk.f:
The soul sheds light, and death is its shadow. When the light dims, life and death embrace.
—Nantuko teaching

TMP:Natural Spring.f: Mirri listened intently, even as Hanna held the healing water to her lips. Would the sound of the spring drown out the elves' approach?

MRD:Dross Prowler.f:
"I would never have believed that on a world with four suns there could exist a place so dark."
—Glissa Sunseeker

POR:Feral Shadow.f: Not all shadows are cast by light—some are cast by darkness.

ULG:Thran Lens.f:
"Every device in the rig is evidence of Thran enlightenment. All mana was the same to them, whether from rock or water, growth or decay. Can you imagine such unity of vision?"
—Urza, journal

LEG:Ghosts of the Damned.f: The voices of the dead ring in the heart long after they have faded from the ears.

HML:Narwhal.f:
"Who needs a spear? Ya break off the horn, and ya stab the fish with it. Easy!"
—Kakra, Sea Troll

DST:Drooling Ogre.f:
"Is it the stomping kind or the munching kind?"
—Slobad, goblin tinkerer

STH:Scapegoat.f: "Enjoy your deception, Vuel," Gerrard said as Volrath's features melted from the dead shapeshifter. "I'll count this one as practice."

FEM:Elvish Hunter.f: The Elves never had a standing army; when battle came, they pressed Hunters, Scouts, and Farmers into a surprisingly effective militia.

UDS:Metalworker.f:
"At this rate I fully expect to be replaced by a clockwork golem by year's end."
—Barrin

INV:Kavu Climber.f: The appearance of the first kavu surprised Multani. As they continued to emerge, he no longer had any doubts about Yavimaya's ability to defend herself.

POR:Armageddon.f:
"'O miserable of happy! Is this the end Of this new glorious world . . . ?'"
—John Milton, *Paradise Lost*

POR:Goblin Bully.f: It's easy to stand head and shoulders over those with no backbone.

JUD:Lead Astray.f:
"Never underestimate our enemy's strength, brutality, . . . or stupidity."
—Commander Eesha

MMQ:Strongarm Thug.f: "No, I insist—let *me* carry all that heavy jewelry."

EXO:Bequeathal.f:
"On my death, I give you this treasure: the knowledge that life is hard, yet too soon past."
—Dal funeral rite

VIS:Femeref Enchantress.f:
"Then she spread a fine dust over the land, like a butterfly shaking its wing."
—"The Enchantress," Femeref tale

MIR:Canopy Dragon.f:
"In the Mwonvuli you must divide your attention between what hangs overhead and what lies underfoot."
—Sidar Jabari

VIS:Feral Instinct.f:
"If a rhino's head is lower than its shoulders, trust me—it is *not* praying."
—Mwani, Mtenda herder

NEM:Animate Land.f: Irony is getting walked on by the earth instead of the other way around.

APC:Goblin Trenches.f: The ground rose and formed into thousands of tiny warriors. This fight was far from over.

APC:Penumbra Bobcat.f: This cat has two lives and it's hunting for more.

ICE:Elder Druid.f:
"I am older than any Elder Druid before me, and still no child has been born with the Mark to take my place. When will the wheel turn?"
—Kolbjörn, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

5DN:Krark-Clan Engineers.f: "Well, I jammed the whatsit into the whackdoodle, but I think I broke the thingamajigger."

TOR:Mortal Combat.f: The crowd roared, the fighters bled, and the dead piled high in the pits. Only the Cabal could win.

MIR:Ritual of Steel.f:
"Our soldiers are blessed with lizard scales as hard and cold as steel."
—Sidar Jabari

VIS:Resistance Fighter.f:
"My soldiers fought without hesitation, died without doubt."
—Sidar Jabari

FEM:Spirit Shield.f: At times, survival must outweigh all other considerations.

CHK:Soratami Mirror-Mage.f: "The clouds obey my whims, and you'll obey theirs."

LGN:Sootfeather Flock.f: They pick at the remains of the city's corpse.

ODY:Muscle Burst.f: As strong as a centaur's will.

NEM:Netter en-Dal.f: The wizard's vocabulary of mogg profanities increased with every net she cast.

CHK:Eiganjo Castle.f: Since the war began, the castle's walls mark the only place on Kamigawa where no kami has ever set foot.

HML:Primal Order.f:
"It's strange, but I can feel it when the land is corrupted. I understand why the Autumn Willow is so protective."
—Daria

ICE:Cooperation.f:
"The Elves train our healers, and we keep the Orcs at bay. Most Elvish bargains aren't as fair."
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox

SCG:Upwelling.f: Once again, Kamahl felt the full force of the Mirari's pull, but he had learned much since the last time.

PCY:Stormwatch Eagle.f: When eagles leave the sky, sailors leave the sea.

LEG:Visions.f:
"Visions of glory, spare my aching sight,/ Ye unborn ages, crowd not on my soul!"
—Thomas Gray, *The Bard*

INV:Llanowar Cavalry.f: For the first time, elves welcomed Benalish soldiers into the forest with something other than arrows.

VIS:Peace Talks.f:
"By the tongues of a thousand serpents, this time I do not lie."
—Ahmahz il Kin, Suq'Ata diplomat

5DN:Razorgrass Screen.f: Hand-stitched, and marked by the blood of the Auriok.

ICE:Orcish Lumberjack.f:
"How did I ever let myself get talked into this project?"
—Toothlicker Harj, Orcish Captain

MMQ:Nether Spirit.f: It roams in both the worlds of the living and the dead but belongs to neither.

ONS:Lay Waste.f: Skirk Ridge had survived earthquakes, mudslides, and meteor showers. Then the goblins moved in.

5DN:Doubling Cube.f: The cube's surface is pockmarked with jagged runes that seem to shift when unobserved.

HML:Roterothopter.f:
"The Roterothopter is as insidious as it is ingenious. It is one of the few creations of our school that I take no pride in."
—Baki, Wizard Attendant

FEM:Goblin War Drums.f: The War Drums enabled Goblin and Orcish armies to crush the sparsely defended Dwarven cities.

ICE:Infuse.f:
"The potential for change lies in all things. Know a thing's nature, know its possibilities, and know it anew."
—Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran Royal Mage

JUD:Benevolent Bodyguard.f: "My destiny is to save others so their destinies may be achieved."

INV:Phyrexian Infiltrator.f:
"It is Yawgmoth's will incarnate: an efficient machine that replaces inefficient flesh."
—Tsabo Tavoc

ICE:Force Void.f:
"My mind and spirit are one—a barrier not readily passed."
—Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran Royal Mage

ULG:Phyrexian Reclamation.f: Death is no excuse to stop working.

TMP:Respite.f: "If they board us we're finished," warned Orim. Crovax nodded. "And if they don't . . . what then?"

2ED:Earth Elemental.f: Earth Elementals have the eternal strength of stone and the endurance of mountains. Primordially connected to the land they inhabit, they take a long-term view of things, scorning the impetuous haste of short-lived mortal creatures.

5DN:Ion Storm.f: When enough artifacts lie too long in the same place, their magical radiation weakens reality, opening rifts of unpredictable destructive power.

WTH:Inner Sanctum.f: "Save me from Maraxus," Starke pleaded, "or condemn me to his wrath. Either way, do not ignore me!"

UDS:Fodder Cannon.f: Step 1: Find your cousin. Step 2: Get your cousin in the cannon. Step 3: Find another cousin.

TMP:Reap.f:
"Let Volrath choke on his crop of hatred."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

MRD:Slith Bloodletter.f: Goblins fear the slith, believing they are children banished from the womb of the Steel Mother, deep within Kuldotha.

ICE:Word of Undoing.f:
"It was in Urza's journals that I finally found the secret at the core of the summonings."
—Journal, author unknown

FEM:Order of the Ebon Hand.f: Dedicated to the principles of Tourach, members of the Order of the Ebon Hand demonstrated their devotion with grisly rituals.

DRK:Blood of the Martyr.f: The willow knows what the storm does not: that the power to endure harm outlives the power to inflict it.

PCY:Mageta's Boon.f:
When the Lion roars, his cubs grow stronger.
—Kipamu saying

ODY:Deluge.f:
"From the sea came all life, and to the sea it will return. The sooner the better."
—Emperor Aboshan

ODY:Squirrel Nest.f: In the Krosan Forest, you've got to keep an eye out for the squirrels.

JUD:Hapless Researcher.f: Scholars possess such lofty knowledge that it shouldn't be surprising when they fall.

TMP:Canyon Drake.f: "These runes are tough enough without the distraction," Ertai muttered, one eye on the drake.

ICE:Arnjlot's Ascent.f:
"The dreams of a child fulfilled:
the wind on my brow,
the air 'neath my feet."
—Arnjlot Olasson, Sky Mage

TOR:Sengir Vampire.f: Empires rise and fall, but evil is eternal.

NEM:Overlaid Terrain.f: One must reap before one can sow.

ULG:Phyrexian Broodlings.f: With limited resources and near unlimited time, Kerrick used parts from one beast to build another.

POR:Vampiric Touch.f: A touch, not comforting, but of death.

DST:Tanglewalker.f: In bringing life to Mirrodin, Memnarch was more successful than he knew—for Mirrodin began to take on a life of its own.

INV:Undermine.f: "Which would you like first, the insult or the injury?"

EXO:Skyshaper.f:
"It'll get us to the portal, but I can't guarantee what it'll do to the ship."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

MRD:Vulshok Berserker.f: He experiences every emotion with passion and repays every slight with vengeance.

STH:Sliver Queen.f: Her children are ever part of her.

LGN:Goblin Firebug.f: Most goblins leave behind a wake of destruction. A few goblins take one with them.

MRD:Detonate.f: The goblins have forty-two different words for "ow."

TMP:Trained Armodon.f: These are its last days. Better to grow broad and heavy. Better that the enemy is crushed beneath its carcass.

EXO:Hatred.f:
"I will flay the skin from your flesh and the flesh from your bones and scrape your bones dry. And still you will not have suffered enough."
—Greven *il*-Vec, to Gerrard

SOK:Feral Lightning.f: They moved like apes, but a thousand times swifter, prying into every corner, leaving pawprints of ash.

MMQ:Notorious Assassin.f: He wears his infamy like a fine silk shirt.

CHK:Kami of the Waning Moon.f:
"For a moment, Reito's defenders regrouped. Then wailing kami reappeared to send them scattering like flocks of frightened birds."
—*Great Battles of Kamigawa*

LGN:Goblin Lookout.f: "Throw rocks at 'em! Throw spears at 'em! Throw Furt at 'em!"

POR:Bee Sting.f: There are few things as motivating as a swarm of bees.

VIS:Shimmering Efreet.f:
Life or death: which is the illusion?"
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

PCY:Troublesome Spirit.f: As erratic and turbulent as a summer squall.

INV:Reckless Spite.f:
"Death is such an exquisite sensation."
—Tsabo Tavoc, Phyrexian general

ODY:Sandstone Deadfall.f:
"Two or three tons of rock can really get you down—and keep you there."
—Kamahl, pit fighter

INV:Planar Portal.f: The sky split, and the air crackled and roiled. The Phyrexian invasion of Dominaria had finally begun.

UDS:Reliquary Monk.f: A thing of Serra's realm exists only by the grace of her followers' faith.

ONS:Cruel Revival.f: Few Cabal fighters fear death. They fear what follows it.

POR:Desert Drake.f: Never doubt a dragon just because of its size.

5DN:Beacon of Unrest.f: A vertical scream pierces the night air and echoes doom through the clouds.

ONS:Fleeting Aven.f: "Don't become so enthralled with magic that you forget you can fly without it."

MRD:Rule of Law.f: Appointed by the kha himself, members of the tribunal ensure all disputes are settled with the utmost fairness.

JUD:Living Wish.f: He wished for growth, but not for a way to control it.

INV:Dromar's Attendant.f: "Dromar is the wings of the ur-dragon, sweeping away all opposition."

ALL:Fatal Lore.f:
"All knowledge has its price."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

TMP:Pit Imp.f: The moans of the Death Pits were underscored by the chattering of imps, for whom the ship was cause for much discussion.

PLS:Nightscape Familiar.f: Nightscape masters don't stop at raising the spirit of a fallen battlemage. They raise the flesh along with it.

MRD:Plated Slagwurm.f: Beneath the Tangle, the wurm tunnels stretch . . . wide as a stone's throw, long as forever, deep as you dare.

BOK:Final Judgment.f:
"The clashing warriors turned to face O-Kagachi, the greatest kami, and their sigh of awe was their last breath."
—*Great Battles of Kamigawa*

ODY:Ember Beast.f:
Spot one ember beast, attack.
Spot a second, best fall back.
—Dwarven saying

DST:Barbed Lightning.f: Every creature on Mirrodin is a lightning rod.

INV:Phyrexian Altar.f:
"Your life was meaningless, but your death will glorify Yawgmoth."
—Tsabo Tavoc

UDS:Compost.f:
A fruit must rot before its seed can sprout.
—Yavimaya saying

MIR:Village Elder.f:
