"Enchant me with your tale-telling. Tell about Tree, Grass, River, and Wind. / Tell why Truth must fight with Falsehood, and why Truth will always win."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

LEG:Typhoon.f: Fierce winds ripped across the tropical landscape. What they did not destroy with their fiery breath was washed away by torrential rain.

5DN:Ebon Drake.f: The deadliest killers serve only those who are not afraid to die.

ICE:Monsoon.f:
"No one in her right mind would venture off the coast of Kjeldor during this season."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

INV:Dream Thrush.f: Whether for good or ill, their arrival always means change.

ODY:Darkwater Catacombs.f: Murky Otarian tides hide the forgotten treacheries of the Phyrexian war.

ONS:Words of War.f:
"Passions can't be shackled by laws or mastered with logic. The choice is freedom or death."
—*Volume IV, The Book of Fire*

INV:Tigereye Cameo.f:
"An elvish adventurer unearthed this stone in Jolrael's jungle. Now it's truly fit for display in one of her palaces."
—Isel, master carver

LEG:Zephyr Falcon.f: Although greatly prized among falconers, the Zephyr Falcon is capricious and not easily tamed.

ARN:Flying Men.f: Saffiyah clapped her hands and twenty flying men appeared at her side, each well trained in the art of combat.

USG:Gaea's Cradle.f:
"Here sprouted the first seedling of Argoth. Here the last tree will fall."
—Gamelen, Citanul elder

P02:Angelic Blessing.f: The man who rose up to fight was not the same man knocked down.

FEM:Delif's Cone.f:
"Where is it written that beasts must cause pain?"
—Delif, *Ponderings*

LEG:Pyrotechnics.f: "Hi! ni! ya! Behold the man of flint, that's me!/ Four lightnings zigzag from me, strike and return." —Navajo war chant

5DN:Endless Whispers.f: Those who find death under the black sun's shadow cannot escape its pull.

MRD:Nuisance Engine.f: All Auriok children know the tale, "Bolgri and the Long Day of Squashing."

TMP:Aluren.f:
Squee bounced up and down. "I sees a horsey, an' a piggy, an' a—"
"If you don't shut up," hissed Mirri, "you'll see a kidney and a spleeny."

TMP:Skyshroud Elf.f:
"It is our duty to endure."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

CHK:Aura of Dominion.f:
"Lies and deceit do yield results, but legitimate authority is the ultimate form of control."
—Meloku the Clouded Mirror

USG:Viashino Outrider.f: "Give thy ration to thy mount, if the road be long. So sayeth the bey."

CHK:Gale Force.f: Everything the kami had done, they did with more force. Gentle breezes became typhoons, rolling rivers turned to crushing rapids, and gentle growth became overnight masses of thorns and vines.

PLS:Thunderscape Familiar.f: Thunderscape masters release familiars to help guide their apprentices down the thunderscape path.

POR:Elvish Ranger.f: It's up to you if you enter their woods—and up to them if you leave.

2ED:Goblin Balloon Brigade.f: "From up here we can drop rocks and arrows and more rocks!" "Uh, yeah boss, but how do we get down?"

ULG:Viashino Bey.f:
When the bey runs, match his stride.
—Viashino saying

MMQ:Cho-Arrim Bruiser.f: He doesn't know why the Cho-Arrim fight the Mercadians, but he's happy to bash heads for them anyway.

STH:Morgue Thrull.f: It's so hard to find good help these days.

LEG:Hornet Cobra.f:
"Then inch by inch out of the grass rose up the head and spread hood of Nag, the big black cobra, and he was five feet long from tongue to tail."
—Rudyard Kipling, *The Jungle Books*

ICE:Skeleton Ship.f:
"The sea gives up her dead as easily as the soil."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

ICE:Glacial Crevasses.f:
"We were chasing Lim-Dûl when the ridge in front of us suddenly crumbled. I can't believe it was mere coincidence."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter, Leader of the Order of the White Shield

CHK:Silent-Chant Zubera.f: When the Honden of Cleansing Fire was abandoned, its attendants swarmed Kamigawa to erode mortal will.

ALL:Urza's Engine.f:
"Humans and machines working together can be fearsome indeed!"
—Arcum Dagsson

INV:Raging Kavu.f: It took Yavimaya a thousand years to breed them, but it took only seconds for them to prove their worth.

MRD:Leonin Skyhunter.f: The skyhunters were born when the first leonin gazed at the heavens and wished to hunt the birds overhead.

PCY:Heightened Awareness.f:
"It startles me how alive one feels on the edge of death."
—Barrin, master wizard

P02:Touch of Brilliance.f: "I don't want what I don't have. I want more of what I *do* have."

P02:Goblin Piker.f: Once he'd worked out which end of the thing was sharp, he was promoted to guard duty.

ATQ:Urza's Mine.f: Mines became common as cities during the days of the artificers.

WTH:Serra's Blessing.f:
"I have seen your strength imbued in angels' wings, and I have felt your sorrow rain down on the ruins brought by the Lord of the Wastes."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

MMQ:Furious Assault.f:
"Does it burn, Saprazzan? Do you wish you had never raised arms against us?"
—Kyren overseer

USG:Sanctum Custodian.f: Serra told them to guard Urza as he healed. Five years they stood.

TMP:Heart Sliver.f: Gerrard looked all around for the source of the mysterious pulse, and at that moment the slivers boiled forth from the crevasses.

5DN:Vanquish.f:
"All beings have an inner light. Let me show you yours."
—Ushanti, leonin seer

MRD:Dross Scorpion.f: They skitter out of the mists to consume fresh kill before Mephidross has a chance to corrode it away.

ATQ:Yotian Soldier.f: After Kroog was destroyed while most of its defenders were at his side, Urza vowed that none of his allies would ever need to fear for their own defense again, even while laying siege to a city far from their homes.

FEM:River Merfolk.f:
"Dwelling in icy mountain streams near Goblin and Orcish foes, the River Merfolk were known for their stoicism."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. V*

STH:Ensnaring Bridge.f:
"I expected a fight, but I didn't expect it from the building itself."
—Gerrard

ULG:Engineered Plague.f:
"The admixture of bitterwort in the viral brew has produced most favorable results."
—Phyrexian progress notes

BOK:Lifegift.f:
"Walk the world and you'll find your soul; search your soul and you'll discover the world."
—Diary of Azusa

POR:Hand of Death.f: Death claims all but the darkest souls.

LEG:Alabaster Potion.f: "Healing is a matter of time, but it is sometimes also a matter of opportunity." —D'Avenant proverb

LEG:Hammerheim.f: "'Tis distance lends enchantment to the view,/ And robes the mountain in its azure hue." —Thomas Campbell, "Pleasures of Hope"

SCG:Accelerated Mutation.f: Its food just got a lot smaller and its stomach a lot bigger.

STH:Crossbow Ambush.f:
There is no drake that flies faster than a crossbow bolt.
—Vec saying

SOK:Blood Clock.f: In an age of war, time is measured not by sand but by blood.

CHK:Earthshaker.f: It scaled the Sokenzan Mountains in search of Kumano's secret. The mountain shook for two days, and the kami never returned.

NEM:Wandering Eye.f: The evincar has many ways of keeping track of his subjects.

MRD:Great Furnace.f: Kuldotha, wellspring of molten metal, temple of the goblin horde.

VIS:Suq'Ata Lancer.f:
"Never stop 'til you see your lance come out the other side."
—Telim'Tor

NEM:Predator, Flagship.f:
"The scourge of Skyshroud is airborne once more."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

MRD:Pewter Golem.f: Centuries before the first chimneys of Mephidross belched clouds of toxic gas, only the golems' movements stirred the air of Mirrodin.

WTH:Fog Elemental.f:
"I've seen fog so thick you could cut it, but none that could cut me."
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

LGN:Riptide Director.f: Those who lead others to wisdom become the wisest themselves.

ICE:Anarchy.f:
"The Shaman waved the staff, and the land itself went mad."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

USG:Cathodion.f: Instead of creating a tool that would be damaged by heat, the Thran built one that was charged by it.

FEM:Orcish Spy.f:
"You idiot! Never let the spies mingle with the Orcish regulars after completing a mission. Now we'll never get them to fight!"
—General Khurzog

SCG:Extra Arms.f:
"Perhaps extra heads would have served them better."
—Foothill guide

WTH:Aether Flash.f:
"You can't get there from here. Well, you *can*—it just won't be fun."
—Ertai, wizard adept

EXO:Wayward Soul.f:
"no home no heart no hope"
—Stronghold graffito

POR:Theft of Dreams.f: Energy is never lost, only transformed.

TMP:Elven Warhounds.f:
"If a creature is dumb enough to love you for leashing it, why would you want to follow its lead?"
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

CHK:Squelch.f: Oku-Doku had gone through all the motions: the same akki cursewords, the same ingredients with their horrid stink, the same rude gestures. Yet not a person died.

ULG:Tragic Poet.f: "I would weep, but my tears have been stolen; I would shout, but my voice has been taken. Thus, I write."

USG:Catastrophe.f: Radiant's eyes flashed. "Go, then," the angel spat at Serra, "and leave this world to those who truly care."

ULG:Last-Ditch Effort.f:
"If you're gonna lose, at least make sure they don't win as much."
—Jula, goblin raider

ONS:Dwarven Blastminer.f: "Life is too short for something like a hunk of rock to get in my way."

SCG:Bonethorn Valesk.f: Barbarians weave its spurs into ceremonial charms to proclaim their hardiness in battle.

ODY:Aven Flock.f: Just as each added feather steadies the wing, so does the flock grow stronger with each new member.

ONS:Unified Strike.f: The tall, reedy grass of the Daru Plains rustles loudly in the winds, a perfect cover for any ambush.

POR:Giant Spider.f: It's not far into the trap, as the crow flies.

USG:Umbilicus.f: It was the explorers' only tether to reality.

TMP:Verdant Force.f:
Burl, scurf, and bower
Birth fern and flower.

MMQ:Deepwood Ghoul.f: They feed on the living to stay undead.

ARN:Ali Baba.f: "When he reached the entrance of the cavern, he pronounced the words, 'Open, Sesame!'" —*The Arabian Nights*, Junior Classics trans.

MMQ:Stone Rain.f: The return of Ramos was foretold by devastating natural disasters and unnatural storms.

TOR:Cabal Surgeon.f: "Clerics give up when their patients die. Can I help it if I'm more compassionate?"

MRD:Mesmeric Orb.f: A step in one direction is two steps away from another.

STH:Endangered Armodon.f: These are its last days. Its doom to be remembered only until the hunters hunger again.

POR:Charging Paladin.f: A true warrior's thoughts are of victory, not death.

MRD:Looming Hoverguard.f: Although mute, hoverguards get their message across loud and clear.

ONS:Biorhythm.f:
"I have seen life's purpose, and now it is my own."
—Kamahl, druid acolyte

VIS:Remedy.f:
"These things will protect you while I'm gone, remind you of my love for you."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

MIR:Spectral Guardian.f:
"A treasure to guard other treasures is worth the highest price."
—Mtai, Civic Guildmage

SOK:Thoughts of Ruin.f:
"In our war with the kami, we annihilate what is our own. Do they too suffer ruination in their hidden world?"
—Diary of Azusa

APC:Vindicate.f:
"Don't mourn for me. This is my destiny."
—Gerrard

MIR:Benevolent Unicorn.f:
The best use for a unicorn's horn is to adorn a unicorn.
—Femeref adage

UDS:Dying Wail.f: This is a world of spiteful wasps that sting and kill even as they die.

2ED:Wall of Stone.f: The Earth herself lends her strength to these walls of living stone, which possess the stability of ancient mountains. These mighty bulwarks thwart ground-based troops, providing welcome relief for weary warriors who defend the land.

HML:Aysen Abbey.f: Serra's gift to her people: a symbol of faith and hope.

FEM:Combat Medic.f:
"We'd no sooner knock 'em back on their heels than that accursed sawbones would show up and patch 'em back together again."
—Ivra Jursdotter

WTH:Southern Paladin.f:
"Look to the south; there you will find peace and serenity."
—*The Book of Tal*

PTK:Zhang Fei, Fierce Warrior.f: Zhang Fei's uncharacteristic alliance with a defeated Riverlands general, Yan Yan, allowed Shu forces to advance through forty-five Riverlands strongpoints with no casualties.

INV:Goblin Spy.f:
"Isn't he on our side?"
"Yep."
"Why's he spyin' on us?"
"Don't ask."

ONS:Towering Baloth.f: The Mirari twisted all that lived in the Krosan Forest into gross mockeries of their former selves.

ATQ:Ashnod's Transmogrant.f: Ashnod found few willing to trade their humanity for the power she offered them.

ICE:Fanatical Fever.f:
"Let go your fury, and hone your anger. Become the fist of Freyalise!"
—Kolbjörn, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

LGN:Goblin Turncoat.f:
"Goblins won't betray their own kind for any price. They'll do it for a very specific price."
—Phage the Untouchable

USG:Windfall.f:
"To fill your mind with knowledge, we must start by emptying it."
—Barrin, master wizard

PTK:Wielding the Green Dragon.f: Named for the eastern part of the sky, the source of energy and renewal, Guan Yu's crescent-moon blade weighed over 100 pounds.

TMP:Mnemonic Sliver.f:
"A jigsaw puzzle that lives, breeds, and thinks."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

MRD:Battlegrowth.f: "I would gladly die for the forest, but I'm much better at killing for it."

FEM:Vodalian Mage.f: Vodalian Mages were invaluable in magical combat. Unfortunately, the Homarids raided with strength, numbers, and very little magic.

LEG:Wall of Opposition.f: Like so many obstacles in life, the Wall of Opposition is but an illusion, held fast by the focus and belief of the one who creates it.

EXO:Reclaim.f: The wise pay as much attention to what they throw away as to what they keep.

TMP:Squee's Toy.f: As the horrors closed in on Gerrard, Squee trembled and clutched his toy for comfort. He didn't know where it came from or why it was so warm, but he was glad he'd kept it near.

MIR:Giant Mantis.f:
"I hate insects of every sort. The only mercy is that they are generally small."
—Mwani, Mtenda goatherd

DRK:Fountain of Youth.f: The Fountain had stood in the town square for centuries, but only the pigeons knew its secret.

UDS:Thieving Magpie.f: Rayne once made several unkind comparisons between the bird's naked opportunism and Urza's.

FEM:Goblin Chirurgeon.f: The Chirurgeons patched up their fallen comrades with a gruesome mix of twisted limbs and mangled flesh.

APC:Ebony Treefolk.f: Its roots are equally happy to drink the water of a clear stream or the oily blood of a Phyrexian warrior.

ICE:Knight of Stromgald.f:
"Kjeldorans should rule supreme, and to the rest, death!"
—Avram Garrisson, Leader of the Knights of Stromgald

TOR:Cabal Coffers.f: Deep within the Cabal's vault, the Mirari pulsed like a dead sun—and its darkness radiated across Otaria.

EXO:Song of Serenity.f: Heartwood brings peace in great symphonies where dryads conduct the trees through every note.

ULG:Sluggishness.f: Vark decided to lie down and think of a good excuse to quit working.

NEM:Mossdog.f: The more you look at it, the more dangerous it becomes.

ICE:Celestial Sword.f:
"So great is its power, only the chosen can wield it and live."
—Avram Garrisson, Leader of the Knights of Stromgald

LGN:Drinker of Sorrow.f: It strikes at your soul, heedless of your prayers.

ICE:Snow Devil.f:
"Give me wings to fly and speed to strike. In return, the glory I earn shall be yours."
—Steinar Icefist, Balduvian Shaman

UDS:Tethered Griffin.f: Poorly trained griffins sometimes attack the noble audiences that gather to watch their progress.

VIS:Undo.f:
"Oft have I wished to undo past deeds, but never did I imagine they would be undone for me."
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

POR:Elven Cache.f: Elves know where to harvest the best of the forest, for they planted it themselves.

JUD:Cephalid Inkshrouder.f: Cephalids shrink from the harsh glare of scrutiny.

SOK:Masumaro, First to Live.f:
"In the waning moments of war, humanity's most ancient ancestors return. But whose side shall they make their own?"
—Isao, Enlightened Bushi

P02:Wild Ox.f: It has the run of the swamps, and it knows it.

MMQ:Rishadan Pawnshop.f: Everything comes to the waterfront eventually, on the tide or on credit.

ONS:Elvish Warrior.f: "My tales of war are the stories most asked for around the fires at night, but they're the ones I care least to tell."

ONS:Wave of Indifference.f:
"Darius?"
"Yeah?"
"There's a goblin sneaking up on you."
"So?"
"Just sayin'."

TMP:Safeguard.f:
"I'm amused by wasted effort when it's not my own."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

MMQ:Dehydration.f:
"You say Saprazzo is a city built on water? I hope they have enough to wash the dust from my throat."
—Sisay

HML:Torture.f:
"It helps you pass the time until you die."
—Grandmother Sengir

MMQ:Pretender's Claim.f: The surest way to lose your holdings is to plead for them in Mercadia City's courts.

SCG:Unspeakable Symbol.f: The symbols are spread throughout Aphetto, marking sites where minions of the Raven Guild and the Cabal can seek refuge.

ALL:Viscerid Drone.f: Not all of Terisiare's flooding was natural . . . .

LEG:Ragnar.f: "On the field of honor, a soldier need have no fear."

CHK:Sokenzan Bruiser.f:
"We camped near the Sokenzan Mountains. Though I know its inhabitants are sparse, I hear cries coming from the highest peaks every night, as if the mountains themselves bellow for vengeance."
—Lost Battalion, message to General Takeno

PTK:Zhao Zilong, Tiger General.f: Zhao Zilong was a brave and noble warrior. Twice he rescued Liu Bei's son, Liu Shan.

MMQ:Dawnstrider.f: Morning's mists can hide many things.

5DN:Conjurer's Bauble.f: It is the moment of discovery, the triumph of the mind, the reimagining of past glory.

WTH:Urborg Stalker.f:
"May you be a stalker's dream."
—Urborg curse

UDS:Wild Colos.f: You'll never get a Keldon's goat.

SOK:Skyfire Kirin.f: Its fiery visitation burns away the fog of war and dissipates the ties of loyalty.

SCG:Stifle.f:
"If I wanted your opinion, I'd have told you what it was."
—Pemmin, Riptide survivor

NEM:Lawbringer.f:
One injustice starts a thousand riots. One law stops a thousand crimes.
—Lawbringer creed

P02:Dakmor Scorpion.f: A scorpion this big you won't find curled up in your boot. Maybe *around* your boot, but not *in* it.

STH:Acidic Sliver.f: The first sliver burst against the cave wall, and others piled in behind to deepen the new tunnel.

CHK:Kodama of the North Tree.f:
"The monks of the North Tree rarely saw their kodama until the Kami War, when it woke like a slumbering, angry bear."
—"Poem of the Five Trees"

ONS:Overwhelming Instinct.f: The biggest difference between a victory and a massacre is which side you're on.

APC:Tranquil Path.f: Freyalise bought the planeswalkers the time they needed by clearing a path through the misshapen hell of Phyrexia.

MRD:Fangren Hunter.f: Big ones hunt the elves, so the elves hunt the small ones to keep them from getting big.

ALL:Storm Crow.f:
"Watch for it! Right on its tailfeathers will be a storm from your nightmares."
—Arna Kennerüd, Skycaptain

TMP:Orim's Prayer.f:
"As usual, there will be time for prayer only *after* the worst happens."
—Orim, Samite healer

CHK:Iname, Death Aspect.f: Iname revels in sadistic glee at the crushing of souls, but soon mourns the lives so cruelly cut short. So the cycle begins anew.

HML:Sengir Bats.f:
"In the face of every one I see the Baron."
—Daria

CHK:Shizo, Death's Storehouse.f: Centuries ago, Shizo was a verdant field of wildflowers. After 891 samurai died in a single battle on its grasses, it became a haunted moor.

TMP:Coercion.f:
"There's very little that escapes me, Greven. And you will escape very little if you fail."
—Volrath

WTH:Nature's Resurgence.f:
Spring follows winter
—Elvish expression meaning "all things pass"

CHK:Befoul.f:
"When the rampaging kami at Reito had crushed the opposing militia, swarms of minor kami swept over the battlefield to consume all that remained."
—*Great Battles of Kamigawa*

PTK:Wu Warship.f: Both Wu and Wei warships patrolled the Yangtze River, the natural border between the two kingdoms.

WTH:Jangling Automaton.f:
"We always look upon our first creations as masterpieces, no matter how awful they are."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

LEG:Killer Bees.f: The communal mind produces a savage strategy, yet no one could predict that this vicious crossbreed would unravel the secret of steel.

MIR:Chariot of the Sun.f:
"Sun follows Moon until she tires, then carries her until she's strong / and runs ahead of him again."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

MMQ:Instigator.f: The desecration of their dead makes even the Saprazzans careless.

SOK:Hidetsugu's Second Rite.f: Hidetsugu never relinquished a grudge. He let it burn within him, gathering ever greater intensity until the final moment of vengeance.

ULG:Treacherous Link.f:
"You cannot possibly know the toll your alliances will exact from you."
—Barrin, to Urza

EXO:Erratic Portal.f: "In Barrin's name!" cried Lyna as Hanna's sword passed through her, "Ertai sends word that the portal is open—but not for long!"

TMP:Wall of Diffusion.f:
"The injury was being caught between this world and our own; the insult was to find walls within."
—Lyna, Soltari emissary

PCY:Whip Sergeant.f: Keldon soldiers learn to move faster than the whip.

LEG:Nether Void.f: These days, some wizards are finding that they have a little too much spell left at the end of their mana.

CHK:Sire of the Storm.f: This storm blows gales through the dreams of men.

CHK:Isamaru, Hound of Konda.f: The hound sniffed the air and let slip a low growl. General Takeno looked down at the faithful Isamaru and calmed him with a touch. "Alert the men. The kami are coming."

P02:Lynx.f: Rarely seen, hardly heard, never caught.

LEG:Halfdane.f: Hail from Tolaria the ever changing 'Dane.

MRD:Megatog.f: In an ironic bit of evolution, the megatog's dozens of teeth are mainly ornamental. It prefers swallowing things whole.

VIS:River Boa.f:
"But no one heard the snake's gentle hiss for peace over the elephant's trumpeting of war."
—Afari, *Tales*

POR:Raging Minotaur.f: The only thing worse than a minotaur with an axe is an angry minotaur with an axe.

WTH:Zombie Scavengers.f:
"Pick a shell upon my shore and put it to your ear. That sound isn't the sea, but the whispers of the fallen."
—Crovax

TOR:Nantuko Shade.f:
"If the Nantuko only knew what awaits them beyond death, they would abandon all they hold dear."
—Cabal Patriarch

SOK:Okina Nightwatch.f: Only the most skilled budoka could protect the Okina Shrine. Only the best of these protectors took the night watch.

INV:Tainted Well.f:
"No, *you* get the water. I ain't thirsty."
—Squee

TOR:Carrion Rats.f:
"Just what I need—more competition."
—Cabal grave robber

USG:Exploration.f: The first explorers found Argoth a storehouse of natural wealth—towering forests grown over rich veins of ore.

PCY:Search for Survivors.f: There's no rest for a Keldon.

STH:Wall of Essence.f:
The ceiling and the floor fell in love, but only the wall knew.
—Dal saying

MRD:Cloudpost.f:
"He watches from above. He watches from below. He watches from within."
—Inscription on Tel-Jilad, the Tree of Tales

USG:Arcane Laboratory.f: It soon became obvious that some experiments were best overseen by fireproof teachers.

PCY:Spore Frog.f: The end of one life is merely the beginning of thousands more.

P02:Talas Merchant.f: The trader let loose a laugh that made all around him check their purses.

VIS:Daraja Griffin.f:
"And the flamingos said, 'Get out of our nest—we can't be seen with the likes of you!' So, the griffin ate them."
—Azeworai, "The Ugly Bird"

MMQ:Magistrate's Veto.f: The magistrate had been the goblins' puppet for so long that he made the right decisions with little prompting.

ALL:Misinformation.f:
"When you cannot rely on your sources, trust your own senses. When you cannot trust those, you must follow your instincts."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

WTH:Blossoming Wreath.f:
"I place this wreath for you, my kin. Even in death, you give me strength to avenge you."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

TMP:Boil.f:
"The fishers will throw out their nets and draw them back filled with dust."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

SCG:Treetop Scout.f: At home among the swaying, supple branches of the treetops, some scouts live their entire lives never touching ground.

DRK:People of the Woods.f:
"Their rain of arrows left only myself alive, cowering within a tree hollow. They did not even come out to loot the bodies."
—Vervamon the Elder

LEG:Cleanse.f: The clouds broke and the sun's rays burst forth; each foul beast in its turn faltered, and was gone.

UDS:Extruder.f: As the invasion drew closer, Urza's means began to resemble Phyrexia's end.

INV:Quirion Sentinel.f: All elvenkind stood against Phyrexia. The Quirion nation deployed its most spiritual adepts, who wielded the power of their native soil.

ICE:Kjeldoran Frostbeast.f:
"Two of my Warriors found that the creature was dangerous not only in combat, but also in simple proximity."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

TMP:Phyrexian Grimoire.f: Every page cost a life; every secret cost a thousand more.

HML:Headstone.f:
"Your headstone is the last page in the book of your life."
—Murat, Death Speaker

CHK:Field of Reality.f:
"The scholars of the Minamo School understood the veil between their world and that of the kami. Moreover, they knew how to exploit it."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

TMP:Metallic Sliver.f: When the clever counterfeit was accepted by the hive, Volrath's influence upon the slivers grew even stronger.

2ED:Living Wall.f: Some fiendish mage had created a horrifying wall of living flesh, patched together from a jumble of still-recognizable body parts. As we sought to hew our way through it, some unknown power healed the gaping wounds we cut, denying us passage.

ATQ:Tawnos's Weaponry.f: When Urza's war machines became too costly, Tawnos's weaponry replaced them.

LEG:Pavel Maliki.f: We all know the legend: Pavel wanders the realms, helping those in greatest need. But is this a measure of his generosity, or of his obligation to atone?

ICE:Vertigo.f:
"I saw the wizard gesturing, but I didn't guess his plan until my Aesthir cried out and went into a dive."
—Arna Kennerüd, Skyknight

PTK:Three Visits.f:
"Trying to meet a worthy man in the wrong way is as bad as closing the door on an invited guest."
—Mencius, a Chinese philosopher

HML:Shrink.f:
"The smallest beast can yet have the greatest heart."
—Gemma, Willow Priestess

ULG:Phyrexian Plaguelord.f:
"The final stage of the illness: delirium, convulsions, and death."
—Phyrexian progress notes

TMP:Phyrexian Hulk.f:
"They are convenient in having no souls, but less so in having no spirit."
—Volrath

2ED:Northern Paladin.f: "Look to the north; there you will find aid and comfort." —The Book of Tal

LGN:Quick Sliver.f: The directors of the Riptide Project wanted instant results on the sliver experiments. They got their wish.

MIR:Dwarven Nomad.f:
A dwarf's life belongs as much to the land as to the dwarf.
—Creed of the Stonethrow Clan

LGN:Beacon of Destiny.f: "We all borrowed life from the Ancestor to exist in this world. Today, I repay that debt."

VIS:Brood of Cockroaches.f:
"It's like waking on a bed of a thousand olives during an earthquake of subtle force."
—Afari, *Tales*

2ED:Uthden Troll.f:
"Oi oi oi, me gotta hurt in 'ere,
Oi oi oi, me smell a ting is near,
Gonna bosh 'n gonna nosh 'n da
hurt'll disappear."
—Traditional

2ED:Ley Druid.f: After years of training, the Druid becomes one with nature, drawing power from the land and returning it when needed.

MMQ:Ballista Squad.f: The perfect antidote for a tightly packed formation.

TMP:Ancient Tomb.f:
There is no glory to be gained in the kingdom of the dead.
—Vec tomb inscription

FEM:Necrite.f: Necrites killed Jherana Rure, ending the counter-insurgency.

5DN:Crucible of Worlds.f: Amidst the darkest ashes grow the strongest seeds.

MIR:Phyrexian Purge.f: Only those who have nothing have nothing to fear.

BOK:Oyobi, Who Split the Heavens.f: Her angry call split the sky. From that rift descended her champions.

ONS:Ixidor, Reality Sculptor.f: "Reality has exiled me. I am no longer bound by its laws."

LEG:Sir Shandlar of Eberyn.f: "Remember Sir Shandlar! Remember and stand firm!" —rallying cry of the Eberyn militia

MIR:Jolrael's Centaur.f:
"What need have I for cavalry when I can have horse and rider both in one?"
—Jolrael

FEM:Svyelunite Priest.f:
"Early Vodalians worshipped Svyelun, goddess of the Pearl Moon. Later she became a more abstract figure."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. V*

ICE:Shield Bearer.f:
"You have almost completed your four years, my son. Soon you shall be a Skyknight."
—Arna Kennerüd, Skyknight

ICE:Earthlore.f:
"Even the ground is our friend."
—Kolbjörn, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

USG:Catalog.f:
"Without order comes errors, and errors kill on Tolaria."
—Barrin, master wizard

ARN:Juzám Djinn.f: "Expect my visit when the darkness comes. The night I think is best for hiding all." —Ouallada

LEG:Karakas.f: "To make a prairie it takes a clover and one bee,/ One clover, and a bee,/ And revery." —Emily Dickinson

PTK:Stalking Tiger.f: Throughout Chinese history, generals have often been referred to as tigers for their fierceness, strength, and bravery.

MMQ:Groundskeeper.f: Whereas the rebels fight to defend the land, they work to renew it.

POR:Angelic Blessing.f: A peasant can do more by faith than a king by proclamation.

INV:Vicious Kavu.f: As battle raged in Shiv, a strange new ally appeared from below the ravaged ground.

P02:Vengeance.f: A bullet renders all sizes equal.

TOR:Major Teroh.f: "I am the holy wind that shall avenge the Cabal's victims."

2ED:Thicket Basilisk.f: Moss-covered statues littered the area, a macabre monument to the Basilisk's power.

LEG:Firestorm Phoenix.f: "The bird of wonder dies, the maiden phoenix,/ Her ashes new-create another heir/ As great in admiration as herself." —William Shakespeare, *King Henry the Eighth*

PLS:Stratadon.f: Designed like the gargadons of Keld—big and brutal.

POR:Mountain Goat.f: Only the heroic and the mad follow mountain goat trails.

5DN:Viridian Scout.f: They know a hoverguard's only blind spot is directly above it.

ODY:Bearscape.f:
"Nature is the endless dance between life and death."
—Seton, centaur druid

MRD:Hum of the Radix.f: The elves learned long ago that anything left here slowly vanishes. Now it is a sacred site where the dead are laid to rest and where unnatural magic is erased forever.

LEG:Transmutation.f: "You know what I was,/ You see what I am: change me, change me!" —Randall

APC:Savage Gorilla.f: These omnivorous gorillas have no qualms about a diet composed of equal parts fruit and Phyrexians.

USG:Corrupt.f: Yawgmoth brushed Urza's mind, and Urza's world convulsed.

POR:Highland Giant.f: Though slow-witted and slow-moving, they are quick to anger.

TMP:Soltari Trooper.f:
"Dauthi blood is Soltari wine."
—Soltari *Tales of Life*

INV:Callous Giant.f: "The invasion has awoken slumbering mountains," noted Urza. "Good. We can use all the help we can get."

CHK:Feast of Worms.f:
"The dust beneath our feet was once part of a mighty civilization. Shall we too provide the path for a future generation?"
—Sensei Golden-Tail

MIR:Harbinger of Night.f:
Embrace the Harbinger
—Suq'Ata expression meaning "abandon hope"

JUD:Anurid Barkripper.f: When it croaks, so do you.

LEG:Glyph of Doom.f:
"He knows he has a short span of life, that the day will come when he must pass through the wall of oblivion . . ."
—William Faulkner

ODY:Execute.f:
"Any fool who would die for honor is better off dead."
—Cabal Patriarch

MMQ:Tonic Peddler.f: "The price is written at the bottom of the cup."

INV:Global Ruin.f:
"The earth shook, the sky rained fire, and it seemed the world was ending."
—Benalish refugee

LEG:Hell's Caretaker.f: You might leave here, Chenndra, should another take your place . . . .

VIS:Talruum Champion.f: In the Talruum language, there is no word for "surprised."

LGN:Brood Sliver.f: Within weeks, more slivers nested in Otaria than ever existed on Rath.

MIR:Unfulfilled Desires.f:
"Like Day from Night, / I'll live my life apart from you, just glimpsing you across the sky, / because you cannot change, my dear, and nor can I."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

INV:Jade Leech.f:
"It took magic to extract one of the stones and five people to carry it."
—Tolarian research notes

PCY:Rhystic Study.f: Friends teach what you want to know. Enemies teach what you *need* to know.

ONS:Symbiotic Elf.f: The elves arriving in Wirewood had no homes, let alone weapons, but they knew that the forest would always provide.

MIR:Telim'Tor.f:
"The curious merely amass knowledge. The ambitious use it."
—Telim'Tor

TOR:Cephalid Snitch.f: The cautious are wary of their enemies. The wise are also wary of their friends.

VIS:Freewind Falcon.f:
"That does it! I'm going back to hunting chickens!"
—Rhirhok, goblin archer

USG:Treetop Rangers.f:
"If you can't catch them, cut the trees down from beneath them. Force them to fight on our terms."
—Mishra

EXO:Spellbook.f:
"Everything the wise woman learned she wrote in a book, and when the pages were black with ink, she took white ink and began again."
—Karn, silver golem

MIR:Paupers' Cage.f: A cage may keep you in, but it does not keep the stones out.

TMP:Scalding Tongs.f:
"This has nothing to do with what you know and everything to do with what I wish."
—Volrath

NEM:Coiling Woodworm.f: Only the elves know where the woods end and the woodworm begins.

TMP:Time Warp.f:
"Let's do it again!"
—Squee, goblin cabin hand

ALL:Gorilla Berserkers.f:
"Their fury is their greatest weapon."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, Elvish Hunter

NEM:Silkenfist Fighter.f:
Simple wooden staff
Made from life, protecting life,
Stronger than cold steel.

USG:Pendrell Flux.f: Devoured by the mists, Tolaria was stuck in time, trapped between two eternal heartbeats.

TOR:Mind Sludge.f: When you get into the swamp, the swamp gets into you.

UDS:Capashen Knight.f: Few warriors dare to challenge a knight of Capashen. Should one do so, there is one fewer.

ODY:Woodland Druid.f: What is a tree? Slow hard thought. What is a flower? Swift soft flesh. What is a druid? Both.

TMP:Spontaneous Combustion.f: "Heat of battle" is usually a metaphor.

PTK:Mountain Bandit.f: Penniless and far from home, many former Yellow Scarves and other soldiers became bandits to survive.

UDS:Plated Spider.f: Most spiders wait patiently for their prey to arrive. Most spiders aren't forty feet tall.

SOK:Descendant of Kiyomaro.f: "The blood of Kiyomaro flows in my veins. He did not let Eiganjo fall and neither shall I."

MMQ:Tidal Kraken.f: To merfolk, pirates are a nuisance. To pirates, merfolk are a threat. To the kraken, they're both appetizers.

ONS:Wirewood Herald.f: The goblins laughed as the elf ran away, until more came back.

TMP:Static Orb.f:
Time passes, time crawls;
Time doesn't move at all.

MRD:Override.f: "The Knowledge Pool has all the answers—especially 'No.'"

CHK:Mothrider Samurai.f: When the night blossoms open, the wings of Eiganjo take flight.

ATQ:Candelabra of Tawnos.f: Tawnos learned quickly from Urza that utter simplicity often led to wondrous, yet subtle utility.

TMP:Soltari Priest.f: "In Rath," the priest said, "there is even greater need for prayer."

ALL:Aesthir Glider.f:
"Sacrilege! A noble ally in life, made nothing more than a glorified kite in death!"
—Arna Kennerüd, Skycaptain

ULG:Pyromancy.f:
Who harnesses fire controls the world.
—Ghitu proverb

LGN:Seedborn Muse.f:
"Her voice is wilderness, savage and pure."
—Kamahl, druid acolyte

INV:Shackles.f: "It could be worse," said Gerrard, looking around. "Well, maybe not."

POR:Coral Eel.f: Some fishers like to eat eels, and some eels like to eat fishers.

STH:Honor Guard.f:
"It is not a choice I make, to have this guard. It is the choice of my people, and my duty to them."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

HML:Truce.f:
"The people of Aysen feed us, and we don't kill them. That's my kind of truce."
—Eron the Relentless

DRK:Miracle Worker.f:
"Those blessed hands could bring surcease to even the most tainted soul."
—Sister Betje, *Miracles of the Saints*

VIS:Summer Bloom.f:
"Our love is like the river in the summer season of long rains. / For a little while it spilled its banks, flooding the crops in the fields."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

ODY:Malevolent Awakening.f: The most popular pit fighters are brought back for encore performances.

MMQ:Ivory Mask.f: "I did not choose my role, Orim," said Cho-Manno patiently, "and I suspect Gerrard did not choose his."

JUD:Commander Eesha.f: "War glides on the simplest updrafts while peace struggles against hurricane winds. It is the way of the world. It must change."

MRD:Tanglebloom.f: Druids converted swaths of the Tangle into tanglebloom orchards. Though heavy tools are needed to cut a leaf in the Tangle, tanglebloom fruit is easily plucked by hand.

NEM:Aether Barrier.f:
"Creatures fade in and out of existence. It's an unfortunate side effect. The losses are tolerable."
—Belbe

LEG:Hellfire.f: "High on a throne of royal state . . . insatiate to pursue vain war with heav'n." —John Milton, *Paradise Lost*

JUD:Anurid Swarmsnapper.f: Anurids have the problem of airborne invaders licked.

INV:Meteor Storm.f: The storm wasn't an omen. It was the fulfillment of one.

MMQ:Disenchant.f:
The scepter of power is fragile in a calloused hand.
—Cho-Arrim saying

POR:Starlit Angel.f: To soar as high as hope, to dive as swift as justice.

WTH:Uktabi Efreet.f:
"The Uktabi efreet and I have something in common: both of our mothers wanted to give us back."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

TMP:Shadowstorm.f:
"You've not seen a storm until you've seen the kind that roars between worlds."
—Lyna, Soltari emissary

VIS:Archangel.f:
"My mother once told me angels sing their swords' names with each strike."
—Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*

WTH:Flux.f:
"Every spell has the potential to be worthless."
—Ertai, wizard adept

VIS:Aku Djinn.f:
"Your arrogance amazes me, Kaervek. Did you not know the price you would pay?"
—Mangara

PLS:Stone Kavu.f: To maintain its hide, it consumes a variety of rocks—not to mention a variety of Phyrexians.

SOK:Scroll of Origins.f: The words from which language sprang, the knowledge from which thought was born, the story from which history was woven.

2ED:Black Knight.f: Battle doesn't need a purpose; the battle is its own purpose. You don't ask why a plague spreads or a field burns. Don't ask why I fight.

PTK:Shu Elite Infantry.f: Kongming's first campaign against the Wei kingdom was a rousing success until an arrogant Shu general, Ma Su, foolishly lost the city of Jieting.

MRD:Wrench Mind.f: What is the sound of one head snapping?

MIR:Sealed Fate.f: It's good to know more about your enemy's fate than your enemy does.

MIR:Dissipate.f:
"If you weren't born with it, you don't need it."
—Grahilah, former trader of Amiqat

LGN:Wirewood Channeler.f: "Your words are meaningless. The rustling of leaves is the only language that makes any sense."

MMQ:Forced March.f: The Caterans call it a screening process. The dead are in no condition to argue.

ODY:Caustic Tar.f:
"Twisted magic, twisted fate, Force the land to ooze with hate."
—Cabal chant

TMP:Jackal Pup.f: The first morning after acquiring her familiar, the wizard awoke with fleabites and mange.

USG:Bog Raiders.f:
"Let weak feed on weak, that we may divine the nature of strength."
—*Phyrexian Scriptures*

DRK:Squire.f:
"Of twenty yeer of age he was, I gesse.
Of his stature he was of even lengthe,
And wonderly deliver, and greete of strengthe."
—Geoffrey Chaucer, *The Canterbury Tales*

ICE:Swords to Plowshares.f:
"The so-called Barbarians will not respect us for our military might—they will respect us for our honor."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter, Leader of the Order of the White Shield

ONS:Riptide Chronologist.f: The wizard consulted the Riptide Project about how to further his research. He wasn't prepared for what they told him.

VIS:Knight of the Mists.f: Fear the mists, for they are armed.

CHK:Akki Coalflinger.f: No matter where you find them, goblins love rocks.

ULG:Vigilant Drake.f: Awake and awing in the blink of an eye.

STH:Sacred Ground.f:
"That which knows itself cannot be shaped to another's will."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

ALL:Soldier of Fortune.f:
"Loyalty to coin alone is loyalty nonetheless."
—General Varchild

TOR:Carrion Wurm.f: Since it eats only carrion, sometimes it needs to make some from scratch.

MMQ:Battle Squadron.f: The goblins made an unruly pile with military precision.

PLS:Amphibious Kavu.f: Merfolk raided the shores untroubled for years . . . until the shores started fighting back.

JUD:Filth.f:
"As the portal closed, Filth oozed through. The stench of evil followed it in."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

INV:Aggressive Urge.f: The power of the wild, concentrated in a single charge.

NEM:Seal of Fire.f:
"I am the romancer, the passion that consumes the flesh."
—Seal inscription

PLS:Daring Leap.f: Most warriors think in only two dimensions. Agnate and his metathran brethren were trained to battle in three.

VIS:King Cheetah.f:
If you find yourself and a friend being chased by a King Cheetah, you have but one chance: Trip your friend.
—Suq'Ata wisdom

P02:Monstrous Growth.f: The nightstalkers' little game of tease-the-squirrel suddenly took an unexpected turn.

P02:Goblin War Cry.f:
"Goblins cry, soldiers fly.
Stones fly, soldiers die!"

CHK:Seshiro the Anointed.f: His family was the first to reach out to the human monks. He soon knew as many koans as he did blade strikes.

INV:Aura Mutation.f:
"Life can be found in all things, even things unnatural."
—Multani, maro-sorcerer

USG:Reclusive Wight.f: There are places so horrible that even the dead hide their faces.

SOK:Kiku's Shadow.f:
"Me? No, I'm not going to kill you. I won't even lay a finger on you. I promise."
—Kiku, Night's Flower

ONS:Daunting Defender.f: "I will wield the stone of my homeland as though it were the fists of the Ancestor."

ALL:Pillage.f:
"Were they to reduce us to ash, we would clog their throats and sting their eyes in payment."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

CHK:Dance of Shadows.f: "Only one man survived, barely sane. He got out two words before collapsing: shadows' shadows."

ULG:Multani's Presence.f: When a tree falls in the forest, Multani hears it.

MMQ:Lightning Hounds.f: Quick enough to avoid jhovalls when alone and fierce enough to attack them in packs, the hounds were as at home in the mountains as the Mercadians were atop theirs.

TMP:Trumpeting Armodon.f: These are its last days. But it will not go quietly.

POR:Gorilla Warrior.f: They were formidable even before they learned the use of weapons.

DRK:Savaen Elves.f: "Purity of magic can only come from purity of the land. How can a meal nourish if the ingredients are spoiled?" —Sidaine of Savaen

5DN:Mana Geyser.f: The Quicksilver Sea hissed and bubbled at the indignity. The Vulshok shaman just smiled.

P02:Blaze.f:
"This isn't what I meant by 'facing the heat of battle!'"
—Jefan, Talas ship captain

TMP:Frog Tongue.f: "But *why* can't I get one?" sniveled Squee. "All da bugs here got wings."

MRD:Leonin Sun Standard.f: The commander tells the troops where to go, but the standard reminds them why they're there.

HML:Koskun Keep.f: Treachery and anarchy make poor partners.

NEM:Seal of Doom.f:
"I am the banisher, the ill will that snuffs the final candle."
—Seal inscription

INV:Urborg Phantom.f: A chilling fog with teeth of ice.

EXO:Medicine Bag.f:
"My medicine bag and I have treated countless wounds and illnesses. But never have I seen so many made so sick for so long. We will *never* eat Squee's cooking again."
—Orim, journal

ATQ:Gaea's Avenger.f: After the destruction of Argoth, Gaea was willing to instill a portion of her own powers into some of her more vengeful followers.

SOK:Ebony Owl Netsuke.f:
"Owls filled the skies during the Kami War, harbingers of darker times to come."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

BOK:Kaijin of the Vanishing Touch.f: When it's finished, all that's left of you is a ripple on a still pond.

WTH:Urborg Justice.f:
"It is a narrow line between justice and vengeance."
—Crovax

FEM:Icatian Lieutenant.f: To become an officer, an Icatian Soldier had to pass a series of tests. These evaluated not only fighting and leadership skills, but also integrity, honor, and moral strength.

TMP:Spinal Graft.f:
"This one has not screamed enough to show effective implantation. Kill it."
—Volrath

ULG:Cessation.f:
"The face of Light will shine upon them, and they will know war no more."
—*Song of All*, canto 918

VIS:Suleiman's Legacy.f: With Suleiman's ascension to power, the djinn and efreets of ancient Rabiah learned humility.

MRD:Tel-Jilad Archers.f: They are extensions of the Tangle, stretching its vines into the furthest reaches of the sky.

MIR:Reflect Damage.f:
From you to me, so me to you.
—Femeref children's taunt

MIR:Ekundu Griffin.f:
"My goat was a small price to pay for the chance to see the hunting griffin dive and seize it."
—Pashad ibn Asim, Suq'Ata trader

WTH:Odylic Wraith.f: By the time you've seen it, you won't remember that you did.

TOR:False Memories.f:
"My enemies will forget everything but their anguish."
—Ambassador Laquatus

APC:Helionaut.f: Hope kept the defenders aloft, but only courage kept them in the fight.

POR:Djinn of the Lamp.f: Once they learn the trick of carrying their own lamps, they never touch the ground again.

TMP:Cloudchaser Eagle.f:
When the eagle catches a cloud, it tears it into strips that fall to earth.
—Vec myth of the rains

TMP:Fevered Convulsions.f:
"Tell me again why you failed to capture Gerrard, you worthless pile of spine."
—Volrath, to Greven

ONS:Aphetto Grifter.f: Aphetto con artists started working in pairs to make it less likely they'd be the victims of con artists.

EXO:Rootwater Alligator.f: Subduing and skinning an alligator is the first rite of maturity adolescent merfolk must pass.

MIR:Disempower.f:
"Mangara is gone. Who among you doubts that I have taken his power?"
—Kaervek

ALL:Storm Shaman.f:
"Embrace the storm. Its voice shall echo within you, and its fire shall become your touch!"
—Lovisa Coldeyes,
Balduvian Chieftain

APC:Planar Despair.f: All of Dominaria recoiled as Yawgmoth and his retainers arrived.

EXO:Mana Breach.f: The wizard had it all—until she tried to use it.

ONS:Goblin Sledder.f: "Let's play 'sled.' Here's how it works: you're the sled."

ICE:Zuran Orb.f:
"I will go to any length to achieve my goal. Eternal life is worth any sacrifice."
—Zur the Enchanter

CHK:Journeyer's Kite.f:
"From the clouds, you can see as far as the distant horizon. It's a reminder of the infinite possibilities of everyday life."
—Noboru, master kitemaker

MRD:Sculpting Steel.f: An artificer once dropped one in a vault full of coins. She has yet to find it.

5DN:Beacon of Tomorrows.f: To look into its light is to meet the gaze of history.

INV:Juntu Stakes.f:
"Those who can't survive are of no consequence."
—Tsabo Tavoc

APC:Phyrexian Rager.f: It takes no prisoners, but it keeps the choicest bits for Phyrexia.

CHK:Eerie Procession.f:
"Though in years past speculation was not encouraged about the strange ways of kami, now we must understand their motivations, if such is even possible to the mortal mind."
—Lady Azami

MMQ:Arrest.f: Orim had no memory of the previous night—the first thing she could remember was waking up with the dead guard's blood on her hands.

VIS:Desolation.f:
"Kill a creature, destroy the present. Kill the land, destroy the future."
—Kaervek

STH:Samite Blessing.f:
Knit bone, darn flesh, Stitch skin, weave breath.
—Samite healing ritual

BOK:Scaled Hulk.f:
"Say, what rhymes with 'run for your lives'?"
—Ku-Ku, akki poet

SCG:Ancient Ooze.f: The ooze has always been. The ooze will always be.

DST:Drill-Skimmer.f: In close proximity, their magnetic energies merge and form a field of protection.

INV:Nomadic Elf.f: "I've journeyed across Dominaria. Phyrexians are everywhere. Plague is everywhere. There's no place left to hide."

ULG:Rivalry.f: The goblins revered it; the viashino defended it. Only Urza understood it.

LGN:Defiant Elf.f: "I lost one home when Yavimaya was destroyed. I will not lose another."

USG:Grafted Skullcap.f:
"Let go your mind. Mine is fitter."
—Gix, Yawgmoth praetor

MIR:Mist Dragon.f:
"Across the plains, farmers who braved the mists began to vanish. Most blamed the goblins; none guessed the truth."
—Hakim, Loreweaver

ICE:Fyndhorn Elves.f:
"Living side by side with the Elves for so long leaves me with no doubt that we serve the same goddess."
—Kolbjörn, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

WTH:Psychic Vortex.f:
"Tolaria floats upon a wheel of fortune."
—Ertai, wizard adept

PLS:Warped Devotion.f:
"Before the glory of Yawgmoth, yes, even this makes sense."
—Urza, to Gerrard

ONS:Syphon Soul.f: As Phage drank their energy, a vague memory of Jeska stirred. Then she lost herself again in the joy of her victims' suffering.

ICE:Jokulhaups.f:
"I was shocked when I first saw the aftermath of the Yavimaya Valley disaster. The raging waters had swept away trees, bridges, and even houses. My healers had much work to do."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran Priest

ONS:Whipcorder.f: His bolas whirl like galaxies, but it's his enemies who see stars.

MMQ:Haunted Crossroads.f: It seemed as if no one wanted them to reach the Henge of Ramos—not even the dead.

ICE:Sunstone.f:
"I dispute Relicbane's hysterical allegations, Commissioner, but it is true that these artifacts can be dangerous."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

TMP:Harrow.f: Changing Rath's landscape is like tearing the scab from a wound.

DRK:Living Armor.f: Though it affords excellent protection, few don this armor. The process is uncomfortable and not easily reversed.

LEG:Flash Counter.f:
"She grinned at me—a wicked grin. 'I hope you weren't relying too heavily on that, my dear.'"
—Medryn Silverwand, *Diary*

SOK:Ronin Cavekeeper.f: The akki were surprised to encounter a human who could fight in the caves as well as they.

CHK:Untaidake, the Cloud Keeper.f: Untaidake is the needle that weaves the fabric of creation.

CHK:Honden of Life's Web.f: To the sorrow of all, its web became a net that strangled those who helped weave it.

MMQ:Volcanic Wind.f: The Cho-Arrim call it "the fury of Ramos."

PCY:Abolish.f: As war raged on, the young mages became more direct in their tactics, often at great cost.

PTK:Yellow Scarves Troops.f: Over 500,000 commoners followed Zhang Jue, General of Heaven, in his attempt to overthrow the corrupt Han dynasty.

ONS:Doomed Necromancer.f:
"His sacrifice shall not be forgotten. Now toss his body over there with the others."
—Phage the Untouchable

DST:Tangle Spider.f: They're considered good luck by the elves they don't eat.

USG:Elvish Herder.f: Before Urza and Mishra came to Argoth, the herders prevented their creatures from stampeding. During the war, they encouraged it.

PCY:Blessed Wind.f:
"The fourth wind of ascension is Anointer, deifying the worthy."
—*Keld Triumphant*

ODY:Mirari.f:
"It offers you what you want, not what you need."
—Braids, dementia summoner

ONS:Weird Harvest.f: Krosa's distorted groves bear strange fruit.

P02:Dark Offering.f:
"Our greatest hope has become our enemy's greatest triumph."
—Restela, Alaborn marshal

MRD:Hematite Golem.f: Centuries before the first peaks of the Oxidda Chain rewrote the laws of magnetism, the golems patrolled Mirrodin's featureless surface unhindered.

ICE:Lim-Dûl's Cohort.f:
"Join me in the place of power, you risen dead. Join me where the waters weep and the trees have no hearts."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

ODY:Aether Burst.f: As fleeting as a cephalid's promise.

MMQ:Cloud Sprite.f: The delicate sprites carry messages for Saprazzans, but they refuse to land in Mercadia City's filthy markets.

ARN:Army of Allah.f: On the day of victory no one is tired. —Arab proverb

INV:Maniacal Rage.f: "Remember me?" Tahngarth roared. "Now I'll repay you for my stay on Rath!"

MRD:Icy Manipulator.f: A model of Mirrodin in both shape and spirit.

HML:Memory Lapse.f:
"Um . . . oh . . . what was I saying?"
—Reveka, Wizard Savant

TMP:Manakin.f: Hanna regarded Squee sternly. "Because it's *not* a toy, no matter how much it may look like one," she said, taking the manakin from him.

WTH:Llanowar Behemoth.f:
"Most people can't build decent weapons out of stone or steel. Trust the elves to do it with only mud and vines."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

MRD:Steel Wall.f:
"We sculpt the land into what we need—homes, armament, fortresses of war. Our strength comes not only from knowing, but from *commanding* the terrain."
—Raksha Golden Cub, leonin kha

ODY:Whipkeeper.f: "If you don't hit your adversaries while they're down, they might get up again."

2ED:Savannah Lions.f: The traditional kings of the jungle command a healthy respect in other climates as well. Relying mainly on their stealth and speed, Savannah Lions can take a victim by surprise, even in the endless flat plains of their homeland.

5DN:Wayfarer's Bauble.f: It is the forest beyond the horizon, the mountain waiting to be climbed, the new land across the endless sea.

MMQ:Cho-Manno, Revolutionary.f:
"Mercadia's masks can no longer hide the truth. Our day has come at last."
—Cho-Manno

MIR:Jolt.f:
"There's nothing like a sudden shock to clarify one's thoughts."
—Pashad ibn Asim, Suq'Ata trader

HML:Clockwork Gnomes.f:
"Until I came to the Floating Isle, I never had to oil the servants."
—Baki, Wizard Attendant

TMP:Repentance.f: "The cannon wasn't aimed at you!" pleaded Vhati. "I'm not sure which is more pathetic," replied Greven, "your judgment or your aim."

ONS:Silvos, Rogue Elemental.f: He was born of the Mirari, thrust out of his homeland before he was even aware. Left without purpose or meaning, he found both in the pits.

PTK:Control of the Court.f: "Power-hungry eunuchs, the curse of the dynasty, have thrown the masses of the people into the depths of misery."

MIR:Political Trickery.f:
"Politics is a game—move a stone here, move a stone there—except sometimes the stones bleed."
—Shauku, Endbringer

NEM:Flowstone Overseer.f: The rebels couldn't see where the roar was coming from. Then they saw it was coming from everywhere.

POR:Wall of Swords.f: Sharper than wind, lighter than air.

5DN:Composite Golem.f: It binds the five suns in human form.

5DN:Sylvok Explorer.f: Any creature on a druid's shoulder is his family, any land under his feet his home.

WTH:Sage Owl.f: The owl asks but never answers.

ICE:Fyndhorn Pollen.f:
"I breathed deeply, and suddenly I knew not who or where I was."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, Elvish Hunter

STH:Hermit Druid.f: Seeking the company of plants ensures that your wits will go to seed.

POR:Armored Pegasus.f: Asked how it survived a run-in with a bog imp, the pegasus just shook its mane and burped.

UDS:Thran Dynamo.f: Urza's metathran children were conceived, birthed, and nurtured by an integrated system of machines.

USG:Dark Ritual.f:
"From void evolved Phyrexia. Great Yawgmoth, Father of Machines, saw its perfection. Thus the Grand Evolution began."
—*Phyrexian Scriptures*

USG:Yawgmoth's Edict.f:
"Phyrexia's purity permits no other."
—Xantcha, Phyrexian outcast

ULG:Fog of Gnats.f: You can swat a thousand gnats, but a thousand more will assail you.

APC:Bog Gnarr.f: Not all of Dominaria's defenders were nourished by the light.

INV:Noble Panther.f: Unlike many hunters, these panthers have no need for camouflage. They're fast enough to catch any prey.

ICE:Mind Whip.f:
"A mind in agony is a sparrow without wings."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

SCG:Titanic Bulvox.f: With natural laws abandoned, excess thrives.

MIR:Granger Guildmage.f:
Leave no mouth agape, no stomach unfilled.
—Granger Guild maxim

MMQ:Brawl.f: Anything can happen when patience is scarce and wine is abundant.

MMQ:Moment of Silence.f: The silence commemorates not those who've died, but those about to.

ODY:Nantuko Disciple.f:
Unanswered prayers are themselves answers.
—Nantuko teaching

MIR:Cloak of Invisibility.f:
"Useful . . . if you can find it."
—Pashad ibn Asim, Suq'Ata trader

MRD:Rustmouth Ogre.f: It has an iron stomach. Literally.

USG:Annul.f: The most effective way to destroy a spell is to ensure it was never cast in the first place.

VIS:Prosperity.f:
"Wealth is a good thing, compared to poverty—your food is better, your robes are softer, and your companions have bathed more recently."
—Kipkemboi, Kukemssa pirate

USG:Disorder.f:
"Then, just when the other guys were winnin', the sky threw up."
—Jula, goblin raider

ULG:Blessed Reversal.f: Even an enemy is a valuable resource.

WTH:Boiling Blood.f:
Your father has no horns!
Your mother wears a bell!
You drink the milk of goats!
—Talruum taunts

TMP:Rampant Growth.f: Rath forces plants from its surface as one presses whey from cheese.

STH:Sword of the Chosen.f: One shard of Selenia yet remained.

NEM:Voice of Truth.f:
"Above them all is Truth, and Truth must be set free. If the wings of Truth are clipped, the voices will fall silent."
—*Song of All*, canto 167

NEM:Mogg Salvage.f: Three moggs, one treasure, too bad.

HML:Root Spider.f:
"They're not half as fierce if they don't see you coming."
—Devin, Faerie Noble

MRD:Living Hive.f: In its center is a single red ant, a queen that regulates the hive's movements.

ONS:Foothill Guide.f: "Like any pests, goblins must be repelled quickly or they multiply."

MIR:Incinerate.f:
"Never taunt an embermage, 'What are you going to do about it?'"
—Akin, seasoned askari

CHK:Soul of Magma.f:
"In every other mind, the battle was lost. General Takeno alone was not touched by despair. Drawing his blade, he was attack and rallying cry in one."
—*Battle of Akagi River: A Survivor's Tale*

CHK:Ashen-Skin Zubera.f: When the Honden of Night's Reach began to crumble, its attendants swarmed Kamigawa to haunt mortal dreams.

TOR:Hydromorph Guardian.f: In front of every strong leader is a pool of loyal bodyguards.

LGN:Aven Envoy.f: Their grieving faces tell far more than a list of casualties ever could.

SOK:Inner Calm, Outer Strength.f: The ghostly objects around the kami circled faster and faster, creating a dizzying cyclone of motion. When it opened its eyes, it struck.

HML:Folk of An-Havva.f:
"There are those who accept being told what to do, what to think, and what to say. Then there are the Folk of An-Havva."
—Reyhan, Samite Alchemist

FEM:Zelyon Sword.f: No sheath shall hold what finds its home in flesh.

LGN:Skirk Outrider.f: Once the goblins thought about it, they preferred being atop a slateback to being in front of, behind, or underneath one.

USG:Scoria Wurm.f: Late at night, ululations echo from deep under Shiv, as the wurms sing of times older than humanity.

VIS:Teferi's Honor Guard.f:
"They may seem ceremonial, but their swords are still sharp."
—Kipkemboi, Kukemssa pirate

SCG:Rain of Blades.f: Some say they are the weapons of heroes fallen in battle, eager for one last chance at glory.

EXO:Dauthi Jackal.f:
"All Dauthi are jackals, regardless of breed."
—Lyna, Soltari emissary

MIR:Pearl Dragon.f:
"They knew Bantau was lost when, to hide the pearl he had found on the beach, he swallowed it—and soon grew wings."
—Hakim, Loreweaver

VIS:Helm of Awakening.f:
"This little prize will cover your head, your spells, your bets, and your behind!"
—Pashad ibn Asim, Suq'Ata trader

PTK:Peach Garden Oath.f:
"We three, though of separate ancestry, join in brotherhood . . . . We dare not hope to be together always but hereby vow to die the selfsame day."
—Peach Garden Oath

DST:Demon's Horn.f: Its curve mimics the twists of life and death.

MMQ:Iron Lance.f:
"The only way to get Mercadians to fight on the front lines is to give them really long weapons."
—Gerrard

TMP:Ghost Town.f:
"The air here smells like a grave."
—Crovax

APC:Soul Link.f: They danced like puppets to a tune only Yawgmoth could hear.

TMP:Coiled Tinviper.f: The bite of the tinviper feels most like a razor drawn across the tongue.

MRD:Disarm.f: "Be thankful I left you your clothes."

ONS:True Believer.f: So great is his certainty that mere facts cannot shake it.

BOK:Three Tragedies.f:
"As the kami passed over the village of Mita, the inhabitants relived their three most grievous tragedies. Some cried. Some raged. Some were driven to madness. But the next morning, none possessed the will to fight."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

INV:Troll-Horn Cameo.f:
"I found a troll-horn fragment in the wooded foothills of Hurloon, and it keeps growing larger. I wonder, is the horn recreating itself or the troll?"
—Isel, master carver

MRD:Welding Jar.f: The wires crawl over broken metal and heat themselves to melting, filling cracks quickly and efficiently.

POR:Skeletal Snake.f: They watched as the snake shed layer after layer until only cold bone remained.

HML:An-Havva Constable.f:
"Joskun and the other Constables serve with passion, if not with grace."
—Devin, Faerie Noble

MIR:Sewer Rats.f:
You lie down with rats, and the rats run away.
—Suq'Ata insult

5DN:Auriok Windwalker.f: Each generation, a handful of Auriok girls are allowed to visit the Cave of Light. They return riding the wind and brandishing steel.

ICE:Giant Growth.f:
"Here in Fyndhorn, the goddess Freyalise is generous to her children."
—Kolbjörn, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

WTH:Fungus Elemental.f:
I rot growth and grow rot. What am I?
—Elvish riddle

MRD:Tower of Fortunes.f: The ur-golem etchings begin by celebrating Mirrodin's creator, a golem of almost limitless power. They end by cursing its protector, a being called Memnarch.

TOR:Stern Judge.f: "How to punish the guilty is up to the Ancestor. Deciding who merits such punishment is up to me."

CHK:Kami of Fire's Roar.f:
"I can hear the shamans chanting in the hills. They say their magic will protect us from the kami, that our gold has bought our safety. But no one sleeps soundly tonight."
—Scroll fragment from the ruins of Reito

MMQ:Kris Mage.f: Her blade draws blood without ever touching its target.

MMQ:Darting Merfolk.f: You might as well try to catch water with a net.

STH:Volrath's Stronghold.f: The seed of a world's evil.

TMP:Flailing Drake.f: Too many choices will always distract a greedy beast.

ULG:Burst of Energy.f:
"I stand ready to die for our world. Who will stand with me?"
—Radiant, archangel

WTH:Straw Golem.f:
"Don't look at me. *I* didn't build it."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

JUD:Grip of Amnesia.f:
"Would you abandon your past to save your future?"
—Ambassador Laquatus

CHK:Counsel of the Soratami.f: "Wisdom is not the counting of all the drops in a waterfall. Wisdom is learning why the water seeks the earth."

MMQ:Cave-In.f: One fleet was gone; others were poised.

UDS:Kingfisher.f: It's tastiest when served with the fish it stole.

ULG:Impending Disaster.f:
"The goblins are in charge of maintenance? Why not just set it on fire now and call it a day?"
—Whip Tongue, viashino technician

CHK:Nine-Ringed Bo.f:
"We received an anonymous letter suggesting that Kumano holds a secret to defeating the kami, but he is nowhere to be found."
—General Takeno, letter to Lord Konda

JUD:Wonder.f:
"The awestruck birds gazed at Wonder. Slowly, timidly, they rose into the air."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

POR:Bog Wraith.f: It moved through the troops leaving no footprints, save on their souls.

ATQ:Urza's Avenger.f: Unable to settle on just one design, Urza decided to create one versatile being.

VIS:Song of Blood.f: Purraj sang slaughter and danced death.

MRD:Lumengrid Warden.f: The Neurok, like the vedalken, are on a constant quest for knowledge. It is their currency, their trade, their life.

ODY:Pardic Swordsmith.f: A finely crafted blade will never meet as many blows on the battlefield as it did on the anvil.

SOK:Gaze of Adamaro.f: Wherever it looked, it saw destruction—the wake of its own gaze.

LEG:Hyperion Blacksmith.f:
"The smith a mighty man is he/ With large and sinewy hands./ And the muscles of his brawny arms/ Are strong as iron bands."
—Henry Wadsworth Longfellow, The Village Blacksmith

BOK:Kami of False Hope.f:
"Across the rift of battle, a bridge of gossamer. And for one moment, it holds."
—Snow-Fur, kitsune poet

DST:Shunt.f: "You might want to work on your aim."

TMP:Angelic Protector.f:
"My family sheltered in her light, the dark was content to wait."
—Crovax

MIR:Sandbar Crocodile.f:
"We've run aground sandbars before, but today, a sandbar ran aground us."
—Kipkemboi, Kukemssa pirate

POR:Giant Octopus.f: At the sight of the thing the calamari vendor's eyes went wide, but from fear or avarice none could tell.

USG:Argothian Elder.f:
Sharpen your ears
—Elvish expression meaning "grow wiser"

STH:Lowland Basilisk.f: Unlike their cousins, Rathi basilisks turn their victims into puddles of flowstone.

5DN:Raksha Golden Cub.f: Some believe that Raksha, youngest of the kha, is the reincarnation of Dakan, the first and mightiest of leonin leaders.

ONS:Elvish Vanguard.f: "Our lives are woven together like the trees' branches over our heads, forming a canopy that protects us all."

PCY:Alexi's Cloak.f:
"Doesn't look like much, does it?"
—Alexi, zephyr mage

POR:Foot Soldiers.f: Infantry deployment is the art of putting your troops in the wrong place at the right time.

ALL:Noble Steeds.f:
"Only an animal born in the wild has sufficient heart to be a true Knight's steed."
—King Darien of Kjeldor

LEG:Kasimir the Lone Wolf.f: Popular indeed is the tale of how Kasimir was once a Holy man who renounced his order to take up the sword. But this tale is no more likely than any other.

INV:Wallop.f: In Yavimaya, flying low to join a battle can be a costly mistake.

INV:Crosis's Attendant.f: "Crosis is the eye of the ur-dragon, piercing illusion and darkness."

ODY:Concentrate.f: "The treasure in my mind is greater than any worldly glory."

USG:Hidden Ancients.f: The only alert the invaders had was the rustling of leaves on a day without wind.

EXO:Equilibrium.f: In Rath, there are only so many souls to go around.

JUD:Defy Gravity.f: Magical or not, it's still a cloud.

PTK:Taunting Challenge.f: Incensed by their opponents' unrelenting taunts, even wise generals were known to rashly lead their troops into battle—often to disastrous defeats.

DST:Oxidda Golem.f: The longer it patrols the smoldering crags of the Oxidda Chain, the more it adopts their fiery temper.

CHK:Soratami Seer.f: Their mirrors show two worlds: that which is and that which should be.

STH:Wall of Tears.f:
"Many have been lost to pity."
—Karn, silver golem

CHK:Honden of Cleansing Fire.f: To the sorrow of all, its fire was turned toward those who worshipped it.

MIR:Afterlife.f: Facets of life, reflections of the soul.

INV:Mourning.f: Barrin waited for the nausea to pass or for Urza to say something else. He waited in vain.

PTK:Zodiac Dragon.f: ". . . The kingdoms three are now the stuff of dream, / For men to ponder, past all praise or blame."

ICE:Clairvoyance.f:
"As we followed the ice wall, we had the distinct feeling of being watched. Many of the party wanted to turn back."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

SOK:Sunder from Within.f: Trapped for eons within the sacred gong, the kami boomed and clanged to a deafening tempo as they destroyed their erstwhile prison.

FEM:High Tide.f:
"When the very tides turn against you, it's time to consider retirement."
—General Khurzog

EXO:Thalakos Drifters.f: They drift in and out of shadow and ever on toward madness.

CHK:Stone Rain.f:
"The kami struck with gouts of fire, showers of rock, and the combined rage of the spirit world. Only Eiganjo Castle remained standing, glistening untouched in the sun."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

ATQ:Weakstone.f: During the brothers' childhood, Tocasia took them to explore the sacred cave of Koilos. There, in the Hall of Tagsin, Mishra discovered the mysterious weakstone.

MMQ:Deadly Insect.f: With his newfound sense of self-importance, Squee set his sights on ever-bigger bugs.

USG:Carrion Beetles.f: It's all fun and games until someone loses an eye.

ONS:Spurred Wolverine.f: After a few painful experiences, goblins learned not to pick their noses around the beasts.

TMP:Flowstone Giant.f:
When the first of these giants woke from the bedrock, he was still sleepy. He yawned and stretched until his legs grew so thin that they snapped like icicles in the sun.
—Vec lore

NEM:Stronghold Discipline.f:
"Crovax never passes up an opportunity to cause widespread misery."
—Belbe

EXO:Wood Elves.f: Secure in the embrace of wood, they want no part of Eladamri's war.

USG:Hopping Automaton.f: Designed to carry equipment across rivers, the hopping automaton was soon pressed into service in the infantry.

ICE:Sibilant Spirit.f:
"Relax. I'm sure it's just a snake hissing."
—Avram Garrisson, Leader of the Knights of Stromgald

LEG:Gwendlyn Di Corci.f: Urborg became the final resting place of many swordsmen of renown, their steel outmatched by the wiles of Gwendlyn.

EXO:Death's Duet.f: Life has always been a dance. It is only fitting that death sing the tune.

P02:Alaborn Musketeer.f: Muskets gave the Alaborn army an advantage it had long lacked—air defense.

MMQ:Rishadan Port.f: Rishada is the gateway to free trade—but the key will cost you.

ICE:Gravebind.f: One foot in the grave, firmly planted.

SCG:Aven Farseer.f: His enemies' trickery and deceit only fuel his righteous anger.

USG:Rain of Salt.f: Here, rain does not wash the land; it desiccates it.

USG:Destructive Urge.f: Red sky at night, dragon's delight.

MMQ:Venomous Breath.f: The dryads need neither size nor strength to defeat their enemies in battle.

LEG:Cyclopean Mummy.f: The ritual of plucking out an eye to gain future sight is but a curse that enables the living to see their own deaths.

MMQ:Venomous Dragonfly.f: A pretty little death is still death.

ICE:Jester's Cap.f:
"Know your foes' strengths as well as their weaknesses."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

MRD:Neurok Spy.f: From the murk of Mephidross to the heart of Kuldotha, the vedalken send their servants forth to gather knowledge from every inch of Mirrodin.

USG:Parasitic Bond.f:
"All bonds are parasitic. Only rulership is pure."
—Gix, Yawgmoth praetor

ONS:Backslide.f: Some things are better left unknown.

APC:Phyrexian Gargantua.f: Other Phyrexians have nightmares about the gargantua.

INV:Shivan Harvest.f:
"The blood of your ancestors ran heavy on this soil. Now it's your turn to sacrifice for the glory of Shiv."
—Viashino heretic

UDS:Yavimaya Hollow.f: For all its traps and defenses, Yavimaya has its havens, too.

EXO:Grollub.f: Mogglings caught in a misdeed often blame the grollub. Even though the creature is usually innocent, no taskmaster can resist an excuse to beat it.

5DN:Moriok Rigger.f: The Moriok scavenge for weapons, for armor, for food—and ultimately for their souls.

MRD:Lumengrid Sentinel.f: The vedalken order their Neurok sentinels to watch over the shores of the Quicksilver Sea, as if they know of intruders yet to come.

DST:Wurm's Tooth.f: A wurm knows nothing of deception. If it opens its mouth, it plans to eat you.

ICE:Gaze of Pain.f: Remove the guardians to ensure your victory.

JUD:Wormfang Turtle.f: Chainer's admirers keep his dreams alive.

USG:Phyrexian Ghoul.f: Phyrexia wastes nothing. Its food chain is a spiraling cycle.

P02:Armored Galleon.f:
"Information equals profits. Our merchants sell it, or our pirates use it."
—Jefan, Talas ship captain

POR:Sacred Nectar.f:
"For he on honey-dew hath fed,
And drunk the milk of Paradise."
—Samuel Taylor Coleridge, "Kubla Khan"

2ED:Frozen Shade.f:
"There are some qualities—some incorporate things,/ That have a double life, which thus is made/ A type of twin entity which springs/ From matter and light, evinced in solid and shade."
—Edgar Allan Poe, "Silence"

STH:Skyshroud Archer.f: In Rath, arrows are guided not by virtue but by necessity.

MIR:Burning Shield Askari.f:
"Any day that I ride my horse up to my ankles in the remains of my enemies is a good day."
—Akin, seasoned askari

NEM:Seal of Removal.f:
"I am the unraveler, the loosened thread that will not hold."
—Seal inscription

MMQ:False Demise.f: "Go down there and fish him out. Maybe his hide will fetch a price."

SCG:Skulltap.f:
"Finally, a use for that head of yours."
—Braids, dementia summoner

TOR:Vengeful Dreams.f: Teroh dreams of his enemies' doom.

NEM:Blinding Angel.f: "Their eyes will shrivel and blacken before faith's true light."

MMQ:Devout Witness.f: The Cho-Arrim fought Mercadia's decadence with more than just swords.

ODY:Nantuko Mentor.f:
That which grows without roots cannot be uprooted.
—Nantuko teaching

P02:Talas Scout.f:
"Scouting a battle before you fight it is just good business."
—Jefan, Talas ship captain

POR:Grizzly Bears.f: Don't worry about provoking grizzly bears; they come that way.

TOR:Insist.f:
"Finesse is no match for brute force."
—Seton, centaur druid

ODY:Mystic Visionary.f: "The aven are heralds of divinity. The greatest glory is to join them in the sky."

ONS:Convalescent Care.f: Enlightenment comes most swiftly at life's end.

ICE:Vibrating Sphere.f:
"Unearthly and invisible fibers emanate from this sphere, entangling all who draw near."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

LEG:Kobold Overlord.f: "One for all, all for one; we strike first, and then you're done!" —Oath of the Kobold Musketeers

UDS:Disease Carriers.f: Rath is a disease all its inhabitants carry.

ULG:Crawlspace.f: The goblins did not understand their attraction to the mana rig. They simply knew it was where they belonged.

USG:Jagged Lightning.f: The pungent smell of roasting flesh made both mages realize they'd rather break for dinner than fight.

MMQ:Rishadan Footpad.f: "The best things in life are free. Money, for instance."

MIR:Viashino Warrior.f:
"When traveling the Great Desert avoid wearing the scales of lizards, for the Viashino rule the sands and look poorly on the skinning of their cousins."
—*Zhalfirin Guide to the Desert*

USG:Peregrine Drake.f: That the Tolarian mists parted for the drakes was warning enough to stay away.

UDS:Ancient Silverback.f: The Phyrexian killing machines couldn't have known the seriousness of their mistake in wounding the ape—they'd never seen it angry.

USG:Wizard Mentor.f: Although some of the students quickly grasped the concept, the others could summon only blackboards.

MIR:Flame Elemental.f: Storyteller: By my hand in the fire, this story is a tale of power. Listeners: May it give you strength.

VIS:Goblin Swine-Rider.f:
"May you get the mount you deserve."
—Suq'Ata curse

PTK:Wu Admiral.f: The Wu kingdom's well-trained admirals were integral to the Southlands' victory at Red Cliffs as well as the kingdom's defense.

BOK:Stream of Consciousness.f:
"All things return to their beginnings. The waters that spill across the Kamitaki Falls flow to sea, only to be returned to her as the rain that joins the mighty river."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

LGN:Berserk Murlodont.f:
"The harder we press forward, the harder Krosa pushes us back."
—Aven scout

ICE:Scaled Wurm.f:
"Flourishing during the Ice Age, these Wurms were the bane of all Kjeldorans. Their great size and ferocity made them the subject of countless nightmares—they embodied the worst of the Ice Age."
—*Kjeldor: Ice Civilization*

MIR:Tidal Wave.f: When mountains ride the sea, waves live upon the fields.

PCY:Rhystic Shield.f: A shield for one is good. A shield for everyone is even better.

STH:Shifting Wall.f:
"You'd almost think Volrath doesn't want me here."
—Gerrard

SCG:Forgotten Ancient.f: Its blood is life. Its body is growth.

VIS:Flooded Shoreline.f:
"Some say the sea is jealous of the land and wishes to climb its heights to meet the sky."
—Afari, *Tales*

POR:Charging Rhino.f: A rhino rarely uses its horn to announce its charge, only to end it.

DST:Machinate.f: As long as there are questions to be asked, the vedalken will ask them.

SCG:Dragonspeaker Shaman.f: "We speak the dragons' language of flame and rage. They speak our language of fury and honor. Together we shall weave a tale of destruction without equal."

SOK:Seek the Horizon.f:
"I've seen this great land from every angle. I know its every tree, stone, and river bend. Yet I have come to realize that knowing a thing is not the same as healing it."
—Diary of Azusa

ATQ:Urza's Tower.f: Urza always put Tocasia's lessons on resource-gathering to effective use.

DST:Angel's Feather.f: If taken, it cuts the hand that clutches it. If given, it heals the hand that holds it.

PTK:Coercion.f: Though he held the title of prime minister, Cao Cao used the emperor's name to exert his own influence on the empire.

WTH:Sawtooth Ogre.f: "You will sharpen your teeth on my enemies' bones," Maraxus promised them, and his ogres cheered.

POR:Craven Giant.f:
"The best armor is to keep out of range."
—Italian proverb

BOK:Heartless Hidetsugu.f: Hidetsugu held over a dozen oni in blood oath. At his touch, rocks scorched. At his word, cities burned.

INV:Annihilate.f:
"Whatever Yawgmoth marks, dies. There is no escape."
—Tsabo Tavoc, Phyrexian general

INV:Drake-Skull Cameo.f:
"A strange skull was turned up by an Ephran farmer's plow. I traded a copper ring for the 'ox skull.' It resonates of the sea and danger."
—Isel, master carver

USG:Outmaneuver.f:
"Push one goblin into sight, an' run a lot. That's tactics."
—Jula, goblin raider

MMQ:Ceremonial Guard.f:
"These guards are the most disciplined military unit in the city. They couldn't fight their way out of a broom closet, but they've got discipline."
—Gerrard, to Sisay

APC:Smash.f:
"They're ugly, and they're in my way."
—Tahngarth

5DN:Vulshok Sorcerer.f: Vulshok sorcerers train by leaping into electrified storm clouds. Dead or alive, they come back down with smiles on their faces.

ODY:Pardic Miner.f: "Punch and drag, Toss the slag, Sift the soil, Leave the spoil."

ALL:Agent of Stromgald.f:
"The Order of Stromgald spreads its poisonous lies from within Varchild's troops, and still she sees only visions of conquest."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

PCY:Rhystic Circle.f: The circle buys time—an important commodity in battle.

TMP:Ranger en-Vec.f:
"The path of least resistance will seldom lead you beyond your doorstep."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

MIR:Shaper Guildmage.f:
Shape this world in Zhalfir's image.
—Shaper Guild maxim

INV:Viashino Grappler.f:
"They've returned for the mana rig, but it no longer belongs to them."
—Viashino bey

PCY:Rhystic Cave.f:
"All mages dip into the same well; some are just in more of a hurry."
—Alexi, zephyr mage

DST:Echoing Truth.f: A single lie unleashes a tide of disbelief.

MMQ:Ferocity.f:
"You lot go on ahead. I'll keep killing them until it sticks."
—Tahngarth

SCG:Goblin Brigand.f: After the Skirk Ridge collapsed, the goblins erected a system of ropes and pulleys to hold up what was left.

INV:Blurred Mongoose.f:
"The mongoose blew out its candle and was asleep in bed before the room went dark."
—Llanowar fable

ONS:Gratuitous Violence.f: Only the Cabal could make a fight to the death more deadly.

ULG:Intervene.f:
"At first I simply observed. But I found that without investment in others, life serves no purpose."
—Karn, silver golem

HML:Leaping Lizard.f:
"I never question the Autumn Willow about her motives, not even when she turns people into Lizards. It's her way."
—Devin, Faerie Noble

MIR:Crystal Golem.f:
"Once, a wealthy king commissioned an artificial creature to be crafted from the royal treasury, thinking it a clever ploy to have the jewels guard themselves."
—Azeworai, "The Golem's Wish"

TMP:Mogg Squad.f: As they crept into the *Weatherlight*'s hold, the squad leader held up his hand and whispered, "Stop, goblins—what's that sound?"

ICE:Hallowed Ground.f:
"On this site where Kjeld's blood was spilled, let none raise a fist or deny a beggar."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran Priest
