HML:Anaba Shaman.f:
"Few master the powers of the earth as well as do the Shamans of the Minotaurs."
—Baki, Wizard Attendant

MIR:Sunweb.f:
"There is no sweeter music than the wails of a dying dragon."
—Rashida Scalebane

LEG:Part Water.f:
". . . and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left."
—Exodus, 14:22

ICE:Whalebone Glider.f:
"It's no Ornithopter, but then I'm no Urza."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

MIR:Divine Offering.f:
"Suq'Ata believe in trade; Femeref, alms; Zhalfirins, steel. Be warned, Kaervek—now we are joined."
—Sidar Jabari

USG:Show and Tell.f: At the academy, "show and tell" too often becomes "run and hide."

TMP:Heartwood Giant.f: Wind in the trees is soothing, but the same can't be said for trees on the wind.

ONS:Cabal Archon.f: "You are weak. I am strong. The protocol is obvious."

ATQ:Drafna's Restoration.f: Drafna, founder of the College of Lat-Nam, could create a working model from even the smallest remnants of a newly unearthed artifact.

MIR:Fetid Horror.f:
"Of the six who went down the Uuserk Trail to scout ahead, one returned. She clawed at her eyes and nostrils and sobbed with horror. I was curious about what she saw, but we chose another path."
—Scout Ekemet, final journal

MRD:Raise the Alarm.f: "The nim raid our homes without warning. We must defend our homes without hesitation."

EXO:Plated Rootwalla.f:
" . . . And the third little boar built his house out of rootwalla plates . . . ."
—Skyshroud children's story

ONS:Sage Aven.f: From their mountain aeries, aven scholars see far more than the distant horizon.

VIS:Triangle of War.f: The Zhalfirin war triangle represents a trinity of might, faith, and guile.

ODY:Molten Influence.f: Lavamancers make simple requests: obey or die.

CHK:Sachi, Daughter of Seshiro.f: "The warriors deal in poison and fangs. We shamans remember why our ancestors crawled with their bellies to the earth."

LGN:Starlight Invoker.f: The Mirari glows in her eyes.

ATQ:Grapeshot Catapult.f: For years scholars debated whether these were Urza's or Mishra's creations. Recent research suggests they were invented by the brothers' original master, Tocasia, and that both used these devices.

PLS:Stormscape Familiar.f: Each Stormscape apprentice must hand-raise and train an owl before attaining the rank of master.

ODY:Traumatize.f: Dreads had half a mind to leave.

HML:Dwarven Sea Clan.f:
"No dwarf alive can best one of my crew dead."
—Zeki, Reef Pirate

LGN:Lavaborn Muse.f:
"Her voice is disaster, painful and final."
—Matoc, lavamancer

FEM:Night Soil.f: Some said killing the Thallids only encouraged them.

STH:Mulch.f: Hope is the one crop that can grow in any climate.

2ED:Prodigal Sorcerer.f: Occasionally a member of the Institute of Arcane Study acquires a taste for worldly pleasures. Seldom do they have trouble finding employment.

ONS:Spined Basher.f:
"How cute. Does it do any other tricks?"
—Braids, dementia summoner

ODY:Aven Archer.f: Aimed by the eyes of eagles, their arrows never miss the mark.

SOK:Inner-Chamber Guard.f:
"It seems that each time I visit Lord Konda his guards are more on edge, perhaps even more eager for the war to reach them."
—Masako the Humorless

PTK:Empty City Ruse.f: Out of time and options, Kongming was forced to bluff at Xicheng. He tricked an army of 150,000 Wei by leaving the city gates open and calmly playing the zither.

ONS:Riptide Biologist.f: "I gave it two choices: life in the lab or death in the hunt."

FEM:Thrull Champion.f:
"Those idiots should never have bred Thrulls for combat!"
—Jherana Rure

ARN:King Suleiman.f:
"We made tempestuous winds obedient to Solomon . . . And many of the devils We also made obedient to him."
—The Qur'an, 21:81

DST:Darksteel Gargoyle.f: The ultimate treasure is one that guards itself.

SOK:Reverence.f:
"Despite the massive forces that allied against him, Konda never once believed he would lose the Kami War."
—Masako the Humorless

JUD:Swirling Sandstorm.f: As dust swept out, vultures swept in.

JUD:Funeral Pyre.f:
"Raze the body. Raise the soul."
—Mystic elder

ICE:Wind Spirit.f:
"To visit the sky requires bravery, and thought, and little else. To master the sky requires the binding of *its* masters, and little else."
—Arnjlot Olasson, Sky Mage

PCY:Spiketail Drake.f: "The spell will have to wait," said Alexi, pointing up. "Drakes."

HML:Dwarven Trader.f:
"Their definition of 'fair profit' is certainly novel."
—Reveka, Wizard Savant

VIS:Man-o'-War.f:
"Beauty to the eye does not always translate to the touch."
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

ODY:Braids, Cabal Minion.f: "Home is where you can find a decent graveyard and strangers can disappear without awkward questions."

MRD:Auriok Steelshaper.f: They put their safety in his hands. He puts sharpened steel in theirs.

HML:Chandler.f:
"Never brag about the latest wonder you've created, students. Chandler might be listening."
—Reveka, Wizard Savant

PTK:Fire Ambush.f: "With fire he broke the battle at Bowang . . . . Striking fear deep into Cao Cao's soul, thus Kongming scored a coup at his debut."

APC:Shield of Duty and Reason.f: The duty: to defend. The reason: to survive.

MMQ:Kyren Sniper.f: Kyren goblins always act behind the scenes—even in battle.

LEG:Shimian Night Stalker.f: "'Tis now the very witching time of night,/ When churchyards yawn and hell itself breathes out/ Contagion to this world." —William Shakespeare, Hamlet

ODY:Thought Eater.f: The first memory it sucks out of its host is how to get rid of it.

ICE:Leshrac's Rite.f:
"Bind me to thee, my soul to thine. I am your servant and your slave. I shall hunger for your word and thirst for your blessing. Blood for blood, flesh for flesh, Leshrac, my lord."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

USG:Pit Trap.f: Yotian soldiers were designed to fight, not watch their feet.

ULG:No Mercy.f:
"We had years to prepare, while they had mere minutes."
—Kerrick, sleeper agent

MRD:Second Sunrise.f: The bright tunnel sometimes leads back to life.

ULG:Weatherseed Elf.f: "My grandmother once told me the future of our world was inside the Weatherseed. When I touched it, I knew she was right."

INV:Scavenged Weaponry.f: "The Phyrexians have progressed," admired Urza. "Their parts are interchangeable."

PLS:Exotic Disease.f:
"Do not fear death. I shall release you from the eternal bonds and bring you glory."
—Lord Dralnu

POR:Blinding Light.f: Let the unjust avert their faces and contemplate their peril.

STH:Megrim.f: "You can run from your pain," explained Gerrard to Crovax, "but take it from experience: you will tire before it does."

APC:Jungle Barrier.f: A massive pull of mana caused all of Dominaria to pause—Multani had transplanted Yavimaya to Urborg's edge.

PTK:Trip Wire.f: Trip wire, hooked poles, and sunken pits were commonly used to unhorse riders during the Three Kingdoms period.

TMP:Darkling Stalker.f:
"In this dark place, yes, I *am* afraid of my own shadow."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

2ED:Drudge Skeletons.f: Bones scattered around us joined to form misshapen bodies. We struck at them repeatedly—they fell, but soon formed again, with the same mocking look on their faceless skulls.

ICE:Dark Ritual.f:
"Leshrac, my liege, grant me the power I am due."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

LEG:Lifeblood.f:
"Foolish wizard! As you tap the power of your lofty keep, so grows my strength."
—Malvern Xelionos, *Letters*

VIS:Cloud Elemental.f:
"You know you've angered the gods when the clouds turn against you."
—Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*

TMP:Altar of Dementia.f:
"It is not that you will go mad. It is that you will beg for madness."
—Volrath

PLS:Confound.f: "Did I know Szat would betray us?" Urza asked quizzically. "I was counting on it."

ICE:Mistfolk.f:
"Although my official log will state there is no evidence pointing to the existence of the Mistfolk, my certainty is lessened by the cursed consistency of the expedition's eyewitness accounts."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

MIR:Early Harvest.f:
"Tonight we'll eat a farewell feast. Cold corn porridge is not enough. / Let's peel papayas, pineapples, and mangoes, drink coconut milk, / and bake bananas."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

POR:Spotted Griffin.f: When the cat flies and the bird stalks, guard your horses carefully.

BOK:Loam Dweller.f:
"You know its mood by the plants that spring up around it. When it is placid, fields of lilies flow in its wake; when it is angry, every stem has a thorn."
—Isao, Enlightened Bushi

INV:Searing Rays.f:
"This is a battle of pawns, for the highest stakes imaginable."
—Urza

PTK:Cao Ren, Wei Commander.f: Cao Cao's cousin, Cao Ren was known throughout the three kingdoms as the fiercest of warriors.

ODY:Steamclaw.f:
"There's dead, and then there's *dead* dead."
—Steamclaw driver

USG:Persecute.f:
"My finest warrior was lost to the Phyrexians. I pray that Lady Selenia died honorably."
—Radiant, archangel

HML:An-Zerrin Ruins.f:
"The An-Zerrins have served me well, ever since I first killed them."
—Baron Sengir

MMQ:Territorial Dispute.f: Bit by bit, Mercadia City had forced the Cho-Arrim from their ancestral lands. They would be pushed no further.

PTK:Slashing Tiger.f:
"Unless you enter the tiger's lair, you cannot get hold of the tiger's cubs."
—Sun Tzu, *Art of War* (trans. Giles)

ICE:Thunder Wall.f:
"The Lemures had barely taken wing when the sky roared with thunder. The swarm of little beasts wavered, divided, and fell, crashing to the earth."
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox

SOK:Kagemaro's Clutch.f: The mist was thick, cloying, and constricting. Shiro fought his way to fresh air only to look back and see his comrades fallen on the battlefield behind him.

CHK:Cut the Tethers.f:
"You cannot bar the path of gods. You can only divert their journey for a while."
—Sensei Hisoka

MRD:Psychic Membrane.f: The vedalken always put their best thought forward.

JUD:Seedtime.f:
The hippo grows wings to fight the condor.
—Nantuko teaching

BOK:Minamo's Meddling.f: Like storm water through the segments of bamboo, the spell followed the links of magic. Then it destroyed them.

TMP:Gerrard's Battle Cry.f: Gerrard grinned and drew his sword. "This won't be a fair fight," he called to his crew. "They should have brought a second ship!"

ODY:Chamber of Manipulation.f: Politics is just a subtle form of mind control—and cephalids are master politicians.

LGN:Crypt Sliver.f:
"Death couldn't contain the slivers. What made us think we could?"
—Riptide Project researcher

ICE:Meteor Shower.f:
"Eenie, meenie, minie, moe . . . oh, why not all of them?"
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

PCY:Spur Grappler.f: Grapplers hunt in packs, driving their victims over steep mountain cliffs.

EXO:Culling the Weak.f:
"The blood of the weak shall be the ink with which we scribe great Yawgmoth's glorious name."
—Stronghold architect, journal

FEM:Brassclaw Orcs.f:
"The large brass claws worn by some Sarpadian Orc tribes were among the least feared weapons ever known."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

ULG:Subversion.f: Kerrick's corrupt domain swelled like a blister on Tolaria's skin.

CHK:Time of Need.f:
"When the kumo attacked the monks' sacred shrine, a mournful toll for help echoed through the forest. Thus began the Battle of Silk, which would last six years."
—*Great Battles of Kamigawa*

MRD:Auriok Bladewarden.f: The Auriok have learned through constant struggle that allies are more precious than water.

MIR:Talruum Minotaur.f:
Don't insult a Talruum unless your mount is swift.
—Suq'Ata saying

USG:Telepathy.f:
"The most disappointing thing about learning telepathy is finding out how boring people really are."
—Teferi, fourth-level student

APC:Bloodfire Colossus.f: It took all its strength to contain the fire within.

ONS:Aven Soulgazer.f: "Every question has a proper answer. Every soul has a proper place."

HML:Irini Sengir.f:
"That cruel being brings shame to all her fellow Dwarves and misery to all the land. She is Sengir's daughter in spirit if not in blood."
—Reveka, Wizard Savant

SOK:Rushing-Tide Zubera.f: Cut off from the kakuriyo by the destruction of their honden, the zubera sought new ways to bring their secrets home.

HML:Baron Sengir.f:
"Beast. Defiler. The source of all my pain."
—Ihsan's Shade

PLS:Allied Strategies.f: Each commander looked at the others and wondered who would be first to break the alliance.

MIR:Mtenda Herder.f:
"All animals—even humans—can be herded. The trick is to make them think they choose their own destination."
—Mangara

USG:Turnabout.f: The best cure for a big ego is a little failure.

LGN:Branchsnap Lorian.f: Lorians treat trees and prey the same way: by ripping them limb from limb.

CHK:The Unspeakable.f: It is madness that drives men to seek forbidden knowledge, and madness has given it form.

MRD:Tel-Jilad Stylus.f: Etched on Tel-Jilad's trunk is an entire history of Mirrodin—except for an expanse near the ground scrubbed smooth by an unknown hand.

SCG:Goblin Psychopath.f: The destruction he causes is nothing next to the chaos in his mind.

INV:Crypt Angel.f: Once an angel, now an abomination.

VIS:Wake of Vultures.f:
"So the vulture said to the griffin, 'You gonna eat that?'"
—Azeworai, "The Ugly Bird"

VIS:Inspiration.f:
"Madness and genius are separated only by degrees of success."
—Sidar Jabari

PTK:Zodiac Goat.f: ". . . Near death in Baidi, having reigned three years, / Bei sadly placed his son in Kongming's care. . . ."

CHK:Honden of Night's Reach.f: To the sorrow of all, its dark reach grasped and crushed those who guarded its silent vigil.

INV:Dueling Grounds.f: "You think you can stop me?" hissed Tsabo. "I think I can kill you," replied Gerrard.

ICE:Maddening Wind.f:
"It is Freyalise, walking on the world."
—Kolbjörn, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

ODY:Balshan Griffin.f: It helps to have an extra direction in which to run.

SCG:Kurgadon.f: When it walks through Krosa, trees step aside, leaves take wing, and the ground shudders.

MRD:Wanderguard Sentry.f: Created by the vedalken to guard Lumengrid, the drones' empty eyes look beyond the Quicksilver Sea.

EXO:Spellshock.f: A snap of fingers, a snap of teeth.

PTK:Zodiac Pig.f: ". . . Zhong Hui and Deng Ai next led armies west: / And to the Cao, Han's hills and streams now passed. . . ."

EXO:Cunning.f:
". . . Dry-walkers die
We feed on sweet flesh . . . ."
—*Rootwater Saga*

HML:Wall of Kelp.f:
"Ya can eat it or ya can weave it, but ya can't fight in it."
—Zeki, Reef Pirate

LGN:Riptide Mangler.f: It wants you to be its chum.

ULG:Purify.f:
"Our Mother! The sky was Her hair; the sun, Her face. She danced on the grass and in the hills."
—*Song of All*, canto 23

WTH:Volunteer Reserves.f:
"I'm always a little leery of anyone who offers to kill other people for free."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

JUD:Krosan Wayfarer.f:
"The Krosan Forest lives, and druids are its seeds."
—Seton, centaur druid

USG:Endless Wurm.f: Ages ago, a party of elves took cover to let one pass. They're still waiting.

ALL:Ritual of the Machine.f:
"Rumors persist of dark deeds performed in the depths of Soldev. When will Dagsson heed the danger therein?"
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic

HML:Dwarven Pony.f:
"I hear Halina's got a pony that can count to six—and likes to eat meat."
—Chandler

5DN:Avarice Totem.f: Souls and steel, the essence of Mirrodin. Memnarch lacks one but has an abundance of the other.

LEG:Darkness.f: "If I must die, I will encounter darkness as a bride,/ And hug it in my arms." —William Shakespeare, *Measure for Measure*

BOK:Frostling.f: Its bite will take off more than a toe.

ICE:Despotic Scepter.f:
"We were not meant to have such terrible things. They should be left where we found them, if not destroyed!"
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic

MRD:Deconstruct.f: "Nothing in this world, not even magic, likes to be caged."

SOK:Captive Flame.f: "Kills and cooks your food in one easy stroke."

FEM:Thelonite Monk.f:
"As the climate worsened, some Thelonites turned to fertilizing with fresh blood in an attempt to keep Havenwood alive and growing."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. III*

TOR:Cabal Ritual.f:
"Each syllable chills your veins. Each word rattles your mind."
—Cabal Patriarch

5DN:Qumulox.f: Even the clouds bend themselves to Memnarch's will, eager to swallow those who oppose him.

POR:Ardent Militia.f: Some fight for honor and some for gold, but the militia fights for hearth and home.

PCY:Troubled Healer.f: "Which is worse: nothing to defend, or no one to defend it?"

USG:Shower of Sparks.f: The viashino had learned how to operate the rig through trial and error—mostly error.

PLS:Ertai's Trickery.f: "Don't worry, Gerrard," said Ertai. "I'm sure the crew will come to your rescue as quickly as they came to mine."

PLS:Alpha Kavu.f: Kavu leaders instinctively protect their herds from harm.

INV:Hooded Kavu.f: The spread of its hood eclipses all hope.

DST:Mephitic Ooze.f: In Mephidross, refuse doesn't last long—it's all scavenged, reanimated, or consumed.

PCY:Steal Strength.f: With each grunt of pain from Haddad, Greel's grin widened.

ALL:Lim-Dûl's High Guard.f:
"Death does not prevent us from service to our absent master. As long as Tresserhorn stands, so shall we."
—Chaeska, Keeper of Tresserhorn

HML:Dry Spell.f:
"Wherever water is lacking, all things suffer."
—Autumn Willow

POR:Wind Drake.f:
"No bird soars too high, if he soars with his own wings."
—William Blake, *The Marriage of Heaven and Hell*

VIS:Diamond Kaleidoscope.f:
"A pretty toy. Now show me its tactical applications."
—Telim'Tor

PLS:Shriek of Dread.f: When Crosis roared, the battle ended and the slaughter began.

VIS:Tempest Drake.f:
"Its speed will be equaled only by the swiftness of my enemy's fall."
—Kaervek

USG:Fecundity.f: Life is eternal. A lifetime is ephemeral.

INV:Lightning Dart.f: Broken and punctured by dozens of Phyrexian portals, the angry sky began to spit lightning back at the world.

MIR:Psychic Transfer.f:
"The memory of your existence will fade like the final stars of morning."
—Kaervek

ODY:Anarchist.f: Those who will not follow are doomed to lead.

WTH:Empyrial Armor.f:
"An angel appeared in the smoldering skies above the fray, her clothes as flames, her armor as fire."
—"Hymn of Angelfire"

NEM:Spiteful Bully.f: Like most creatures bent on total destruction, they rarely bother to double-check their targets.

MMQ:Rushwood Dryad.f: Rushwood is a living jewel that reflects its dwellers' hearts.

DRK:Scarwood Goblins.f: Larger and more cunning than most Goblins, Scarwood Goblins are thankfully found only in isolated pockets.

ALL:Carrier Pigeons.f:
"Birds know no borders! Why, then, should we?"
—General Varchild, in a missive to King Darien of Kjeldor

2ED:Verduran Enchantress.f: Some say magic was first practiced by women, who have always felt strong ties to the land.

MRD:Leaden Myr.f: The Moriok saw the myr as fellow scavengers, never knowing just who the myr were scavenging for.

ODY:Minotaur Explorer.f: After the invasion devastated the Talruum and Hurloon tribes, the survivors began to search for other minotaurs.

5DN:Myr Quadropod.f: Each myr was designed to fill a specific role. This one, for example, was designed to stomp on other myr.

5DN:Hoverguard Sweepers.f: They only appear in emergencies, and emergencies never last long.

MMQ:Warmonger.f: Funny how money and war travel so well together.

POR:Symbol of Unsummoning.f:
". . . inviting the soul to wander for a spell in abysses of solitude . . . ."
—Kate Chopin, *The Awakening*

ONS:Words of Wind.f:
"Be logical in all things. Do not allow instinct or passion to cloud your mind."
—*Volume II, The Book of Insight*

PCY:Zerapa Minotaur.f: There's no difference between bone and crystal when it's piercing your throat.

USG:Veil of Birds.f: When wind marries sky, even the bride's veil sings her praises.

SOK:Locust Miser.f: "They're numerous, attack in swarms, and are always hungry. No wonder we rats hold such a kinship with them."

MMQ:Soul Channeling.f: Driven by masters more terrible than the Mercadians could imagine, the dark overseers would pay any price to keep their shipwrights working.

ONS:Aura Extraction.f: Every day, Order clerics contain as much of the Mirari's energy as possible, hoping to delay Otaria's demise.

TMP:Deadshot.f:
"Carrion! Keep your distance. My blade will come to you!"
—Crovax

ONS:Inspirit.f: "We will force the Cabal into their own pits!"

UDS:Elvish Piper.f:
From Gaea grew the world, and the world was silent. From Gaea grew the world's elves, and the world was silent no more.
—Elvish teaching

ONS:Leery Fogbeast.f: It emerges from the mists only to feed.

DRK:Sisters of the Flame.f: We are many wicks sharing a common tallow; we feed the skies with the ashes of our prey.

ODY:Blessed Orator.f: His quiet words fade into the night's chill, yet they burn into his listeners' minds with all the power of a thousand suns.

USG:Reprocess.f: Everything will find its use in Phyrexia. Eventually.

WTH:Infernal Tribute.f:
"I would not barter my soul for any of the filth that they called power. So they took it from me and damned me to solitude."
—Crovax

HML:Anaba Bodyguard.f:
"Not someone to pick a fight with, unless you're fond of pain."
—Halina, Dwarven Trader

DST:Leonin Shikari.f: Her instinct is as sharp as her blade.

ONS:Fade from Memory.f: Proper burial is a luxury Otarians can no longer afford.

WTH:Buried Alive.f:
"Is it worse to walk while dead, or to be buried alive? I have witnessed both."
—Crovax

MIR:Blistering Barrier.f:
I live without food, stand without leg, wound without force, and am harder to fight than to kill. What am I?
—Femeref riddle

USG:Raze.f: The viashino believe that the oldest mountains hate everyone equally.

CHK:Jukai Messenger.f: Dosan's monks, deep in spiritual thought, could walk through the thickest of forests without leaving a mark, even the leaves beneath their feet unaffected by their passing.

USG:Silent Attendant.f: "The answer to life should never be death; it should always be more life, wrapped tight around us like precious silks."

VIS:Quirion Ranger.f:
"Respect the earth, for it will one day be your shield and another day your blanket."
—Liefellen, Quirion exarch

ICE:Moor Fiend.f:
"Let them close the gates of Krov from dusk until dawn if they so choose. It matters not. My fiends shall yet rend their flesh from their bones."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

ICE:Fear.f:
"Even the bravest of warriors yet knows the dark clutch of fright upon his stalwart heart."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

UDS:Phyrexian Monitor.f: Being one would be an honor, if the word "honor" had any meaning in Phyrexia.

ATQ:Argothian Pixies.f: After the rape of Argoth Forest during the rule of the artificers, the Pixies of Argoth bent their magic to more practical ends.

WTH:Cone of Flame.f:
"Mine is not the warmth of compassion."
—Ertai, wizard adept

LEG:Angus Mackenzie.f: "Battles no longer served a purpose in Karakas." —Angus Mackenzie, *Diary*

NEM:Seal of Strength.f:
"I am the feeder, the morsel that revives the starving."
—Seal inscription

5DN:Magma Giant.f: Its open mouth is a furnace blast that blisters the skin. Its smoking fists are meteors that split the earth.

UDS:Thran Golem.f: Karn felt more secure about his value to Urza when he realized he didn't need regular trimming.

MRD:Fatespinner.f: No one knows what she is watching, but she never takes her eyes off it.

ODY:Chance Encounter.f: The more unlikely the victory, the more memorable the success.

ALL:Browse.f:
"Once great literature—now great litter."
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

PCY:Thresher Beast.f: It destroys everything in its path, including the path itself.

DST:Memnarch.f: In the blur between metal and flesh, Memnarch found madness.

POR:Sacred Knight.f: "No flame, no horror can sway me from my cause."

SCG:Fatal Mutation.f:
"You wear that shell as a mask. Now it's your coffin."
—Cabal cleric

ONS:Strongarm Tactics.f: "If you can't pay your gambling debts, you just might be tomorrow's main attraction at the Grand Coliseum."

INV:Wayfaring Giant.f: Its stature and stride increase with each step it takes.

LGN:Goblin Assassin.f: The more victims he kills, the more likely he is to get the right one.

PTK:Relentless Assault.f: With only 70,000 men under his command at the battle of Guandu, Cao Cao was able to defeat Yuan Shao and his 700,000.

ODY:Battle of Wits.f: The wizard who reads a thousand books is powerful. The wizard who memorizes a thousand books is insane.

ODY:Aven Smokeweaver.f: In a world still pained from burns, some are born already scarred.

POR:Stone Rain.f:
I cast a thousand tiny suns—
Beware my many dawns.

SCG:Dragonstalker.f:
"When the skies are filled with flames, the brave shall step forward to quench them."
—Order prophecy

JUD:Valor.f:
"The cracks widened, the shell crumbled, and Valor spread throughout the land."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

APC:Gerrard's Verdict.f: A heart of light and a soul of darkness cannot coexist.

ONS:Oblation.f: "A richer people could give more but they could never give as much."

PCY:Mageta the Lion.f: In the jungle of war there is always a Lion.

LEG:Sunastian Falconer.f: Sunastian has roots in both sorcery and swordplay; he has learned never to depend too heavily on the latter.

ATQ:Artifact Possession.f: Any black mage could coax a Thraxodemon to inhabit a magical device.

PTK:Desert Sandstorm.f: While pursuing the remnants of Yuan Shao's forces into the Wuhan Desert, Cao Cao was temporarily turned back by a fierce sandstorm.

INV:Charging Troll.f: They stop for nothing, not even the end of a battle.

USG:Great Whale.f:
"As a great whale dies, it flips onto its back. And so an island is born."
—Mariners' legend

5DN:Retaliate.f: The Auriok learned perseverance from their forebears. They learned justice from the leonin.

P02:Dakmor Plague.f: The tiniest cough can be deadlier than the fiercest dragon.

UDS:Multani's Decree.f:
"This is my place of power. Nothing can take root here unless I allow it."
—Multani, maro-sorcerer

P02:Volcanic Hammer.f: Fire finds its form in the heat of the forge.

FEM:Hymn to Tourach.f: Knowing the Hymn's power, the followers of Leitbur carefully guarded their pillaged transcriptions.

ONS:Defensive Maneuvers.f: "Only on the battlefield can we repay all the Order has given us."

WTH:Peacekeeper.f:
"I have always imagined my mother as such a woman, strong and wise."
—Sisay, journal

WTH:Maraxus of Keld.f:
"I have no master. I am chaos."
—Maraxus of Keld

DST:Rebuking Ceremony.f: From the Radix at the hub of the Tangle all the way out to the Edges of Forgetting, a Viridian elf's life is built around the temporary.

ULG:Rank and File.f: "Left, right, left, right . . . hmm. Okay—left, left, left, left, . . ."

UDS:Blizzard Elemental.f: Students who had seen Rayne argue with Urza were certain she had summoned it to make him seem warmer by comparison.

POR:Keen-Eyed Archers.f: "If it has wings, shoot it. If it doesn't, shoot it anyway."

POR:Nature's Ruin.f: One chill blast—the exhalation of the grave.

STH:Awakening.f:
"There are times when destiny calls forth a people and demands an action. *Now* is the time. *We* are the people. *This* is our action. Charge!"
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

5DN:Fangren Pathcutter.f:
"Tracking a fangren pack is easy. Catching up to one is fatal."
—Viridian scout

ICE:Hipparion.f:
"Someone once said that Hipparions are to Warriors what Aesthir are to Skyknights. Don't believe it."
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox

DST:Loxodon Mystic.f: As the nim storm across the plains, a lone priest stands in their path. At his silent gesture, the battle line breaks, and the tide turns.

SCG:Thundercloud Elemental.f: Some days it's better to stay inside.

5DN:Early Frost.f: Under its mists, the earth sleeps.

MMQ:Caustic Wasps.f: Even the wasp knows how to pay the magistrate his due respect.

MRD:Platinum Angel.f: In its heart lies the secret of immortality.

ATQ:Ornithopter.f: Many scholars believe that these creatures were the result of Urza's first attempt at mechanical life, perhaps created in his early days as an apprentice to Tocasia.

USG:Absolute Law.f: The strength of law is unwavering. It is an iron bar in a world of water.

MMQ:Blockade Runner.f: "I need to get back to Mercadia City," said Sisay. "We can get you there," the vizier answered. "Easily."

PCY:Wing Storm.f: A thousand wings beating as one can choke the sky itself.

MIR:Jungle Troll.f:
"You eat plants; I eat plants. You eat beasts; I eat you."
—Drulvurg, troll king

ICE:Stone Rain.f:
"May the forces that took Argoth beneath the waves never come among us again."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

ICE:Ray of Erasure.f:
"What is real can be unreal."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

MMQ:Wishmonger.f: "It's not what you ask for, but how you ask for it."

ALL:Gorilla Shaman.f:
"Each generation teaches the next that artifice is the enemy of natural order."
—Kaysa, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

MIR:Ersatz Gnomes.f:
From jungle to sea, from sea to stone, from stone to field, from field to bone. What am I?
—Zhalfirin riddle

ALL:Soldevi Digger.f:
"This ceaseless device has helped uncover marvels unreachable by mere flesh."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

INV:Crown of Flames.f:
"All my life I've fought these monsters. Today I finish that fight."
—Barrin

5DN:Leonin Squire.f:
"I may be kha, but without my soldiers, my people, I am nothing."
—Raksha Golden Cub

SOK:One with Nothing.f: When nothing remains, everything is equally possible.

ATQ:Jalum Tome.f: This timeworn relic was responsible for many of Urza's victories, though he never fully comprehended its mystical runes.

MMQ:Sustenance.f: Like the dryads, the forest itself willingly gives up some of its life for the sake of the future.

WTH:Goblin Grenadiers.f: For once, Squee realized, *he* wasn't the dumb one.

APC:Quagmire Druid.f: As the druids had devoted their lives to preserving Dominaria, so did they devote their deaths.

ULG:Gang of Elk.f: The elk is Gaea's favorite, who wears the forest on its brow.

TMP:Blood Pet.f: "You are wrong," Volrath said. "I do not hate the living. They often prove quite useful to me." And then he laughed.

INV:Angelic Shield.f:
"If only an angel's wings could shelter us all."
—Barrin

ULG:Harmonic Convergence.f: When the eternal stars align, can mere mortals resist?

CHK:Kami of the Hunt.f:
"Don't worry, Jiro. The kami would never attack us this close to home . . . . Jiro?"
—Hoto, temple guardian, last words

2ED:Wall of Brambles.f: "What else, when chaos draws all forces inward to shape a single leaf." —Conrad Aiken

LEG:Flash Flood.f: Many people say that no power can bring the mountains low. Many people are fools.

PLS:Hunting Drake.f: Even the fiercest beast will flee when faced with the possibility of becoming dinner.

ONS:Brightstone Ritual.f: Wizards fought over the stone to exploit its power. Goblins fight over it because it's shiny.

JUD:Hunting Grounds.f: In the heavy hush of Krosa, drawing on mana is like ringing a dinner bell.

ICE:Freyalise Supplicant.f:
"We have joined with the Druids of the Juniper Order. Our faith is one."
—Laina of the Elvish Council

UDS:Mark of Fury.f: Many Keldon warriors bear the mark of intentional insanity.

PCY:Greel's Caress.f: Greel's grin is far less loathsome than his touch.

ODY:Aven Fisher.f: The same spears that catch their food today will defend their homes tomorrow.

5DN:Stasis Cocoon.f: Though the grip of a golem is strong, the grip of Auriok magic is far stronger.

ICE:Balduvian Conjurer.f:
"The very lands of Balduvia are alive."
—Arna Kennerüd, Skyknight

BOK:Mending Hands.f:
"I can staunch their blood, mend their flesh, and knit their bones. But I cannot restore their hope."
—Tender-Hand, kitsune healer

INV:Angel of Mercy.f:
"In times like these, people need to be reminded of compassion."
—Sisay

HML:Reef Pirates.f:
"Corpses for crew don't sit well with me. Zeki and his dead ship had best keep their distance."
—Joskun, An-Havva Constable

ALL:Elvish Spirit Guide.f:
"We are never without guidance, if we but seek it."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, Elvish Hunter

ALL:Nature's Blessing.f:
"Be open to the blessings, whatever their form."
—Kaysa, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

ICE:Goblin Snowman.f:
"Strength in numbers? Right."
—Ib Halfheart, Goblin Tactician

5DN:Beacon of Creation.f: A chorus of life heralds the arrival of Mirrodin's final sun.

CHK:Eight-and-a-Half-Tails.f: "Virtue is an inner light that can prevail in every soul."

CHK:Order of the Sacred Bell.f: "Our bodies are weak compared to those of the kami, our knowledge limited, and our magic poor. Yet we draw breath. That alone is reason to hope."

JUD:Erhnam Djinn.f: He provides a safe path to nowhere.

STH:Hidden Retreat.f: After an hour in the hidey-hole, Squee seriously pondered the advantages of danger over boredom.

NEM:Flowstone Thopter.f: Airborne flowstone isn't less dangerous, only less common.

MIR:Mind Harness.f: Centuries ago, Mangara won the loyalty of the Quirion not by ruling their minds but by supporting their independence.

WTH:Shadow Rider.f: In its world of complete darkness, it has no shadows to fear.

ODY:Nantuko Elder.f:
Plant a field with wishes, and you will grow more wishes.
—Nantuko teaching

ARN:Bird Maiden.f:
"Four things that never meet do here unite
To shed my blood and to ravage my heart,
A radiant brow and tresses that beguile
And rosy cheeks and a glittering smile." —*The Arabian Nights*, trans. Haddawy

ULG:Defense Grid.f:
"We've managed to keep the goblins in their assigned areas, but there's little we can do about the smell."
—Whip Tongue, viashino technician

BOK:Gnarled Mass.f:
"On the fifty-seventh day of the Battle of Silk, the bell again tolled in hopes of summoning mortal aid. This time, a new breed of kami rose to answer its call."
—*Great Battles of Kamigawa*

USG:Tolarian Winds.f: Afterward, Tolaria's winds were like the whispers of lost wizards, calling for life.

USG:Sanguine Guard.f:
"Father of Machines! Your filigree gaze carves us, and the scars dance upon our grateful flesh."
—*Phyrexian Scriptures*

MIR:Soulshriek.f:
"The flesh is a casket for the soul."
—Shauku, Endbringer

INV:Blind Seer.f:
"I think he sees more than he lets on."
—Gerrard

MIR:Cerulean Wyvern.f:
"Once, a Quirion asked why I was so cautious when the day was clear. I told him of the sky-blue hide of the cerluean wyvern, and he offered me double if I could conjure a strong tailwind!"
—Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*

STH:Amok.f: Crovax's rage was horrifying. Within moments only blood and shreds of flesh remained of the shapeshifter.

ICE:Ritual of Subdual.f:
"That which does not bend to the will of Freyalise shall surely break."
—Kolbjörn, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

USG:Mishra's Helix.f: The helix was the finest example of Mishra's campaign strategy: if he couldn't have Argoth, no one could.

WTH:Bloodrock Cyclops.f:
"He's big an' dumb an' ready to fight. A lot like ol' Hornhead here."
—Squee, goblin cabin hand, scouting report

ICE:Staff of the Ages.f:
"We found this staff useful on our visit to this very commission. Would Relicbane prefer we had been slain by Lim-Dûl's horrors?"
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

MIR:Shimmer.f:
To buy unseen land, pay in unseen coin.
—Suq'Ata maxim

LGN:Goblin Grappler.f: Daru soldiers learned it's better to have a clean death from a sharp blade than to tangle with a goblin's rusted chains.

PTK:False Defeat.f:
"All warfare is based on deception."
—Sun Tzu, *Art of War* (trans. Giles)

5DN:Tyrranax.f: It outnumbers you one to many.

MMQ:Corrupt Official.f: His favor comes at a high price.

UDS:Marker Beetles.f: In case of emergency, crush bug.

2ED:Royal Assassin.f: Trained in the arts of stealth, the royal assassins choose their victims carefully, relying on timing and precision rather than brute force.

MIR:Searing Spear Askari.f: When the other soldiers of Zhalfir fall, the askaris will yet stand.

APC:Evasive Action.f: Effective use of terrain is a lesson good commanders learn quickly.

MRD:Rustspore Ram.f: Where herds have passed, the dented ground is lined with piles of rust.

ICE:Aegis of the Meek.f:
"With this marvel, even the weak have a fighting chance!"
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

USG:Symbiosis.f: Although the elves of Argoth always considered them a nuisance, the pixies made fine allies during the war against the machines.

USG:Faith Healer.f: The power of faith is quiet. It is the leaf unmoved by the hurricane.

LEG:Al-abara's Carpet.f: Al-abara simply laughed and lifted one finger, and the carpet carried her high out of our reach.

MMQ:Primeval Shambler.f: His mind, like his body, is made up of the swamp's flotsam.

ULG:Peace and Quiet.f:
"In time our realm will shine again. But it will gleam only when we scour away the taint of doubt."
—Radiant, archangel

CHK:Midnight Covenant.f:
"Not all mortals fought the kami. The ogres revered the oni, while some humans made pacts based upon empty promises."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

ICE:Wall of Pine Needles.f: The power of the forest takes a hundred forms. Some are more surprising than others.

MMQ:Lumbering Satyr.f:
The satyr carves the path that all of Rushwood follows.
—Cho-Arrim saying

MMQ:Rishadan Airship.f: The view is truly spectacular—as long as you don't look at Rishada itself.

MIR:Mystical Tutor.f:
"To the tutors, a 'poem of sand' was of little account, a 'poem of ivory,' priceless."
—Afari, *Tales*

P02:Tidal Surge.f: Four little goblins, trapped by the sea. One teased a serpent, and then there were three.

MRD:Seat of the Synod.f: Lumengrid, site of the Knowledge Pool, source of vedalken arcana.

JUD:Earsplitting Rats.f: Rats come in one amount: too many.

TOR:Grim Lavamancer.f: "Fools dig for water, corpses, or gold. The earth's real treasure is far deeper."

ALL:Yavimaya Ants.f:
"Few natural forces are as devastating as hunger."
—Kaysa, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

5DN:Tangle Asp.f:
"I have no fangs, yet I constantly bite. I have no scales, yet I slither through you. What am I?"
—Riddle of the viper's venom

ONS:Akroma's Vengeance.f: Ixidor had only to imagine their ruin and Akroma made it so.

CHK:Soratami Cloudskater.f: "You hide your actions from eyes on the ground, but nothing escapes the clouds."

ULG:Might of Oaks.f: Suddenly, she couldn't see the acorns for the trees.

STH:Victual Sliver.f: "We are kinfolk," explained Karn to the sliver queen. "Just as you need your progeny to complete you, so do I need the pieces of the Legacy to make me whole."

ODY:Resilient Wanderer.f: Nomads understand many cultures and therefore travel without fear.

PTK:Eunuchs' Intrigues.f: Taking control of powerful court positions one by one, eunuchs eventually brought on the fall of the Han dynasty, leading to the chaos of the Three Kingdoms.

POR:Summer Bloom.f: Summer sends its kiss with warmth and blooming life.

USG:Stroke of Genius.f: After a hundred failed experiments, Urza was stunned to find that common silver passed through the portal undamaged. He immediately designed a golem made of the metal.

PTK:Zodiac Monkey.f: ". . . By six offensives from the hills of Qi Kongming sought to change Han's destiny. . . ."

UDS:Mental Discipline.f: Barrin drowned his doubts about Urza's project by delving ever deeper into its details.

TMP:Mogg Cannon.f: Moggs never volunteer for anything twice.

TOR:Crazed Firecat.f:
"The longer it's caged, the madder it gets."
—Firecat handler

LEG:Petra Sphinx.f: What walks on four legs in the morning, two legs in the afternoon, and three legs in the evening?

PLS:Sunken Hope.f: While Dominarians fought for their world, Rath stole it from under their feet.

DRK:Inquisition.f: Many of those entrusted to Primata Delphine's care tended to express themselves with screams.

UDS:Wall of Glare.f: The blinding barrier served Benalia better than a hundred shields.

NEM:Noble Stand.f: Soldiers will always endanger their lives to defend many other lives.

ATQ:Argivian Blacksmith.f: Through years of study and training, the Blacksmiths of Argive became adept at reassembling the mangled remains of the strange, mechanical creatures abounding in their native land.

EXO:Pandemonium.f:
"If we cannot live proudly, we die so!"
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

PCY:Ridgeline Rager.f: While armies battled across Jamuraa, beasts stalked the high places looking for victims.

VIS:Undiscovered Paradise.f: Jolrael's choice of homes was far better than her choice of allies.

SOK:Wine of Blood and Iron.f: Godo never revealed what went into his special brew, but he always had more of it after great victories.

MIR:Waiting in the Weeds.f: The trees have ears, eyes, and teeth.

VIS:Guiding Spirit.f:
"Retainer of eternal Sun! Life flash again upon thy wings."
—"Song to the Sun," Femeref song

MIR:Dark Banishing.f:
"Femeref was guided by the wisdom of the Council of Voices. But in one terrible instant, they were slain, leaving Asmira as the sole voice of leadership."
—Hakim, Loreweaver

TMP:Shatter.f:
"Such fuss over machines, Gerrard. Remember that you are the prize of the Legacy. Throw away your toys!"
—Orim, Samite healer

INV:Phyrexian Slayer.f: Benalia was only the first nation victimized by Tsabo Tavoc's specialized killers.

NEM:Complex Automaton.f:
"This wasteful design cannot possibly be Phyrexian."
—Belbe

CHK:Orochi Sustainer.f: "Nothing is the same anymore. The forests are not as lush, the waters not as pure, the air not as clear. Without the kami to direct and sustain the forces of nature, it's only a matter of time before we feel their neglect."

INV:Spirit of Resistance.f:
"Our victory must come from all of Dominaria, or it will not come."
—Urza

JUD:Suntail Hawk.f:
"Our forebears once flew like this—carefree, needing nothing but a warm nest and a full belly. Our intellect may be more burden than blessing."
—Commander Eesha

BOK:Orb of Dreams.f:
"Behind the eyelids, a flickering flame. Beneath the dream, a flickering sorrow. Can peace find you in this sleep When all the world is tossed by war?"
—Snow-Fur, kitsune poet

ODY:Whispering Shade.f: It glides through the shadows until it reaches yours.

UDS:False Prophet.f: "You lived for Serra's love. Will you not die for it?"

LEG:Torsten Von Ursus.f: "How can you accuse me of evil? Though these deeds be unsavory, no one will argue: good shall follow from them."

MRD:Dragon Blood.f: A single drop turns skin to scale and fist to claw.

ONS:Bloodline Shaman.f: Every creature of the forest has a name, and she knows them all.

TMP:Spell Blast.f: Call it the thinking mage's version of brute force.

ODY:Zombie Cannibal.f: Nothing is sacred to the undead—not even their own kind.

MIR:Vitalizing Cascade.f:
"Water is like breathing—necessary for life."
—Asmira, Holy Avenger

USG:Scald.f:
"Shiv may be surrounded by water, but the mountains go far deeper."
—Fire Eye, viashino bey

USG:Goblin Cadets.f: "If you kids don't stop that racket, I'm turning this expedition around *right now!*"

MIR:Femeref Scouts.f:
"The days before the war were filled with strange portents: scouts and herders spoke of villages reduced to ash, of farmers taken from their fields, and of foul beasts roaming the plains in packs. I know, for I spoke to them all."
—Hakim, Loreweaver

5DN:Beacon of Immortality.f: The cave floods with light. A thousand rays shine forth and meld into one.

LEG:Lost Soul.f: She walks in the twilight, her steps make no sound,/ Her feet leave no tracks on the dew-covered ground./ Her hand gently beckons, she whispers your name—/ But those who go with her are never the same.

LEG:Adun Oakenshield.f: ". . . And at his passing, the bodies of the world's great warriors shall rise from their graves and follow him to battle." —*The Anvilonian Grimoire*

TMP:Muscle Sliver.f: The air was filled with the cracks and snaps of flesh hardening as the new sliver joined the battle.

MIR:Elixir of Vitality.f:
"Eternal life or your money back."
—Unnamed Suq'Ata merchant, deceased

ODY:Treetop Sentinel.f: Crian's patrols afford him plenty of opportunity to take potshots at the "dirtwalkers" far below.

ODY:Scrivener.f: A good memory is no match for a good scribe.

PTK:Zhuge Jin, Wu Strategist.f: When Zhuge Jin proposed the marriage of Guan Yu's daugher and Sun Quan's heir, Guan Yu's arrogant refusal led to disaster.

CHK:Lava Spike.f: Some kami attacks during the war were rife with trickery, subterfuge, and subtlety, draining hope and pride from the mortal world. Other attacks were a lot more straightforward.

PTK:Wu Light Cavalry.f: A cunning strategist, Cao Ren tricked Zhou Yu by letting him enter Nanjun. Zhou Yu thought he was capturing the city until Cao Ren's arrows rained down upon him.

ODY:Pilgrim of Justice.f: "I would die a thousand deaths before I let you harm another."

UDS:Treachery.f:
"The academy educates; I employ. It's a perfect arrangement."
—Gatha, Tolarian renegade

ALL:Gorilla War Cry.f:
"The only 'art' these beasts possess is the art of noise!"
—Jaya Ballard

POR:Jungle Lion.f: The lion's only loyalty is to its hunger.

USG:Reflexes.f:
"Here's how ya win. Don't let the other guy hit back first."
—Jula, goblin raider

CHK:Ronin Houndmaster.f: Some samurai fell so far out of grace that only dogs would keep them company.

5DN:Fold into Aether.f: Æther portals drift across Mirrodin's surface, dragging creatures across time and space.

ICE:Errant Minion.f: Abandon not your faith when others abandon you.

STH:Stronghold Taskmaster.f:
"With the completion of each joyous task, we are closer to Yawgmoth's divine vision."
—Stronghold architect, journal

ULG:Goblin Welder.f: "I wrecked your metal guy, boss. But look! I made you an ashtray."

TOR:Mutilate.f:
"They appreciate my handiwork. I hear their joy in every scream."
—Chainer, dementia master

LEG:Thunder Spirit.f:
"It was full of fire and smoke and light and . . . it drove between us and the Efrafans like a thousand thunderstorms with lightning."
—Richard Adams, *Watership Down*

TMP:Pallimud.f: The old Vec tell tales of a beast that fed on scraps but turned its nose up at the lavish banquet they set in its honor.

PTK:False Mourning.f: Zhou Yu, Sun Ce, and other famous generals feigned their deaths in order to later surprise their opponents.

ICE:Mind Ravel.f: An end to reason, an end to order. Forget all that has been.

ICE:Hymn of Rebirth.f:
"There will come soft rains, and spring shall be amongst us, a welcome friend."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran Priest

NEM:Carrion Wall.f: A wall built from the bodies of the enemy will never lack building material in times of war.

INV:Rogue Kavu.f: "I know how this one feels," said Urza. "It's not like others of its kind and has been shunned for its differences."

P02:Nightstalker Engine.f: Part metal, part bone, and all death.

5DN:Night's Whisper.f: The Moriok call the black moon the Whisperer. At her apex, she whispers of power.

USG:Glorious Anthem.f: Once heard, the battle song of an angel becomes part of the listener forever.

ARN:Repentant Blacksmith.f: "For my confession they burned me with fire And found that I was for endurance made." —*The Arabian Nights*, trans. Haddawy

ALL:Whirling Catapult.f:
"Direct confrontation never was to the Orcs' taste."
—General Varchild

NEM:Stronghold Biologist.f: He twists the laws of nature until they scream.

NEM:Death Pit Offering.f:
"Kill them all and feed them to the new recruits."
—Crovax

TOR:Organ Grinder.f: It knows what makes you tick. It knows how to make the ticking stop.

MMQ:Saprazzan Raider.f: Some quick dagger work and then back to the sea—that's the Saprazzan way.

ALL:Sol Grail.f:
"Look deep into the Grail, and see there what you desire most."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

USG:Whetstone.f:
To hone swords and dull minds.
—Whetstone inscription

PTK:Ravaging Horde.f: Upon his return to the capitol after taking soldiers to loot a nearby peaceful town, the prime minister, Dong Zhou, boasted of it as a victory over bandits.

ICE:Elemental Augury.f:
"It is the changing of perception that is important."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

CHK:Deathcurse Ogre.f: After their worship of oni began, only a few of Kamigawa's ogres remained in the bitter cold of the Tendo Peaks. Most were drawn to the darkness of Takenuma.

ULG:Second Chance.f: The greatest gift is the opportunity to right one's wrongs.

MIR:Merfolk Seer.f:
The sea leaves no room for tears.
—Zhalfirin adage

ICE:Ghostly Flame.f:
"Walk slowly when in the nether world, and seek that which calls."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

BOK:Mark of the Oni.f:
"As more oni walked Kamigawa, more darkness infested its inhabitants' souls."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

USG:Wirecat.f: Its purr is the sound of iron filings sliding down satin.

MIR:Memory Lapse.f:
"The caliph was so intelligent he could not remember what he knew."
—Azeworai, "Three Riddles"

ODY:Filthy Cur.f: Some things even fleas won't bite.

MMQ:Charisma.f: It was Gerrard's nature to lead and the Mercadians' to follow.

ICE:Wall of Shields.f:
"It's the pokey bits that hurt the most."
—Ib Halfheart, Goblin Tactician

APC:Index.f: "Let's see . . . Mercadia, mercenary, merfolk . . . you know, I really need a better filing system."

MMQ:Steadfast Guard.f: The Mercadians were prepared for the guard, but the guard was even more prepared for the Mercadians.

VIS:Shrieking Drake.f:
"Kaervek believes the drakes' cries herald his victory; in truth, they mourn aloud for his impending demise."
—Teferi

ULG:Opportunity.f:
"He cocooned himself alone in his workshop for months. When he finally emerged, all broad grins and excited chatter, I knew he'd found his answer."
—Barrin, master wizard

DRK:Bone Flute.f: After the Battle of Pitdown, Lady Ursnell fashioned the first such instrument out of Lord Ursnell's left leg.

NEM:Dominate.f:
"I've come to reclaim what is mine. And you, Greven, are mine."
—Volrath

MIR:Lion's Eye Diamond.f:
Held in the lion's eye
—Zhalfirin saying meaning "caught in the moment of crisis"

WTH:Thran Tome.f: Every line holds a tale, and between lie a thousand more.

LEG:Remove Soul.f: Nethya stiffened suddenly, head cocked as if straining to hear some distant sound, then fell lifeless to the ground.

CHK:Floating-Dream Zubera.f: When the Honden of Seeing Winds was forgotten, its attendants swarmed Kamigawa to uncover mortal secrets.

PCY:Lesser Gargadon.f:
Trod on by a gargadon
—Kipamu expression meaning "wiped out"

UDS:Rescue.f:
"Urza, I've discovered more promising students than you and my husband have, combined. And I haven't lost a single one."
—Rayne, Academy Chancellor

TMP:Lightning Blast.f:
"Those who fear the darkness have never seen what the light can do."
—Selenia, dark angel

5DN:Cackling Imp.f: Its laughter drives needles through your mind.

LEG:Hell Swarm.f: The brightness of day turned in an instant to dusk as the swarm descended upon the battlefield.

USG:Priest of Gix.f:
"Gix doesn't want a people to rule but puppets to entertain his madness."
—Xantcha, Phyrexian outcast

ODY:Seton, Krosan Protector.f: "Survival of the fittest is not only the law of the pits, it is the law of nature. That is why I fight."

VIS:Simoon.f:
"The black-and-white sacred monkey holds her children to her, and waits."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

ODY:Piper's Melody.f: Those who follow nature's path eventually walk in a circle.

ICE:Illusionary Wall.f:
"Let them see what is not there and feel what does not touch them. When they no longer trust their senses, that is the time to strike."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

MRD:Disciple of the Vault.f: He stands in the shadow of his lord, Geth, drinking in the dark energies of the Vault.

DST:Viridian Acolyte.f: "We have no sun to guide our dead, so I tend the prismatic flames of the spirit fires that show the souls their way. When I die, I hope there is one left to guide my spirit home."

TMP:Bottle Gnomes.f:
"I am reminded of the fable of the silver egg. Its owner cracks it open to see what jewels it holds, only to discover a simple yellow yolk."
—Karn, silver golem

PCY:Living Terrain.f: Keldons were accustomed to rugged terrain, but they never expected it to be aggressive.

LGN:Havoc Demon.f: A cry of pain as it enters this world. A chorus of screams as it leaves.

CHK:Graceful Adept.f:
"When you have mastered my lessons, it will seem as though the whole of the world has opened up to your mind and nothing is beyond your grasp."
—Lady Azami

TMP:Pacifism.f: Frozen by conscience, Karn did not resist as the moggs carried him to the *Predator*.

ATQ:Clay Statue.f: Tawnos won fame as Urza's greatest assistant. After he created these warriors, Urza ended his apprenticeship, promoting him directly to the rank of master.

5DN:Krark-Clan Ogre.f: The Krark Clan believes it's caught an ogre. The ogre believes he's caught seven goblins.

ICE:Johtull Wurm.f:
"To bring her down we must be on all sides at once—leave one avenue open and we'll all be dead."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, Elvish Hunter

DST:Razor Golem.f: The longer it stands among the deadly blades of the Razor Fields, the more it adopts their harsh exterior.

WTH:Nature's Kiss.f:
I cradle my rage even as the earth cradles my dead kin.
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

ODY:Flame Burst.f: As hot as a dwarf's rage.

MMQ:Wild Jhovall.f: Jhovalls sharpen their claws on trees—or on Mercadians, if no trees are handy.

ICE:Soldevi Golem.f: Slow and steady wins the race.

2ED:Stone Giant.f: What goes up, must come down.

UDS:Twisted Experiment.f: Gatha showed remarkable prowess in increasing his subjects' stature. Their lifespans, however, were another matter.

MMQ:Drake Hatchling.f: There is beauty in the space between learning to fly and taking it for granted.

PTK:Sima Yi, Wei Field Marshal.f: Sima Yi fought for four generations of the Cao family before his own grandson became emperor and united the three kingdoms.

UDS:Metathran Soldier.f: Just as Serra crafted angels of light and faith, Urza constructed an army of sorcery and power to resist the coming invasion.

MMQ:Putrefaction.f:
"Do you want to be alive or whole?"
—Ta-Karnst, Cho-Arrim healer

ONS:Dive Bomber.f: "Your graves will lie beneath my final nest."

TMP:Charging Rhino.f:
"Is it wrong to go straight for what you want? Sneaking is for cats and goblins."
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

5DN:Silent Arbiter.f: Scholars say that arbiters exist on every world, created by an unknown hand to enforce justice.

TMP:Dauthi Slayer.f:
"They have knives for every soul."
—Lyna, Soltari emissary

MRD:Trolls of Tel-Jilad.f: "The secret of this world weighs upon us, and we have been shaped by time and duty to bear it."

ONS:Mobilization.f: Newcomers to Otaria find themselves at the bottom of the heap. In the pits, they at least have the chance to climb atop a heap of bodies.

TMP:Legerdemain.f: Squee tucked the warm ball in his pocket and slipped a pebble in its place. 'Glok,' he mumbled, and hid.

LGN:Cloudreach Cavalry.f: "It's easy to lose sight of hope until you gaze out from my vantage point."

MRD:Lumengrid Augur.f: Information pumps like blood through vedalken society.

INV:Elfhame Palace.f: Llanowar has seven elfhames, or kingdoms, each with its own ruler. Their palaces are objects of awe, wonder, and envy.

DRK:Orc General.f: "Your army must fear you more than the enemy. Only then will you triumph." —Malga Phlegmtooth

DRK:Worms of the Earth.f: The ground collapsed, leaving nothing but the great Worms' mucous residues.

SCG:Rush of Knowledge.f:
"Limitless power is glorious until you gain limitless understanding."
—Ixidor, reality sculptor

USG:Sandbar Merfolk.f: You are not prey until a predator knows of your existence.

P02:Alluring Scent.f: No earthly armor is protection against this sweetness.

ICE:Fyndhorn Bow.f:
"With a bow like this, the hunting is always good."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, Elvish Hunter

ONS:Jareth, Leonine Titan.f: Light's champion in the stronghold of darkness.

USG:Dromosaur.f: They say dromosaurs are frightened of dogs, even little ones. There are no dogs in Shiv. Not even little ones.

MIR:Noble Elephant.f:
"Proud am I, / strong am I, / courageous in defending my children / and fierce in punishing what stands in my way."
—"So the Elephant Speaks," Zhalfirin song

UDS:Fatigue.f: "Mind if I just lie down right here for a few weeks?"

POR:Rain of Salt.f: It pelts the land with its fury, spoiling what was once sweet.

MIR:Sacred Mesa.f:
"Do not go there, do not go / unless you rise on wings, unless you walk on hooves."
—"Song to the Sun," Femeref song

ICE:Kjeldoran Royal Guard.f:
"Honorable in battle, generous in death."
—Motto of the Kjeldoran Royal Guard

ODY:Earnest Fellowship.f:
"The world has enough strife as it is. Where would we be if we turned against each other?"
—Pianna, nomad captain

LEG:Wall of Caltrops.f: "Ow! Ow ow ow! Oooh, ow, OW!"

PCY:Citadel of Pain.f:
"Battle is our religion. This fortress is our temple."
—Latulla, Keldon overseer

USG:Exhaustion.f: The mage felt as though he'd been in the stasis suit for days. Upon his return, he found it was months.

INV:Metathran Zombie.f:
"Rise, metathran. You shall serve a nobler cause in death."
—Tsabo Tavoc, Phyrexian general

SCG:Goblin Warchief.f: They poured from the Skirk Ridge like lava, burning and devouring everything in their path.

ICE:Nature's Lore.f:
"Fyndhorn is our home."
—Kolbjörn, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

UDS:Aether Sting.f: When Gatha fell, he was called to account for each abomination he created.

USG:Gaea's Bounty.f: The forest grew back so quickly that lumbering machines were suspended in the treetops.

PLS:Ertai, the Corrupted.f: Altered by Phyrexian science, corrupted by black mana, and twisted by rage, Ertai still looked in the mirror and saw only glory.

ODY:Screams of the Damned.f: It's important to face your inner demons . . . unless they're the kind of demons that can kill you.

MMQ:Charmed Griffin.f: Are you sure you can afford such a luxury?

MMQ:Righteous Aura.f:
"There is a great difference between pain and injury."
—Cho-Manno

2ED:Mahamoti Djinn.f: Of royal blood among the spirits of the air, the Mahamoti Djinn rides on the wings of the winds. As dangerous in the gambling hall as he is in battle, he is a master of trickery and misdirection.

DRK:Banshee.f: Some say Banshees are the hounds of Death, baying to herd their prey into the arms of their master.

POR:King's Assassin.f: Fear is as effective a weapon as the blade.

MRD:Glissa Sunseeker.f: "There's a secret at the heart of this world, and I will unlock it."

2ED:Two-Headed Giant of Foriys.f: None know if this Giant is the result of aberrant magics, Siamese twins, or a mentalist's schizophrenia.

ULG:Phyrexian Debaser.f:
"The second stage of the illness: high fever and severe infectiousness."
—Phyrexian progress notes

MIR:Feral Shadow.f:
"The night stalkers are such a minor power in Urborg. Their sad eagerness to elevate themselves makes them willing tools in the plundering of little Femeref."
—Kaervek

LEG:Marhault Elsdragon.f: Marhault follows a strict philosophy, never letting emotions cloud his thoughts. No chance observer could imagine the rage in his heart.

MRD:Razor Barrier.f: "We protect our homelands. Why should they not protect us?"

DRK:Barl's Cage.f: For a dozen years the Cage had held Lord Ith, but as the Pretender Mairsil's power weakened, so did the bars.

MMQ:Ignoble Soldier.f: Cowardice is a term invented by those with no cunning.

PTK:Riding the Dilu Horse.f:
"All men have their appointed time; that's something no horse can change."
—Liu Bei, after being told that the Dilu brings its master ill fortune

PTK:Stone Rain.f: Soldiers often blocked off the steep mountain passes to ambush enemy troops in western and central China.

SCG:Guilty Conscience.f:
Those who most feel guilt don't need to, while those who most need to feel guilt never do.
—Order proverb

MMQ:Vendetta.f: Starke knew the voice was Takara's, but the venom was Volrath's.

ULG:Ghitu Slinger.f: If you survive a slinger attack, the slinger wished you to live.

PLS:Gaea's Might.f: With the Heart of Yavimaya aiding him, Multani didn't even strain at the load.

POR:Valorous Charge.f: Stand in the way of truth at your peril.

INV:Urza's Filter.f: "It's a tool for aiding my other tools," explained Urza. "Now they'll work in harmony."

WTH:Briar Shield.f: In all its forms, the forest is the elves' best protector.

ICE:Silver Erne.f:
"I've seen a larger Erne knock a Giant to the ground and stay airborne. They move not with the wind, but as the wind."
—Arna Kennerüd, Skyknight

INV:Empress Galina.f: "Above the waves you may be mighty indeed, but down here you belong to me."

ONS:Meddle.f: Strength may win the fight, but style wins the crowd.

MIR:Ashen Powder.f:
"What you call decay, I call ripening. You'll gain no sustenance from this harvest."
—Kaervek

MIR:Goblin Soothsayer.f:
"I see a great victory and rivers of blood. And . . . hmm, looks like a spleen."
—Grishnak, goblin soothsayer

ICE:Flow of Maggots.f:
"The very earth seemed alive and made a sound like the writhing of the damned."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter, Leader of the Order of the White Shield

HML:Serra Aviary.f:
"Serra, like Feroz, is long since dead. But remember, Daria: her spirit shall survive so long as the Homelands do."
—Taysir

ONS:Future Sight.f:
"My past holds only pain and loss. I will conquer it by creating the perfect future."
—Ixidor, reality sculptor

USG:Hibernation.f: On its way to the cave, the armadillo brushed by a sapling. It awoke to find a full-grown tree blocking its path.

INV:Dredge.f:
"I'd strip away the world to see what's under it, but I'd never just leave it to these Phyrexian parasites and their false god."
—Urborg witch

MIR:Hazerider Drake.f:
"The hazerider danced in the thunderstorm and sang to its music."
—Afari, *Tales*

FEM:Vodalian Knights.f: Fear the Knight leaping from the water into the air, weapon ready.

ODY:Repel.f:
"I have a hunch we'll be seeing that one again soon."
—Ambassador Laquatus

5DN:Skullcage.f: Only a focused mind can survive it.

P02:Goblin Raider.f:
"I seen lots o' fights. To win ya gotta bash hard and not get bashed back."
—Goblin grunt

PLS:Hull Breach.f: "Crovax knows we're coming now," said a grinning Sisay. "I just sent the *Predator* crashing into his stronghold."

MMQ:Fountain Watch.f: The Cho-Arrim didn't rely only on a secret location to protect their Fountain.

ICE:Sabretooth Tiger.f:
"Daughter, it is now your turn to hunt the Tiger, and make a blanket of its fur."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

TMP:Servant of Volrath.f:
"Volrath is a harsh master. My reflection is a constant reminder of that."
—Greven *il*-Vec

ICE:Illusionary Terrain.f:
"The drawing of maps is fruitless in the west near the ice walls; the very earth is formless."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

CHK:Pain Kami.f:
"All kami are our enemies now, A very tough lesson to learn. But it's one that's taken quickly, When you feel what it's like to burn!"
—Ku-Ku, akki poet

VIS:Waterspout Djinn.f:
"Fly us higher, out of its storm."
—Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*

LEG:Frost Giant.f: The Frost Giants have been out in the cold a long, long time, but they have their rage to keep them warm.

ALL:False Demise.f:
"Far too many of our missing 'dead' seem to be turning up in Varchild's ranks!"
—King Darien of Kjeldor

INV:Serpentine Kavu.f: Under Yavimaya's peaceful facade beat the hearts of many savage beasts.

ODY:Shadowblood Ridge.f: The carnage of conflicts long past still stains the Otarian soil.

ICE:Curse of Marit Lage.f:
"Our world has not felt her thundering steps in lifetimes, but Marit Lage's presence is still with us."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran Priest

ONS:Gangrenous Goliath.f: Cabal clerics don't heal the sick—they heal the dead.

MMQ:Natural Affinity.f: As long as the dryads are a part of the forest, the forest is a part of the army.

JUD:Dwarven Driller.f:
"Drill the planet, it's no trouble: Mining granite, making rubble."
—Dwarven drilling song

ONS:Dispersing Orb.f:
"Like the seas, the Æther is fickle and ever-changing. If we can control one, we can master the other."
—Riptide Project director

ODY:Magma Vein.f:
Standing near a volcano
—Barbarian expression meaning "asking for it"

MMQ:Ghoul's Feast.f: Mercadians not wealthy enough to buy a tomb are thrown into a bog called "the Ghoul's Larder."

USG:Heat Ray.f: It's not known whether the Thran built the device to forge their wonders or to defend them.

PLS:Dralnu's Crusade.f:
"Don't you agree that mogg intellects are improved by zombification?"
—Lord Dralnu

DRK:Carnivorous Plant.f: "It had a mouth like that of a great beast, and gnashed its teeth as it strained to reach us. I am thankful it possessed no means of locomotion." —Vervamon the Elder

LEG:Field of Dreams.f: Some people say that the world is round, and if you travel far enough you'll come to the other side, where everything is upside down.

LEG:Vampire Bats.f: "For something is amiss or out of place/ When mice with wings can wear a human face." —Theodore Roethke, "The Bat"

LEG:Wall of Vapor.f:
"Walls of a castle are made out of stone,/ Walls of a house out of bricks or of wood./ My walls are made out of magic alone,/ Stronger than any that ever have stood."
—Chrysoberyl Earthsdaughter, *Incantations*

STH:Dungeon Shade.f: A sickness stirs in its eyes, a nightmare born in darkened wails.

SCG:Xantid Swarm.f: When they land on you, all you can think about is tearing them off.

MMQ:Bog Witch.f: The world is the body. The mana is the blood. The witch is the surgeon.

APC:Jaded Response.f:
"Calm down everyone; it's nothing we haven't seen before."
—Sisay

EXO:Scare Tactics.f:
"Fear rules those weak enough to accept it."
—Greven *il*-Vec

JUD:Ember Shot.f: Dwarves bring poor coal to market, use good coal in their homes, and throw their best coal away.

MMQ:Maggot Therapy.f:
"If this is the cure, I'd hate to see the disease."
—Orim

ICE:Stromgald Cabal.f:
"Kjeldor must be supreme at any cost."
—Avram Garrisson, Leader of the Knights of Stromgald

PTK:Brilliant Plan.f: At Red Cliffs, Kongming and Zhou Yu each wrote his plan for defeating the Wei on the palm of his hand. They laughed as they both revealed the same word, "Fire."

PCY:Mungha Wurm.f: Cities have crumbled under its weight.

CHK:Blood Rites.f:
"The threat of the kami was made worse by the blood rituals of the ogres, who freed terrifying oni to wander Kamigawa unhindered."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

ICE:Binding Grasp.f:
"What I want, I take."
—Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran Royal Mage

MMQ:Horn of Ramos.f: Ramos touched, and there was life.

PHPR:Giant Badger.f: The wizard Greensleeves called a Giant Badger to her aid in an battle with the desert mage Karli.

ONS:Taunting Elf.f: The safety of the village depends on the beast thinking with its stomach.

INV:Tangle.f: Gaea battles rampant death with abundant life.

DST:Soulscour.f:
"I have seen the end of times, a future in which all our kind are torn from this world."
—Ushanti, leonin shaman

LGN:Stoic Champion.f: His outer calm belies his inner fury.

ODY:Mossfire Valley.f: Lush growth spreads like a ferocious blaze across the Otarian hillsides.

PTK:Poison Arrow.f: In ancient China, not wearing armor could be a fatal mistake. Guan Yu, Zhou Yu, Sun Ce, and other heros were struck by poison arrows.

ICE:Blessed Wine.f:
"May the bounty of Kjeld enrich your days."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran Priest

UDS:Plague Dogs.f: They're not just retrievers, they're carriers.

SCG:Coast Watcher.f: The aven came to fear the forest's clawing branches, but the watchers quickly renewed their courage.

CHK:Sideswipe.f: Hisoka's wizards struggled for years to master the art of redirection that came so naturally to the shamans of Ganzan Pass.

UDS:Mask of Law and Grace.f: The archangels zealously drove Serra's light into every corner of their new home as if their creator still commanded them.

CHK:Heartbeat of Spring.f:
"It is true that we monks hold the key to paradise, but most don't understand that the paradise we guard is the one within."
—Diary of Azusa

DST:Well of Lost Dreams.f: Some say the knowledge lost during the Ritual of Rebuking is returned through the well's waters.

NEM:Oraxid.f:
"I'm constantly amazed by the tenacity of living creatures on this plane. Even in the stronghold's white-hot core, life persists."
—Ertai

POR:Cruel Tutor.f: The more you pay for the lesson, the better you'll remember it.

TMP:Serene Offering.f:
"A sacrifice made in peace is worth a dozen made in panic."
—Orim, Samite healer

WTH:Cinder Wall.f:
"Easy. All ya gotta do is push somebody into it."
—Squee, goblin cabin hand, scouting report

MIR:Brushwagg.f:
"Defiantly, the young cyclops popped the brushwagg into his mouth. His cheeks suddenly puffed, his eye bulged, and he was forced to agree with his elder."
—Afari, *Tales*

LGN:Windborn Muse.f:
"Her voice is justice, clear and relentless."
—Akroma, angelic avenger

FEM:Icatian Scout.f:
"Of course I'm not a spy! The enemy has spies. I am a Scout."
—Ailis Connaut

CHK:No-Dachi.f: Not keen-edged enough for cutting armor, the no-dachi slew by folding its victim rapidly and violently under the weight of its impact.

TMP:Lotus Petal.f: "Hard to imagine," mused Hanna, stroking the petal, "such a lovely flower inspiring such greed."

ODY:Barbarian Lunatic.f:
"I once saw a single barbarian charge a band of twenty nomads. I've seen some crazy ones, too."
—Nomad sentry

UDS:Bubbling Muck.f: The muck claims a hundred living things for each meager treasure it spews forth.

TMP:Soltari Crusader.f:
"Carry war to the Dauthi, no matter the way, no matter the world."
—Soltari battle chant

ICE:Songs of the Damned.f: Not wind, but the breath of the dead.

EXO:Ravenous Baboons.f: Build something and the baboons will tear it down. Leave the pieces lying and they will scatter them.

PTK:Zodiac Snake.f: "Thrice Xuande's ardent quest led to Nanyang, / Where Sleeping Dragon unveiled Han's partition: . . ."

ALL:Errand of Duty.f:
"Call every able sword to our side. Kjeldor will stand triumphant!"
—King Darien of Kjeldor

JUD:Ray of Revelation.f: Webs of illusion unravel in the light of truth.

ATQ:Tablet of Epityr.f: Originally considered the work of Urza, this tablet was created by forgers seeking to imitate Urza's masterpieces.

ODY:Angelic Wall.f:
"The Ancestor protects us in ways we can't begin to comprehend."
—Mystic elder

USG:Elite Archers.f: Arrows fletched with the feathers of angels seldom miss their mark.

MIR:Fog.f:
"More armies have been lost in the confusion of the jungle mists than to any battle."
—Jolrael

STH:Dauthi Trapper.f: Merfolk tell their young of Dandân, humans of Rag Man. Dal tell tales of the Dauthi, and they are far worse.

JUD:Cephalid Constable.f: Cephalids don't police people. They police loyalties.

MIR:Wildfire Emissary.f:
"The efreet is a striding storm with a voice that crackles like fire."
—Qhattib, Vizier of Amiqat

INV:Andradite Leech.f:
"Older specimens are completely encrusted with gems, which serve as both armor and weapons."
—Tolarian research notes

DRK:Brainwash.f: "They're not your friends; they despise you. I'm the only one you can count on. Trust me."

ICE:Goblin Mutant.f: If only it had three brains, too.

POR:Phantom Warrior.f: The phantom warrior comes from nowhere and returns there just as quickly.

PTK:Sun Quan, Lord of Wu.f: "One score and four he reigned, the Southland king: / A dragon coiled, a tiger poised below the mighty Yangtze."

EXO:Mind Over Matter.f:
Lyna turned to the figure beside her. "They're gone. What now?"
"As ever," said Urza, "we wait."

MIR:Gravebane Zombie.f:
"A zombie's bed must be a lumpy one or he wouldn't leave it so often."
—Rana, Suq'Ata market fool

ALL:Veteran's Voice.f:
"Teach by example. If your students do not survive, they were not worth the lesson."
—General Varchild

PTK:Zhou Yu, Chief Commander.f:
"After making me, Zhou Yu, did you have to make Kongming?"
—Zhou Yu crying to heaven on his deathbed

MIR:Withering Boon.f:
"Life for life: this is the immutable law."
—Panya, Granger Guildmage

JUD:Keep Watch.f: "I see their moral dilemmas. I see their raw courage. I see their self-sacrifice. I see our victory."

USG:Hollow Dogs.f: A hollow dog is never empty. It is filled with thirst for the hunt.

MIR:Shauku's Minion.f:
"My minions serve me in the light; I serve no one."
—Shauku, Endbringer

PTK:Wei Strike Force.f: At the battle of Chang'an, Ma Chao defeated the two generals Cao Cao sent to guard the pass but was forced to flee when Cao Cao's trickery turned his own ally against him.

INV:Phyrexian Lens.f:
"There's nothing I wouldn't give to achieve victory. Can you say the same?"
—Tsabo Tavoc, to Gerrard

ODY:Cephalid Scout.f: The more they survey the dreadful dry expanses, the more the cephalids thirst to tame them.

ODY:Dwarven Grunt.f:
Hard as stone and twice as stubborn.
—Dwarven compliment

PLS:Kavu Recluse.f: Few ever see this particular breed of kavu, which hides in forests of its own making.

INV:Darigaaz's Attendant.f: "Darigaaz is the breath of the ur-dragon, burning away the burdens of mortality."

STH:Flowstone Shambler.f: Flowstone troops are notoriously difficult to keep in formation.

DST:Echoing Courage.f: A single seed unleashes a flurry of growth.

WTH:Llanowar Sentinel.f:
"The forest has as many eyes as leaves."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

ONS:Tribal Unity.f: Kamahl left the violence of his former life behind him, but he still believes in the power of muscle.

P02:Norwood Warrior.f: "The woods hold peace for those who desire it, but those who seek battle will find me."

ALL:Phyrexian Boon.f:
"Dagsson should have paid attention to the lessons of Phyrexia before attempting to create a mechanical utopia."
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic

ICE:Prismatic Ward.f:
"These, of all spells, must have common components I can isolate and use."
—Halvor Arensson, Kjeldoran Priest

PCY:Alexi, Zephyr Mage.f: The Keldons didn't know her name, but they still cursed her in battle.

CHK:Long-Forgotten Gohei.f: Long ago, the priests would wave the gohei to call down the gods. Now it lies forgotten, but the spirits still feel its pull.

FEM:Dwarven Soldier.f:
"Let no one say we did not fight until the last . . . ."
—Headstone fragment from a mass grave found in the Crimson Peaks

ICE:Pyknite.f:
"Never cross a Pyknite, if you value your scalp."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

MMQ:Honor the Fallen.f:
"May the River claim Cho-Manno's body, wherever it lies."
—Ta-Karnst, Cho-Arrim healer

5DN:Armed Response.f: Raksha watched as the goblins continued to pour onto the Razor Fields. "They just don't know when to stop, do they?"

USG:Stern Proctor.f:
"I preferred the harsh tutors—they made mischief all the more fun."
—Teferi, third-level student

SCG:Nefashu.f: Where the nefashu pass, blood rolls like a silk carpet.

STH:Venerable Monk.f: Age wears the flesh but galvanizes the soul.

VIS:Griffin Canyon.f:
"Where are falling feathers deadlier than falling rock?"
—*The One Thousand Questions*

CHK:Kami of the Painted Road.f: In ancient times, precepts of kami law were inscribed onto bridges as a gesture of respect. During the war, humans regarded them as warnings of where not to travel.

LEG:Craw Giant.f: Harthag gave a jolly laugh as he surveyed the army before him. "Ho ho ho! Midgets! You think you can stand in my way?"

MMQ:Glowing Anemone.f: Beautiful to behold, terrible to be held.

TMP:Orim, Samite Healer.f:
"The silkworm spins itself a new existence. So the healer weaves the threads of life."
—Orim, Samite healer

PCY:Squirrel Wrangler.f: "Gnawed to death. Bad way to go."

WTH:Hurloon Shaman.f:
"I believe it when they say they're connected to the land—looks like somebody plowed her face."
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

SOK:Oni of Wild Places.f: The oni leapt easily from peak to peak, toying with its victims, its voice a purr from the rumbling depths of nightmare.

POR:Wall of Granite.f: The wisest man builds his house *behind* the rock.

ODY:Sungrass Egg.f:
"Has your peaceful nature led you on a crusade?"
—Watnik, master glassblower

ONS:Nosy Goblin.f: To his surprise, Furt discovered that the strange creatures were not at all like bugs.

SOK:Meishin, the Mind Cage.f: It's dangerous indeed to be lost in someone else's thoughts.

TMP:Light of Day.f:
"I do not miss sunlight. The very memory of it burns my eyes."
—Volrath

MIR:Energy Bolt.f: Life and death are two faces of the same coin.

EXO:School of Piranha.f: Some schools aren't worth getting into.

DRK:Goblin Hero.f: They attacked in an orgy of rage and madness, but only one seemed as focused on killing us as on the sheer joy of battle.

TMP:Tooth and Claw.f:
"You deify nature as female—kind and gentle—yet you cringe at what is natural."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

TMP:Enfeeblement.f: Crovax had witnessed Selenia lead the *Predator* to the *Weatherlight*. As the battle raged on deck, he felt his strength melt in the heat of her betrayal.

VIS:Viashivan Dragon.f: The Viashivan understand that cruelty arises from opportunity.

CHK:Terashi's Cry.f:
"The sun kami is terrible to behold. When its temper flares, best seek shade and pray for forgiveness."
—Sensei Golden-Tail

ULG:Defender of Chaos.f: Some knights will not follow orders—only disorder.

EXO:Dizzying Gaze.f:
"When I cut down my angel I only started my fall."
—Crovax

HML:Abbey Gargoyles.f:
"Though Serra has not been seen for twenty years, her Gargoyles still watch over our city and punish the guilty."
—Gulsen, Abbey Matron

MIR:Unyaro Bee Sting.f:
"Much can be learned from the bees about dying for a cause."
—Asmira, Holy Avenger

POR:Devastation.f: There is much talk about the art of creation. What about the art of destruction?

CHK:Shimatsu the Bloodcloaked.f: Their dominion over dark and destructive forces twisted the oni into beings of pure malevolence.

MIR:Disenchant.f:
"There are harsher ways to learn the meaning of the word 'no.'"
—Rashida Scalebane

INV:Utopia Tree.f: The fruit of this fabled tree takes on the flavor of whatever food you love most.

ATQ:Cursed Rack.f: Ashnod invented several torture techniques that could make victims even miles away beg for mercy as if the End had come.

JUD:Trained Pronghorn.f:
"The desert asked the Ancestor for children, and the antelope were born."
—Nomad myth

TMP:Death Pits of Rath.f: As the sludge below began to shift and take shapes, Gerrard turned from the railing to Orim. "I suppose," he said, "it's a little too late for prayer, isn't it?"

ODY:Spellbane Centaur.f: "No mage's deception can harm those who keep nature balanced."

ICE:Zuran Enchanter.f:
"We are Kjeldorans no more."
—Zur the Enchanter

ICE:Hoar Shade.f:
"The creature we fought in the western waste was doubly dangerous: mortally wounded, it rebounded and attacked again."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

POR:Venerable Monk.f: His presence brings not only a strong arm but also renewed hope.

MIR:Razor Pendulum.f:
"Amazing thing, gravity. It seems to work every time."
—Telim'Tor

APC:Shimmering Mirage.f:
"Oh, is *that* all you need? Why didn't you just say so?"
—Reef shaman

PCY:Scoria Cat.f: Like a volcano, it too can erupt without warning.

2ED:Samite Healer.f: Healers ultimately acquire the divine gifts of spiritual and physical wholeness. The most devout are also granted the ability to pass physical wholeness on to others.

ODY:Thought Nibbler.f: Balshan wizards have long used them to gnaw away the memories they wish to forget.

BOK:Stir the Grave.f:
"Your lungs may not draw breath, but while your hands can grip a sword, you will be useful to me."
—Nighteyes, nezumi necromancer

JUD:Cagemail.f:
"Power often costs too high a price."
—Commander Eesha

PTK:Virtuous Charge.f: "The empire belongs to no one man but to all in the empire. He who has virtue shall possess it."

MRD:Inertia Bubble.f:
"I wouldn't want you to hurt yourself."
—Bruenna, Neurok leader
