PTK:Wei Infantry.f: Wei won the battle of Hefei when Zhang Liao defeated Sun Quan and then foiled a Wu scheme to incite rebellion.

ONS:Stag Beetle.f: Its voice crackles with the hum of a thousand wings beating at once.

DRK:Dark Sphere.f:
"I was struck senseless for a moment, but revived when the strange curiosity I carried fell to the ground, screaming like a dying animal."
—Barl, Lord Ith

MIR:Taniwha.f:
"Taniwha rolls in its sleep, and the land is awash with the waves."
—Poetics of Hanan

USG:Wildfire.f:
"Shiv hatched from a shell of stone around a yolk of flame."
—Viashino myth

ONS:Grinning Demon.f: It's drawn to the scent of screaming.

CHK:Marrow-Gnawer.f: Marrow-Gnawer united three nezumi gangs when he slew their leaders in a single night. Now they call him their first lord.

INV:Llanowar Vanguard.f: Llanowar rallied around Eladamri's banner and united in his name.

USG:Voice of Grace.f:
"Opposite Law is Grace, and Grace must be preserved. If the strands of Grace are unraveled, its design will be lost, and the people with it."
—*Song of All*, canto 167

SCG:Clutch of Undeath.f: The hand of death recognizes its own.

DST:Ritual of Restoration.f: Leonin raising ceremonies take place at the white sun's dawn, the rebirth of artifacts mirroring the birth of a new day.

CHK:Indomitable Will.f:
"None of you are yet samurai. Defend your homes with honor, die for your cause, and perhaps then you will be worthy of the word."
—General Takeno

TMP:Steal Enchantment.f:
"Why should I flatter another with imitation when I can satisfy myself through possession?"
—Ertai, wizard adept

SOK:Spiraling Embers.f: The akki knew to stay indoors on the days the oni flew their kites.

VIS:Crypt Rats.f:
"Once I dreamt of death, but now it dreams of me / And only rats and rotting flesh can hear my silent plea."
—Mundungu chant

TMP:Mogg Conscripts.f:
"Torahn's horns! They've seen us. Now, statue, you must fight to save yourself!"
—Tahngarth, aboard the *Predator*

5DN:Advanced Hoverguard.f:
"They are like their vedalken masters: untouchable, aloof, and omnipresent."
—Bruenna, Neurok leader

MRD:Vault of Whispers.f: Ish Sah, den of the warlord Geth, commander of countless nim.

ONS:Goblin Sky Raider.f: The goblin word for "flying" is more accurately translated as "falling slowly."

TMP:Lowland Giant.f: "Faugh!" snorted Tahngarth. "Why would it make a meal of something like you?" Squee looked relieved. "No," he continued, "you'd make a much better toothpick."

TMP:Thalakos Sentry.f:
"Ill luck and poor geography caught the Thalakos between us and the Dauthi."
—Lyna, Soltari emissary

2ED:Will-o'-the-Wisp.f:
"About, about in reel and rout
The death-fires danced at night;
The water, like a witch's oils,
Burnt green, and blue and white."
—Samuel Coleridge, "The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

BOK:Ward of Piety.f: Reluctant to strike at the kami directly, some kitsune trained in more passive fighting techniques.

MMQ:Cateran Brute.f: The Cateran guild prefers to call them "public relations."

5DN:Desecration Elemental.f: Its precious corpses dance like puppets to attract mindless nim prey.

INV:Treefolk Healer.f: Protected by druids for untold centuries, the forest began to return the favor.

ARN:Sandstorm.f: Even the landscape turned against Sarsour, first rising up and pelting him, then rearranging itself so he could no longer find his way.

TMP:Mirri's Guile.f: Hanna was astounded. Mirri read every leaf and wisp of breeze like a book of ancient lore.

MMQ:Uphill Battle.f: Cho-Manno knew he had no choice but to ally with Gerrard. If that's what it took to free his people, he'd pay the price.

MRD:Slith Firewalker.f: The slith incubate in the Great Furnace's heat, emerging on Mirrodin's surface only when the four suns have aligned overhead.

ICE:Shield of the Ages.f:
"This shield is a true rarity: an artifact whose purpose is obvious."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

ARN:War Elephant.f: "When elephants fight it is the grass that suffers." —Kikuyu Proverb

LEG:Kobold Drill Sergeant.f: "Joining this army is easy, boy. Just survive your first battle."

EXO:Cursed Flesh.f: A farewell to arms . . . and feet . . . and legs . . . .

SOK:Deathmask Nezumi.f:
"We had him cornered, we did . . . and, well, you know what they say about rats."
—Araba patrol survivor

MIR:Sidar Jabari.f:
"Prophecy is whatever one makes of it, but destiny cannot be changed."
—Sidar Jabari

MMQ:Crossbow Infantry.f: The crossbow is the ideal weapon for the lazy Mercadians: just point and shoot.

EXO:Vampire Hounds.f: The hounds' barks are a horrifying chorus of screams, moans, and whispers.

VIS:Relentless Assault.f:
"Flog and Squee / Up the tree / See the army / Flee, flee, flee."
—Goblin nursery rhyme/war cry

STH:Death Stroke.f: For a sharp second, Selenia froze, and Crovax's blade found home. As the angel shattered like glass, Crovax felt his mind collapse—the curse had been fulfilled.

2ED:Nightmare.f: The Nightmare arises from its lair in the swamps. As the poisoned land spreads, so does the Nightmare's rage and terrifying strength.

2ED:Wall of Fire.f: Conjured from the bowels of hell, the fiery wall forms an impassable barrier, searing the soul of any creature attempting to pass through its terrible bursts of flame.

P02:Prowling Nightstalker.f: Silent as a serpent, twisted as a lone bog tree, evil as Tojira's heart.

TOR:Laquatus's Champion.f: Chainer's dark gift to a darker soul.

SCG:Exiled Doomsayer.f: He's desperate to hold back the future because he has seen it.

SCG:Misguided Rage.f: Only when the anger passed did Varv realize he had burned down his home, destroyed his weapons, and killed his friend Furt.

ONS:Disciple of Malice.f: The lantern he carried did not light his way—it signaled his approach.

P02:Bee Sting.f:
Busy as a bumblebee, blistered as a goblin.
—Alaborn saying

ALL:Mishra's Groundbreaker.f: The very ground yielded to Mishra's wishes.

JUD:Browbeat.f:
"Even the threat of power has power."
—Jeska, warrior adept

INV:Zap.f: "All this time I thought Squee was useless," chuckled Sisay. "Who knew he'd be such a good shot?"

2ED:Roc of Kher Ridges.f: We encountered a valley topped with immense boulders and eerie rock formations. Suddenly one of these boulders toppled from its perch and sprouted gargantuan wings, casting a shadow of darkness and sending us fleeing in terror.

PCY:Rhystic Syphon.f: Jamuraan wizards are linked together by magic, a bond that only the wicked dare exploit.

PCY:Bog Elemental.f:
"When the bog walks, the wise run."
—Erissa, bog witch

INV:Rampant Elephant.f: No matter how righteous the cause, it helps to bring along some muscle.

CHK:Minamo, School at Water's Edge.f: Its students graduate the school and enter history.

EXO:Exalted Dragon.f: If dragons excel at anything more than vanity, it is greed.

DST:Arcbound Worker.f: The parts are as strong as the whole.

MIR:Divine Retribution.f:
"To the undiscerning eye, justice and vengeance can look the same."
—Rashida Scalebane

CHK:Call to Glory.f:
"General Takeno glared at us as if we were the enemy. 'The day is not over yet,' he shouted, 'and unless you have a nezumi's heart, you *will* stand and fight!'"
—*Battle of Akagi River: A Survivor's Tale*

CHK:Nature's Will.f:
"Without the kami to speak to nature on our behalf, we must beg help from nature directly."
—Seshiro the Anointed

ONS:Catapult Squad.f: Together they could hit anything between the heavens and the horizon.

ICE:Legions of Lim-Dûl.f:
"I have seen the faces of my dead friends among that grim band, and I can bear no more."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter, Leader of the Order of the White Shield

TMP:Whispers of the Muse.f:
"I followed her song only to find it was a dirge."
—Crovax

PLS:Ancient Spider.f: It outlived both king and castle.

ONS:Enchantress's Presence.f: "The wise learn from successes as well as mistakes."

MRD:Predator's Strike.f: If you hear it coming, you're not its prey.

MRD:Groffskithur.f: It growls not to threaten, but to summon.

ONS:Fallen Cleric.f: The most terrifying zombies are those with just a hint of their old selves left.

SCG:Dragon Mage.f: "You'll bend to my will—with or without your precious sanity."

CHK:Gutwrencher Oni.f:
"Blood drips. Blood sings. Blood devours all and only blood remains."
—Ogre chant

UDS:Telepathic Spies.f: "Do try to keep an open mind, would you?"

TMP:Precognition.f: A gleam like struggling sunlight penetrated Selenia's dark thoughts.

MRD:Tower of Murmurs.f: Etched on its surface are warnings from a long-lost race of ur-golems pushed to the brink of extinction.

PLS:Thornscape Familiar.f: Blessed with many options, Thornscape masters favor scarabs as familiars.

USG:Gorilla Warrior.f: The gorilla beat its chest and threw great handfuls of leaves into the air. It howled challenge and showed its teeth. The mechanical soldier, not understanding, simply killed it.

VIS:Panther Warriors.f:
"When you run you're graceful and swift, sleek as a powerful panther."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

MMQ:Statecraft.f:
"Inside these walls, peace; outside, sharks. You choose."
—Saprazzan vizier

VIS:Miraculous Recovery.f:
"You stop breathing for just a few minutes and everyone jumps to conclusions."
—Zarkuu, necrosavant

NEM:Flame Rift.f: Crovax hungered for power, and the stronghold devoured the sky.

INV:Wash Out.f:
"Rest now. You've neither won nor lost, but this battle is over for you just the same."
—Teferi

INV:Recover.f: As Barrin exhumed his daughter's body, he finally realized the full price of his faith in Urza.

PTK:Strategic Planning.f: "Plans evolved within the tent decide a victory 1,000 *li* away."

WTH:Mana Chains.f:
"The Lord of the Wastes must be destroyed; I am bound to this destiny by the chains of fate. If only Gerrard would see his part."
—Sisay, journal

ALL:Fyndhorn Druid.f:
"All struggles ultimately require sacrifice. It's just that some sacrifices are dearer than others."
—Jaeuhl Carthalion, Juniper Order Advocate

PTK:Lu Meng, Wu General.f: As the Wu chief commander, Lu Meng conquered Shu-held Jingzhou in 219 by disguising soldiers as merchants on boats filled with hiding troops.

TOR:Dwell on the Past.f:
None can find what hasn't been lost.
—Nantuko teaching

TMP:Telethopter.f: After losing several of the devices to midair collisions, Greven forbade moggs from operating telethopters.

PLS:Morgue Toad.f:
"The toads of Urborg aren't fast, powerful, or pleasant, but they have their uses."
—Ertai

MIR:Wild Elephant.f:
"I will tell my father's stories . . . . How the elephants trampled the leopard cub, and its father, though he knew, killed nine goats instead."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

USG:Claws of Gix.f: When the Brotherhood of Gix dug out the cave of Koilos they found their master's severed hand. They enshrined it, hoping that one day it would point the way to Phyrexia.

DRK:Blood Moon.f: Heavy light flooded across the landscape, cloaking everything in deep crimson.

VIS:Urborg Mindsucker.f:
"My pet will pick the ripe fruit from your tortured brain as if it were hanging from a vine."
—Kaervek

ICE:Formation.f:
"I have been a warrior for over four hundred years, and yet each generation of Kjeldorans teaches me new tricks. There can be no better allies."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, Elvish Hunter

ODY:Cephalid Retainer.f: Cephalids whisper flattery in your ear, put jewels in your hand, spin dreams in your head, and stick knives in your back.

POR:Virtue's Ruin.f: All must fall, and those who stand highest fall hardest.

ODY:Price of Glory.f:
"True strength lies in action. Let the weak react to me."
—Kamahl, pit fighter

PLS:Phyrexian Bloodstock.f: It reeks of terror and chaos.

ICE:Stone Spirit.f:
"The spirit of the stone is the spirit of strength."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

INV:Fertile Ground.f: As Phyrexians descended, Multani paused to reflect on the beauty that might never be seen again.

MIR:Harbor Guardian.f:
"Our guardian levies a tax on all traders. Wise travelers pay with a minimum of fuss."
—Qhattib, Vizier of Amiqat

MRD:Krark's Thumb.f:
"I can think of *one* goblin it ain't so lucky for."
—Slobad, goblin tinkerer

POR:Hulking Cyclops.f: Anyone can get around a cyclops, but few can stand in its way.

MMQ:Eye of Ramos.f: Ramos wept, and there were seas.

TOR:Waste Away.f: Chainer's insanity touched nearly every living thing—including viruses.

USG:Acidic Soil.f: Phyrexia had tried to take Urza's soul. He was relieved that Shiv tried to claim only his soles.

HML:Aysen Crusader.f:
"A renegade rallying the rabble does not a true Crusader make."
—Irini Sengir

CHK:Thoughtbind.f:
"As the rest of the mortal world waged war, Lady Azami and her students invaded tomes of knowledge. Their search yielded spells critical in the fight."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

USG:Thran Turbine.f: When Urza asked the viashino what it did, they answered: "It hums."

MIR:Painful Memories.f:
"It is terrible how one brief action can live forever in memory."
—Jolrael

LEG:Pendelhaven.f: "This is the forest primeval. The murmuring pines and the hemlocks . . . / Stand like Druids of old." —Henry Wadsworth Longfellow, "Evangeline"

NEM:Dark Triumph.f: All that's left is the coronation.

LGN:Akroma's Devoted.f: Akroma asked for only one thing from her troops: unwavering, unconditional loyalty.

MIR:Rock Basilisk.f: In the eastern reaches of Jamuraa are arrangements of massive stones. No one knows their origins—for certain.

TOR:Obsessive Search.f: The question strained his sanity. The answer snapped it in half.

LGN:Mistform Sliver.f: Taking the form of a junior researcher, the first sliver slipped out of Riptide.

APC:Kavu Mauler.f: To the kavu, all Phyrexians are merely crunchy snacks.

TOR:Aven Trooper.f: The very skies seethe with the aven's hatred for the Cabal.

P02:Natural Spring.f: The dying ask for water because they know it contains life.

ICE:Lava Burst.f:
"Overkill? This isn't a game of Kick-the-Ouphe!"
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

STH:Bandage.f: Takara shook with guilt. She knew the last image her father had seen was her sword flashing toward him.

MMQ:Crash.f: Gerrard shook his head as the ground rushed to meet him. "This," he thought, "is not the start I was hoping for."

ICE:Storm Spirit.f:
"Come to us, with your lightning. Come to us, with your thunder. Serve us with your strength, and smite our foes with your power."
—Steinar Icefist, Balduvian Shaman

JUD:Glory.f:
"Glory was gone; Glory was everywhere."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

ODY:Simplify.f:
A blossom's petals close inward to shut out the frost.
—Nantuko teaching

DST:Dragon's Claw.f: Though no longer attached to the hand, it still holds its adversary in its grasp.

USG:Disciple of Law.f: A religious order for religious order.

USG:Retaliation.f: A foul, metallic stench clogged Urza's senses. It was then he knew his brother was no more.

USG:Monk Realist.f: "We plant the seeds of doubt to harvest the crop of wisdom."

FEM:Hand of Justice.f:
"The Hand of Justice will come to cleanse the world if we are true."
—Oliver Farrel

PCY:Wild Might.f: The hunted can become the fiercest hunters.

ICE:Rime Dryad.f:
"The Dryads told us to stay, as no new horrors would come when it was so cold. Three of us left anyway. The rest believed their lies, and their skeletons weren't found until the thaw."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

5DN:Joiner Adept.f: A talented apprentice makes all things. The master makes all things possible.

2ED:Dragon Whelp.f:
"O to be a dragon . . . of silkworm size or immense . . ."
—Marianne Moore, "O to Be a Dragon"

TMP:Winter's Grasp.f:
Summer is buried there, centuries deep;
A crypt of years where seasons sleep.

LEG:Crookshank Kobolds.f: The Crookshank military boasts a standing army of nearly twenty-four million, give or take twenty-two million.

ULG:Ostracize.f: Kerrick was to find that some borders can never be crossed.

ALL:Undergrowth.f:
"The art of war is turning obstacle to advantage."
—Jaeuhl Carthalion, Juniper Order Advocate

ALL:Elvish Ranger.f:
"How can any Human hope to match our skills? We are children of Fyndhorn, and its sap runs in our veins."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, Elvish Hunter

PLS:Malicious Advice.f:
"Rule through fear, Darigaaz. Only if the dragons feel terror will they truly be your servants."
—Tevesh Szat

MMQ:Revive.f: Gerrard's heart ached, recalling the living wreath Mirri laid for her dead kin. No such memorial was left for her in Rath.

ICE:Mercenaries.f:
"Blasted amateurs! Doesn't the queen think we can fight well enough on our own?"
—Avram Garrisson, Leader of the Knights of Stromgald

POR:Snapping Drake.f: Drakes claim to be dragons—until the dragons show up.

MIR:Nettletooth Djinn.f:
"The few of us who survived were denied entry to our camp for two days—so like the pox were the marks we bore."
—*Travelogue of Najat*

TMP:Reflecting Pool.f:
"The reflection of land interests me far more than its reality."
—Volrath

MRD:Nim Lasher.f: The rotting metal feeds the necrogen mists, and in turn the mists feed the nim.

PCY:Searing Wind.f:
"The first wind of ascension is Forger, burning away impurity."
—*Keld Triumphant*

UDS:Magnify.f: The seed torches' pollen gives off light, but the elves find it heightens their senses as well.

VIS:Warrior's Honor.f:
"We are to be bound together as the reeds of a basket."
—Asmira, Rashida, and Jabari, unity chant

FEM:Icatian Phalanx.f: Even after the wall was breached in half a dozen places, the Phalanxes fought on, standing solidly against the onrushing raiders. Disciplined and dedicated, they held their ranks to the end, even in the face of tremendous losses.

WTH:Dwarven Berserker.f: "I may be small, but I can kick *your* butt."

MMQ:Counterspell.f:
"Your attack has been rendered harmless. It is, however, quite pretty."
—Saprazzan vizier

HML:Serra Paladin.f:
"Would that I could be a Paladin again, but the dead hold no place among their ranks."
—Ihsan's Shade

MIR:Reign of Terror.f:
"I don't know what takes them; they die around me without time to scream."
—Scout Ekemet, final journal

DST:Wirefly Hive.f:
"The lifespan of a wirefly can be precisely described as 'short.'"
—Bruenna, Neurok leader

ODY:Mad Dog.f: The bones it buries may be yours.

PCY:Copper-Leaf Angel.f:
"When Serra made angels, people called her a goddess. My angels are far superior to hers."
—Latulla, Keldon overseer

P02:Temple Acolyte.f: Young, yes. Inexperienced, yes. Weak? Don't count on it.

JUD:Death Wish.f: He wished for power, but not for the longevity to abuse it.

PTK:Shu Grain Caravan.f: Keeping a million-man army fed was no easy task. Grain and rice caravans were the lifeblood of the empire.

5DN:Channel the Suns.f: To some the birth of the fifth sun was a sign of doom. To others it was a sign of salvation. But to all it was a sign.

ODY:Sungrass Prairie.f: On Otaria, peace and harmony are rare. Places that provide both are cherished.

SCG:Vengeful Dead.f: Those who don't learn from their deaths are destined to repeat them.

ALL:Feast or Famine.f:
"We are not yet free of Lim-Dûl's terrors."
—Halvor Arensson, Kjeldoran Priest

P02:Ironhoof Ox.f: The good news is it's vegetarian. The bad news is it just doesn't like you.

TMP:No Quarter.f: As Gerrard and Greven neared each other, the moggs caught between them realized they should flee.

APC:Foul Presence.f: The Phyrexians have one word that means both "evolution" and "pain."

SCG:Aphetto Runecaster.f: "The ignorant fear change; the wise use it as a weapon."

POR:Déjà Vu.f: The past is a mirror of the future.

USG:Shiv's Embrace.f: "Wear the foe's form to best it in battle. So sayeth the bey."

HML:Aysen Bureaucrats.f:
"All the tortures of my vault of horrors pale in comparison to dealing with those petty Bureaucrats."
—Baron Sengir

TMP:Rats of Rath.f:
"These creatures offer new challenges in the scrutiny of entrails."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

USG:Confiscate.f:
"I don't understand why he works so hard on a device to duplicate a sound so easily made with hand and armpit."
—Barrin, progress report

ULG:Hope and Glory.f:
"Serra ruled by faith. I cannot afford that luxury."
—Radiant, archangel

POR:Hill Giant.f: Hill giants are mostly just big. Of course, that does count for a lot!

CHK:Kashi-Tribe Warriors.f: The orochi and the monks had always had an unspoken agreement: live and let live. But when the kami began raging, some warrior youths began questioning that agreement.

BOK:Akki Blizzard-Herder.f:
"It remains unclear whether the akki shamans could in fact create storms or simply predicted them."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

PTK:Wu Elite Cavalry.f: At the second battle of Ruxu, the brave Wu general Gan Ning raided Cao Cao's camp of 400,000 men with only 100 cavalry. Not a single man or horse was lost.

USG:Goblin Spelunkers.f:
"It only short jump. You go first."
"AIIIEEEE!"
"Hmm . . . we go different way now."

ICE:Dwarven Armory.f:
"Few of us left, now. Confounded Yeti have opened all the vents. We'd best hide here with the weapons."
—Perena Deepcutter, Dwarven Armorer

MRD:Duskworker.f: At the setting of each sun, it emerges to clean Mirrodin's floor of the day's carrion.

MMQ:Desert Twister.f: The magical dust clouds Mercadian mages use to traverse the plane generate storms that devastate the surrounding terrain. But as long as the storms don't touch the mountain, the nobles simply don't care.

DST:Auriok Siege Sled.f: Everything in its path is either pushed aside or ground under.

MMQ:Robber Fly.f: In pursuit of the juicy fly, Squee stumbled on the hidden hangar.

STH:Volrath's Gardens.f: "Watch yourself," warned Starke. "These plants aren't nice when they're hungry."

ULG:Tinker.f:
"I wonder how it feels to be bored."
—Jhoira, artificer

ODY:Buried Alive.f: The scrape of shovels and the tumble of cold dirt soon muffled their pleas.

ODY:Persuasion.f: "Protocol demands that you bow down before me. I always stand on protocol."

PLS:Destructive Flow.f: Stage two of the Phyrexian invasion included the complete alteration of Dominaria's landscape.

VIS:Mystic Veil.f:
"Magic is my thread, my will the needle. I weave over you as if you never were."
—Poetics of Hanan

TMP:Rathi Dragon.f: Wrap the flame as twine Kingdoms will be thine.

VIS:Rock Slide.f:
"Good ol' rock. Nothing beats rock."
—Rhirhok, goblin archer

SCG:Long-Term Plans.f: "Wait, it'll come to me in a minute."

MRD:Irradiate.f: The blast ignores the cage of metal but devours the flesh inside.

VIS:Army Ants.f:
"Do not underestimate the power of many against one."
—Sidar Jabari

HML:Spectral Bears.f:
"I hear there are Bears—or spirits—that guard caravans passing through the forest."
—Gulsen, Abbey Matron

ODY:Tremble.f: Otaria's frequent tremors are the last stages of Dominaria's recovery from the Phyrexian war.

MMQ:Jhovall Rider.f: Don't be fooled by the riders' fluid grace—it takes years of practice to ride these beasts.

5DN:Skyhunter Prowler.f:
"If what I have seen comes to pass, we will need our guardians more than ever."
—Ushanti, leonin seer

INV:Riptide Crab.f: It sleeps with its claws open.

STH:Intruder Alarm.f: Mirri was startled by Volrath's apparition—it had no scent.

INV:Rainbow Crow.f: Children claim no two feathers are exactly the same color, then eagerly gather them for proof.

CHK:Horizon Seed.f: In peaceful times, these beings escorted the honored kami to their new shrines. In the Kami War, they became the medics of an unstoppable army.

USG:Blood Vassal.f:
"They are bred to suffer and born to die. Much like humans."
—Gix, Yawgmoth praetor

PCY:Overburden.f: The Kipamu League knew what Keld refused to acknowledge: the land could support no more.

ONS:Elvish Pioneer.f:
"Destruction is the work of an afternoon. Creation is the work of a lifetime."
—Kamahl, druid acolyte

5DN:Screaming Fury.f: He's got an axe to grind.

TMP:Dauthi Embrace.f:
"The Dauthi army grows by screams and bounds."
—Lyna, Soltari emissary

ICE:Aurochs.f: One Auroch may feed a village, but a herd will flatten it.

TMP:Hanna's Custody.f:
"I protect the Legacy with my life if necessary, for its purpose is far more important than my own."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

UDS:Goblin Gardener.f: "Grow food in dirt? Save time—eat dirt."

ICE:Shatter.f:
"Let the past be the past. Do not call up that which you cannot put down. Destroy that which destroyed us, so long ago."
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic

STH:Wall of Blossoms.f: Each flower identical, every leaf and petal disturbingly exact.

FEM:Vodalian Soldiers.f:
"Vodalian Soldiers had some unique advantages. Often they would ride into battle on war machines rumored to have come from the far northern oceans."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. V*

SOK:Mikokoro, Center of the Sea.f:
"Center of the Sea, Eye of the World, Shrine of Enlightenment. Seek it for answers. Seek it for healing. Seek it and return transformed."
—Scroll fragment from the ruins of Minamo

ICE:Tor Giant.f:
"What do you do then? Run. Run very fast. Don't stop until you see the camp—or a bigger Giant."
—Toothlicker Harj, Orcish Captain

APC:Ana Disciple.f: "The blessings of Gaea alone are no longer enough."

CHK:Ethereal Haze.f:
"Imagine a dove flying through smoke. Does the dove injure the smoke? Does the smoke impede the dove?"
—Teachings of Eight-and-a-Half-Tails

ICE:Pale Bears.f:
"Daughter, on the day you have killed your Pale Bear, then will I give you your true name."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

ONS:Butcher Orgg.f: It can kill you with three arms tied behind its back.

MMQ:Horned Troll.f:
"If I says it's a troll, it's a troll. Goblins is always right in Mercadia."
—Squee

EXO:Cartographer.f: How do you map a world when the land moves beneath your feet?

ONS:Rorix Bladewing.f: In the smoldering ashes of Shiv, a few dragons strive to rebuild their native land. The rest seek any opportunity to restore the broken pride of their race.

MIR:Pyric Salamander.f:
When you've been chased by a dragon, you run from every lizard.
—Suq'Ata saying

TOR:Angel of Retribution.f: Bitter vengeance never glowed so bright nor sang so sweet.

ONS:Cryptic Gateway.f: Its lock changes to fit each key.

TOR:Hell-Bent Raider.f: He doesn't slow until his spear is weighted with corpses.

ODY:Escape Artist.f: "Not even my shadow knows where I am."

UDS:Donate.f: Campus pranksters initiate new students with the old "beeble bomb" routine.

HML:Aliban's Tower.f:
"Those who hide in hollow towers would do well to remember the rain."
—Reyhan, Samite Alchemist

INV:Vile Consumption.f: The plague moved faster than an army and was far more deadly.

TOR:Stupefying Touch.f: Just because your eyes are open doesn't mean you're awake.

LEG:Jerrard of the Closed Fist.f: Once, the order of the Closed Fist reached throughout the Kb'Briann Highlands. Now, Jerrard alone remains to uphold their standard.

TMP:Flowstone Sculpture.f: The sculptor, weary of his work, created art that would finish itself.

ODY:Life Burst.f: As uplifting as a mystic's dreams.

FEM:Balm of Restoration.f:
"Not all armies enjoyed the services of a medic. For them, Balm of Restoration was that much more valuable."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. I*

UDS:Illuminated Wings.f: For a moment, Urza thought not of war and destruction, but of the freedom of the skies.

VIS:Betrayal.f:
"Sometimes a burden can be borne only on the shoulders of a willing enemy."
—Suq'Ata aphorism

PDRC:Nalathni Dragon.f:
These small but intelligent Dragons and their Olesian allies held back the tide of Pashalik Mons's hordes of Goblin Raiders.
*DragonCon 1994*

MIR:Soul Rend.f:
"Since I cannot stop death, I choose to stop life."
—Kaervek

SOK:Akki Drillmaster.f: "What part of 'hayaku ikee!' did you not understand?"

ONS:Mistform Mask.f: Trust, the fifth myth of reality: Every truth holds the seed of betrayal.

VIS:Lightning Cloud.f:
The mightiest clouds sit upon spires of fire.
—Femeref adage

UDS:Replenish.f: Treasures, trinkets, trash—the relics of the past are brought forth again.

P02:Goblin General.f: Lead, follow, or run around like crazy.

ICE:Spectral Shield.f:
"What can be a stronger shield than concealment? Have you ever defeated an enemy you didn't know existed?"
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

TMP:Apocalypse.f:
"There is a future in which I can see only mist and a single shadow."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

2ED:Mesa Pegasus.f: Before a woman marries in the village of Sursi, she must visit the land of the Mesa Pegasus. Legend has it that if the woman is pure of heart and her love is true, a Mesa Pegasus will appear, blessing her family with long life and good fortune.

MMQ:Blaster Mage.f: "Don't get up. I'll show myself out."

BOK:Bile Urchin.f:
"The two youths argued and tempers flared. One youth opened his mouth to utter a vile curse, but what he spat out instead was a kami of poison and filth."
—Sensei Golden-Tail

MIR:Tranquil Domain.f:
"An ancient court mage unified the houses into guilds to serve Zhalfir above their own interests. Even during the civil war, the guilds stood together, a testament to the wisdom of Teferi."
—Afari, *Tales*

POR:Rain of Tears.f: When emotions rain down, what rivers will be born?

LGN:Blood Celebrant.f:
"Their blood is the nectar that nourishes the Cabal."
—Phage the Untouchable

ALL:Soldevi Adnate.f:
"An idiot cannot hear sense, even when a thousand people speak it."
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic

VIS:Mortal Wound.f:
"Their tears spill over Jamuraa. Mixed with blood, they wash everything red."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

USG:Vernal Bloom.f: Many cultures have legends of a lush, hidden paradise. The elves of Argoth had no need of such stories.

PTK:Misfortune's Gain.f: The mourning families of commanders and generals were often given land, valuables, or money to compensate for their losses.

MMQ:Cinder Elemental.f: Their rage can grow to such proportions that they explode in a cloud of fire.

ONS:Sandskin.f: "Those who live by the sword will die by the sword. I choose to do neither."

USG:Congregate.f:
"In the gathering there is strength for all who founder, renewal for all who languish, love for all who sing."
—*Song of All*, canto 642

P02:Talas Air Ship.f:
"Their ships pollute our air as they themselves pollute our forest."
—Arathel, elvish queen

UDS:Skittering Horror.f:
"This monstrosity will do—for now."
—Davvol, Evincar of Rath

TMP:Dregs of Sorrow.f: Crovax gazed upon the dead, and for one dark moment he saw a banquet.

VIS:Elven Cache.f:
"The elves can hide better than most can look."
—Mwani, Mtenda herder

DST:Hallow.f: "Bend with the storm, then reply in kind."

WTH:Bogardan Firefiend.f:
"The next one who tells me to relax and curl up by a fire is dead."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

USG:Whirlwind.f: Urza tried to rule the air, but Gaea taught him that she controlled all the elements.

2ED:Demonic Hordes.f: Created to destroy Dominia, Demons can sometimes be bent to a more focused purpose.

CHK:Distress.f:
"Today I asked Master Dosan what the ogre mages did with the humans they sacrificed. He gave me a hard look and said to think no more on the matter."
—Meditation journal of young budoka

LGN:Akroma, Angel of Wrath.f: "No rest. No mercy. No matter what."

MIR:Null Chamber.f: Discovered by Femeref mages, the Null Chamber is the ultimate testing ground for the uncreative.

CHK:Kami of Old Stone.f:
"There was a wall here. Now it is dust. A tower rose here. Now it is fallen. An army fought here. Now it is dead. A spirit was here. It is all that remains."
—Snow-Fur, kitsune poet

USG:Crazed Skirge.f: They are Phyrexia's couriers; the messages they carry are inscribed on their slick hides.

PLS:Slingshot Goblin.f: It's most effective when it doesn't eat the ammunition.

ODY:Puppeteer.f: "Getting people to do what you want is merely a matter of telling them what they want to hear."

INV:Razorfoot Griffin.f:
"Do griffins fight to defend their homes or purely for sport?"
—Sisay

PCY:Rhystic Scrying.f:
"The trick is to ask when no one's listening."
—Alexi, zephyr mage

ICE:Cold Snap.f: Who knows from whence the winter comes?

TMP:Advance Scout.f:
"The soldier's path is worn smooth by the tread of many feet—all in one direction, none returning."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

STH:Warrior Angel.f: She represents not hope, but hope's desperate fury.

HML:Ebony Rhino.f:
"That Rhino would fetch us a tidy sum, Joven. Perhaps it's time to make it ours."
—Chandler

PTK:Zodiac Rooster.f: ". . . But the time of Han had run—could he [Kongming] not tell?— / That night his master star fell past the hills. . . ."

APC:Vodalian Mystic.f:
"Sometimes when I look at the ocean, I could swear it changes colors."
—Sisay

MRD:Copperhoof Vorrac.f: Like all forest beasts, it lives by one rule: if there's no room to grow, make some.

ONS:Krosan Groundshaker.f: You know it's coming when you hear the distant thunder. You know where it's been when you see the path of broken trees.

SOK:Aether Shockwave.f:
"The strain upon the veil between worlds began to show near the end of the Kami War. Strange happenings that neither side could control lashed out across Kamigawa."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

PTK:Imperial Seal.f: "If Heaven has placed it in your hands, it means that the throne is destined to be yours."

PCY:Well of Discovery.f:
When you have given everything, then you are capable of anything.
—Well inscription

HML:Ihsan's Shade.f:
"Ihsan, the weak. Ihsan, the fallen. Ihsan, the betrayer. He has brought shame to the Serra Paladins where none existed before. May his suffering equal his betrayal."
—Baris, Serra Inquisitor

ODY:Cartographer.f: "Finding the way once is luck. Finding the way twice takes a good map."

DRK:Ashes to Ashes.f: "All rivers eventually run to the sea. My job is to sort out who goes first." —Maeveen O'Donagh, Memoirs of a Soldier

USG:Ill-Gotten Gains.f: Urza thought it a crusade. Xantcha knew it was a robbery.

PCY:Jolrael's Favor.f:
"War destroys; nature renews."
—Jolrael, empress of beasts

LGN:Plated Sliver.f: Overcoming extinction has only made the slivers more determined to live.

HML:Didgeridoo.f:
"Play the song of he who delivered us. Play the song of Feroz."
—Onatah, Anaba Shaman

ONS:Mythic Proportions.f: The blood of Krosa turns rational beings into primal forces.

MIR:Melesse Spirit.f: Like a laughing knife, immaculate and sharp, is the Melesse.

POR:Python.f: What could it have swallowed to grow so large?

CHK:Ghostly Prison.f: Destroyed in one of the first battles of the Kami War, the town of Reito still grieved.

ODY:Aboshan, Cephalid Emperor.f: "No one can fight the tide forever."

MMQ:Puffer Extract.f: The puffer's flesh is the deadliest in the sea—and therefore the most useful.

LGN:Earthblighter.f: "A single dedicated mind can bring about the greatest destruction. That, or goblins—goblins work too."

USG:Hermetic Study.f:
"Books can be replaced; a prize student cannot. Be patient."
—Urza, to Barrin

INV:Sabertooth Nishoba.f: They sneer at the terrestrial dangers found on peaks and shores, eager to prove themselves against new and even mightier foes.

ICE:Errantry.f:
"There is no shame in solitude. The lone Knight may succeed where a hundred founder."
—Arna Kennerüd, Skyknight

5DN:Arachnoid.f: It follows the green sun over Mirrodin's surface, spinning massive webs of whispersilk as it goes.

LEG:The Lady of the Mountain.f: Her given name has been lost in the mists of time. Legend says that her silent vigil will one day be ended by the one who, pure of heart and spirit, calls out that name again.

5DN:Thought Courier.f: It is telling of the vedalkens' culture that they trust human couriers more than their own comrades.

USG:Coral Merfolk.f: It is not unusual for a single family of coral merfolk to spend centuries carefully guiding the growth of the reefs where they make their home.

MRD:Somber Hoverguard.f: The vedalken interrogate all intruders—once the hoverguards are done with them.

INV:Hanna, Ship's Navigator.f: "I never thought I'd spend my life fighting. I'm a maker, not a destroyer."

TMP:Fool's Tome.f: Squee: "What's that?" Ertai: "It's a magical book." Squee: "Am I smart enough ta use it?" Ertai: "You could say that."

APC:Quicksilver Dagger.f: The dwarves call their quicksilver techniques "improvisational weaponsmithing."

ONS:Shock.f:
"I love lightning! It's my best invention since the rock."
—Toggo, goblin weaponsmith

CHK:Uncontrollable Anger.f: To an akki warrior, gravity is the direction of the nearest unsmashed face.

ICE:Kelsinko Ranger.f:
"Rangers not trained by the Elves just aren't the same."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter, Leader of the Order of the White Shield

ODY:Need for Speed.f: His feet buckled the ground, his hands cut the wind to ribbons, and he was gone.

USG:Hawkeater Moth.f: Each day at dusk the birds above the canopy grow silent.

PTK:Wei Elite Companions.f: Cao Cao was more concerned with capabilities than lineage. He excelled at recruiting and retaining men of talent to serve him.

MMQ:Tranquility.f: Sisay had been restored to her place on the ship, the Legacy had been recovered, and the *Weatherlight* was sailing home to Dominaria. Gerrard focused on the debts he'd settled . . . and on those he'd soon collect.

ICE:Krovikan Fetish.f: Some Krovikans find strength in the ears and eyes of their victims and wear such fetishes into battle.

LGN:Macetail Hystrodon.f: The goblins tracked the hystrodon with much stealth and cunning. Then they were eaten with much pain and yelling.

UDS:Carnival of Souls.f: "'Davvol, blast those elves.' 'Davvol, transport those troops.' No one cares that today is my birthday."

STH:Contemplation.f:
"How fascinating it is to watch the machinations of one's own mind play themselves out."
—Volrath

DRK:Uncle Istvan.f: Solitude drove the old hermit insane. Now he only keeps company with those he can catch.

USG:Presence of the Master.f:
Peace to all. Peace be all.
—Great Hall floor inscription

INV:Simoon.f: Hot wind whipped up as if the weather itself wanted to fight Phyrexians.

MRD:Shatter.f: Days of planning. Weeks of building. Months of perfecting. Seconds of smashing.

EXO:Sabertooth Wyvern.f: Most creatures grow out of their baby teeth, but sabertooth wyverns grow into theirs.

APC:Phyrexian Arena.f: An audience of one with the malice of thousands.

TMP:Unstable Shapeshifter.f:
"In a world of untruths, the living lie rules."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

EXO:Charging Paladin.f: "Hope shall be the blade that severs our bonds."

POR:Rowan Treefolk.f: One of the forest's best protectors is the forest itself.

MMQ:Tremor.f: Without a word, Gerrard and Sisay ran deeper into the mountain. Neither of them intended to leave Mercadia without the *Weatherlight* and its crew.

PLS:Mogg Sentry.f:
"Nobody stands in one place better than a mogg."
—Tahngarth

STH:Hammerhead Shark.f: Cross the eyes of a hammerhead and you'll dot its teeth.

MIR:Azimaet Drake.f:
"A vizier's dish, best served drenched in honey and almonds."
—Suq'Ata royal recipe

TMP:Mana Severance.f:
"And when this land is wasted, where will we go?"
—Thalakos lament

5DN:Viridian Lorebearers.f: A small band of elves pledged many years ago to avoid the Edges of Forgetting. They have remained hidden until now.

ATQ:Golgothian Sylex.f: From their earliest educations, the brothers had known that no human contrivance could stand against the true masters of Dominia.

MRD:Slith Strider.f: A slith's form and function are determined by the color of the sun under which it's born.

ALL:Soldevi Sentry.f:
"A dreadful invention. What ease is there under the watchful eye of cold steel?"
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic

CHK:Strength of Cedars.f:
"No sooner had the beast collapsed under the blows of Takeno's sword than the earth rippled and the creature rose again to face him."
—*Battle of Akagi River: A Survivor's Tale*

UDS:Taunting Elf.f: Much to Multani's chagrin, Rofellos gleefully tutored Yavimaya's elves on the rudest and most vulgar words spoken in Llanowar.

MMQ:Rain of Tears.f: Mercadian elitism is reinforced daily by physical position: their neighbors are literally beneath them and are treated accordingly.

USG:Electryte.f: Shivan inhabitants are hardened to fire, so their predators have developed alternative weaponry.

CHK:Guardian of Solitude.f:
"It seemed an easy thing, to step into the nothingness, to fall, to die. But then, for an instant, I saw it, eyes filled with endless sorrow, and I turned back to face my pain."
—Snow-Fur, kitsune poet

CHK:Kodama's Reach.f:
"The land grows only where the kami will it."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

MMQ:Bargaining Table.f: Although it looks like a game, business around the table is deadly serious.

5DN:Dross Crocodile.f: The necrogen may have taken its sight, but it can still taste the fear of its prey.

ULG:About Face.f: The overconfident are the most vulnerable.

FEM:Conch Horn.f: Even the most skilled of modern mages only partially understand the Conch Horn's awesome powers.

VIS:Retribution of the Meek.f:
"Tread upon the meek, and they shall wound your feet and make you crawl."
—Asmira, Holy Avenger

MMQ:Chambered Nautilus.f: What's merely a home for the nautilus can become exquisite jewelry in the hands of Saprazzan artisans.

STH:Mortuary.f:
"Think of them not as failures but as works in progress."
—Volrath

ODY:Psionic Gift.f: For sale: Complete wizard's library. Rare scrolls, grimoires, and works of ancient spellcrafting! Slightly abridged.

SOK:Reki, the History of Kamigawa.f:
"After his death, monks spent ten years transcribing the tattoos from Reki's body and gathering stories from those who spoke with him. Thus the volume you hold was written."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

INV:Saproling Infestation.f: "My army took centuries to gather," remarked Urza. "Yavimaya seems to conjure hers out of thin air."

5DN:Disruption Aura.f: Vedalken weapons sold to outsiders are as dependable as the vedalken themselves.

ULG:Bouncing Beebles.f: Beebles are frequently hurled against stone surfaces at high speed but always zing back into the air with a giggle.

POR:Warrior's Charge.f: It is not the absence of fear that makes a warrior, but its domination.

USG:Waylay.f: "You reek of corruption," spat the knight. "Why are you even here?"

ONS:Supreme Inquisitor.f: "It's hard to fight on an empty mind."

MMQ:Ramosian Commander.f: "Cho-Manno guides your spirit. I guide your sword."

POR:Bog Imp.f: Don't be fooled by their looks. Think of them as little knives with wings.

INV:Obsidian Acolyte.f:
The truthful will stand in the gaze of death and escape unharmed.
—Obsidian acolyte creed

ONS:Elvish Guidance.f: "Old home never forgotten, new home ours forever."

LEG:The Abyss.f: "An immense river of oblivion is sweeping us away into a nameless abyss." —Ernest Renan, *Souvenirs d'Enfance et de Jeunesse*

APC:Bloodfire Dwarf.f: For them, the only honorable death is one that leaves a crater.

MMQ:Thrashing Wumpus.f: Young wumpuses are malevolent and vicious—but they grow out of it.

DST:Screams from Within.f: There's no escaping an enemy that lives inside your head.

BOK:Empty-Shrine Kannushi.f: "Crease the folds, bend the paper, turn the spirits, shield the soul."

5DN:Blind Creeper.f: It shuns everything except its next meal.

TMP:Auratog.f: The auratog enjoys eating its wards.

FEM:Goblin Flotilla.f: Exceptionally poor sailors, Goblins usually arrived at their destination retching and in no condition to fight.

WTH:Strands of Night.f:
"I have seen the night torn into thin darkling strips and woven into shapes too bleak for dreams."
—Crovax

TMP:Gravedigger.f: A full coffin is like a full coffer—both are attractive to thieves.

ULG:Sick and Tired.f: The Phyrexians' only interest in organic life is discerning its weakness.

STH:Tidal Surge.f:
"It is nature that gives us our boundaries and nature that enforces them."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

TMP:Dream Cache.f:
"The sanctity of poverty is an invention of the rich."
—Starke

PCY:Marsh Boa.f: Though a powerful constrictor, it prefers simply to drown its prey.

PTK:Southern Elephant.f: While defending their southern borders, both the Wu and Shu kingdoms fought against the barbarians' trained elephants.

HML:Ambush Party.f:
"Call it a cost of doing business. The best way to protect against thieves is to hire better thieves."
—Eron the Relentless

LEG:Giant Turtle.f:
"The turtle lives 'twixt plated decks/ Which practically conceal its sex./ I think it clever of the turtle/ In such a fix to be so fertile."
—Ogden Nash, "The Turtle"

MRD:Tangleroot.f: As if there's glitch in the system, the Tangle sometimes folds in on itself, throwing off sparks of mana in a mystifying display.

ICE:Pyroclasm.f:
"Leaves more room for the big ones to fight in, you know."
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

SCG:Carrion Feeder.f: Stinking of rot, it leaps between gravestones in search of its next meal.

CHK:Hanabi Blast.f: The most powerful of akki fire spells were developed at the cost of blood, toil, tears, sweat, and usually a nose or two.

INV:Blinding Light.f: An angel's sword impales only the body; her righteousness penetrates the soul.

BOK:Uproot.f:
"We arrived at the battlefield too late. *Again*. Another error on your part, and you will have to answer to me personally."
—General Takeno, letter to the imperial mapmaker

USG:Oppression.f:
"Do not presume to speak for yourself."
—Gix, to Xantcha

ALL:Casting of Bones.f:
"Only a necromancer would create such a foul form of divination."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

ODY:Obstinate Familiar.f:
"Lizards make excellent familiars. They never know when they've lost."
—Matoc, lavamancer

LGN:Cephalid Pathmage.f: Pathmages can open doors that aren't even there.

WTH:Hidden Horror.f: Lifespans are measured by its dreadful length.

ICE:Shambling Strider.f: Freyalise forbid that any stranger should wander into the Striders' territory.

ICE:Pygmy Allosaurus.f:
"I don't understand the appeal of keeping these things as pets, unless you want your children eaten."
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox

DST:Pulse of the Tangle.f: Before predators or prey, there was life.

ICE:Foxfire.f:
"Only the foolish fear Foxfire."
—Kolbjörn, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

TMP:Staunch Defenders.f:
"Hold your position! Leave doubt for the dying!"
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

TOR:Skullscorch.f:
"A good whack on the head usually has the same effect."
—Kamahl, pit fighter

MIR:Ethereal Champion.f:
"If I have learned anything as a wizard it is this: never fight your own battles."
—Waffa, sorcerer of Nyomba

HML:Sea Sprite.f:
"No one can catch what won't be caught."
—Kakra, Sea Troll

USG:Healing Salve.f:
"Xantcha is recovering. The medicine is slow, but my magic would have killed her."
—Serra, to Urza

MMQ:Panacea.f: A drop numbs the tongue. A sip sends the heart racing. A draught reforges the body.

INV:Hunting Kavu.f: Dominarians gladly fought alongside kavu . . . until the kavu figured out some Dominarians were quite tasty.

ONS:Accursed Centaur.f:
"The Cabal mocks the natural order. For its minions, death is just a pause between duties."
—Kamahl, druid acolyte

ODY:Mindslicer.f: It *is* the thing that goes bump in the night.

INV:Bog Initiate.f:
"Urborg's magic is strong. Did Urza send you to protect us or to protect against us?"
—Urborg witch, to Barrin

BOK:Goblin Cohort.f: Akki shells provided good protection when downhill charging became headlong tumbling.

ICE:Fiery Justice.f:
"The fire of justice burns like nothing else."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

ICE:Giant Trap Door Spider.f:
"So large and so quiet—a combination best avoided."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

WTH:Lava Hounds.f:
What cats bury, dogs eat.
—Urborg aphorism

5DN:Ouphe Vandals.f: The ouphes finally managed to still the clockwork monstrosity by catching themselves in its cogs.

PCY:Vintara Snapper.f:
"The snapper is still when all else moves
And strikes when all are dozing."
—*Tales of the Vintara Forest*

NEM:Flowstone Wall.f: The rebels assaulted the wall, never suspecting the wall would assault back.

ULG:Delusions of Mediocrity.f: When nothing but second best will do.

MIR:Patagia Golem.f: It scattered falcons like a lion hunting among jackals.

MMQ:Lure.f: Deepwood's reach is not long, so it invites its enemies in.

INV:Ravenous Rats.f: Nothing is sacred to the rats. Everything is simply another meal.

POR:Lava Flow.f: People ran as never before at the thought of being buried and cremated at the same time.

PCY:Panic Attack.f: Sometimes everyone decides to go for help at the same time.

WTH:Argivian Find.f:
"We often bury our pasts, and then someone comes along and digs them up."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

POR:Devoted Hero.f: The heart's courage is the soul's guardian.

USG:Spined Fluke.f: Its spines are prized as writing quills by the priests of Gix.

LGN:Aven Redeemer.f: Redeemers rise with the sun, and the spirits of the people rise with them.

DRK:Goblin Digging Team.f: "From down here we can make the whole wall collapse!" "Uh, yeah, boss, but how do we get out?"

APC:Gaea's Skyfolk.f: The grace of the forest and the spirit of the sea.

ARN:Piety.f: "Whoever obeys God and His Prophet, fears God and does his duty to Him, will surely find success." —The Qur'an, 24:52

TMP:Disenchant.f: The swarm seemed unmoved by the artificial slivers' destruction. "They clearly were not the leaders," Hanna cursed. "I guess we'll have to do this the hard way."

MMQ:Gerrard's Irregulars.f: Had Gerrard realized he'd end up fighting against them, he might not have trained them so well.

SCG:Death's-Head Buzzard.f: Infested with vermin, ever hungering, dropping from night's sky.

ODY:Unifying Theory.f: Scribbles of a lunatic and formulas of a genius are often indistinguishable.

DRK:Marsh Goblins.f: Even the other Goblin races shun the Marsh Goblins, thanks to certain unwholesome customs they practice.

CHK:Kami of Twisted Reflection.f: Its form reflected humanity as it stood during the Kami War: disjointed, confused, and incomplete.

BOK:Crack the Earth.f:
"As the war progressed, the destruction the kami caused became more widespread and less predictable."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

TMP:Knight of Dusk.f:
Fall like night upon the foe.
—Motto of the Knights of Dusk

UDS:Aura Thief.f: Illusion steals reality from the unwise.

PTK:Straw Soldiers.f: The overnight appearance of miles of "armed" Wu forts at Guangling frightened a much vaster Wei force into fleeing for their lives.

HML:Mystic Decree.f:
"Curse Reveka, and curse her coddled conjurers. Their sorcerers' school shall yet be ours."
—Irini Sengir

EXO:Scrivener.f:
"History is a potent weapon."
—Karn, silver golem

CHK:Samurai Enforcers.f: From the moment they swore their oaths, they belonged to their lord, sword and soul.

MMQ:Muzzle.f:
Clenched teeth do not bite.
—Cho-Arrim saying

MRD:Vedalken Archmage.f:
"The Knowledge Pool knows. Memnarch understands."
—Janus, speaker of the synod

ONS:Wall of Mulch.f: Mulch is the fabric of life in the forest. Plants live in it, they die in it, and then they become part of it, feeding countless generations to come.

MMQ:Rampart Crawler.f:
"Not even the magistrate in his lofty tower is out of our reach."
—Cateran overlord

USG:Cradle Guard.f:
Mother, sleep / Dream our lives
Our roots your soul / Our leaves your bed.

ODY:Liquid Fire.f: There's no such thing as a little bit of lava.

ODY:Overeager Apprentice.f: Slow and steady may not always win the race, but at least it doesn't end up splattered on the walls.

MRD:Annul.f:
"Murder of the living is tragic, but murder of the idea is unforgivable."
—Janus, speaker of the synod

ICE:Foul Familiar.f:
"Serve me, and live forever."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

MMQ:Renounce.f: Gerrard offered no defense to Orim's condemnation; the mission was under his command, and he was responsible.

ICE:Baton of Morale.f:
"The Goblins would kill to get ahold of this one."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

POR:Panther Warriors.f: The dogs of war are nothing compared to the cats.

WTH:Xanthic Statue.f:
"Until you have lived as a statue, do not talk to me of pigeons."
—Karn, silver golem

NEM:Mind Slash.f: "I can't think with all that screaming."

LGN:Synapse Sliver.f:
"Species XR17 feeds upon the mental energies of its victims. This explains why the goblins remain unaffected."
—Riptide Project researcher

SOK:Briarknit Kami.f: One thorn to warn, ten thorns to defend, a hundred thorns to destroy.

FEM:Dwarven Catapult.f:
"Often greatly outnumbered in battle, Dwarves relied on catapults as one means of damaging a large army."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

ODY:Think Tank.f: Cephalids seek knowledge not to better themselves, but to best others.

HML:Greater Werewolf.f:
"The wolf-things are no mere beasts, but the lieutenants of the Baron."
—Taysir

EXO:Necrologia.f:
"My enemies' death yields threefold benefit: removal, reuse, and research."
—Volrath

TMP:Watchdog.f: Its growl is a long, rumbling grind of gears and clockwork, its bark a blast of hissing steam.

WTH:Revered Unicorn.f:
"I felt unworthy even to dream of it."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

WTH:Aboroth.f: The *Weatherlight* banked sharply as the colossal beast rose up to crush the lone rider. "My bet's on the dirt," Gerrard said flatly.

ULG:Weatherseed Faeries.f: Two days after the forge was completed, the faeries were immune to its flames.

2ED:Hurloon Minotaur.f: The Minotaurs of the Hurloon Mountains are known for their love of battle. They are also known for their hymns to the dead, sung for friend and foe alike. These hymns can last for days, filling the mountain valleys with their low, haunting sounds.

VIS:Quirion Druid.f:
"The land has been gracious enough to let you tread upon her for years. That privilege is about to end."
—Liefellen, Quirion exarch

UDS:Fledgling Osprey.f: It isn't truly born until its first flight.

MIR:Haunting Apparition.f: Like some foul herdbeast, it grazes on the dead.

VIS:Vanishing.f:
"Careless, like a child with fire, so was I with time."
—Teferi

TMP:Sea Monster.f: Water is life. Or perhaps it is just something to wash it down with.

MIR:Firebreathing.f:
"Magic's only part of it, my friend. Diet does the rest."
—Pashad ibn Asim, Suq'Ata trader

ODY:Devoted Caretaker.f: Her eyes blaze with the strength of twenty shields. Every glance is a salvation.

LEG:Durkwood Boars.f: "And the unclean spirits went out, and entered the swine; and the herd ran violently . . ." —Mark 5:13

ICE:Brainstorm.f:
"I reeled from the blow, and then suddenly, I knew exactly what to do. Within moments, victory was mine."
—Gustha Ebbasdotter,
Kjeldoran Royal Mage

INV:Reviving Dose.f: As healers battled each plague, they learned more about the next.

PCY:Excise.f:
"Creation is no great feat. Anything you make, I can unmake in a heartbeat."
—Alexi, zephyr mage

MMQ:Hoodwink.f: The youths of Rishada's marketplace are always ready for a quick footrace.

2ED:Veteran Bodyguard.f: Good bodyguards are hard to find, mainly because they don't live long.

PTK:Famine.f: "But it was a year of dearth. People were reduced to eating leaves of jujube trees. Corpses were seen everywhere in the countryside."

ODY:Amugaba.f: The aven claim it feeds on thunder and rainbows.

USG:Shivan Hellkite.f: A dragon's scale can be carved into a mighty shield, provided you can procure a dragontooth to cut it.

ONS:Improvised Armor.f: "I trust what I make for myself. Do you trust more what is made for you by another?"

ICE:Melting.f:
"Who needs the sun when you've got me around?"
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

ATQ:Argothian Treefolk.f: Haunting cries we hear in our dreams As the forest dies, a death from machines.

STH:Heat of Battle.f: "Takara, it's me!" shouted Starke. It was no use—she obeyed Volrath.

MMQ:Waterfront Bouncer.f: Closing time comes earlier to some than to others.

EXO:Kor Chant.f: The true treasure no thief can touch.

POR:Natural Spring.f: Though many have come to this place to wash their wounds, the water has never turned red.

ODY:Cursed Monstrosity.f:
"Run away! It's an . . . um . . . run away!"
—Nomad sentry

MRD:Titanium Golem.f: Centuries before the first blades of the Razor Fields chimed in the wind, Mirrodin echoed with the golems' footsteps.

WTH:Gallowbraid.f:
"If its skin looks like stone, it is only to match its heart."
—Crovax

ALL:Balduvian Horde.f:
"Peace will come only when we have taken Varchild's head."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

INV:Yavimaya Barbarian.f: Not all elves embrace the pastoral life. Some still roam the forest's edge, forever making war against their hated enemies.

MMQ:Misstep.f:
The feet have no eyes.
—Saprazzan saying

POR:Hulking Goblin.f: The bigger they are, the harder they avoid work.

2ED:White Knight.f: Out of the blackness and stench of the engulfing swamp emerged a shimmering figure. Only the splattered armor and ichor-stained sword hinted at the unfathomable evil the knight had just laid waste.

EXO:Price of Progress.f: Man versus nature is not a fair fight.

PCY:Fen Stalker.f: As silent as a shadow, and just as hard to flee.

INV:Slimy Kavu.f: Its slime liquefies the ground as efficiently as its fangs shred prey.

P02:Alaborn Cavalier.f:
"Course he ran! *I* wouldn't want to stare down that barrel, either!"
—Alaborn soldier

NEM:Rootwater Commando.f: Rootwater merfolk are seldom seen these days, but elf corpses are as numerous as ever.

BOK:Ishi-Ishi, Akki Crackshot.f:
"Here fell Ishi-Ishi, King of the Flaming Pebbles, Scourge of the Mountain Kami, Lover of Goats. May his shell never burn."
—Cave inscription

DRK:Scavenger Folk.f: String, weapons, wax, or jewels—it makes no difference. Leave nothing unguarded in Scarwood.

ODY:Divert.f: "What's the fun of being a wizard if you can't mess with people's heads?"

ICE:Orcish Librarian.f: Us hungry, need food . . . . Lots of books . . . . Hmm . . . .

INV:Exotic Curse.f:
Fouler than a necromancer's kiss.
—Jamuraan expression

CHK:Vassal's Duty.f: "My life is yours, my lord. There is no greater service than to yield it for your safety."

PTK:Xun Yu, Wei Advisor.f: "A splendid talent, admired of all men! His folly lay in serving Cao Cao's power."

UDS:Reckless Abandon.f: The climax of a warlord's career is always death.

APC:Divine Light.f:
"Phyrexia is an unforgiving place, and I am an angry lord in an unforgiving mood."
—Lord Windgrace

PCY:Reveille Squad.f: "To arms! To arms! The Lion roars!"

LEG:Tundra Wolves.f: I heard their eerie howling, the wolves calling their kindred across the frozen plains.

JUD:Swelter.f: No circle has a beginning, but many have foreseeable ends.

SOK:Death Denied.f: Takenuma was filled with a chorus of moans, shrieks, and wails. Some came from the living, some from the dying, and some, most horribly, from the dead.

LGN:Frenetic Raptor.f:
"How do you stop a raptor from charging? No, seriously! Help!"
—Blarg, goblin jester

SCG:Rock Jockey.f: Goblins don't know much about physics, but they know lots about falling and rocks.

ULG:Hidden Gibbons.f: When these apes want something, it's a matter of gibbon take.

CHK:Wandering Ones.f:
"I saw them once, when I was a child. They led me to my parents' arms when I was lost. Why have they abandoned me now? Why won't they take me home again?"
—Unnamed beggar

PTK:Guan Yu's 1,000-Li March.f: "He [Guan Yu] covered the ground on a thousand-*li* horse; / With dragon blade he took each pass by force."

MMQ:Collective Unconscious.f: Gerrard knew little of Ramos, the sky god they worshiped. But he felt the power of the chant.

BOK:Shinka Gatekeeper.f:
"Understanding is not a virtue of the ogre. Do not seek to reason your way into Shinka Keep."
—Kiku, Night's Flower

WTH:Relearn.f:
"Barrin taught me that the hardest lessons to grasp are the ones you've already learned."
—Ertai, wizard adept

BOK:Isao, Enlightened Bushi.f:
"I do not care if he claims no allegiance in this war. Find him, Takeno."
—Lord Konda

ONS:Glory Seeker.f: The turning of the tide always begins with one soldier's decision to head back into the fray.

MIR:Ekundu Cyclops.f:
"Big one I, One big eye. One-eye see Two-eye die!"
—Traditional cyclops chant

P02:Norwood Riders.f: "Trade my moose? Sure—when I find a *horse* that can spear ten goblins at a time!"

INV:Atalya, Samite Master.f: "Healing is a gift the divine ones have shared with us. It is a sacred trust."

USG:Citanul Hierophants.f: From deep in the caves beneath the forest, the hierophants planned the druids' raids against the enemy.

USG:Angelic Chorus.f: The very young and the very old know best the song the angels sing.

ONS:Arcanis the Omnipotent.f: He has journeyed where none have been before. Now he returns to ensure that none follow.

USG:Worship.f:
"Believe in the ideal, not the idol."
—Serra

LGN:Magma Sliver.f: As malleable as molten steel, but as dangerous as the finished blade.

INV:Essence Leak.f:
"We define the boundaries of reality; they don't define us."
—Teferi

PCY:Branded Brawlers.f:
"The sword or the lash. Choose."
—Akul, Keldon whip sergeant

STH:Duct Crawler.f:
"The mountain's ducts will be like organ pipes, amplifying the glorious roar of the dying."
—Stronghold architect, journal

APC:Lay of the Land.f: Victory favors neither the righteous nor the wicked. It favors the prepared.

ODY:Twigwalker.f:
"Break one in half and you'll get a decent—if gooey—pair of weapons."
—Centaur warrior

TMP:Marsh Lurker.f: From the mists it rises, into the mists it retreats; through the mists it walks, fearless and unseen.

EXO:Reckless Ogre.f: There is no such thing as a regiment of ogres.

HML:Leeches.f:
"Where our potions and powders fail, perhaps nature will succeed."
—Reyhan, Samite Alchemist

MIR:Femeref Healer.f:
"Faith is my shield, and hope is my armor; I am vulnerable only to myself."
—Asmira, Holy Avenger

CHK:Reito Lantern.f: Lanterns carved from the mystic stones of the Reito Mines were said to light the way of lost souls.

MIR:Volcanic Geyser.f:
My thunder comes before the lightning; my lightning comes before the clouds; my rain dries all the land it touches. What am I?
—Femeref riddle

SCG:Putrid Raptor.f: It eagerly gobbles up bits of its own rotting flesh as they fall to the swampy ground.

ODY:Decimate.f:
"Anyone can admire creation. Only a barbarian sees the beauty in demolition."
—Kamahl, pit fighter

INV:Turf Wound.f:
"I can't imagine how anyone lives in Shiv, let alone why they choose to stay."
—Sisay

TMP:Reckless Spite.f:
"My plan's elegance leads my enemies to believe it is spite that fuels me."
—Volrath

TMP:Energizer.f: Like a kettle set to boil, it must eventually go off—on someone.

MIR:Femeref Knight.f:
"I will return / with lizard skins for your sandals. Paint your eyes black and wait for me."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

PCY:Rethink.f: "Are you *sure* you want to do that?"

ODY:Demolish.f:
"Pound the steel until it fits. Doesn't work? Bash to bits."
—Dwarven forging song

ODY:Decompose.f:
"Sheesh! How am I supposed to make a decent living around here?"
—Cabal grave robber

ALL:Yavimaya Ancients.f:
"We orphans of Fyndhorn have found no welcome in this alien place."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, Elvish Hunter

ATQ:Strip Mine.f: Unlike previous conflicts, the war between Urza and Mishra made Dominia itself a casualty of war.

ALL:Juniper Order Advocate.f:
"In these troubled times, we alone carry the hope of reconciliation between Elf and Human."
—Jaeuhl Carthalion, Juniper Order Advocate

ICE:Trailblazer.f:
"Our Elvish Hunter Taaveti led us swiftly along hidden paths through the dense forest. We caught the Orcs from behind, and completely by surprise."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter, Leader of the Order of the White Shield

TOR:Skywing Aven.f: "I am as the wind that bears me: harsh yet gentle, fleeting yet ever-present. Together we fly beyond imagination."

ONS:Imagecrafter.f: When Otarians learned not to trust wizards, the wizards learned to adapt.

CHK:Imi Statue.f:
"Just looking at it fills me with dread . . . . Yet since it arrived, I've done little else. My blades have dulled and my business has failed, and still I cannot look away."
—Keisaku, master swordmaker

CHK:Sakura-Tribe Elder.f: There were no tombstones in orochi territory. Slain warriors were buried with a tree sapling, so they would become a part of the forest after death.

TMP:Wind Drake.f: Orim regarded Gerrard coolly. "You are like the drake," she said, her expression unchanging. "It works hard to maintain its position, but to us it seems to glide along effortlessly. You *must* do the same."

DST:Murderous Spoils.f: Scavengers are always the first to pay their respects.

STH:Bottomless Pit.f:
"I'm sure it came with the place. I don't think you build one on purpose."
—Gerrard

USG:Fluctuator.f: Fiko summoned only atogs for three straight sessions. The tutor couldn't decide whether to punish his failure or praise his consistency.

INV:Chromatic Sphere.f:
"Let insight and energy be your guides."
—The Blind Seer, to Gerrard

PCY:Sunken Field.f: The land is heavy with promise, the harvest ripe with betrayal.

MMQ:Timid Drake.f: It flees from anything that isn't shaped like a cloud.

MRD:Seething Song.f: Vulshok mana rituals echo the day when the red sun burst through Mirrodin's surface to take its place in the heavens.

ODY:Phantom Whelp.f: It lurks in the mist, waiting for stragglers to fall behind. When the fog clears, nothing remains but footprints.

TMP:Dark Banishing.f:
"It is the way of most wizards to begin by exiling themselves and to end by exiling everyone else."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

WTH:Tolarian Serpent.f:
"When the fishtails' threats of magic didn't move me, they set their pet on us."
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

VIS:Matopi Golem.f: Some potmakers claim to use the mud of such creatures to make their finest bowls—and that the bowls scream when fired.

WTH:Touchstone.f:
"One touch to the stone and the sidar's son turned me from stalwart to statue."
—Karn, silver golem

2ED:Pearled Unicorn.f: "'Do you know, I always thought Unicorns were fabulous monsters, too? I never saw one alive before!' 'Well, now that we have seen each other,' said the Unicorn, 'if you'll believe in me, I'll believe in you.'" —Lewis Carroll

TMP:Skyshroud Troll.f: The elves and merfolk have nothing but bitterness for each other. The trolls, however, find them both rather tasty.

MIR:Reign of Chaos.f:
"The Burning Isles are the home to a dozen lords who claim dominion. Jamuraa will look to only one leader: me."
—Kaervek

SOK:Razorjaw Oni.f: It gnashed its teeth, and the battlefield filled with the screech of blade striking blade.

CHK:Rend Flesh.f:
"The Reito Massacre was a testament to the kami's unstoppable power. The human defenders might as well have been moths battling a forest fire."
—*Great Battles of Kamigawa*

TMP:Puppet Strings.f: "Have no illusions," Volrath warned Greven, "about free will."

ICE:Order of the White Shield.f:
"Shall we turn away a worthy soul because his parents were peasants? I think not."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter, Leader of the Order of the White Shield

TMP:Kindle.f: Hope of deliverance is scorched by the fire of futility.

UDS:Bloodshot Cyclops.f: After their first encounter, the goblins named him Chuck.

MRD:Viridian Shaman.f: Because the elves are so in touch with Mirrodin's nature, they understand best how to dismantle it.

BOK:Minamo Sightbender.f: Woven from threads of the spirit world, the mistcloak rendered its wearer invisible, but quickly fell to tatters.

MRD:Galvanic Key.f: A solution in search of a problem.

USG:Skirge Familiar.f: The first Yawgmoth priest to harness their power was rewarded with several unique mutilations.

MRD:Yotian Soldier.f: Poets dream the verses of otherworldly stories. Artificers dream the blueprints of otherplanar artifacts.

DRK:Scarecrow.f: There was more malice in its button eyes than should have been possible in something that had never known life.

STH:Cloud Spirit.f:
Clouds are the soil, dreams are the crop.
—Kor saying

TOR:Sickening Dreams.f: The Patriarch dreams of vile plague.

ONS:Run Wild.f: Wirewood's beasts didn't seem to mind when the elves moved in. In fact, they hardly noticed them underfoot.

USG:Douse.f: The academy's libraries were protected by fire-prevention spells. Even after the disaster, the books were intact—though forever sealed in time.

USG:Skittering Skirge.f: The imps' warbling cries echo through Phyrexia's towers like those of mourning doves in a cathedral.

TMP:Bayou Dragonfly.f:
"Like a sugar stick with wings!"
—Squee, goblin cabin hand

SCG:Silver Knight.f: Otaria's last defense against the wave of chaos threatening to engulf it.

2ED:Benalish Hero.f: Benalia has a complex caste system that changes with the lunar year. No matter what the season, the only caste that cannot be attained by either heredity or money is that of the hero.

STH:Grave Pact.f:
"The bonds of loyalty can tie one to the grave."
—Crovax

UDS:Soul Feast.f: As no one has ever accepted a second invitation to Davvol's table, the evincar often dines alone.

TMP:Abandon Hope.f: As Gerrard's form vanished into the maw of trees, Hanna mouthed a silent plea, mourning a crushed dream.

2ED:Bog Wraith.f: 'Twas in the bogs of Cannelbrae My mate did meet an early grave 'Twas nothing left for us to save In the peat-filled bogs of Cannelbrae.

USG:Abyssal Horror.f: It has no face of its own—it wears that of its latest victim.

EXO:Cat Burglar.f: The *il*-Kor no longer roam the open plains, but they are still hunters.

MMQ:Rishadan Cutpurse.f:
The bigger the purse, the greater the fool.
—Rishadan saying

STH:Hibernation Sliver.f: Mogglings have been known to play ball with hibernating slivers, completely unaware of their true nature.

ULG:Silk Net.f: Sometimes it's possible to pull a meal out of thin air.

EXO:Rootwater Mystic.f:
"Read the roots tell the tale
Future forms in waving weeds
Higher than truth is hope."
—*Rootwater Saga*

5DN:Vedalken Orrery.f: The model incorporated the fifth sun effortlessly, as if it had always known.

BOK:Shimmering Glasskite.f: A child's whisper could crack its shell, but not even an oni's scream could penetrate it.

LGN:Stonewood Invoker.f: The Mirari pulses in his veins.

MRD:Tree of Tales.f: Tel-Jilad, sanctum of the ancient trolls, keepers of the secret of Mirrodin's origin.

TMP:Mogg Raider.f: The evisceration of one mogg always cheers up the rest.

DRK:Drowned.f: We asked Captain Soll what became of the Serafina, but all he said was, "Ships that go down shouldn't come back up."

ULG:Molten Hydra.f:
Keep off the glass.
—Hydra warning sign

MMQ:Seismic Mage.f: The ground shakes when he walks. His customers shake if they're late with his fee.

LEG:Moat.f: The purpose of any moat is to impede attack. Some are filled with water, some with thistles. Some are filled with things best left unseen.

ONS:Shepherd of Rot.f:
"My priests swore loyalty to the Cabal not until death, but beyond it."
—Cabal Patriarch

POR:Volcanic Hammer.f: Cast the weight as though it were a die, to see a rival's fate.

P02:Armageddon.f: War destroys more than just the land. War destroys hope.

MIR:Emberwilde Caliph.f: The fire breathes while the air burns.

MIR:Benthic Djinn.f:
"In all my years I've only met one mage who successfully trapped a djinn—and none who tried and failed."
—Talibah, embermage

NEM:Harvest Mage.f: "Why should one limit oneself to the resources at hand?"

ICE:Grizzled Wolverine.f:
"Before you release a Wolverine from the trap, make sure it's really dead."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

UDS:Opposition.f:
"Urza says he's sane. Perhaps, but measures of sanity among planeswalkers are hard to come by."
—Barrin

ONS:Dragon Roost.f: A powerful mage created the roost to guard a portal between the planes. The mage is long gone, but dragons still keep watch at the gate.

ULG:Pygmy Pyrosaur.f:
Do not judge a lizard by its size.
—Ghitu proverb

ALL:Soldevi Heretic.f:
"It cannot be! Soldev crushed, and my machines to blame?"
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

INV:Shimmering Wings.f:
"Wings are but fins for swimming the sky."
—Empress Galina

APC:Urborg Uprising.f: In Urborg, few things are less permanent than death.

PLS:Sunscape Familiar.f: The spirits of fallen battlemages can serve their guilds as familiars by joining with any physical form.

MIR:Teremko Griffin.f:
"When we're aloft, I love to lean over the *Weatherlight*'s railing and watch the patterns the griffins' shadows make on the clouds below."
—Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*

2ED:Obsianus Golem.f:
"The foot stone is connected to the ankle stone, the ankle stone is connected to the leg stone..."
—Song of the Artificer

ODY:Werebear.f: He exercises his right to bear arms.

USG:Priest of Titania.f: Titania rewards all those who honor the forest by making them a living part of it.

DST:Fireball.f: The spell fell upon the crowd like a dragon, ancient and full of death.

ULG:Treefolk Mystic.f: Urza's wards fell from him like autumn leaves as he entered the dreaming grove. He awoke imprisoned in living wood.

MRD:Ornithopter.f: Regardless of the century, plane, or species, developing artificers never fail to invent the ornithopter.

PTK:Exhaustion.f: Starving and worn, Cao Cao escaped from the battle of Red Cliffs with only 27 of his original 800,000 men.

FEM:Icatian Infantry.f:
"Never Surrender"
—Motto carved into a fragment of an Icatian wall

PTK:Borrowing 100,000 Arrows.f: Kongming and Lu Su tricked Wei troops into shooting over 100,000 arrows at them to later use against the Wei at Red Cliffs.

MMQ:Soothing Balm.f: Orim taught Ta-Karnst and the other Cho-Arrim healers a far less invasive method of healing.

UDS:Heart Warden.f:
"In Llanowar, we tend the forest's boughs and branches. In Yavimaya, we are a part of them."
—Rofellos of Llanowar

LEG:Crimson Manticore.f: Noted neither for their good looks nor their charm, Crimson Manticores can be fearsome allies. As dinner companions, however, they are best left alone.

ODY:Overrun.f:
The dance of angry feet
—Nantuko expression meaning "stampede"

INV:Tranquility.f: The plagues robbed Dominaria of all but its dreams. Eladamri hoped dreams were enough.

POR:Mobilize.f: A rested mind is the sharpest weapon.

UDS:Thorn Elemental.f: Rain from this storm leaves you pinned to the ground like an insect.

HML:Daughter of Autumn.f:
"Those who say that Serra is dead have never met the Autumn Willow's daughters. They are as kind and as generous as Serra would wish us to be."
—Gulsen, Abbey Matron

JUD:Harvester Druid.f: "In the end, the same soil lies atop the field, within the mountain, and under the sea."

WTH:Alms.f:
"Helping people is mostly a matter of teaching them to help themselves."
—Sisay, journal

POR:Cloak of Feathers.f: A thousand feathers from a thousand birds, sewn with magic and song.

PTK:Forced Retreat.f:
"Leadership, not numbers, determines victory."
—A Wu commander, before his 5,000 troops forced 15,000 Wei troops to retreat from Ruxu

5DN:Skyhunter Skirmisher.f:
"Like dawn's first light, blind the unprepared and banish the shadows."
—Skyhunter creed

MRD:Krark-Clan Shaman.f: "What do you mean, we're out of stuff to melt down? Give me your leg."

ODY:Ground Seal.f:
"Let all we have buried be buried forever."
—Seton, centaur druid

DST:Death Cloud.f: The swarm's million wings stir the foulest of breezes.

VIS:Katabatic Winds.f: Wind will win, whatever we wish.

LEG:Jedit Ojanen.f: Mightiest of the Cat Warriors, Jedit Ojanen forsook the forests of his tribe and took service with the Robaran Mercenaries, rising through their ranks to lead them in the battle for Efrava.

MRD:Pyrite Spellbomb.f:
"Melt that which was never frozen."
—Spellbomb inscription

DST:Auriok Glaivemaster.f: "Give me a bit of steel and I'll deliver it into the hearts of my enemies."

LEG:Eternal Warrior.f: Warriors of the Tsunami-nito School spend years in training to master the way of effortless effort.

UDS:Lurking Jackals.f: Often it's not the hunter or the hunted but the opportunist who thrives in Rath.

INV:Urborg Drake.f: Relentless as the sea, remorseless as death.

DST:Fangren Firstborn.f: In the Tangle, bad is often followed by worse.

UDS:Mantis Engine.f: Tawnos left a legacy of animal designs in many of Urza's creations.

ODY:Extract.f: To say Nixar had a splitting headache would be a bit of an understatement.

DST:Chittering Rats.f: Bottom feeders sometimes rise to the top.

MRD:Farsight Mask.f: It turns the adversity of the moment into the knowledge of a lifetime.

TMP:Bounty Hunter.f: "Once they've marked you," Starke said, "the world is made of glass."

INV:Shivan Oasis.f: Only the hardiest explorers survive to eat the fruit.

ODY:Confessor.f: "There will be gains for our losses. There will be rights for our wrongs."

INV:Treva's Attendant.f: "Treva is the voice of the ur-dragon, demanding cries of worship."

POR:Border Guard.f: "Join the army, see foreign countries!" they'd said.

ULG:Devout Harpist.f: The notes themselves are irrelevant. The music's effect, however, is worth ten armies.

USG:Pendrell Drake.f: The mages of Tolaria found strange ways to spend their free time. Occasionally they had contests to see whose kite was eaten last.

CHK:Cleanfall.f: During the war, the rites of purification were still effective, but the kami, not the kitsune, chose what to cleanse.

ODY:Sadistic Hypnotist.f: "Victory in the pits is almost as rewarding as the methods I use to achieve it."

CHK:Cage of Hands.f:
"Our own actions built the prisons that now hold us. Our hands reached too far and tried to hold too much."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

USG:Thundering Giant.f: The giant was felt a few seconds before he was seen.

5DN:Devour in Shadow.f:
"Feel the burn of the mists. Master them. They will devour your enemies."
—Geth, keeper of the Vault

MMQ:Lithophage.f: It's viciously territorial, destroying every creature on the mountain it has chosen to consume.

PCY:Mercenary Informer.f: The problem with rebels is that they so quickly reject authority.

ICE:Arctic Foxes.f:
"Those Foxes are wily, swift, and ferocious. They are the warriors of the snows."
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox

LEG:Moss Monster.f: After the battle, an eerie silence gripped the forest. The losers' remains were lightly dusted with green.

DST:Darksteel Forge.f:
"Did it have this shape upon Mirrodin's creation, or did some inconceivable force shape the unshapable?"
—Pontifex, elder researcher

POR:Soul Shred.f: It would be a shame to let life slip away to nothing.

JUD:Goretusk Firebeast.f: As a youth, Kamahl took one for a pet. His hair has yet to grow back.

MMQ:Extravagant Spirit.f: The fewer your possessions, the fewer your worries.

ULG:Archivist.f: Some do. Some teach. The rest look it up.

5DN:Acquire.f: Sometimes "innovation" means "stealing another's secret before anyone else can."

TMP:Storm Front.f: The calmest day on Rath would be thought a storm anywhere else.

DST:Essence Drain.f: Mephidross claims all life within it. What cannot be twisted is absorbed.

CHK:Lantern Kami.f:
"Snuffing the light of a lantern without saying a small prayer is bad luck. Though its flame can only singe, its soul can repeatedly visit misery on one's house."
—Teachings of Eight-and-a-Half-Tails

APC:Razorfin Hunter.f: No one knew if they'd been lurking under the sea all along, or if they'd been created by the Phyrexian overlay.

PCY:Spiketail Hatchling.f: It dodges waves of water to prepare for waves of magic.

ONS:Insurrection.f:
"Maybe they wanted to be on the winning side for once."
—Matoc, lavamancer

BOK:Threads of Disloyalty.f:
"Over time, Konda grew ever more suspicious, fearing even his most loyal allies were being manipulated by unseen hands."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

5DN:Fist of Suns.f:
"It is all in my grasp. Every petty dream, every grand scheme, every soul, every fear. It all flows through me and from me."
—Memnarch

ONS:Wirewood Savage.f:
"She is truly Wirewood's child now."
—Elvish refugee

TMP:Root Maze.f:
"We should step up repairs. I think the forest has plans for us."
—Crovax

ICE:Shyft.f:
