"Capturing this specimen was not easy. Study it well, that you someday might be as versatile."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

MIR:Blinding Light.f:
"My shield will bear a shining sun so you will always be with me. / Inlaid with gold, it will shine like glowing embers."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

HML:Beast Walkers.f:
"The Beast Walkers do a great service to Aysen. As humans or as beasts, their heart is yet to Serra true."
—Baris, Serra Inquisitor

SOK:Michiko Konda, Truth Seeker.f:
"Watch over my father. Tell him I'm safe, but I won't come home until I find out how to bring him back to his senses, and Kamigawa is again at peace."
—Michiko Konda, last letter to General Takeno

P02:Raise Dead.f:
"Life from death is part of the natural cycle. This is merely a shortcut."
—Tojira, swamp queen

BOK:Day of Destiny.f:
"Rise like the sun, stand like the mountain, charge like the lion, die as a hero."
—General Takeno

TMP:Wasteland.f:
"The land promises nothing and keeps its promise."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

ONS:Grand Melee.f: Hot blood washes away cold reason.

DST:Carry Away.f: Stealing goblin weapons would be easier if the goblins were smart enough to let go.

VIS:Desertion.f: First the insult, then the injury.

PCY:Trenching Steed.f: The Keldons took several of the steeds as trophies of war. They'd never seen such a light beast stand so firm.

MMQ:Tooth of Ramos.f: Ramos smiled, and there was day.

JUD:Nomad Mythmaker.f: Nomads weave tales thicker than tapestries.

ODY:Burning Sands.f:
"Pain teaches lessons no scholar can."
—Kamahl, pit fighter

TMP:Rootbreaker Wurm.f: As Gerrard made his escape, the wurm covered his flight by helping itself to three great mouthfuls of merfolk.

ONS:Smother.f:
"I can't hear them scream, but at least I don't have to listen to them beg."
—Phage the Untouchable

STH:Spined Sliver.f:
"Slivers are evil and slivers are sly; And if you get eaten, then no one will cry."
—Mogg children's rhyme

WTH:Steel Golem.f:
"Although I would give my life to protect Gerrard, my conscience will not let me take another's. There are many who would not hesitate."
—Karn, silver golem

EXO:Aether Tide.f: The tide of magic brought them here. Now it would take them home.

JUD:Dwarven Bloodboiler.f: His battle cry unleashes an avalanche of dwarves.

ICE:Soul Barrier.f:
"There's more than one way to skin an Ouphe—or thwart a mage."
—Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran Royal Mage

HML:An-Havva Township.f: Folk of good heart will always find a home.

MMQ:Rushwood Herbalist.f: When generals gather their armies, healers gather their herbs.

PTK:Wei Ambush Force.f: The battle of Puyang marked the beginning of the end for Lu Bu. He lost the city—and later his life—to Cao Cao.

INV:Tribal Flames.f:
"Fire is the universal language."
—Jhoira, master artificer

USG:Horseshoe Crab.f: In the final days before the disaster, all the crabs on Tolaria migrated from inlets, streams, and ponds back to the sea. No one took note.

ONS:Blackmail.f: Even the most virtuous person is only one secret away from being owned by the Cabal.

USG:Blanchwood Armor.f:
"Braid her branches, life fulfilling Goddess loving, Goddess killing."
—Citanul chant

ICE:Essence Filter.f:
"Freyalise has cleansed our bodies and minds of the plagues of Kjeldor; all she asks in return is that we keep pure our newly given home in Fyndhorn."
—Kolbjörn, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

MRD:Vermiculos.f: Mirrodin's artificial environment requires its own predators, scavengers, and senseless forces of nature.

APC:Dead Ringers.f: "Beautiful, isn't it?" crowed Crovax. "They fought together. Now they will die together."

APC:Mournful Zombie.f: Treated with a powerful mix of herbs and potions, its wrappings have a remarkable preservative effect, even for the living.

NEM:Moggcatcher.f: "They're not worth much, but they're easy to catch."

USG:Veiled Crocodile.f: Some roads are paved with bad intentions.

LEG:Ivory Guardians.f: The elite guard of the Mesa High Priests, the Ivory Guardians, were created to protect the innocent and faithful. Some say their actions are above the law.

MRD:Bosh, Iron Golem.f: As Glissa searches for the truth about Memnarch, Bosh searches to unearth the secrets of his past.

TOR:Pitchstone Wall.f: Its material may not be precious, but the minds it protects are.

LEG:Sivitri Scarzam.f: Even the brave have cause to tremble at the sight of Sivitri Scarzam. Who else has tamed Scarzam's Dragon?

TMP:Selenia, Dark Angel.f:
"I am light. I am dark. I must give my life to serve; not even death can release me."
—Selenia, dark angel

P02:Goblin Glider.f: The goblins call the gliders "death from above." Everyone else calls them "clods in the clouds."

P02:Trokin High Guard.f: Battle tempers soldiers as fire tempers steel.

ICE:Incinerate.f:
"Yes, I think 'toast' is an appropriate description."
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

ONS:Battlefield Medic.f: "Death never stops to rest. Neither can we."

ICE:Krovikan Sorcerer.f:
"These Sorcerers always seem to have another surprise up their sleeves."
—Zur the Enchanter

ALL:Omen of Fire.f:
"Let Balduvia burn to warm Kjeldor's hearth!"
—General Varchild

ODY:Shelter.f: Good strategists seize opportunities. Great strategists make their own.

LEG:Divine Offering.f: D'Haren stared at the twisted lump of metal that had been a prized artifact. The fight was getting ugly.

CHK:Akki Rockspeaker.f: The lava-proof shells of akki evolved over centuries, as akki pranks almost always got seriously out of hand.

ULG:Defender of Law.f: "It is not my place to question Radiant's rule. I exist to enforce her will."

TMP:Marble Titan.f:
"Strapping on nine hundred pounds of armor every morning would make any warrior cross."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

PCY:Thrive.f: "We wait and watch, and as we prepare for war, we grow strong."

ULG:Thornwind Faeries.f: Guarding the ship is the Thornwinds' first concern. Getting along with the locals ranks fourth or fifth at best.

MRD:Relic Bane.f: A sword that has seen cowardice in battle exacts the price of honor from its wielder.

SOK:Sakura-Tribe Scout.f:
"Scouts of the Sakura Tribe spent two years wandering the forest to learn every leaf and tree. That knowledge was called upon during the Kami War to ensure the orochi's survival."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

5DN:Chimeric Coils.f: The energy that infuses the rings with life also melts them away, leaving only useless puddles of slag.

UDS:Emperor Crocodile.f: The king of Yavimaya's waters pays constant attention to his subjects . . . and thrives on their adulation.

UDS:Thran Foundry.f:
"What we do not use up, we use again."
—Urza

WTH:Vodalian Illusionist.f:
"Torahn gore these shifty fishtails! You can't even get close to one."
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

MMQ:Alabaster Wall.f: Its mortar is mixed with waters straight from the Fountain of Cho.

SOK:Dense Canopy.f: The orochi learned how to move swiftly and surely along the forest floor, like fish darting through gull-watched waters.

DST:Juggernaut.f: The goblins built it far larger than the cave opening, but to their glee, it smashed into the mountainside, ripping itself a new exit.

WTH:Harvest Wurm.f:
The wurm's weave
—Elvish expression meaning "plowed fields"

PTK:Lu Su, Wu Advisor.f: Lu Su served as an intermediary between the Wu and Shu kingdoms until Zhou Yu's death in 210, when he became Wu's supreme commander.

DRK:Niall Silvain.f: This is his domain, and while you remain here you must value all life as you value your own.

CHK:Reach Through Mists.f:
"Know one part of the name, obsession begins. Know two parts, paranoia sets in. Know three parts, madness descends. Know all, and only the kami know what will become of you."
—Lady Azami

VIS:Impulse.f:
"Controlling time ensures you need never look impulsive again."
—Teferi

ICE:Yavimaya Gnats.f:
"It is our third day of travel on the Yavimaya River, and still these creatures plague us. Davin Lansson, our naturalist, has facetiously labeled them 'gnats,' and the name has stuck."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

INV:Voracious Cobra.f: There's no known antidote for the cobra's venom . . . or its appetite.

DST:Dismantle.f:
"If only the living were so easily salvaged."
—Memnarch

TMP:Earthcraft.f:
"The land gives up little, but we are masters of persuasion."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

MMQ:Tectonic Break.f: Only the foolish and the rich build their houses where the land is thin and the ocean is near.

USG:Seasoned Marshal.f: There are only two rules of tactics: never be without a plan, and never rely on it.

ALL:Soldevi Steam Beast.f:
"Nothing has ever broken my heart so much as this—the betrayal of Soldev by my beloved machines!"
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

LEG:Tuknir Deathlock.f: An explorer of the Æther, Tuknir often discovers himself in the most unusual physical realms.

ODY:Upheaval.f: The calm comes after the storm.

LGN:Elvish Soultiller.f: Mutated elves wondered if this was their final form, or if it was just another step.

EXO:Coat of Arms.f:
"Hup, two, three, four,
Dunno how to count no more."
—Mogg march

LGN:Dreamborn Muse.f:
"Her voice is insight, piercing and true."
—Ixidor, reality sculptor

MIR:Reckless Embermage.f: Many mages have been consumed by their work.

ONS:Anurid Murkdiver.f: Aphetto's swamps are alive with the dead.

POR:Scorching Spear.f: Lift your spear as you might lift your glass, and toast your enemy.

USG:Rewind.f:
"Time flows like a river. In Tolaria we practice the art of building dams."
—Barrin, master wizard

ICE:Heal.f:
"Sometimes even the smallest boon can save a life."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran Priest

MIR:Carrion.f: King or herder, the maggots care not.

USG:Meltdown.f: Catastrophes happened so often at the mana rig that the viashino language had a special word to describe them.

TMP:Thalakos Mistfolk.f:
"They are 'between' in every way."
—Lyna, Soltari emissary

USG:Goblin Matron.f: There's always room for one more.

FEM:Derelor.f:
"Strength it has, but at the cost of a continuous supply of energy. Such failure can bear only one result."
—From the execution order for Endrek Sahr, Master Breeder

MMQ:Spidersilk Armor.f: It hardly weighs anything, but it takes all day to remove.

MMQ:Inviolability.f: A soldier's faith is magic strong enough to protect against any blade.

INV:Teferi's Moat.f:
"Isolation is not the answer."
—Urza, to Teferi

CHK:Azusa, Lost but Seeking.f: "I do not miss Jukai Forest. It is not my home. My home is Kamigawa, its people my family. Wherever I set my pack and rest my head, I am home."

ONS:Battering Craghorn.f: Their skeletons can be found all over Skirk Ridge, tangled in each other's horns.

INV:Seashell Cameo.f:
"Today a seashell fell from the empty sky here in Kinymu, a hundred leagues from the sea. I'm torn—shall I carve a woman or a bird?"
—Isel, master carver

USG:Headlong Rush.f: A landslide of goblins poured toward the defenders—tumbling, rolling, and bouncing their way down the steep hillside.

WTH:Argivian Restoration.f:
"The Argivian University taught me two things: always look to the past, and never dismiss what appears useless."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

TMP:Mawcor.f: From its maw comes neither word nor whisper—only wind.

MRD:Auriok Transfixer.f: "My grandfather knew enough spells to fill a hundred scrolls. Nowadays, if a spell cannot fight the levelers, it is not even taught to our young."

P02:Righteous Charge.f:
"Bravery shines brightest in a pure soul."
—Restela, Alaborn marshal

VIS:Phyrexian Walker.f:
"I have heard terrible tales of black rains, ashen fields, and metal that screams. I have consoled myself that the tales were a myth of some fevered mind. But today I saw a walker—and now I fear the truth."
—Kasib Ibn Naji, Letters

DST:Metal Fatigue.f: The Auriok have fought the metal hordes for so long now that knowing how to cripple them has become an instinct.

ICE:Soldevi Simulacrum.f: They look human— until they bleed.

DRK:Curse Artifact.f: Voska feared the artifact had come too easily.

UDS:Trumpet Blast.f: Keldon warriors don't need signals to tell them when to attack, but when to stop.

ODY:Aven Windreader.f: "The tiniest ripple tells a story ten fathoms deep."

ALL:Inheritance.f:
"More than lessons may be gained from the past."
—Halvor Arensson, Kjeldoran Priest

MMQ:Brainstorm.f:
"I see more than others do because I know where to look."
—Saprazzan vizier

ODY:Nomad Decoy.f: If you can take something from a nomad, it's probably bait.

TOR:Devastating Dreams.f: Kamahl dreams of storms of fire.

MMQ:Heart of Ramos.f: Ramos bled, and there was fire.

JUD:Unquestioned Authority.f:
"Only the Ancestor should be revered."
—Mystic heretic

BOK:Tallowisp.f: Isolated on its little candlewick, the kami never heard of the crime that drove its comrades to war.

POR:Tidal Surge.f:
"'Twas when the seas were roaring With hollow blasts of wind . . . ."
—John Gay, "The What D'Ye Call It"

MIR:Leering Gargoyle.f:
"Only a gargoyle would take such delight in a thunderstorm."
—Qhattib, Vizier of Amiqat

PCY:Sword Dancer.f: Most soldiers think of the sword as a weapon. In the hands of Zho monks, swords are also the strongest of shields.

VIS:Sisay's Ring.f:
"With this ring, you have friends in worlds you've never heard of."
—Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*

FEM:Aeolipile.f:
"Although fragile, the Aeolipile could be quite destructive."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. I*

WTH:Thunderbolt.f:
"Most wizards consider a thunderbolt to be a proper retort."
—Ertai, wizard adept

FEM:Breeding Pit.f: The Thrulls bred at a terrifying pace. In the end, they overwhelmed the Order of the Ebon Hand.

LEG:Underworld Dreams.f: "In the drowsy dark cave of the mind dreams build their nest with fragments dropped from day's caravan." —Rabindranath Tagore

SCG:Metamorphose.f: If it's not one thing, it's another.

PTK:Broken Dam.f: Using nature to their advantage, wise Three Kingdoms generals often let dammed rivers loose to destroy their enemies.

LGN:Fugitive Wizard.f: Many wizards came to the Riptide Project hoping to return home with answers. Most, however, wouldn't return home at all.

EXO:Nausea.f: Any mogg will tell you there's nothing more nauseating than the smell of cute.

PTK:Wei Scout.f:
"He will win who, prepared himself, waits to take the enemy unprepared."
—Sun Tzu, *Art of War* (trans. Giles)

DRK:Grave Robbers.f:
"If you don't have your health, you don't have anything."
—Proverb

NEM:Laccolith Warrior.f: The screams are brief. The silence lingers.

POR:Dry Spell.f: A fist of dust to line your throat, a bowl of sand to fill your belly.

SOK:Glitterfang.f:
"Through the veil's rip spilled hundreds of minor kami, rushing over the battlefield like embers from a kicked campfire. Then they were gone."
—*Great Battles of Kamigawa*

MRD:Atog.f: On Dominaria, a scavenger. On Mirrodin, a predator.

5DN:Synod Centurion.f:
"We order them to stand, they stand. We order them to wait, they wait. We order them to die, they die."
—Pontifex, elder researcher

LGN:Brontotherium.f: Lucky victims get run over. Unlucky victims get run through.

5DN:Furnace Whelp.f: Baby dragons can't figure out humans—if they didn't want to be killed, why were they made of meat and treasure?

TMP:Soltari Emissary.f: Alone at the portal, Ertai began his meditation. He realized immediately that he was not alone.

MIR:Burning Palm Efreet.f: Even the lion envies the lark.

MIR:Raging Spirit.f:
"Its burning power is more elusive than shade on the Unyaro Plains, more perilous than the horn of a rhino."
—Akin, seasoned askari

DST:Voltaic Construct.f: The undead may outlast the living, but those who have never lived outlast them both.

MRD:Gilded Lotus.f: Over such beauty, wars are fought. With such power, wars are won.

POR:Whiptail Wurm.f: It's hard to say for certain which end is more dangerous.

POR:Path of Peace.f: The soldier reaped the profits of peace.

USG:Bulwark.f:
"It will be the goblin's first bath, and its last."
—Fire Eye, viashino bey

DRK:Murk Dwellers.f: When Raganorn unsealed the catacombs, he found more than the dead and their treasures.

PTK:Flanking Troops.f: Following the battle of Redcliffs, both Liu Bei and Sun Quan coveted the province of Jingzhou. After Sun Quan's troops failed to capture it, Liu Bei's succeeded.

TMP:Extinction.f:
"I once had an entire race killed just to listen to the rattling of their dried bones as I waded through them."
—Volrath

MIR:Restless Dead.f:
The rich's heirs often thank them after death . . . but preferably not in person.
—Suq'Ata epigram

MIR:Gibbering Hyenas.f:
Hyenas laughing—what's the joke?
—Femeref phrase meaning "that's not funny"

ONS:Mistform Mutant.f: Familiarity, the first myth of reality: What you know the best, you observe the least.

INV:Rith's Attendant.f: "Rith is the claw of the ur-dragon, scattering seeds of devastation."

LEG:Gravity Sphere.f: On the morning of the Battle of Gal-Shan, the Sorcerer's cry rang out: "Let no bird fly, let no creature take wing, let all the battle join as one."

INV:Horned Cheetah.f: "I think she wants us to eat it," said Squee, staring at the oily carcass the cheetah had dragged to their fire.

CHK:Otherworldly Journey.f:
"The landscape shimmered and I felt a chill breeze. When my vision cleared, I found myself alone among the corpses of my fallen friends."
—Journal found in Numai

NEM:Stampede Driver.f: "The thunder of hooves is music to my ears."

EXO:Crashing Boars.f: Bores ruin a party. Boars are party to ruin.

EXO:Anarchist.f: "I'll take that. You won't need it when the revolution comes."

ODY:Dwarven Strike Force.f: Any given foothill may hide dozens of dwarves waiting to spill from their tunnels like fire ants.

TMP:Pegasus Refuge.f:
The first Rath-born pegasus was so offended by the sky that it hid its eyes in the earth.
—Vec lore

TMP:Diabolic Edict.f: Greven *il*-Vec lifted Vhati off his feet. "The fall will give you time to think on your failure."

ATQ:Haunting Wind.f: These devices lured so many spirits that sometimes entire battlefields would become haunted at once.

ULG:Yavimaya Scion.f: Each time the saw blade bit, the tree spat it out.

TMP:Humility.f:
"One cannot cleanse the wounds of failure."
—Karn, silver golem

UDS:Plow Under.f:
To renew the land, plow the land. To destroy the land, do nothing.
—Druids' saying

PCY:Sheltering Prayers.f: "It matters not if the gods hear my prayers. Jamuraa does."

TMP:Firefly.f:
"If they don't pinch, they burn. Can't ya eat any of da bugs here?"
—Squee, goblin cabin hand

STH:Flowstone Mauler.f: Once these horrifying creatures were perfected, there was no need for armodons.

UDS:Sigil of Sleep.f: Arrows are only one way to remove an enemy.

DST:Goblin Archaeologist.f: Always easily impressed, Durg was about to be blown away.

5DN:Feedback Bolt.f: The path of least resistance is often through your enemies.

ONS:Shade's Breath.f: The grim business of the Coliseum casts long shadows.

LEG:Wall of Heat.f: At a distance, we mistook the sound for a waterfall . . .

SOK:Oboro Breezecaller.f:
"I feel their unnatural influence in the weary, weeping land. Do they care nothing for the creatures who walk below their clouds?"
—Eight-and-a-Half-Tails

MIR:Barreling Attack.f:
"The trollish game of push-fall inspired this impressive tactic."
—Sidar Jabari

P02:Wild Griffin.f: Two little goblins, out in the sun. Down came a griffin, and then there was one.

UDS:Goblin Berserker.f:
Goblins don't know the meaning of the word "tactics"
—or the word "meaning," for that matter.

HML:Evaporate.f:
"The body is a temple with a foundation of sand."
—Autumn Willow

LEG:Emerald Dragonfly.f: "Flittering, wheeling, / darting in to strike, and then / gone just as you blink." —"Dragonfly Haiku," poet unknown

USG:Bedlam.f: Sometimes quantity, in the absence of quality, is good enough.

VIS:Hulking Cyclops.f:
"Some say a great cyclops turns the world in its hands, looking down upon it with its one bright eye."
—Afari, *Tales*

UDS:Rofellos's Gift.f:
"Rise, elf. We are both of Gaea, and thus we are equal."
—Multani, to Rofellos

FEM:Draconian Cylix.f:
"There is no gain without sacrifice."
—Icatian proverb

ICE:Orcish Cannoneers.f:
"It's a thankless job, and you'll probably die in an explosion. But the pay is pretty good."
—Toothlicker Harj, Orcish Captain

CHK:Moss Kami.f: Kami manifest in the form of whatever they embody in the physical plane. Some tower in the shape of moss or bark, while others take forms beyond mortal imagining.

MMQ:Misshapen Fiend.f: You'd scarcely believe they could fly until they drop out of the sky onto you.

ONS:Information Dealer.f:
"One wizard is a suspect. Two wizards are a conspiracy."
—Elvish refugee

LEG:Primordial Ooze.f: The thick, moving mass from the beginning of evolution swallows and digests the animate and inanimate as it unthinkingly strives to continue its existence.

ULG:Rack and Ruin.f:
"My people are bound by masters centuries dead. Each artifact we destroy is another link broken in that chain."
—Barb Tail, viashino heretic

BOK:Shuko.f:
"One scratch on a wall meant safe passage, two that the target had already been raided, and three warned of a trap."
—*Weaponry of Kamigawa*

DST:Steelshaper Apprentice.f: Theirs is a craft brought about by necessity, now raised to the level of art.

POR:Howling Fury.f: I howl my soul to the moon, and the moon howls with me.

JUD:Border Patrol.f:
"We have been victims of treachery, of the Cabal, and of our own ambitions. No more."
—Commander Eesha

DRK:Stone Calendar.f: The Pretender Mairsil ordered a great Calendar drawn up to show when the paths to the Dark Lands were strongest.

ICE:Touch of Death.f:
"What was yours is mine. Your land, your people, and now your life."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

INV:Crusading Knight.f: "My only dream is to destroy the nightmares of others."

MIR:Goblin Scouts.f:
"Pathetic—like I wouldn't know a goblin painted up to look like a dwarf!"
—Pashad ibn Asim, Suq'Ata trader

CHK:Blind with Anger.f:
"I can post only the most honorable and strong-willed samurai to defend your stronghold. I have seen what can happen to lesser men."
—General Takeno, letter to Lord Konda

UDS:Flame Jet.f: Did the land make the Keldons? Did the Keldons make the land? Or were they simply meant for each other?

MRD:Copper Myr.f: The elves thought of the myr as minor threats, just as the myr thought of the elves.

FEM:Ring of Renewal.f: To the uninitiated, the Ring of Renewal is merely an oddity. For those fluent in the wielding of magic, however, it is a source of great knowledge.

2ED:Jade Statue.f:
"Some of the other guys dared me to touch it, but I knew it weren't no ordinary hunk o' rock."
—Norin the Wary

CHK:Unnatural Speed.f:
"How can we hope to match the speed of lightning? The fury of storms? The power of mountains? The answer is simple. We cannot. I advise against this war."
—Sensei Hisoka, letter to Lord Konda

PTK:Desperate Charge.f: "Lieutenants dishonored, corpses carted home; The general raises troops again to take revenge."

ONS:Wirewood Pride.f: "Though you may leave this haven we have found, may our strength never leave you."

5DN:Loxodon Anchorite.f: The loxodon ascribe religious superiority to those born albino, believing them to be spiritually pure.

MMQ:Power Matrix.f: As he repaired the ship's planeswalking engine, Karn saw for the first time how he could catalyze the *Weatherlight*'s evolution.

CHK:Jade Idol.f: Before the Kami War, the shishi were symbolic guardians, protecting the shrines where they stood. But after the kami turned on the material world, shishi began pouncing from their perches to attack would-be supplicants.

SCG:Recuperate.f:
"Rise once more, so you may continue to destroy our enemies."
—Karona, false god

TOR:Breakthrough.f: The ideas came flooding in so fast that they couldn't all be contained.

ODY:Touch of Invisibility.f: Cephalids specialize in things unseen, be they politics, betrayal, or themselves.

ONS:Break Open.f: There are two ways to resolve puzzling situations: thoughtful contemplation or force. After thoughtful contemplation, most barbarians choose force.

PCY:Coastal Hornclaw.f: Jamuraan farmers fear three things above all else: droughts, floods, and hornclaws.

POR:Storm Crow.f: Storm crow descending, winter unending. Storm crow departing, summer is starting.

2ED:Craw Wurm.f: The most terrifying thing about the Craw Wurm is probably the horrible crashing sound it makes as it speeds through the forest. This noise is so loud it echoes through the trees and seems to come from all directions at once.

SOK:Kataki, War's Wage.f:
"Before the war, we prayed to Kataki to sharpen our swords and harden our armor. Without his blessing our weapons are all but useless against the kami hordes."
—Kenzo the Hardhearted

MRD:Arrest.f:
"Unfortunately, it doesn't restrain the beast's smell."
—Glissa Sunseeker

MRD:Awe Strike.f: Stunned by the mere presence of the leonin kha, the nim raider quickly fell to its knees.

ATQ:Ivory Tower.f: Valuing scholarship above all else, the inhabitants of the Ivory Tower reward those who sacrifice power for knowledge.

VIS:Juju Bubble.f:
"If my heart had a lid, I would lift it and show you my joy."
—From Suq'Ata wedding ceremony

ICE:Dire Wolves.f:
"It's amazing how scared a city kid can get at a dog. Now, of course, I'd cross Terisiare alone, and keep no watch if I had a pack of greys hanging on my flanks as I went."
—Oddveig Ulfsson, caravan scout

ONS:Symbiotic Wurm.f: The insects keep the wurm's hide free from parasites. In return, the wurm doesn't eat the insects.

TOR:Morningtide.f:
"The spirits of the righteous shall rise into the sky. Even dirtwalkers will fly like aven."
—Major Teroh

TMP:Rootwater Diver.f:
"Drop a dagger into the murky deep and the merfolk will cut your throat with it."
—Skyshroud saying

BOK:Terashi's Grasp.f:
"The jeweler, the potter, the smith . . . They all imbue a bit of their souls into their creations. The kami destroy that crafted mortal shell and absorb the soul within."
—Noboru, master kitemaker

ATQ:Su-Chi.f: Flawed copies of relics from the Thran Empire, the Su-Chi were inherently unstable but provided useful knowledge for Tocasia's students.

UDS:Fend Off.f: The best defense is to not get hit.

MIR:Zebra Unicorn.f:
"I'll capture gentle zebras / for your steeds and fill the stable with every kind of unicorn."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

MMQ:Extortion.f: The enforcers make no effort to distinguish gold from flesh.

PCY:Quicksilver Wall.f: "Ogg hit wall. Ogg no kill wall. Ogg hate wall!"

TMP:Renegade Warlord.f:
"His tongue must be honey, the way he gathers ants to fight with him."
—Volrath

TMP:Shimmering Wings.f: The brighter the wings, the deeper the impact crater.

MMQ:Dark Ritual.f:
"Eye of twilight, give us sight.
Take our offer, give us might.
Make our power tears of night."

2ED:Dwarven Demolition Team.f: Foolishly, Najib retreated to his castle at El-Abar; the next morning he was dead. In just one night, the dwarven forces had reduced the mighty walls to mere rubble.

DRK:Inferno.f: "Any scrap of compassion that still existed in my soul was permanently snuffed out when they cast me out into the flames." —Mairsil, called the Pretender

ULG:Aura Flux.f: To some, the Tolarian sunrise was a blinding flash; to others, a lingering glow.

ATQ:Staff of Zegon.f: Though Mishra was impressed by the staves Ashnod had created for Zegon's defense, he understood they only hinted at her full potential.

TMP:Winds of Rath.f:
"There shall be a vast shout and then a vaster silence."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

ONS:Feeding Frenzy.f: It wasn't as much a strategy as a dim instinct to drown their prey.

APC:Symbiotic Deployment.f:
"You know your orders. I know your hearts. Now the stronghold will know defeat."
—Eladamri

CHK:Battle-Mad Ronin.f: "I fought fiercely, bravely, and without mercy. Had I not struck down my captain in the heat of battle, I might have become a hero instead of an outcast."

EXO:Fade Away.f:
"Consider the fable of the greedy herder. As her flock grew, so did her weariness; she slept, and the sheep wandered off."
—Karn, silver golem

PCY:Flay.f: The Keldons would never admit it, but Greel unsettles them, too.

MMQ:Crackdown.f:
"There is no place for mercy in defense of our lives."
—Ta-Spon, Cho-Arrim executioner

TMP:Nature's Revolt.f:
"One day the land will don the semblance of flesh and challenge even the plowshare's blade."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

PLS:Gainsay.f:
"I'd be happy to stop contradicting you, Urza, just as soon as you start being right."
—Bo Levar, planeswalker

INV:Tidal Visionary.f: Beneath the waves, things appear the way merfolk want them to.

NEM:Air Bladder.f: Random mutations among Rootwater merfolk were common—and disturbing.

ICE:Kjeldoran Elite Guard.f: The winged helms of the Guard are put on for pageants—but taken off for war.

WTH:Call of the Wild.f: Thinking of dinner made Squee realize that the forest was probably thinking the same thing.

MRD:Fabricate.f: "The secret to invention is to see something in your mind, then find where it hides in the world."

ONS:Catapult Master.f: "There's no 'I' in 'team,' but there's a 'we' in 'weapon.'"

PTK:Renegade Troops.f: "Across the land rebellions seethed and swarmed / As vicious war lords swooped down on all sides."

PLS:Implode.f: To save Dominaria, nine planeswalkers sought the annihilation of Phyrexia itself.

ALL:Taste of Paradise.f:
"There is, in each of us, the potential to heal and the gift of renewed life."
—Kaysa, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

MMQ:Energy Flux.f: Karn said nothing—he just grasped the powerstone and squeezed tightly. The wild flashing ceased.

VIS:Sands of Time.f:
"But once, with a magician's help, Time was stopped and Day stood still."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

BOK:Flames of the Blood Hand.f: Many ogres extracted blood oaths from the oni they summoned. Others simply extracted blood.

ATQ:Triskelion.f: A brainchild of Tawnos, the Triskelion proved its versatility and usefulness in many of the later battles between the brothers.

APC:Angelfire Crusader.f: Nothing burns hotter than the fires of holy rage.

VIS:Parapet.f: There is no wall that can't be improved by making it taller.

NEM:Topple.f:
"Let all witness the fate of those who defy me."
—Crovax

TMP:Skyshroud Condor.f:
Condor's flight augurs sleepless night.
—Skyshroud proverb

POR:Horned Turtle.f: Its spear has no shaft, its shield no handle.

MIR:Asmira, Holy Avenger.f:
"Omens lie in this early harvest's fruit."
—Asmira, Holy Avenger

ALL:Hail Storm.f:
"If they can't take the hail, they'd better stay home."
—Arna Kennerüd, Skycaptain

ONS:Krosan Colossus.f: When it walked, it altered geography. When it bellowed, it changed the weather.

PCY:Mine Bearer.f: "The Keldons may have explosive tempers, but *I* have explosives."

P02:Theft of Dreams.f: "First they fight, then they sleep, then they dream. And finally I receive my reward."

PLS:Volcano Imp.f: Its claws cut faster than a flame flickers.

CHK:Hana Kami.f: It grew in lands lit by pride and watered by tears.

TOR:Centaur Veteran.f: He wears his scars like badges of honor, warning his foes that he's not easily defeated.

ICE:Battle Frenzy.f:
"One day you, too, shall drink the blood of your foes. It is something to look forward to."
—Toothlicker Harj, Orcish Captain

LEG:Giant Strength.f: "O! it is excellent/ To have a giant's strength, but it is tyrannous/ To use it like a giant." —William Shakespeare, *Measure for Measure*

TMP:Emmessi Tome.f: It is like life and destiny: we think we know the story, but we have read only half the tale.

CHK:Hisoka, Minamo Sensei.f: "By all rights we should have perished in the Kami War. Our perseverence is a tribute to mortal ingenuity. And perhaps a few forgotten secrets found in the nick of time."

PTK:Vengeance.f:
"Until I've gnawed their flesh and exterminated their clans, my humiliation will not be effaced."
—Liu Bei, on the death of his oath-brother Guan Yu

USG:Exhume.f:
"Death—an outmoded concept. We sleep, and we change."
—Sitrik, birth priest

LEG:Divine Transformation.f: Glory surged through her and radiance surrounded her. All things were possible with the blessing of the Divine.

PTK:Blaze.f: "Spreading flames illumined cloud and sea: Cao Cao went down; 'twas Zhou Yu's victory."

ICE:Hurricane.f:
"This was quite possibly the least pleasant occurrence on the entire expedition."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

LGN:Blade Sliver.f: After breaking free from the Riptide Project, the slivers quickly adapted to life on Otaria—much to the dismay of life on Otaria.

TMP:Krakilin.f:
"A perfect reflection of its world: brutal, fetal, and lacking truth."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

APC:Martyrs' Tomb.f:
Honor the brave who fought,
Honor the dead who fell,
Honor the world they saved.
—Memorial inscription

DST:Krark-Clan Stoker.f: Fallen enemies are fed to the scavengers. Fallen friends are thrown into the Great Furnace, their souls returned to the Great Mother.

UDS:Ravenous Rats.f:
"For all the priceless tomes they have destroyed, one would think they would taste better."
—Davvol, Evincar of Rath

MIR:Civic Guildmage.f:
To condemn the innocent you must first condemn yourself.
—Civic Guild maxim

EXO:Cinder Crawler.f: The crawler doesn't care what gets in its way. It pushes everything into the boiling muck and waits for the meal to cook.

SOK:Kitsune Bonesetter.f:
"He kept generations whole before the Kami War, and now he turns his century of wisdom to healing the latest casualties."
—Eight-and-a-Half-Tails

NEM:Kill Switch.f: Success is largely a matter of knowing which lever to pull.

2ED:Giant Spider.f: While it possesses potent venom, the Giant Spider often chooses not to paralyze its victims. Perhaps the creature enjoys the gentle rocking motion caused by its captives' struggles to escape its web.

HML:Reveka, Wizard Savant.f:
"It's nice to see a sister Dwarf in a position of such power, but why'd it have to be one of those seafaring muleheads?"
—Halina, Dwarven Trader

BOK:Phantom Wings.f: Many kami could fly, which put some warriors at a distinct disadvantage. The mages of Minamo took it upon themselves to correct that imbalance.

P02:Hand of Death.f: The touch of death is never gentle.

WTH:Avizoa.f: "Maybe we can trap them with bait," thought Tahngarth, eyeing Squee.

TOR:Pardic Collaborator.f: "We've been taught that strength is everything. So how can an alliance with the strongest be a betrayal?"

ICE:Glaciers.f:
"Even the highest mountain can be ground to dust."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter, Leader of the Order of the White Shield

CHK:Numai Outcast.f:
"Beware the blade of dishonor. It kills more silently than war, more quickly than age."
—Sensei Golden-Tail

ONS:Steely Resolve.f: No one in Wirewood understands what is happening. They just know it's unnatural—and coming from Krosa.

TOR:Unhinge.f:
"Don't let your mind wander—it might not come back."
—Braids, dementia summoner

MIR:Suq'Ata Firewalker.f:
"Comfortable even in a furnace? I've never met one who'd accept my wager."
—Talibah, embermage

LGN:Withered Wretch.f: Once it consecrated the dead. Now it desecrates them.

USG:Titania's Boon.f: When the winds rock the trees, listen for voices in the creaking of the trunks. If you hear your name, you are one of the Goddess's chosen.

ICE:Pentagram of the Ages.f:
"Take this item, for instance. How would it destroy us, Relicbane?"
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

MMQ:Jhovall Queen.f: War-trained jhovalls eat twice their weight in war-trained soldiers daily.

CHK:Cursed Ronin.f: "You are fortunate, my enemy. You have paid the price but once. I never stop paying."

SOK:Dreamcatcher.f:
"Be careful where your mind wanders. Even in the quietest moments, the kami are listening, and your thoughts give them shape."
—Lady Azami

ONS:Gustcloak Sentinel.f: Entire platoons have mysteriously vanished from battle, leaving enemy weapons to slice through empty air.

ONS:Barkhide Mauler.f: Anywhere else they would be hunted for their skins, but in Wirewood, they are safe.

LEG:Livonya Silone.f: Livonya's own nature is a matter of mystery. Nothing is known for sure, merely rumors of unearthly stealth, and unholy alliances.

SCG:Claws of Wirewood.f: They say the forest has eyes. They never mention its claws.

MMQ:Hammer Mage.f: When he's holding the hammers, everything looks like a nail.

EXO:Elven Palisade.f:
"Volrath is not the only one who can shape this world to serve him."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

ICE:Wall of Lava.f:
"Now *there's* something you don't see every day."
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

ONS:Cabal Slaver.f: "In its natural habitat, the goblin is stupid, yet devious. Now it's stupid, devious, and powerful."

5DN:Spark Elemental.f: Vulshok shamans summon spark elementals to burn paths through thick underbrush—or through goblin salvage squads.

WTH:Thran Forge.f: "This will work," Gerrard called to the elves as he used the forge to strengthen the aboroth, "but if it doesn't, we won't survive to care."

TOR:Barbarian Outcast.f:
"We offer power to anyone willing to take it. Sadly, few are unburdened enough by their prejudices to accept."
—Cabal surgeon

5DN:Auriok Champion.f:
"Her will shall banish the shadows. Her might shall punish the lawless. Her beauty shall restore the light."
—Ushanti, leonin seer

LEG:Horror of Horrors.f:
"And a horror of outer darkness after,/ And dust returneth to dust again."
—Adam Lindsay Gordon, The Swimmer

LEG:Glyph of Life.f: Any wall can be battered down, but at what cost?

DRK:Brothers of Fire.f: Fire is never a gentle master.

PLS:Guard Dogs.f:
"A good guard is alert. A great guard is also loyal."
—Benalish kennelmaster

MMQ:Silent Assassin.f: She feels no need to disturb her victim's slumber.

MIR:Shadow Guildmage.f:
To keep the dead so others may live.
—Shadow Guild maxim

LEG:Wolverine Pack.f: "Give them great meals of beef and iron and steel, they will eat like wolves and fight like devils." —William Shakespeare, *King Henry V*

PLS:Mirrorwood Treefolk.f: It doesn't need a bite. The bark works just fine.

CHK:Honor-Worn Shaku.f: Before being presented to its lord, each shaku is blessed by every hero of every region within that lord's domain.

BOK:Ornate Kanzashi.f: Masako was privy to a great many of Konda's deepest secrets, and her hair was always perfect.

USG:Brand.f:
"By this glyph I affirm your role."
—Urza, to Karn

BOK:Indebted Samurai.f: "Forgive me, Saburo. I could not save you. But your blade will not rest in my hand."

DRK:Venom.f: "I told him it was just a flesh wound, a wee scratch, but the next time I looked at him, poor Tadhg was dead and gone." —Maeveen O'Donagh, *Memoirs of a Soldier*

ODY:Tombfire.f: The fondest memories burn brightest. As they're lost forever, the flames grow hotter still.

P02:Rain of Daggers.f: Knives in the sky, cries in the air, and blood on the ground.

WTH:Ardent Militia.f:
"While the rest of us got paid to serve the Benalish army, the militia didn't. I used to say they stood for freedom—free *and* dumb."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

ARN:Aladdin's Ring.f: "After these words the magician drew a ring off his finger, and put it on one of Aladdin's, saying: 'It is a talisman against all evil, so long as you obey me.'" —*The Arabian Nights*, Junior Classics trans.

ONS:Goblin Pyromancer.f: "The good news is, we figured out how the wand works. The bad news is, we figured out how the wand works."

ONS:Symbiotic Beast.f: The insects found a meal in the carrion of the beast's prey. The beast found a spiffy new hairstyle.

ATQ:Feldon's Cane.f: Feldon found the first of these canes frozen in the Ronom Glacier.

DST:Vulshok War Boar.f: It must eat its weight in metal daily, or its furnacelike belly will consume itself for lack of fuel.

STH:Rebound.f: Insult, like an arrow, is beyond control once loosed.

PCY:Windscouter.f: These nimble ships were designed for hit-and-run tactics.

UDS:Field Surgeon.f: Commanders order soldiers to attack. Field surgeons order them to heal. Both are obeyed without question.

DST:Pulse of the Dross.f: Before tyrants or torturers, there was evil.

DST:Hunger of the Nim.f: Their pain is so great, they can't help but share it with others.

VIS:Righteous War.f:
"This is a war without neutrality."
—Asmira, Holy Avenger

MMQ:Squeeze.f: Any pirate would prefer Rishada's swift and cruel justice to Saprazzo's patient punishments.

DST:Coretapper.f: It converts the faintest surges of power from Mirrodin's core into usable energy, providing endless power for Memnarch's creations on the surface.

FEM:Goblin Warrens.f:
"Goblins bred underground, their numbers hidden from the enemy until it was too late."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

ICE:Krovikan Elementalist.f:
"The Elementalists' talents could be useful if turned to other purposes."
—Zur the Enchanter

ONS:Read the Runes.f: "The world is a puzzle, and the mind is its key."

MMQ:Pious Warrior.f: The Cho-Arrim make no distinction between healers and soldiers.

NEM:Flowstone Surge.f: The army was never at a loss for weapons; Crovax was their forge.

WTH:Null Rod.f:
Gerrard: "But it doesn't *do* anything!"
Hanna: "No—it *does* nothing."

ARN:Jandor's Saddlebags.f: Each day of their journey, Jandor opened the saddlebags and found them full of mutton, quinces, cheese, date rolls, wine, and all manner of delicious and satisfying foods.

BOK:Terashi's Verdict.f: It was as though the sky opened its eyes and found what it saw displeasing.

ICE:Stampede.f:
"We could see the horizon blacken with the great beasts, but it was too late. The icefield offered no immediate safety, but luckily most of us reached a crevasse in which we could take cover."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

ONS:Profane Prayers.f: "We have ways to make you talk, but you have nothing interesting to say."

STH:Wall of Souls.f:
"It is the nature of evil to turn you against yourself."
—Starke

ULG:Viashino Cutthroat.f:
"You guys go on ahead. I'll catch up with ya."
—Vark, goblin scout, last words

ICE:Mountain Titan.f:
"The Titans claimed to draw strength from the rocks, but I suspect them of some darker allegiance."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

LEG:Wall of Wonder.f: So confusing is the Wall's appearance that few of its victims even see it move.

MIR:Maro.f: No two see the same Maro.

MIR:Locust Swarm.f: Better a fierce thunderhead than a sky filled with locusts.

TOR:Churning Eddy.f:
"Magic is like the tide—both ebb, both flow, and both serve my whims."
—Empress Llawan

STH:Walking Dream.f: Dreams, by definition, live shorter lives than those who dream them.

PLS:Honorable Scout.f: "I've faced your kind before. This time I'm ready for you."

MIR:Soar.f:
"Would you give up your hands to fly? That is what the birds have done."
—*The One Thousand Questions*

MIR:Chaosphere.f:
"I dance the nothing dance, / Feet in the air, knives in the ground."
—Femeref chant

SCG:Unburden.f: Cabal initiates enter training full of hopes and fears. They graduate with neither.

TOR:Cephalid Aristocrat.f: It's easy to tell the difference between the devious cephalids and the trustworthy ones. The trustworthy ones are dead.

MIR:Volcanic Dragon.f: Speed and fire are always a deadly combination.

TMP:Patchwork Gnomes.f:
"Just when I get them working, they always start fighting and tearing at each other for spare parts."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

PTK:Deception.f: Believing they wrote the forged letter that had been stolen from Zhou Yu, Cao Cao rashly executed his two best admirals for treason.

BOK:Gods' Eye, Gate to the Reikai.f: Listen at its walls and you will hear the whispers of gods.

PLS:Deadapult.f:
"Nothing ruins your day like a blazing zombie."
—Tahngarth

DST:Purge.f: For the first and last time, the horrific creature experienced terror.

2ED:Fire Elemental.f: Fire Elementals are ruthless infernos, annihilating and consuming their foes in a frenzied holocaust. Crackling and blazing, they sear swift, terrible paths, leaving the land charred and scorched in their wake.

DST:Pulse of the Fields.f: Before religion or civilization, there was order.

UDS:Disappear.f: If at first you don't succeed, run away and hide.

TMP:Soltari Foot Soldier.f:
"Children of the Ruins, raised to be warriors, know that life begins when another speaks their names."
—Soltari *Tales of Life*

UDS:Urza's Incubator.f:
"Stop thinking like an artificer, Urza, and start thinking like a father!"
—Rayne, Academy Chancellor

WTH:Heavy Ballista.f:
"Archers, ballistae—you can't even get near the island of Avenant."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

CHK:Iname, Life Aspect.f: Iname rejoices in the dawn of a new life, but soon becomes jealous of the simple joys denied him by his station. So the cycle begins anew.

INV:Wings of Hope.f: Urza knew Phyrexians would come through the air and sent his soldiers to greet them.

NEM:Fanatical Devotion.f: The Oracle told Eladamri he would save his people by abandoning them. His followers adopted that ideal.

WTH:Agonizing Memories.f:
"An innocent man died because of my anger. That knowledge will haunt me for all eternity."
—Karn, silver golem

TMP:Fighting Drake.f: Two things are needed to survive the harsh skies of Rath: a thick hide and a thicker skull.

VIS:City of Solitude.f:
"My horizon was the arcing petals, my new home resplendent with spires of weeds and pillows of fragrant pollen."
—Naimah, Femeref philosopher

TMP:Vhati il-Dal.f: "Sir, I just thought . . . ," explained Vhati. "Don't think," interrupted Greven. "It doesn't suit you."

ODY:Pilgrim of Virtue.f: "A life is measured by the lives it saves."

INV:Ruby Leech.f:
"Its gems didn't stop pulsating until they were completely removed."
—Tolarian research notes

ODY:Zoologist.f: "With friends like these, who needs people?"

ICE:Enduring Renewal.f: That which lasts longest serves best.

INV:Skittish Kavu.f: Fierce when roused, this breed of kavu is easily distracted by a strong voice or melodic tune.

TMP:Needle Storm.f: The rain is driven like nails.

JUD:Ironshell Beetle.f:
"Why waste time creating weapons? Nature provides us with all we need."
—Centaur warrior

ONS:Wellwisher.f: "Close your ears to the voice of greed, and you can turn a gift for one into a gift for many."

MMQ:Barbed Wire.f: A steel snake with ten thousand teeth.

5DN:Rite of Passage.f: Every scar is a lesson, every battle a test of what you have learned.

JUD:Book Burning.f: The wizard's spellbook was full of burning questions.

VIS:Breezekeeper.f:
"He blows a gust across the cliff to vanish in a breath of wind."
—"Song of the Wind Being"

LGN:Spectral Sliver.f:
"Sure, I've seen agents of the Cabal here and there. Well, not here, and certainly not in any of the sliver labs. Oh dear, I've said too much."
—Apprentice researcher

MRD:Barter in Blood.f:
"In the game of conquest, who cares about the pawns if the king yet reigns?"
—Geth, keeper of the Vault

WTH:Duskrider Falcon.f:
"Seaborne ships have their dolphins to dance in their wakes; I have my duskriders."
—Sisay, journal

TOR:Longhorn Firebeast.f: Its blast can fuse armor to bone, leaving skeletons that glint brightly in the sun.

TMP:Knight of Dawn.f:
Flash like daybreak to the fray.
—Motto of the Knights of Dawn

LGN:Clickslither.f: The least popular goblins get the outer caves.

EXO:Paladin en-Vec.f: "Our belief shall be the lance that pierces Volrath's heart."

DRK:Pikemen.f: "As the cavalry bore down, we faced them with swords drawn and pikes hidden in the grass at our feet. 'Don't lift your pikes 'til I give the word,' I said." —Maeveen O'Donagh, *Memoirs of a Soldier*

PCY:Well of Life.f:
When you have given everything, then you have everything to gain.
—Well inscription

PCY:Gulf Squid.f: If it could capture the power it wastes, it would be invincible.

TMP:Dark Ritual.f:
"If there is such a thing as too much power, I have not discovered it."
—Volrath

STH:Sift.f:
"Twice I have let the Legacy slip away. Never again."
—Karn, silver golem

TMP:Flowstone Salamander.f: The Furnace of Rath is periodically illuminated by their sparkling yawns.

P02:Kiss of Death.f:
"I'd sooner lock lips with a viper. At least I might walk away from *that*."
—Elvish scout

MIR:Enfeeblement.f:
"If it is weak, either kill it or ignore it. Anything else honors it."
—Kaervek

MMQ:Deepwood Tantiv.f: A single tantiv is just as dangerous as a herd.

BOK:Takenuma Bleeder.f: "I prefer to weave my magic through oni blood, but yours will do in a pinch."

TMP:Giant Strength.f: "Crovax seems filled only with shadows," thought Orim. "Where does his strength come from?"

MIR:Phyrexian Tribute.f:
"In your final breath you still have something to offer Phyrexia."
—Afari, *Tales*

VIS:Jamuraan Lion.f:
The lion blinked
—Femeref expression meaning "situation avoided"

PLS:Aurora Griffin.f: Though a fierce fighter, its true value is that it inspires beleaguered forces.

VIS:Snake Basket.f:
"Uh, does anyone have a flute?"
—Rana, Suq'Ata market fool

PCY:Devastate.f:
"You're willing to die for your homeland. I'm willing to kill for it."
—Latulla, Keldon overseer

CHK:Akki Avalanchers.f: Among Godo's hordes, "beware of falling rocks" came to mean "akki live nearby."

TOR:Teroh's Faithful.f: The light of reason follows them even into battle.

INV:Disrupt.f: Teferi wanted no part of Urza's battle plans, but both agreed the Phyrexian portal must be closed.

MRD:Domineer.f: Since they haven't seen their original master for millennia, golems are eager to take orders from anyone.

ODY:Words of Wisdom.f: Knowledge can't be kept in a bottle or sealed in a box. It yearns to be spread and shared.

LGN:Toxin Sliver.f: It doesn't need to use its venom—it just needs you to know it can.

PTK:Riding Red Hare.f: One of the greatest steeds in the empire, Red Hare could travel a thousand *li* a day and climb hills as if running on flat ground.

ARN:Fishliver Oil.f: Then the maiden bade him cast off his robes and cover his body with fishliver oil, that he might safely follow her into the sea.

ODY:Mind Burst.f: As haunting as a zombie's curse.

PTK:Huang Zhong, Shu General.f: "Virile in war, he kept the north in fear; His prodigies subdued the western sphere."

ULG:Plague Beetle.f: It is the harbinger of disease, not the carrier.

TMP:Stun.f:
"I concede it was a cheap shot, but it was the only one I could afford."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

ONS:Naturalize.f: "From here, let the world be reborn."

LGN:Whipgrass Entangler.f: "Now that I have your attention, perhaps I can tell you of the Order."

ALL:Reinforcements.f:
"Let them send their legions! I will show them that my truth is stronger than their swords."
—General Varchild

PLS:Skyshroud Blessing.f: "Behold," said Freyalise to Eladamri. "Your Skyshroud home has followed you to Dominaria."

JUD:Aven Fogbringer.f: "I cover the land with blankets and it sleeps."

CHK:Nezumi Bone-Reader.f: Four generations ago, old Split-Tail stole a bundle of scrolls from the Minamo School. Soon after, the first nezumi shamans were born.

5DN:Beacon of Destruction.f: The Great Furnace's blessing is a spectacular sight, but the best view comes at a high cost.

SOK:Kitsune Loreweaver.f: "Know your history. The lessons of the past will shield you in times of doubt."

ONS:Grassland Crusader.f: "Everyone deserves a chance to live. My job is to make sure they get it."

LEG:Wall of Earth.f: The ground shuddered violently and the earth seemed to come to life. The elemental force contained in the vast wall of earth was trapped, bent to its controller's will.

ALL:Unlikely Alliance.f:
"Strange alliances are alliances still, and provide the same protection."
—King Darien of Kjeldor

MRD:Skyhunter Patrol.f:
"They are the first to raise the alarm when the levelers attack, and the first to risk their lives to defend the pride."
—Raksha Golden Cub, leonin kha

INV:Crimson Acolyte.f:
The faithful will walk through streams of fire and emerge unscathed.
—Crimson acolyte creed

MRD:Loxodon Mender.f: The Auriok believe that in the hands of a loxodon, no weapon can be broken.

FEM:Homarid Shaman.f:
"The ground grew swampy; hooves and claws sank into the marshy earth. Snarls of rage and bleats of despair echoed through the trees as the waters grew higher and higher."
—Kyliki of Havenwood, "Havenwood Remembered"

INV:Elvish Champion.f:
"For what are leaves but countless blades
To fight a countless foe on high."
—Skyshroud hymn

FEM:Rainbow Vale.f: In the feudal days of Icatia, finding the Rainbow Vale was often the goal of Knights' quests.

MIR:Zuberi, Golden Feather.f:
"If the griffins tell of their gods, perhaps they speak of feathers bright as the Sun."
—Afari, *Tales*

INV:Vodalian Merchant.f: Not choosing sides in a war can be dangerous—but lucrative.

APC:Overgrown Estate.f: The decay of Crovax's ancestral home matched the state of his soul.

SCG:Raven Guild Initiate.f: The Raven Guild soars on winds of unease.

STH:Contempt.f:
"Predictable little man. In all these years you taught me so much yet learned so little."
—Volrath, to Starke

MMQ:Righteous Indignation.f: "You are the disease that plagues Mercadia. I am the healer's knife that will cut you out."

HML:Dark Maze.f:
"The path of faith is fortunately fraught with failure."
—Irini Sengir

PCY:Chilling Apparition.f: Mortal minds shrivel at its touch.

MMQ:Bog Smugglers.f: They slide over the bog like oil across glass.

PCY:Flowering Field.f: Some lands are soothing, and their peace can be felt in the soul.

MIR:Teferi's Drake.f:
"We threw dried fruit to the drakes that rode the air, streaming along the *Weatherlight'*s side as we sailed amidst the clouds."
—Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*

TMP:Armor Sliver.f:
Hanna: "We must learn how they protect each other."
Mirri: "After they're done trying to kill us, all right?"

WTH:Tolarian Entrancer.f:
"Why should I boast? The bards will do it for me—and with music."
—Ertai, wizard adept

INV:Quirion Trailblazer.f: "All that matters is the path ahead."

ICE:Stormbind.f:
"Once, our people could call down the storm itself to do our bidding."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

MMQ:Sever Soul.f:
"With the proper tools, even the Great River can be dammed."
—Ta-Spon, Cho-Arrim executioner

UDS:Braidwood Cup.f:
"I think it no accident that every civilized people has discovered the art of distillation."
—Rofellos of Llanowar

CHK:Wicked Akuba.f: The sound of children weeping is a song that fills its heart with joy.

TMP:Dauthi Mercenary.f:
"The Dauthi believe they dignify murder by paying for it."
—Lyna, Soltari emissary

ICE:Pyroblast.f:
"Just the thing for those pesky water mages."
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

MMQ:Balloon Peddler.f: The market festival turned out to be the high point of Jaffy's visit.

ONS:Akroma's Blessing.f: The clerics saw her as a divine gift. She saw them only as allies in her war against Phage.

NEM:Seahunter.f: "They can't feel pain. They just wiggle 'cause they're scared."

EXO:Peace of Mind.f:
Three are the paths of the soul:
One out—roam across the plain,
One back—dwell with tribe and tent,
One in—turn an enemy's hate.

ONS:Walking Desecration.f: Such sacrilege turns blinding grief into blinding rage.

MRD:Nim Shrieker.f: As imps they were an annoyance. As nim they are a pestilence.

FEM:Elven Lyre.f: Scholars are uncertain whether it was the actual sound or some other magical property of the Elven Lyre that transformed its player.

DRK:Diabolic Machine.f: "The bolts of our ballistae smashed into the monstrous thing, but our hopes died in our chests as its gears continued turning." —Sevti Mukul, *The Fall of Alsoor*

DRK:Holy Light.f: "Bathed in hallowed light, the infidels looked upon the impurities of their souls and despaired." —*The Book of Tal*

MIR:Uktabi Faerie.f:
Victim of the two-toed faerie
—Suq'Ata expression meaning "broken"

JUD:Giant Warthog.f:
"When the Ancestor saw the cruelty her human children were capable of, Her fury shook the world. From this outburst sprang the warthogs."
—Nomad myth

DRK:Morale.f: "After Lacjsi's speech, the Knights grew determined to crush their ancient enemies clan by clan." —Tivadar of Thorn, *History of the Goblin Wars*

WTH:Serrated Biskelion.f:
"Whereas I was created to protect, the biskelion was created to destroy."
—Karn, silver golem

MRD:Electrostatic Bolt.f: It's hard to avoid electric shock when the entire plane is metallic.

ODY:Zombie Assassin.f:
"Zombies don't kill. They recruit."
—Braids, dementia summoner

ONS:Invigorating Boon.f: The Mirari's echoes rang in the scouts' minds long after they had returned from the Krosan Forest.

2ED:Water Elemental.f: Unpredictable as the sea itself, Water Elementals shift without warning from tranquility to tempest. Capricious and fickle, they flow restlessly from one shape to another, expressing their moods with their physical forms.

WTH:Tranquil Grove.f:
"Even the fiercest storm has a peaceful eye."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

SOK:Hail of Arrows.f:
"Do not let a single shaft loose until my word. And when I give that word, do not leave a single shaft in Eiganjo."
—General Takeno

MRD:Grid Monitor.f: The vedalken protect the Knowledge Pool at any cost.

USG:Western Paladin.f:
"Their weak laws. Their flawed systems. They inhibit the Grand Evolution. In Yawgmoth's name, we shall erase them."
—Oath of the West

HML:Anaba Ancestor.f:
"The Ancestors are the wisdom of the tribe and the soul of the Homelands. I am eternally in their debt."
—Taysir

5DN:Vedalken Mastermind.f: The vedalken see other beings from a cold distance, as either experimental subjects or objects of study.

FEM:Thrull Wizard.f:
"In crafting intelligent Thrulls to assist in sacrifices, Sahr inadvertantly set the stage for the Thrull Rebellion."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. II*

ONS:Aphetto Dredging.f: Phage became both executioner and savior, helping others to the same rebirth she had found.

ICE:Enervate.f:
"Worlds turn in crucial moments of decision. Make your choice."
—Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran Royal Mage

CHK:Kitsune Diviner.f: She who once led prayers honoring the kami adapted to use her influence to stay them.

ICE:Karplusan Giant.f:
"They aren't the brightest or the quickest of Giants. For that matter, the same holds true if you compare them to rocks."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

EXO:Shackles.f: Shackles of gold are still shackles.

CHK:Hair-Strung Koto.f:
"The Kami War drove many members of Konda's court insane. As their spiritual world turned against them, so too did their minds turn from reality."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

P02:Norwood Archers.f:
"'Air superiority?' Not while our archers scan the skies."
—Elvish scout

MRD:Leonin Abunas.f: Only leonin clerics who can survive the Razor Fields for one turning of the suns can stand in the Cave of Light.

NEM:Infiltrate.f: Getting in was the easy part. Getting out proved to be more difficult.

ICE:Battle Cry.f:
"In the thick of battle, you must keep your wits about you. Yelling a lot helps, too."
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox

UDS:Brass Secretary.f: The students disliked the secretary for its unfailing memory—until they discovered it couldn't dodge thrown objects.

PTK:Overwhelming Forces.f: By the year 208, Cao Cao commanded more than 1,000 experienced generals and a million infantry, cavalry, and naval troops.

APC:Unnatural Selection.f: What nature makes, magic can modify.

APC:Flowstone Charger.f: A mane of flowstone and a mien of fury.

ICE:Pit Trap.f:
"These traps are truly a symbol of great cruelty and sinister cunning."
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic

CHK:Crushing Pain.f: It is said that the mere touch of a kami is like embracing the sun itself.

PTK:Imperial Edict.f: Frustrated with Cao Cao's control of the imperial court, Emperor Xian secretly issued an edict condemning him, using his own blood as ink.

APC:Coalition Honor Guard.f: Giving little thought to their own defense, they carried the flag that united their army.

MIR:Reality Ripple.f:
"Can you prepare for the unexpected? No, you cannot. You can prepare only to be surprised."
—Teferi

DST:Darksteel Citadel.f: Panopticon, forge of the Darksteel Eye, home of Mirrodin's keeper.

VIS:Solfatara.f:
"A burst of hot air tossed the moon into the air, and the moon liked it up there so much it never needed the ground again."
—Azeworai, "Glitter Moon"

ONS:Crafty Pathmage.f: The most valuable commodity in the pits is a way out.

UDS:Solidarity.f: Their commitment to Serra is as solid as any shield.

UDS:Covetous Dragon.f: Gatha survived as long as he did by giving all Keld's predators exactly what they wanted.

5DN:Krark-Clan Ironworks.f: All the junk, refuse, and offal of the Krark Clan is diligently collected, melted down, and made into more junk, refuse, and offal.

WTH:Dense Foliage.f:
"Big plants not only good for hidin', but full o' tasty bugs, too."
—Squee, goblin cabin hand

P02:Tree Monkey.f:
"They serve the world best on a platter with shallots and onions."
—Talas sailor

CHK:Kumano's Pupils.f:
"Long before he reluctantly joined the war, stories spread of Kumano's followers winning victories against the kami."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

TOR:Retraced Image.f: An army from a soldier, a flock from a bird, a school from a fish . . . a profit from an atrocity.

HML:Willow Priestess.f:
"Those of faith are those of strength."
—Autumn Willow

ULG:Angelic Curator.f:
"Do not treat your people as you treat your artifacts. Let them go, and they will live; seal them here, and they will die."
—Urza, to Radiant

POR:Minotaur Warrior.f: The herd's patience, the stampede's fury.

DRK:Goblin Caves.f: The stench of countless generations of unspeakable activities was enough to loosen both our footing and our stomachs.

BOK:Lifespinner.f:
"The husk splits like a madman's smile And mystery steps forth."
—Snow-Fur, kitsune poet

WTH:Disrupt.f: Oh, I'm sorry—did I break your concentration?

WTH:Guided Strike.f:
"If you can kill your enemy with the first stroke, you save yourself the labor of the second."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

APC:Reef Shaman.f: With one gesture, she can render a thousand years of navigational charts obsolete.

PLS:Mana Cylix.f: Overflowing with visions of the possible future, it lends power to those in the present.

ODY:Aura Graft.f: "It's not really stealing. It's more like extended borrowing."

USG:Cave Tiger.f: The druids found a haven in the cool limestone tunnels beneath Argoth. The invaders found only tigers.

EXO:Memory Crystal.f: Hues of recollection flicker like facets of a gem.

SOK:Infernal Kirin.f: The kirin bellowed—an echoing, twisted parody of its once-inspirational call.

DST:Hoverguard Observer.f: It could be made to run silently, but its low hum reminds the Neurok that they are always watched.

ICE:Death Ward.f:
"Sometimes, a soul is not ready to complete its journey to the next world."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran Priest

USG:Planar Birth.f:
"From womb of nothingness sprang this place of beauty, purity, and hope realized."
—*Song of All*, canto 3

ONS:Elvish Pathcutter.f: In harsh times, the strongest currency is cooperation.

5DN:Eternal Witness.f: She remembers every word spoken, from the hero's oath to the baby's cry.

EXO:Recurring Nightmare.f:
"I am confined by sleep and defined by nightmare."
—Crovax

MMQ:Squallmonger.f: "Squall, gale, hurricane—it's all a matter of size . . . and price."

WTH:Cloud Djinn.f:
As elusive as the footprint of a djinn
—Suq'Ata expression

INV:Alabaster Leech.f:
"Its stones seem to serve a healing function, but removing them intact is an exhausting process."
—Tolarian research notes

STH:Spindrift Drake.f: Sea brine for blood, washing foam for laughter.

MIR:Pacifism.f: For the first time in his life, Grakk felt a little warm and fuzzy inside.

ODY:Skycloud Expanse.f: From Otaria, the sun above meets the sea below at a glittering horizon.

INV:Ancient Kavu.f: Those with the ability to change their nature survived Phyrexia's biological attacks. Everything else died.

JUD:Tunneler Wurm.f: If an anurid's lucky, it'll find a warm tunnel for bedtime. If a wurm's lucky, it'll find a warm anurid for breakfast.

BOK:Akki Raider.f: Akki were very territorial, attacking and destroying any settlements that came too close to their mountain homes. The more successful their raids, the bolder they became.

PTK:Red Cliffs Armada.f: By the battle of Red Cliffs in the year 208, the Wu kingdom controlled more than 7,000 warships on the Yangtze.

CHK:Teller of Tales.f: Words never uttered by mortals flowed incessantly from its many mouths.

TMP:Aftershock.f:
"Every act of destruction has a repercussion."
—Karn, silver golem

POR:Vengeance.f: Bitter as wormwood, sweet as mulled wine.

ODY:Gravedigger.f: Oddly, no one questioned the Cabal's wisdom in hiring a zombie to work at the cemetery.

5DN:Door to Nothingness.f:
"All memory of your existence will be wiped from reality. You will die, and no one will mourn."
—Memnarch

NEM:Flowstone Crusher.f:
"Someone must have done something very bad to make a rock that angry."
—Rebel scout

PTK:Alert Shu Infantry.f: Kongming's predecessor helped Liu Bei win the battle of Fancheng by recognizing and defeating Cao Ren's use of the dreaded "Eight Gold Locks" formation.

ONS:Annex.f: Most refugees left their ancestral homes behind when they came to Otaria. A few decided to bring them along.

5DN:Anodet Lurker.f: These machines build fearsome visages out of scrap metal to scare off predators who would otherwise be eager to consume them.

ULG:Ghitu War Cry.f: The war cry is not simply a shout but a sacrament.

ONS:Ravenous Baloth.f:
"All we know about the Krosan Forest we have learned from those few who made it out alive."
—Elvish refugee

PCY:Rebel Informer.f: The problem with mercenaries is that if you can buy their loyalty, others can too.

LEG:Jovial Evil.f: "Today, for a lark, let's visit the plains. I'm sure we'll find something to entertain us."

MIR:Cadaverous Bloom.f:
"It's filthy work, planting them."
—Kifimbo, Shadow Guildmage

ONS:Boneknitter.f: Nothing comes together as easily as it comes apart.

UDS:Yavimaya Enchantress.f: From each seed, a world. From each world, a thousand seeds.

MIR:Emberwilde Djinn.f: A hefty price is no guarantee of quality merchandise.

ALL:Sustaining Spirit.f:
"Faith is our greatest protector."
—Halvor Arensson, Kjeldoran Priest

2ED:War Mammoth.f: I didn't think Mammoths could ever hold a candle to a well-trained battle horse. Then one day I turned my back on a drunken soldier. His blow never landed; Mi'cha flung the brute over ten meters.

MRD:Leonin Den-Guard.f: No one under the four suns can elude the watchful eye of the den-guard.

MIR:Jabari's Influence.f:
"Common soldiers can't understand what a sidar knows: the enemy can be a resource."
—Sidar Jabari

JUD:Cunning Wish.f: He wished for knowledge, but not for the will to apply it.

PLS:Sea Snidd.f: It always has the home-turf advantage.

ULG:Levitation.f: Barrin's pride in his apprentice was diminished somewhat when he had to get the others back down.

ONS:Sigil of the New Dawn.f:
"We lay our dead to rest in a beautiful bed, in hopes that the Ancestor will think it a fit cradle for the next life."
—Mystic elder

DST:Viridian Zealot.f: "I will fight only the way nature intended—and nature intended us to win."

ULG:Sustainer of the Realm.f:
"The harder you push, the stronger we become."
—Radiant, to Urza

VIS:Talruum Piper.f: When the Talruum began to play, the dragons fell from the sky to squash the obnoxious noise.

TMP:Mogg Fanatic.f: "I got it! I got it! I—"

ICE:Reclamation.f:
"We shall oppose Lim-Dûl and his forces by any means necessary, even if the very earth be torn asunder."
—Arna Kennerüd, Skyknight

JUD:Battlewise Aven.f: Experience is a good teacher, not a kind one.

USG:Duress.f:
"We decide who is worthy of our works."
—Gix, Yawgmoth praetor

ODY:Crypt Creeper.f: To unearth its dinner, it inters itself.

EXO:Fighting Chance.f: A stroke of luck can smite an army.

SOK:Footsteps of the Goryo.f: In the case of violent deaths, kami offered a chance for revenge if the deceased offered up its corpse as a host to the invading kami.

LGN:Hunter Sliver.f: Once they get the scent, there is no escape.

ICE:Howl from Beyond.f:
"From the mouths of my servants, my voice shall emerge to shake the souls of my foes."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

TMP:Rootwater Shaman.f:
"Ugh! When did orcs and fish start having kids?"
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

USG:Victimize.f: The priest cast Xantcha to the ground. "It is defective. We must scrap it."

USG:Fault Line.f:
We live on the serpent's back.
—Viashino saying

UDS:Serra Advocate.f: An angel's touch can prepare a soldier for battle more than a thousand military drills.

LEG:Tobias Andrion.f: Administrator of the military state of Sheoltun, Tobias is the military right arm of the empire and the figurehead of its freedom.

TMP:Rain of Tears.f:
"These rains cannot quench; they carve the land's face like a scalpel on flesh."
—Crovax

MIR:Mtenda Lion.f:
"The lion drank that lake right up! In thanks, he gave Siti the power to speak with lions and make them leave the goats alone."
—Afari, *Tales*

ARN:Stone-Throwing Devils.f: Sometimes those with the most sin cast the first stones.

5DN:Lantern of Insight.f: Each eye sees a different possibility for tomorrow.

MIR:Zhalfirin Commander.f:
"Command is the act of balancing on a vine and convincing others that it is firm ground."
—Sidar Jabari

P02:Path of Peace.f:
"You could die famous or you could die old. I chose old."
—Former soldier

ICE:Juniper Order Druid.f:
"The filthy towns of Kjeldor are no place for anyone to live. Fyndhorn is our home now."
—Kolbjörn, Elder Druid of the Juniper Order

EXO:Ogre Shaman.f: Ogre shamans must be bright enough to learn their invocations and dim enough to use them.

POR:Thing from the Deep.f: Seafarers fear sailing off the world's edge not so much as down its gullet.

POR:Steadfastness.f: Brute force wins the battles. Conviction wins the wars.

EXO:Jackalope Herd.f: There's little more demeaning than getting your butt kicked by a bunch of bunnies.

LGN:White Knight.f: In the wretched depths of the Grand Coliseum, his soul shines like a single torch blazing in the night.

ICE:Walking Wall.f:
"The fortress is not what it seems."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

MIR:Enlightened Tutor.f:
"I do not teach. I simply reveal."
—Daudi, Femeref tutor

FEM:Icatian Town.f: Icatia's once peaceful towns faced increasing attacks from Orcs and Goblins as the climate cooled. By the time the empire fell, they were little more than armed camps.

ONS:Gustcloak Skirmisher.f: They're trained in the art of pressing their luck.

LEG:Carrion Ants.f: "'War is no picnic,' my father liked to say. But the Ants seemed to disagree." —*General Chanek Valteroth*

INV:Kavu Scout.f: The kavu evolved for centuries deep inside Dominaria, and some can draw from its strength.

POR:Stalking Tiger.f: No one is happy when they notice a tiger.

DRK:Hidden Path.f:
"Where moments before we were lost beyond hope, the strange, floating lights showed us the way and restored our morale."
—Vervamon the Elder

LEG:Amrou Kithkin.f: Quick and agile, Amrou Kithkin can usually escape from even the most fearsome opponents.

WTH:Teferi's Veil.f:
"I don't like to speak ill of 'walkers . . . but just what did Teferi think he was doing?"
—Ertai, wizard adept

STH:Stronghold Assassin.f: The assassin sees only throats and hears only heartbeats.

ATQ:Shapeshifter.f:
Born like a Phoenix from the Flame, But neither Bulk nor Shape the same.
—Jonathan Swift, "Vanbrug's House"

MIR:Regeneration.f:
"Death is not a debt I am yet willing to pay."
—Purraj of Urborg

EXO:Seismic Assault.f: The flowstone seemed for a moment to assume Greven's rage—it lunged like a wild beast at the *Weatherlight*.

LEG:Pit Scorpion.f: Sometimes the smallest nuisance can be the greatest pain.

PTK:Zodiac Dog.f: ". . . Jiang Wei alone still strove with might and main: / Nine times more he fought the north—in vain. . . ."

LEG:Xira Arien.f: A regular guest at the Royal Masquerade, Arien is the envy of the Court. She appears in a new costume every hour.

DST:Kraken's Eye.f: Bright as a mirror, dark as the sea.

MRD:Ancient Den.f: Taj-Nar, throne of Raksha Golden Cub, destined leader of the leonin prides.

MIR:Cursed Totem.f:
Pass me from soul to soul / soldier to herder, herder to beast, beast to soil / until I am everywhere. / Then pass me those souls.
—Totem inscription (translated)

TMP:Benthic Behemoth.f:
"Deep devourer concealed in darkhome
Shrouded it seeks all becomes fodder
Once we swam alone and asea
But no more."
—*Rootwater Saga*

ICE:Imposing Visage.f:
"I can't believe they expect me to fight with this rabble. A Goblin in a big mask sends 'em running for cover."
—Avram Garrisson, Leader of the Knights of Stromgald

ICE:Warning.f:
"The folk of the Karplusan Mountains are impossible to ambush."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

NEM:Vicious Hunger.f:
"Blood is foul, the flesh dross. My ascendance thirsts for life itself."
—Crovax

INV:Tsabo Tavoc.f: "I might almost pity my enemies—if it wasn't so amusing to watch them die."

ODY:Zombie Infestation.f: The nomads' funeral pyres are more practical than ceremonial.

PLS:Mire Kavu.f: "At this rate," said Sisay, "the next kavu we see will have wings."

INV:Phyrexian Reaper.f: It desires only to help others shed the itchy wet skin of life.

USG:Gaea's Embrace.f: The forest rose to the battle, not to save the people but to save itself.

ICE:Mountain Goat.f:
"Folkore has it that to capture a Mountain Goat is a sign of divine blessing. I just know it's a sign that dinner is on the way."
—Klazina Jansdotter, Leader of the Order of the Sacred Torch

VIS:Infernal Harvest.f:
"I offered you eternal life; I just didn't say *where*."
—Shauku, Endbringer

P02:Air Elemental.f: As insubstantial, and as powerful, as the wind that carries it.

ODY:Lava Blister.f:
To treat flesh wounds, use earth. To treat earth wounds, use flesh.
—Barbarian saying

ALL:Lat-Nam's Legacy.f:
"All the knowledge of Lat-Nam could not protect its sages from the Brothers' War."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

USG:Wall of Junk.f: Urza saw the wall and realized that even if he tore every Phyrexian to pieces, they would still resist him.

PTK:Shu Foot Soldiers.f: Liu Bei lost many men at the battle of Runan because of his lack of strategy. It wasn't until he met Kongming that he began to truly succeed as a leader.

MRD:Skyhunter Cub.f: Every young leonin wishes to become a skyhunter, for they soar closest to the suns.

2ED:Phantom Monster.f:
"While, like a ghastly rapid river,
Through the pale door,
A hideous throng rush out forever,
And laugh—but smile no more."
—Edgar Allan Poe, "The Haunted Palace"

ALL:Kaysa.f: Kaysa speaks as the Elder Druid, but the Yavimaya recognizes only one voice: its own.

MIR:Tropical Storm.f:
"After the storm, I found a sea turtle dying on the sands, a blade of grass driven through its shell."
—*Travelogue of Najat*

DRK:Goblin Shrine.f: "I knew it weren't no ordinary pile of—you know." —Norin the Wary

HML:Wizards' School.f: The legacy of Feroz lives on.

PCY:Inflame.f: Wound, maim, kill: it's all the same to a Keldon.

FEM:Thelonite Druid.f:
"The magic at the heart of all living things can bear awe-inspiring fruit."
—Kolevi of Havenwood, Elder Druid

ONS:Daru Lancer.f: Although the Order frowned upon his preparations for the pits, behind closed doors most saw the fights as a necessary evil.

ODY:Patchwork Gnomes.f: When building gnomes, dwarves adhere to the highest standards. The gnomes themselves aren't as particular.

USG:Sunder.f: The flow of time was disrupted; like a flooding river it rose from its banks. Tolaria was drowned in an instant that stretched toward infinity.

INV:Obliterate.f: For his family, Barrin made a funeral pyre of Tolaria.

LGN:Dripping Dead.f: It oozes death from every pore.

P02:Steam Catapult.f: "You idiots! Turn it around! Turn it around!"

MIR:Sandstorm.f:
Better to fight the sand for a few hours than to sleep beneath it forever.
—Suq'Ata truism

P02:Moaning Spirit.f: The dead sing their own lullabies.

ONS:Ancestor's Prophet.f: "We have faced horrors of war and terrors beyond imagining. We will overcome the uncertainties of this new life."

TMP:Rootwater Hunter.f:
"Bitter water vicious wave
Shadow-cold shallows root-made maze
Home's angry embrace."
—*Rootwater Saga*

LGN:Totem Speaker.f: "Elves and beasts are tied together, and I am the knot that binds them."

MIR:Sirocco.f:
"Blow, fiery wind, / strip illusion from the eye. / Blow, fiery wind of truth."
—Femeref chant

HML:Aether Storm.f:
"I do love the rain . . . but this storm feels somehow wrong, Taysir."
—Daria

MMQ:Spontaneous Generation.f: Saprolings always thrive on the ruins of others, and Mercadia ruins more than most.

ICE:Kjeldoran Warrior.f:
"Give me a thousand such Warriors and I could change the world."
—Avram Garrisson, Leader of the Knights of Stromgald

ATQ:Argivian Archaeologist.f: Fascinated by the lore of ancient struggles, the Archaeologist searches incessantly for remnants of an earlier, more powerful era.

TMP:Gaseous Form.f:
"It's hard to hurt anyone when you're as transparent as your motives."
—Ertai, wizard adept

INV:Marauding Knight.f: "They ride our trails as if they were designed to," said the guard. "They were," replied Gerrard.

HML:Autumn Willow.f:
"We must shake her limbs and rattle her brains."
—Grandmother Sengir

LGN:Enormous Baloth.f: Its diet consists of fruits, plants, small woodland animals, large woodland animals, woodlands, fruit groves, fruit farmers, and small cities.

ONS:Swat.f: Few who cross Phage have the chance to repeat the mistake.

MMQ:Cackling Witch.f: The touch of his madness can drive anyone into a killing frenzy.

ICE:Brand of Ill Omen.f:
"Let those who bear the brand receive no shelter, no kindness, and no comfort from our people."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

HML:Apocalypse Chime.f:
"One day, or another, perhaps I shall ring my pretty chime . . . loudly, so that all may hear."
—Grandmother Sengir

ONS:Discombobulate.f:
"I said 'pick his brain,' not 'tear off his head.'"
—Riptide Project researcher

ICE:Kjeldoran Skycaptain.f:
"If we do our duty and uphold our honor, Kjeldor shall stand for a thousand years."
—Arna Kennerüd, Skyknight

MIR:Horrible Hordes.f: Few are able to underestimate the hordes.

JUD:Test of Endurance.f:
"If we have learned nothing else, we have learned to survive."
—Mystic elder

FEM:Fungal Bloom.f:
"Thallids could absorb energy from the forest itself. Even Elves were at a disadvantage in fighting them."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. III*

CHK:Kabuto Moth.f:
"Many great warriors died in the first days of the war, as the spirits of their weaponry turned against them with terrifying rage."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

NEM:Skyshroud Claim.f: The forest's constant struggle is to keep the spreading flowstone at bay.

INV:Distorting Wake.f: Gerrard savored a grim smile as the Phyrexian portals disappeared behind the *Weatherlight*.

SCG:Wipe Clean.f: "The light of the Ancestor will scour the taint of darkness from the land."

INV:Bind.f:
"The battlefield is cluttered enough. Be still."
—Multani, maro-sorcerer

MMQ:Alley Grifters.f: One distracts the victim, the other extracts the valuables.

UDS:Sanctimony.f: "To forgive our enemies is to forgive ourselves."

ODY:Spark Mage.f: The Pardic Mountains are known for their spicy cuisine.

TMP:Horned Sliver.f: A bristling wave of slivers broke against the *Weatherlight*'s timbers.

LEG:Gaseous Form.f:
". . . [A]nd gives to airy nothing/ A local habitation and a name."
—William Shakespeare, *A Midsummer-Night's Dream*

CHK:Unearthly Blizzard.f:
"We are trapped. The mountains and blinding kami storms have made us hopelessly lost. We are starving. In the name of all things sacred, please, send help . . . ."
—Lost Battalion, final message to General Takeno

DST:Vedalken Engineer.f: Art is unknown to the vedalken—for them, all creations must serve a purpose.

TMP:Dread of Night.f:
