"These moonless, foreign skies keep me in thrall. Dark whispers echo in the night, and I cannot resist."
—Selenia, dark angel

LEG:Urborg.f: "Resignedly beneath the sky/The melancholy waters lie./So blend the turrets and shadows there/That all seem pendulous in air,/While from a proud tower in town/Death looks gigantically down." —Edgar Allan Poe, "The City in the Sea"

USG:Ravenous Skirge.f: Hunger is a kind of madness—and here, all madness flourishes.

JUD:Mirror Wall.f:
"Breaking it would be about four hundred years bad luck."
—Nomad sentry

ICE:War Chariot.f:
"I wouldn't advise using it with a Woolly Mammoth, but it's quite appropriate for many other beasts."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

5DN:Into Thin Air.f:
"Perhaps I should take Mirrodin apart and begin again."
—Memnarch

MIR:Merfolk Raiders.f:
"Turn your back for a second and they just vanish! As if they weren't shifty enough before."
—Rhirhok, goblin archer

UDS:Repercussion.f: Not all Keld's warriors are found on the battlefield.

USG:Goblin Patrol.f:
"Take the sharp metal stick and make a lotta holes."
—Jula, goblin raider

PLS:Gerrard's Command.f: "Unless you like the idea of becoming some goblin's lunch, get up and move!"

MIR:Kukemssa Pirates.f:
". . . pirates gambled with a djinn and lost the thing more dear than gold."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

DST:Arcane Spyglass.f: It breaches not physical distances but temporal ones.

LGN:Merchant of Secrets.f: To scrape out a living in Aphetto, wizards are reduced to selling rumors, lies, forgeries, or—if they get desperate enough—the truth.

INV:Coastal Tower.f: The Capashen built the highest towers in Benalia to afford themselves the best view.

ODY:Fledgling Imp.f: Imps aren't born knowing how to fly—just how to annoy.

MRD:Malachite Golem.f: Centuries before the first branches of the Tangle gave shelter from the suns' cold light, the shadows of golems were Mirrodin's only shade.

VIS:Keeper of Kookus.f: Wanted: Thick-skinned goblin for guarding mean ol' Kookus. Must like fires. Must heal quickly.

LEG:Riven Turnbull.f: "Political violence is a perfectly legitimate answer to the persecution handed down by dignitaries of the state."

PCY:Verdant Field.f: Jolrael tends the land so that the land will tend the beasts.

JUD:Guided Strike.f:
"May the Ancestor strengthen my hand and guide my blade."
—Nomad war prayer

ONS:Astral Slide.f:
"The hum of the universe is never off-key."
—Mystic elder

POR:Boiling Seas.f: What burns the land, boils the seas.

MMQ:Specter's Wail.f: As he gritted his teeth to focus through the pain, Tahngarth glanced at Takara. She seemed completely unaffected.

POR:Mind Knives.f: To dodge the unerring knife, one must be free of thought.

WTH:Debt of Loyalty.f: "I killed him because I had to," Starke lied to Gerrard. "But now I pledge my loyalty to you."

ICE:Lightning Blow.f:
"If you do it right, they'll never know what hit them."
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox

LEG:Headless Horseman.f:
". . . [T]he ghost rides forth to the scene of battle in nightly quest of his head . . . he sometimes passes along the Hollow, like a midnight blast . . ."
—Washington Irving, The Legend of Sleepy Hollow

ICE:Updraft.f:
"The power of flight has but one equal in battle: surprise. Understanding how to use both is the key to victory."
—Arnjlot Olasson, Sky Mage

USG:Tainted Aether.f: Gix despised the sylvan morass. The gouge that the portal had torn in the forest was the only pleasing sight.

PTK:Barbarian Horde.f: Only twenty years after the Sima clan united the empire, invading barbarians divided it again.

ODY:Dedicated Martyr.f:
"If he's so willing to suffer for his cause, then by all means, let us oblige him."
—Cabal Patriarch

ODY:Deserted Temple.f: A monument to long-forgotten gods, it stands as a tribute to the fleeting nature of human ways.

ATQ:Crumble.f: The spirits of Argoth grant new life to those who repent the folly of enslaving their labors to devices.

LEG:Cat Warriors.f: These stealthy felines have survived so many battles that some believe they must possess many lives.

BOK:Hero's Demise.f:
"What will it say on our graves, Lord Konda? Will it say we led our world to conquer immortal forces or that we were crushed by our own arrogance? At each defeat, I wonder."
—Sensei Hisoka, letter to Lord Konda

INV:Stun.f:
"They certainly are well protected. Too bad for them they're not well balanced."
—Sisay

ICE:Stonehands.f:
"Trust in the power of stone. Stone is strong; stone shatters swords; stone breaks bones. Trust in stone."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

MRD:Sunbeam Spellbomb.f:
"Cure that which was never ill."
—Spellbomb inscription

INV:Captain Sisay.f: Her leadership forged the *Weatherlight*'s finest crew.

CHK:Vigilance.f:
"Put a spear in a peasant's hands, and you have an expendable troop. Put a purpose in his heart, and you win a warrior."
—Sensei Golden-Tail

HML:Joven's Tools.f:
"If that thief Joven ever shows his head around here again, make sure he leaves without it."
—Eron the Relentless

ODY:Innocent Blood.f: Zombies mourn for the living and celebrate those who will soon be given the gift of death.

ALL:Floodwater Dam.f: Viscerid dams may be of living creatures as well as bones and mud.

MMQ:Deepwood Elder.f: They'd guarded the Henge so long that they were as attuned to the powerstones as they were to the trees.

ICE:Hyalopterous Lemure.f:
"The Lemures looked harmless, until they descended on my troops. Within moments, only bones remained."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter, Leader of the Order of the White Shield

ONS:Charging Slateback.f: Goblins prize its hide for building rock sled runners.

CHK:Shinka, the Bloodsoaked Keep.f: The glow from within looks inviting, but woe awaits whomever finds out who stokes the fire or what simmers in the pot.

ONS:Words of Waste.f:
"Terror corrupts order and paralyzes instinct."
—*Volume III, The Book of Decay*

PTK:Capture of Jingzhou.f: The province of Jingzhou was the fulcrum of the three kingdoms. At separate times it was coveted and controlled by the Wu, the Shu, and the Wei.

MMQ:Cowardice.f: Gerrard was the Mercadian soldiers' greatest hero; they followed him blindly. When he left, they stumbled around blindly.

SOK:Adamaro, First to Desire.f:
"Beware Adamaro! In him all pain and anger is perfected."
—Isao, Enlightened Bushi

JUD:Cabal Trainee.f:
"Ah, a faceshredder. Very rare. Nearly unstoppable. Good luck!"
—Cabal instructor

NEM:Stronghold Machinist.f: She stretches the laws of physics until they snap.

USG:Pouncing Jaguar.f: One pounce, she's hungry—you die quickly. Two, she's teaching her cubs—you're in for a long day.

DST:Unforge.f: Compared to the fire of the forge, the strength of steel is nothing.

DST:Burden of Greed.f:
"The one who dies with the most toys is still dead."
—Geth, keeper of the Vault

VIS:Kaervek's Spite.f:
"The end justifies the means. What do I care if I rule over the dead rather than over the living? The dead ask fewer questions."
—Kaervek

UDS:Impatience.f: Ask a Keldon to hold his temper and you'll be left holding your guts.

ICE:Avalanche.f:
"The pass was completely blocked by the avalanche; we're forced to turn back. Nevertheless, we've gone farther and seen more than any before us."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

ULG:Parch.f:
"Your porous flesh betrays you."
—Fire Eye, viashino bey

PCY:Shrouded Serpent.f: Many travelers have wandered into a fog only to find that it had teeth, claws, and an appetite.

MRD:Arc-Slogger.f: A shuffling sound and the smell of ozone follow the slogger as surely as its electric tail.

ICE:Kjeldoran Dead.f:
"They shall kill those whom once they loved."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

PCY:Keldon Firebombers.f:
"If there isn't enough of Jamuraa left to stand on, I will still claim it for Keld."
—Latulla, Keldon overseer

POR:Muck Rats.f: The difference between a nuisance and a threat is often merely a matter of numbers.

WTH:Wave of Terror.f: The sea of fear has endless depths.

HML:Merchant Scroll.f:
"There's no trade without trust."
—Eron the Relentless

POR:False Peace.f: Mutual consent is not required for war.

PLS:Urza's Guilt.f: Deep in Yawgmoth's realm, Urza stopped dead in his tracks and rubbed his soot-filled eyes. "Mishra?"

LEG:Tolaria.f: "Fairest Isle, all isles excelling,/ Seat of Pleasures, and of loves . . ." —John Dryden

TMP:Broken Fall.f:
"I think I used up all my good luck and all my bad luck in the same fall."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

STH:Ruination.f:
"We have built a wall upon sand. The wall will vanish. The sand will remain."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

POR:Fire Snake.f: The snake's final thrashings only spread the fire within it.

ODY:Time Stretch.f: There's lots of time like the present.

POR:Craven Knight.f: "I say victory is better than honor."

PLS:Dark Suspicions.f:
"After four thousand years, you learn to plan for betrayal."
—Urza

STH:Skyshroud Troopers.f:
"We were not made for war. Like flowstone, Volrath shaped us to it."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

POR:Nature's Lore.f: Nature's secrets can be read on every tree, every branch, every leaf.

ICE:Flare.f:
"I strive for elegance and speed in my work."
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

WTH:Orcish Settlers.f: They wouldn't know their house from a charred hole in the ground.

MRD:Needlebug.f: Near Tel-Jilad, the Tangle is almost silent, save for the trolls' chants and the skittering of needlebugs.

5DN:Roar of Reclamation.f:
"Yesterday's relics will determine the outcome of tomorrow's war."
—Ushanti, leonin seer

PTK:Warrior's Oath.f:
"If I fail, my head is yours."
—Warrior's oath common during the Three Kingdoms period

LGN:Vexing Beetle.f: As the Mirari's mutating effects grew out of control, centaurs and druids fled—but insects swarmed closer.

SOK:Ashes of the Fallen.f: The ashes of the dead mingle with the soil, and both become as one.

ICE:Kjeldoran Knight.f:
"Those who do not ride the wind on Aesthir still command loyalty and respect."
—Arna Kennerüd, Skyknight

ATQ:Rocket Launcher.f: What these devices lacked in subtlety, they made up in strength.

MIR:Shallow Grave.f: Good help is hard to dig up.

MRD:Tempest of Light.f:
"This world reeks of another's hand. Someone or something is defying the power of the gods and shaping this planet. I intend for it to stop."
—Glissa Sunseeker

ONS:Pinpoint Avalanche.f:
"Some solve problems by thinking and talking. Others use rocks."
—Toggo, goblin weaponsmith

USG:Crystal Chimes.f: As Serra was to learn, the peace and sanctity of her realm were as fragile as glass.

EXO:Null Brooch.f:
Give away everything so others have nothing.
—Brooch inscription

5DN:Eon Hub.f: Its power source is time itself. It absorbs unused minutes and hours, bringing the end of existence always closer.

MMQ:Horn of Plenty.f:
"This horn is an exact replica of the fabled Horn of Ramos, except mine is more lavish."
—Mercadian magistrate

USG:Copper Gnomes.f: Start with eleven gnomes and a room of parts, and come morning you'll have ten and a monster the likes of which you've never seen.

ONS:Psychic Trance.f: The Riptide Project was perhaps the only school devoted to preventing the spread of knowledge.

EXO:Soul Warden.f:
Count carefully the souls and see that none are lost.
—Vec teaching

INV:Artifact Mutation.f:
"From shards and splinters I call forth my living horde."
—Molimo, maro-sorcerer

APC:Fervent Charge.f: Crovax was nearly buried beneath the weight of his opponents.

USG:Guma.f: When the giant returned for the night, he found a dead merfolk on his pillow. Although he praised the little guma, he inwardly wondered where she had hid the head.

USG:Pegasus Charger.f:
"The clouds came alive and dove to the earth! Hooves flashed among the dark army, who fled before the spectacle of fury."
—*Song of All*, canto 211

DRK:Bog Rats.f: Their stench was vile and strong enough, but not nearly as powerful as their hunger.

2ED:Wall of Air.f: "This 'standing windstorm' can hold us off indefinitely? Ridiculous!" Saying nothing, she put a pinch of salt on the table. With a bang she clapped her hands, and the salt disappeared, blown away.

NEM:Stronghold Zeppelin.f: As long as the stronghold controlled the sky, the rebels were doomed.

P02:Ogre Taskmaster.f: Three little goblins, enjoying their brew. One bumped an ogre, and then there were two.

JUD:Telekinetic Bonds.f:
"Nature's been fired. The oceans are under new management."
—Ambassador Laquatus

ODY:Hint of Insanity.f: "Practice makes perfect, but obsession makes better."

CHK:Masako the Humorless.f: Konda's servants dared not neglect their duties for a moment under Masako's icy gaze, knowing that what she saw, Lord Konda would hear.

MRD:Creeping Mold.f: The deadliest force on Mirrodin isn't the largest organism—it's the smallest.

LEG:Spinal Villain.f: "Striking silent as a dream,/ Cutting short the strangled scream . . ." —Tobrian, "Watchdragon"

NEM:Treetop Bracers.f: Gravity is truly what you make of it.

MIR:Unyaro Griffin.f: The griffin's shadow gives courage to the righteous and dread to the idle.

VIS:Mundungu.f:
"Our buried kings silently await the revolt of dead peasants."
—Tuwile, mundungu of Aku

BOK:First Volley.f:
"We searched their bodies for signs of the blades that had killed them, but found nothing more than scorched flesh."
—Tender-Hand, kitsune healer

EXO:Thrull Surgeon.f: "Just take a little off the top."

SCG:Enrage.f: "You wouldn't like me when I'm angry."

WTH:Vitalize.f:
"After waking to the magic of Llanowar, no dreams can compare."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

INV:Pledge of Loyalty.f: Urza convinced many Dominarians not only to set aside their differences, but to embrace them.

SCG:Temple of the False God.f: Those who bring nothing to the temple take nothing away.

P02:Bear Cub.f:
Every little cub has its mother's teeth to guard it.
—Elvish saying

PCY:Rib Cage Spider.f: Everything it sees it considers food—and with that many eyes, it's not liable to miss much.

ICE:Sacred Boon.f:
"Divine gifts are granted to those who are worthy."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran Priest

CHK:Hearth Kami.f:
"Every treachery, great or small, begets a spirit that rages at the injustice. Given the opportunity, each will return that treachery to its owner tenfold."
—Sensei Hisoka

2ED:Grizzly Bears.f: Don't try to outrun one of Dominia's Grizzlies; it'll catch you, knock you down, and eat you. Of course, you could run up a tree. In that case you'll get a nice view before it knocks the tree down and eats you.

MIR:Crash of Rhinos.f:
Love is like a rhino, short-sighted and hasty; if it cannot find a way, it will make a way.
—Femeref adage

LEG:Walking Dead.f: The Walking Dead are the remains of freakish experiments by the Necromantic Lords.

POR:Wrath of God.f:
"As flies to wanton boys, are we to the gods. They kill us for their sport."
—William Shakespeare, *King Lear*

FEM:Icatian Priest.f:
"May you be strong and valiant, to defeat the enemies of the pure."
—"Leitbur's Prayer"

ONS:Lightning Rift.f: Options will cost you, but a lack of them will cost you even more.

BOK:Unchecked Growth.f:
"That energy was once granted to growing things. Now the kami keep it for themselves, releasing it in sudden floods that overwhelm flesh and foliage alike."
—Sakiko, Mother of Summer

ATQ:Onulet.f: An early inspiration for Urza, Tocasia's Onulets contained magical essences that could be cannibalized after they stopped functioning.

2ED:Wall of Ice.f:
"And through the drifts the snowy cliffs/ Did send a dismal sheen:/ Nor shapes of men nor beasts we ken—/ The ice was all between."/
—Samuel Coleridge, "The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

ODY:Gallantry.f: The courageous accomplish more in a single moment than the cowardly do in a lifetime.

TMP:Havoc.f: As Orim put the lightning rod into place on the bow, she cast a spell of protection to shield herself from the heat. That's when the Furnace got personal.

CHK:Ben-Ben, Akki Hermit.f: Some akki thought of Ben-Ben as a kami of trickery in disguise. They hunted for him in the maze of warrens, often falling prey to his traps.

TMP:Warmth.f:
"Flame grows gentle with but a little distance."
—Orim, Samite healer

P02:Golden Bear.f: The elvish scout was scrupulous about the truth. She told the traders that gold lay nearby.

FEM:Thrull Retainer.f:
"Until the Rebellion, Thrulls served their masters faithfully—even at the cost of their own lives."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. II*

PLS:Insolence.f:
"Sacrificing mortal dragons to satisfy your immortal hunger ends here."
—Darigaaz, to Rith

BOK:That Which Was Taken.f:
"This god held prisoner in human hands has put all humanity in the hands of angry gods."
—Masako the Humorless

TMP:Scragnoth.f: It possesses no intelligence, only counter-intelligence.

PTK:Taoist Hermit.f: Taoists chose to be hermits for many reasons, but all shared one unchanging goal: to follow the Tao.

PCY:Darba.f: Legend has it the darba gave up its wings in return for an extra stomach.

INV:Sparring Golem.f: "Part drill sergeant, part training dummy," thought Gerrard. "I hope it can stand up to a real war."

PCY:Agent of Shauku.f: "Go ahead. Take it. You'll be so very powerful . . . and what harm can it do?"

ONS:Searing Flesh.f: Zemoo found out the hard way that "inflammable" and "flammable" mean the same thing.

ALL:Ashnod's Cylix.f: Few remember that Ashnod's defilement of Terisiare's resources outstripped even that of her peers.

TMP:Eladamri's Vineyard.f: The mushroom wine made Gerrard's head spin, and his stomach soon followed suit.

BOK:Heart of Light.f:
"There is a shining in the mortal heart that even the kami cannot reach."
—Sensei Golden-Tail

MMQ:Crenellated Wall.f: Mercadian soldiers excel at finding things to stand behind.

CHK:Part the Veil.f: At the waterfall, the border between the humanoid and the spirit worlds was weakest. The kami moved across it with ease and at will.

INV:Shoreline Raider.f:
"This strange new beast makes for an excellent meal. Get me more."
—Empress Galina

DRK:Eater of the Dead.f: Even the putrid muscles of the dead can provide strength to those loathsome enough to consume them.

ICE:Drift of the Dead.f:
"Take their dead, and entomb them in the snow. Risen, they shall serve a new purpose."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

JUD:Spirit Cairn.f: It marks the border between here and hereafter.

VIS:Zhalfirin Crusader.f:
"War is the crucible of leadership."
—Rashida Scalebane

ICE:Thoughtleech.f:
"A resourceful mage has many sources of information. The best one is your foe."
—Zur the Enchanter

EXO:Killer Whale.f: Hunger is like the sea: deep, endless, and unforgiving.

DST:Aether Snap.f:
"May you wake to find you were only ever a dream."
—Mephidross curse

USG:Titania's Chosen.f:
"What do a hero and an arrow have in common? In times of war are many more made."
—Elvish riddle

NEM:Belbe's Percher.f: Long and powerful, these birds were used to carry messages to and from the evincar.

LEG:Righteous Avengers.f: Few can withstand the wrath of the righteous.

UDS:Elvish Lookout.f: Like a masterful quilter, Yavimaya stitches together patches of color to warn its denizens of threats.

MIR:Radiant Essence.f:
"Her beauty was the beauty of the Sun at midday, deadly to those who underestimated her strength."
—Azeworai, "Kenechi's Dream"

2ED:Zombie Master.f: They say the Zombie Master controlled these foul creatures even before his own death, but now that he is one of them, nothing can make them betray him.

ODY:Ghastly Demise.f:
"Anyone can snap her fingers and yank a soul. I prefer to kill creatively."
—Braids, dementia summoner

TMP:Sadistic Glee.f:
"First blood isn't as important as last blood."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

SCG:Uncontrolled Infestation.f: The grounds of the Riptide Project are now populated only by slivers, broken beakers, and the lonely screeching of gulls.

ONS:Aven Brigadier.f: He represents what little pride the Order has left.

INV:Phyrexian Battleflies.f: After encountering them, Squee finally lost his appetite for bugs.

SOK:Shape Stealer.f:
"Stand back. I know just what to do."
—Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker

ICE:Seizures.f:
"Sheathe your sword, warrior, lest ye fall on it when stricken."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

TOR:Enslaved Dwarf.f: Captive dwarves always regain their freedom, either through escape or through a desperate, fiery death.

MMQ:Delraich.f: It wears the souls of its victims like jewels on a chain.

ONS:Explosive Vegetation.f: Torching Krosa would be pointless. It grows faster than it burns.

ONS:Thrashing Mudspawn.f: It just obeys you. It doesn't *like* you.

2ED:Orcish Artillery.f: In a rare display of ingenuity, the Orcs invented an incredibly destructive weapon. Most Orcish artillerists are those who dared criticize its effectiveness.

POR:Regal Unicorn.f: Unicorns don't care if you believe in them any more than you care if they believe in you.

PCY:Keldon Berserker.f: They fight beyond thought, beyond fear, and beyond mercy.

STH:Elven Rite.f: As the bough stretches, so shall you grow. As the roots spread, so shall you thrive.

TMP:Counterspell.f:
"It was probably a lousy spell in the first place."
—Ertai, wizard adept

INV:Backlash.f: Darigaaz decided his foe would be more useful as a weapon.

MMQ:Indentured Djinn.f: It's not always clear who's the master and who's the servant.

P02:Piracy.f: The sea gives, and the sea takes. Some just help with the taking.

USG:Voice of Law.f:
"Life's balance is as a star: on one point is Law, and Law must be upheld. If the knots of order are loosened, chaos will spill through."
—*Song of All*, canto 167

MMQ:Arms Dealer.f: He has the weapons, he has the connections, and he knows the hangar's dark secret.

INV:Pulse of Llanowar.f:
"Gaea's memory is eternal, and she exists in all things."
—Molimo, maro-sorcerer

JUD:Venomous Vines.f:
"True strength comes from within. The false promise of unnatural power only incurs Krosa's wrath."
—Seton, centaur druid

PCY:Root Cage.f: The Vintara Forest welcomes its enemies with a crushing embrace.

SOK:Fiddlehead Kami.f:
"Like a riddle, it unwinds. Like a green wind, it reaches out. Like a sudden guilt, it seizes."
—Snow Fur, kitsune poet

P02:Temple Elder.f:
"Give us breath. Give us life. Prepare us for the day we make."
—The Alaborn "Rite of Battle"

NEM:Rupture.f: All creatures have an inner fire. Releasing it can be dangerous.

DRK:Ghost Ship.f: "That phantom prow split the storm as lightning cast its long shadow on the battlefield below." —Mireille Gaetane, *The Valeriad*

LEG:Jasmine Boreal.f: "Peace must prevail, even if the wicked must die."

5DN:Steelshaper's Gift.f: Some blades seek their own wielders.

INV:Defiling Tears.f: Serra's living warriors looked on in horror. "Where is our Lady now?" they cried.

ONS:Gluttonous Zombie.f: Greed and gluttony led him to death. Now they are his greatest assets.

MMQ:Deepwood Wolverine.f: The jhovalls are depleting its food sources, the Mercadians are eroding its home, and you're wondering why it's angry?

VIS:Nekrataal.f:
"I have seen the horrors Kaervek has freed. My betrayal is certain—but of Kaervek or of Jamuraa, I cannot say."
—Jolrael

TMP:Pincher Beetles.f:
"No fair! Since when does a bug get ta munch on *me*?"
—Squee, goblin cabin hand

PLS:Escape Routes.f:
"I'll get you to safety—or whatever passes for safety these days."
—Urborg ferry pilot

LGN:Covert Operative.f: Some spies seek clarity. Others seek transparency.

BOK:Kyoki, Sanity's Eclipse.f:
"Kyoki, Eater of Minds, Corrupter of Thoughts, Bringer of Madness, Lord of Fear. Return, by our blood, and walk again."
—Ogre chant

2ED:Firebreathing.f:
"And topples round the dreary west
A looming bastion fringed with fire."
—Alfred, Lord Tennyson, "In Memoriam"

JUD:Golden Wish.f: She wished for nobility, but not for a nation to honor it.

DRK:Fellwar Stone.f: "What do you have that I cannot obtain?" —Mairsil, called the Pretender

BOK:Kami of Tattered Shoji.f: It remembered all the shadows lantern-cast upon its paper wings, and sometimes those silhouettes played across its shape again, acting out silent tragedies.

NEM:Bola Warrior.f: The ingredients for panic include equal parts danger, uncertainty, and helplessness.

CHK:Hinder.f:
"Do not react to force in kind. Turn it aside. Direct it to where it can do no harm."
—Meloku the Clouded Mirror

USG:Pacifism.f:
"Fight? I cannot. I do not care if I live or die, so long as I can rest."
—Urza, to Serra

DST:Synod Artificer.f: Memnarch shared a touch of his power with the vedalken in return for their service. It is a debt he intends to collect.

MIR:Lead Golem.f: Slow and heavy swings the club.

MRD:Bloodscent.f: To study the predators of the Tangle, two people are required: one to watch from above, and one to run like hell.

WTH:Serenity.f:
"Just think of me as the storm before the calm."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

P02:Bloodcurdling Scream.f:
"I have all the weapons my enemies have—and far deeper rage."
—Tojira, swamp queen

PLS:Eladamri's Call.f: Tribal rivalries and petty disputes were laid aside at Eladamri's summons.

ODY:Laquatus's Creativity.f: One never knows when inspiration will bubble up.

CHK:Night of Souls' Betrayal.f:
"How can we wage war against ourselves? What happens when the kami of our very souls rise against us? I answer simply: We cannot. We die. There can be no victory in this war."
—Sensei Hisoka, letter to Lord Konda

ULG:Phyrexian Denouncer.f:
"The first stage of the illness: rash and nausea."
—Phyrexian progress notes

MRD:Altar's Light.f:
"The altar does nothing; the device is crushed under the weight of its own impurity."
—Ushanti, leonin seer

ALL:Wild Aesthir.f:
"High in the Karplusans, death is swift and razor-clawed."
—Arna Kennerüd, Skycaptain

VIS:Warthog.f:
"Too much work—it takes a long time to break them in, and more than a few recruits."
—Grebog, goblin swine-rider

STH:Rolling Stones.f: Walls collapse and kill people all the time. Some are just more aggressive about it.

LEG:Planar Gate.f: Nireya reached through the Gate, sensing the energies trapped beyond.

USG:Cloak of Mists.f:
"All we could lose, we did. All we could keep, we do. And both are shrouded by mists."
—Barrin, master wizard

INV:Coalition Victory.f:
"You can build a perfect machine out of imperfect parts."
—Urza

MRD:Omega Myr.f: Last to charge, last to fall.

VIS:Stampeding Wildebeests.f: Prayers for rain are answered with the thunder of hooves.

BOK:Kentaro, the Smiling Cat.f: "The bonds of bushido will draw the dishonored back someday, and I will be there waiting."

STH:Mogg Maniac.f: Stand clear if he gets an itch.

ULG:Yavimaya Wurm.f: When the gorilla playfully grabbed the wurm's tail, the wurm doubled back and playfully ate the gorilla's head.

MIR:Wall of Corpses.f:
"I shall make walls of their flesh, and their blood will be my mortar."
—Kaervek

SOK:Hand of Honor.f: "The sword is just a tool. It is the samurai's hand that brings it to life."

HML:Rashka the Slayer.f:
"Rarely be the prey so haughty as to hunt the hunter."
—Baron Sengir

INV:Lotus Guardian.f: Lotus fields are too valuable to leave undefended.

MMQ:Molting Harpy.f: Shed harpy feathers leave painful wounds—which explains the harpies' mood.

5DN:Magnetic Theft.f: Among the Vulshok, the most prized blades are those that killed their original owners.

POR:Pyroclasm.f: Chaos does not choose its enemies.

TMP:Fireslinger.f:
"Remember the moral of the fireslinger fable: with power comes isolation."
—Karn, silver golem

TMP:Heartwood Treefolk.f:
"In all my years in Llanowar I never understood where trees fit in. They are revered by elves and watered on by dogs."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

P02:Volunteer Militia.f: People fight hardest on their own soil.

BOK:Ashen Monstrosity.f: There was a dull thunder at the vanguard, then shocked cries in the midst of the column. Moments later, Takada, last of the rearguard, faced the kami alone.

CHK:Hold the Line.f: "Forgive me, Master Kami, but in the interest of my people I must halt your advance."

TMP:Starke of Rath.f:
"I know to whom I owe the most loyalty, and I see him in the mirror every day."
—Starke

P02:Talas Warrior.f: The sea is in their blood. Literally.

ALL:Mystic Compass.f:
"And *I* say north is where I *want* it to be!"
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

P02:Coercion.f:
"Human tenderness is simply weakness in a pretty package."
—Tojira, swamp queen

P02:Bargain.f: Bargaining with a goblin is like trading with a child; both believe they already own everything.

ICE:Flooded Woodlands.f: Freyalise's tears bring life and renewal, though they also bring trouble.

PCY:Aura Fracture.f: Jamuraa's rhystic mages treat magic as their garden, uprooting unwanted spells as bothersome weeds.

ONS:Threaten.f: Goblins' motivational techniques are crude, but effective.

WTH:Cinder Giant.f:
"The giant wept tears of embers for the deaths of his allies."
—Azeworai, "The Lonely Giant"

ODY:Careful Study.f: Books are like crops—they must be thinned for best yield.

5DN:Cosmic Larva.f: For millennia they wandered from plane to plane, devouring all metal. Finally, their wanderings are over.

MMQ:Ramosian Lieutenant.f: "Give me your hand and I will give you victory."

ODY:Beloved Chaplain.f: Nomad and Nantuko, eagle and elephant; all the birds and beasts are charmed by his quiet dignity.

P02:Muck Rats.f:
"Just as some fool said it couldn't get worse, the rats began to show up."
—Alaborn soldier

PTK:Burning Fields.f:
"In raiding and plundering, be like fire, in immovability like a mountain."
—Sun Tzu, *Art of War* (trans. Giles)

VIS:Firestorm Hellkite.f:
"If it can scar the sky with fire, do not share its destination."
—Mwani, Mtenda herder

USG:Viashino Weaponsmith.f: Within the rig settlement, those who have mastered the making of weapons earn highest honor.

MMQ:Soothsaying.f: The vizier's wisdom proved invaluable in untangling the Mercadian knot of lies.

SCG:Grip of Chaos.f: When the world is consumed by chaos, the skilled and the foolish are on equal footing.

LEG:Kobolds of Kher Keep.f: Kher Keep is unique among fortresses: impervious to aerial assault but defenseless from the ground.

2ED:Hill Giant.f: Fortunately, Hill Giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.

ONS:Essence Fracture.f:
"Shaping reality is simply a matter of knowing where to apply pressure."
—Ixidor, reality sculptor

DST:Slobad, Goblin Tinkerer.f:
"I used to joke that he had been exiled for being too smart. Now I know why he never laughed."
—Glissa Sunseeker

LEG:Barbary Apes.f: Unpredictable in the extreme, these carnivorous apes will prey even upon their own kind.

MRD:Loxodon Punisher.f: The loxodons believe punishment comes in two steps: pain and atonement. They carry a weapon for each.

INV:Aura Shards.f: Gaea forged her soldiers into self-wielding weapons that struck down all impurities.

MIR:Bay Falcon.f:
"Wear the falcon's feathers in your hair—
be fast as the falcon, bright as the Sun."
—"Rise on Wings," Zhalfirin song

CHK:Innocence Kami.f: Her voice was light, her substance music.

SCG:Reward the Faithful.f: "When you have drunk your fill, pass the cup to others who thirst."

JUD:Wormfang Newt.f: Spawned by mages emulating the insane.

USG:Urza's Armor.f:
"Tawnos's blueprints were critical to the creation of my armor. As he once sealed himself in steel, I sealed myself in a walking crypt."
—Urza

EXO:Elvish Berserker.f: Their fury scatters enemies like a pile of dry leaves.

MMQ:Bribery.f: In Mercadia City, loyalties extend only as far as your purse can stretch.

SOK:Ivory Crane Netsuke.f: It is said that the feathers of a crane are clouds, plucked and sewn together by the hands of the kami.

MMQ:Rock Badger.f: The Kyren goblins created most of the inverted mountain's tunnels simply by driving the beast before them.

ARN:Camel.f: Everyone knew Walid was a pious man, for he had been blessed with many sons, many jewels, and a great many Camels.

PCY:Rhystic Tutor.f: Any lock can be undone, any secret revealed.

MMQ:War Cadence.f: The rhythm isn't a call to arms, but a signal that the goblins have made a new enemy.

USG:Zephid.f: Once you've seen one, you'll understand why spells won't go near them.

MMQ:Warpath.f: Cho-Manno had never seen Mercadia City's forces fight so well. The magistrate must have hired a new hero.

WTH:Tolarian Drake.f: Many have been lost just in staring at its wings. What's seen differs from account to account, but madness is always part of the story.

STH:Flame Wave.f:
"I hear the roaring of a wave whose waters are red and whose mists are black."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

MMQ:Fresh Volunteers.f: Every Cho-Arrim villager is a potential warrior; when they are called, they abandon their peaceful way of life and take up arms to defend it.

LGN:Goblin Clearcutter.f:
"Did you know that wood burns even better than rocks?"
—Toggo, goblin weaponsmith

DRK:Amnesia.f: "When one has witnessed the unspeakable, 'tis sometimes better to forget." —Vervamon the Elder

P02:Angelic Wall.f: Be at peace, and observe its beauty. Be at war, and feel its justice.

APC:Standard Bearer.f: The standard was a rallying point for the army and a target for the enemy.

ICE:Woolly Spider.f:
"We need not fear the forces of the air; I've yet to see a Spider without an appetite."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, Elvish Hunter

PHPR:Windseeker Centaur.f: Loyal and passionate in battle, the Windseeker tribe roams the Green Lands near the Honeyed Sea.

JUD:Exoskeletal Armor.f:
"We use only what we need—but in times of strife, our need becomes great."
—Centaur warrior

FEM:Farrelite Priest.f: Although their methods were often brutal, Farrel's followers believed in the preservation of justice and virtue.

VIS:Tar Pit Warrior.f:
"The cyclops shrugged off savage blows, but casual insults made him weep."
—Azeworai, "The Cyclops who Couldn't"

2ED:Hypnotic Specter.f:
"...There was no trace/ Of aught on that illumined face..."
—Samuel Coleridge, "Phantom"

USG:Sulfuric Vapors.f: It was the dragons who first learned to chase their prey into the vapors before igniting them.

5DN:Granulate.f: There aren't *that* many ways to destroy a solid steel weapon, but somehow the goblins keep finding new ones.

USG:Goblin Raider.f: He was proud to wear the lizard skin around his waist, just for the fun of annoying the enemy.

PTK:Meng Huo's Horde.f: Through his allies, Meng Huo commanded several hundred thousand troops composed of cavalry, rattan-armored warriors, infantry, naked men with swords, and wild animals.

HML:Death Speakers.f:
"Such innocent little birds. They sing a sweet song, sitting on their fragile branch."
—Grandmother Sengir

ONS:Gravespawn Sovereign.f: The Cabal never expected its creations to create servants of their own.

MRD:Granite Shard.f: It's a piece of a world the goblins have never seen but would dearly like to blow up.

NEM:Sneaky Homunculus.f: Keep watch only for the giants and you'll be eaten by the ants.

P02:Alaborn Trooper.f:
"I dedicate my body to my country And my life to my King."
—Alaborn Soldier's Oath

INV:Reya Dawnbringer.f: A beacon of hope for a battered army.

CHK:Seizan, Perverter of Truth.f:
"If you would taste the wisdom of the oni, be prepared to salt it with your blood."
—Kiku, Night's Flower

ICE:Rally.f:
"Stand your ground, troops! This shall be our finest hour!"
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox, last words

DST:Inflame.f: A Vulshok weapon strikes with the fire of the forge that made it.

PTK:Stolen Grain.f: At the battle of Guandu, Cao Cao defeated Yuan Shao by raiding his grain depot, leaving him with no way to feed his troops.

ODY:Patrol Hound.f: To the camp, it was a fierce and loyal protector. To the sentry's youngest daughter, it would always be her "Wuv Muffin."

UDS:Master Healer.f: Behind his eyes is the pain of every soldier his hands have healed.

MRD:Damping Matrix.f: The priests tried cursing it. The mages tried dispelling it. In the end, they all obeyed it.

ODY:Druid's Call.f: Suffer the little creatures, for they may yet rise up and beat you senseless.

MRD:Cathodion.f: Cathodions repair the Great Furnace by soldering parts of themselves to the mechanism. Eventually, they become one with the machine.

TOR:Balshan Collaborator.f:
"Power, gold, crackers—every bird has its price."
—Chainer, dementia master

P02:Tremor.f: One little goblin shook up the ground. When the dust cleared, no one was found.

LGN:Ward Sliver.f: The first wave of slivers perished from the Riptide wizards' magic. The second wave shrugged off their spells like water.

PLS:Disciple of Kangee.f: When no birds are available, Kangee's disciples fill the sky with anything that's willing to fight.

ICE:Brown Ouphe.f:
"Ouphes love trinkets and love to take them apart. I only wish they wouldn't do so with the magical ones."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, Elvish Hunter

ICE:Centaur Archer.f:
"Centaurs will kill our Aesthir if they can; they've always been enemies. Destroy the horse-people on sight."
—Arna Kennerüd, Skyknight

USG:Falter.f: Like a sleeping dragon, Shiv stirs and groans at times.

DST:Vex.f:
"The druids would be better off if they spent more time in the lab and less time watching trees grow."
—Pontifex, elder researcher

MRD:Glimmervoid.f: An empty canvas holds infinite possibilities.

TMP:Heartwood Dryad.f: To snare what lies between worlds takes the patient reach of trees.

JUD:Liberated Dwarf.f: Freed from their chains, these dwarves are bound only by honor.

DRK:Martyr's Cry.f:
"It is only fitting that one such as I should die in pursuit of knowledge."
—Vervamon the Elder

NEM:Oracle's Attendants.f: The future isn't sacred, but its speaker is.

2ED:Gray Ogre.f: The Ogre philosopher Gnerdel believed the purpose of life was to live as high on the food chain as possible. She refused to eat vegetarians, and preferred to live entirely on creatures that preyed on sentient beings.

JUD:Laquatus's Disdain.f: "The first time was amusing, but now you're getting tiresome."

VIS:Longbow Archer.f:
"If it bears wings, I will pin it to the skies over Tefemburu."
—Ruya, Zhalfirin archer

TMP:Choke.f:
"One day we shall walk where once was water."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

BOK:Jetting Glasskite.f: The bolt struck with a flash and there was a terrible sound, as of glass shattering, but the creature was unharmed.

INV:Benalish Trapper.f: "I'm up here. You're down there. Now who's the lower life form?"

TMP:Ancient Runes.f: Ertai volunteered to open the portal. He figured he owed it one.

HML:Baki's Curse.f:
"Those who fling spells too quickly should have reason to regret it."
—Baki, Wizard Attendant

ODY:Animal Boneyard.f:
"The animal spirits are the Ancestor's grandchildren. Remember them."
—Mystic elder

PTK:Meng Huo, Barbarian King.f: The stubborn Meng Huo was captured and released by Kongming seven times before finally surrendering.

PCY:Soul Strings.f: Everyone is manipulated. It's just more obvious with the dead.

MRD:Tel-Jilad Exile.f: For his crimes, he was made to forget all the trolls' secrets. Now he knows only that he is outcast, but not why.

STH:Foul Imp.f: The imp, unaware of its own odor, paused to catch its breath . . . and promptly died.

ONS:Mistform Skyreaver.f: Conviction, the third myth of reality: Only those who seek the truth can be deceived.

DRK:Bog Imp.f: On guard for larger dangers, we underestimated the power and speed of the Imp's muck-crusted claws.

LGN:Mistform Ultimus.f: It may wear your face, but its mind is its own.

MRD:Ogre Leadfoot.f: When the goblins need more scrap for the Great Furnace, they simply let the ogres loose and follow in their wake.

JUD:Sudden Strength.f: The Mirari's magic transformed the Krosan Forest—and its inhabitants.

STH:Hesitation.f: Gerrard hesitated, looking up at the enemy ship. The future hesitated with him, changed forever by the pause.

PLS:Noxious Vapors.f: Urborg would just as soon steal your memories as your life.

DRK:Dark Heart of the Wood.f: Even the Goblins shun this haunted place, where the tree limbs twist in agony and the ground seems to scuttle under your feet.

USG:Flesh Reaver.f: Though the reaver is horrifyingly effective, its dorsal vents spit a highly corrosive cloud of filth.

UDS:Attrition.f:
"I will trade life for life with the insurgents. Our resources, unlike theirs, are limitless."
—Davvol, Evincar of Rath

VIS:Sun Clasp.f:
"And darkness shall be cast from me
For my soul resides in the Sun."
—Femeref dirge

CHK:River Kaijin.f:
"Since the war began, fishermen don't sing to the kaijin to ask for full nets. They guard the shore with thrice-blessed spears, saving the nets for their wives to pack their belongings and leave."
—Hayato, master sailor

ICE:Breath of Dreams.f:
"Get up, blast you! They're attacking! Why are you all so slow?"
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox

ODY:Famished Ghoul.f: Memories have distinct tastes. Its favorites are the sickly sweetness of lost love and the bitter smokiness of cruel murder.

ONS:Silklash Spider.f: The only thing that flies over the Krosan Forest is the wind.

MIR:Choking Sands.f:
"The people wiped the sand from their eyes and cursed—and left the barren land to the hyenas and vipers."
—Afari, *Tales*

VIS:Mob Mentality.f:
"Why is loud stupidity so infectious?"
—Rana, Suq'Ata market fool

FEM:Orcish Captain.f: There's a chance to win every battle.

UDS:Squirming Mass.f: Only the coldest hearts and the strongest stomachs can stand against it.

TMP:Perish.f:
"There will come a time when the voices of soil and seedling will sing only laments."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

NEM:Spineless Thug.f: These troops are only as strong as the evincar's control.

STH:Temper.f:
"I don't need a plan, just a goal. The rest will follow on its own."
—Gerrard

MRD:Blinkmoth Well.f: When dictated by blinkmoth migratory patterns, clouds of tiny lights well up from Mirrodin's core.

PLS:Flametongue Kavu.f:
"For dim-witted, thick-skulled genetic mutants, they have pretty good aim."
—Sisay

ODY:Lieutenant Kirtar.f:
"His strengths are pride, devotion, and ambition. His weaknesses are the same."
—Pianna, nomad captain

DST:Test of Faith.f: Those who survive the test bear a mark of power anyone can recognize.

MMQ:Squall.f: The air that holds them aloft can just as easily put them down.

DRK:Whippoorwill.f: If the Whippoorwill remains silent, the soul has not reached its reward.

POR:Renewing Dawn.f: Dawn brings a new day, and a new day brings hope.

MMQ:Snorting Gahr.f: There's little advantage to surprising the gahr.

FEM:Feral Thallid.f:
"Born and bred of fungus, Thallids were nearly impossible to kill."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. I*

ODY:Skycloud Egg.f:
"Have your dreams of a better society become an obsession?"
—Watnik, master glassblower

PCY:Death Charmer.f: It vents the chill of the grave.

MRD:Nim Shambler.f: Called "the Dross" by its inhabitants, Mephidross is home to the nim, Mirrodin's mindless, ravenous undead.

TMP:Wild Wurm.f:
Wurm heads appear
Wild wurm near
Wurm tails you see
Wild wurm flee

LEG:Segovian Leviathan.f:
"Leviathan, too! Can you catch him with a fish-hook/ or run a line round his tongue?"
—*Job 40:25*

LEG:Ramirez DePietro.f: Ramirez DePietro is a most flamboyant pirate. Be careful not to believe his tall tales, especially when you ask his age.

NEM:Ascendant Evincar.f:
"Things are going to change around here."
—Crovax

P02:Town Sentry.f:
"So he gots a sword. Big deal."
"Yeah, it's a big deal—it's a big sword!"
—Two goblins outside the gates of Trokin

NEM:Spiritual Asylum.f: Trapped in safety is still trapped.

POR:Time Ebb.f: Like the tide, time both ebbs and flows.

WTH:Paradigm Shift.f:
"Barrin always said that reality is relative. 'The world,' he cautioned, 'is but pieces of one's perception.'"
—Ertai, wizard adept

MIR:Stone Rain.f:
"What rainbow could possibly come of this rain?"
—Asmira, Holy Avenger

MIR:Goblin Tinkerer.f:
"Can they *do* that?"
—Imwita, Zhalfirin artificer, last words

MMQ:Vine Trellis.f: "We protect our own with our own."

WTH:Firestorm.f:
"Glok loved storms! He'd sit an' watch an' laugh through the whole thing. I miss him."
—Squee, goblin cabin hand

INV:Sapphire Leech.f:
"The subject's wings are clearly vestigial. We suspect the gems somehow keep it aloft."
—Tolarian research notes

TMP:Scorched Earth.f:
"Fire cleanses as well as destroys; that is the nature of change."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

SCG:Undead Warchief.f: It has the strength of seven men. In fact, it used to be seven men.

MIR:Spitting Earth.f:
"There are times solid ground gives precious little comfort."
—Talibah, embermage

INV:Llanowar Knight.f: Her armor and steed were borrowed, but her courage was hers alone.

LGN:Primoc Escapee.f: Though a completely artificial species, primocs are a natural fit for the skies of Otaria.

P02:Raging Goblin.f: He raged at the world, at his family, at his life. But mostly he just raged.

ULG:Lone Wolf.f: A wolf without a pack is either a survivor or a brute.

VIS:Necrosavant.f:
"Ah, I remember my first death."
—Zarkuu, necrosavant

ONS:Festering Goblin.f: In life, it was a fetid, disease-ridden thing. In death, not much changed.

POR:Arrogant Vampire.f: Charm and grace may hide a foul heart.

CHK:Dripping-Tongue Zubera.f: When the Honden of Life's Web was destroyed, its attendants swarmed Kamigawa to ensure mortal defeat.

MMQ:Gush.f: Don't trust your secrets to the sea.

STH:Primal Rage.f: "Charge!" A great cry went out, and countless elves and Vec soldiers charged up the mountain. Their fury and passion hid the fact that they were horribly outnumbered.

BOK:Ribbons of the Reikai.f:
"If wisdom is a river, then we cup our hands, reach in, and drink from it in sips. The kami, however, are like fish, swimming, breathing, surrounded in its presence."
—Dosan the Falling Leaf

ALL:Phyrexian War Beast.f:
"Deal with the spawn of Phyrexia cautiously; only with time may we control them."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

MMQ:Shock Troops.f: When goblins blow themselves up, it's called stupidity. When humans do, it's called heroism.

MMQ:War Tax.f: The worst thing about being a depraved pirate is having to work with a bunch of depraved pirates.

STH:Lancers en-Kor.f: Nearly all sets of Kor twins are trained as lancers.

VIS:Python.f:
"How can you claim the gods are merciless when they robbed the snake of its limbs to give the other creatures a sporting chance?"
—Hakim, Loreweaver

MIR:Vaporous Djinn.f:
"What is taking them so long to fill the waterskins?"
—Mwani, Mtenda goatherd

JUD:Envelop.f:
"What you made will be unmade. What you learned will be unlearned. And when you're done, you will be undone."
—Ambassador Laquatus

TOR:Balthor the Stout.f:
"I like to think of him as concentrated barbarian."
—Kamahl, pit fighter

2ED:Phantasmal Forces.f: These beings embody the essence of true heroes long dead. Summoned from the dreamrealms, they rise to meet their enemies.

MRD:Psychogenic Probe.f: The same devices sold as surgeons' tools in Lumengrid are sold as implements of torture in Mephidross.

PLS:Phyrexian Tyranny.f:
"He is Yawgmoth's reward to me. I shall kill him a hundred times a day."
—Crovax, to Ertai

WTH:Benalish Infantry.f:
"My favorite part of getting into the infantry was getting out again."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

MIR:Femeref Archers.f:
"They say a Zhalfirin archer can split the eye of a griffin. Nonsense, of course: they have no faith to guide their darts."
—Nuru, Femeref archer

SCG:Wirewood Guardian.f: Tall as a tree and probably related.

MRD:Regress.f:
"Once cast, a spell can be undone. But once revealed, a secret can never again be kept."
—Pontifex, elder researcher

ONS:Thoughtbound Primoc.f: Efforts to use them as spies failed when they kept reporting to the enemy.

ONS:Dream Chisel.f: Itself a product of Ixidor's tortured psyche, the chisel brings his darkest dreams to life.

INV:Addle.f:
"I'll wring out your tiny mind like a sponge."
—Urborg witch

CHK:Orochi Ranger.f:
"The young come to me, confused. They have been taught to respect the kami, and now they must fight them? I do not know what to say."
—Sachi, to her father

MMQ:Saber Ants.f: They stay on the battlefield only long enough to consume the losers.

DRK:Festival.f: Only after the townsfolk had drawn us into their merry celebration did we discover that their holiday rituals held a deeper purpose.

WTH:Thundermare.f: Its hooves strike lightning and the thunder follows quickly after.

POR:Redwood Treefolk.f: The soldiers chopped and chopped, and still the great tree stood, frowning down at them.

TMP:Endless Scream.f:
"I have made Crovax weep; now I will make him scream. The pain will not end, but will bind him to me."
—Volrath

MMQ:Sacred Prey.f: To see one is a good omen to the Cho-Arrim.

ICE:Arcum's Sleigh.f:
"With the proper equipment and caution, one can travel anywhere."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

DST:Tangle Golem.f: The longer it weaves through the twisted vines of the Tangle, the more it adopts their hidden strength.

VIS:Gossamer Chains.f:
"Harah swung his sword mightily, but still the air held him fast."
—Azeworai, "Kenechi's Dream"

ODY:Druid Lyrist.f: The druids and the forest are in perfect harmony. They sing the same songs.

MIR:Armorer Guildmage.f:
Zhalfir's destiny rings in tempered steel.
—Armorer Guild maxim

HML:Anaba Spirit Crafter.f:
"The Spirit Crafters sing of all our people. They sing of those lost, of those found, and of those who are yet to be."
—Onatah, Anaba Shaman

WTH:Benalish Missionary.f:
"These horn-haters say no gods but theirs exist. I say let him find out for himself—right now!"
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

MRD:Leonin Elder.f:
"The wisdom of the elders is just as much a weapon as a sword or spear. We must learn to wield it."
—Ushanti, leonin seer

ONS:Slipstream Eel.f: "It's a fine way to travel, if you don't mind the smell."

PCY:Greel, Mind Raker.f: "You're Latulla's gift to me, and I always play with my presents."

2ED:Scryb Sprites.f: The only sound was the gentle clicking of the Faeries' wings. Then those intruders who were still standing turned and fled. One thing was certain: they didn't think the Scryb were very funny anymore.

MMQ:Lunge.f: Cho-Arrim righteousness was no match for Benalish combat training.

SOK:Freed from the Real.f: When a strong mind moves, form and energy shift to heed it.

JUD:Brawn.f:
"'I have arrived,' bellowed Brawn, and the plane shuddered."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

USG:Retromancer.f: "If one harm us, strike them in return. So sayeth the bey."

TMP:Elite Javelineer.f:
"Precision is frequently more valuable than force."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

P02:Time Ebb.f:
"The ogre had come from out of the blue, so that's where I sent it back."
—Talas wizard

STH:Craven Giant.f:
What is high as a mountain and low as a snake?
—Dal riddle

DST:Pulse of the Forge.f: Before wars or weapons, there was anger.

LGN:Wirewood Hivemaster.f: "Most insects have been drawn to the Mirari. But all that remain in Wirewood are under my care."

INV:Kavu Monarch.f: Kavu emerged all across Dominaria, but the first and the strongest came from Yavimaya.

TMP:Wind Dancer.f:
"Flying like a bird does not make you as free as one."
—Volrath

FEM:Dwarven Lieutenant.f:
"Dwarven officers were tireless in battle, moving up and down the lines to rally their troops and boost morale."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

ICE:Minion of Tevesh Szat.f:
"A minion given over to Tevesh Szat is a stronger minion gained."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

TMP:Sandstone Warrior.f:
"I used to describe something stable as 'rock solid.' So much for *that* expression."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

ICE:Woolly Mammoths.f:
"Mammoths may be good to ride on, but they're certainly bad to fall off of!"
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

SCG:Primitive Etchings.f: Ancient carvings in the trees of Krosa glow with power once again.

MMQ:Common Cause.f: Mercadia City's troops are at their best when they have no enemy to fight.

INV:Urborg Shambler.f: A writhing mass of rot, with sharp claws and a vicious spirit.

PTK:Counterintelligence.f: Before the battle of Red Cliffs, a supposedly sleeping Zhou Yu allowed his old friend, a Wei advisor, to steal a planted letter forged as if from Wei's two best admirals.

ONS:Gustcloak Runner.f: Cabal spies trying to follow the Order's movements are constantly frustrated by tracks that stop dead.

MIR:Illumination.f:
"A brilliant light can either illuminate or blind. How will you know which until you open your eyes?"
—Asmira, Holy Avenger

PCY:Ribbon Snake.f: All snakes slither. Only this one soars.

ONS:Skirk Prospector.f:
"I like goblins. They make funny little popping sounds when they die."
—Braids, dementia summoner

MIR:Zhalfirin Knight.f:
"You returned a warrior. . . . Your hair was cut, your eye tattooed with the red triangle of war."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

LGN:Dark Supplicant.f: Cabal clerics serve two masters: their patriarch and their god.

POR:Bog Raiders.f: Those who live amid decay must expect scavengers.

SCG:Cabal Conditioning.f:
"Hear only the Cabal's voice.
See only the Cabal's way.
Speak only the Cabal's word."
—Cabal mantra

5DN:Thermal Navigator.f: It takes off with a roar of superheated wind, startling wild pterons as they survey the ground below.

TMP:Sky Spirit.f:
"Like a strain of music: easy to remember but impossible to catch."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

ICE:Skull Catapult.f:
"Let any who doubt the evil of using the ancient devices look at this infernal machine. What manner of fiend would design such a sadistic device?"
—Sorine Relicbane, Soldevi Heretic

MRD:Fists of the Anvil.f: Gron's mind reeled with possibilities, most of which are best left unmentioned.

BOK:Heed the Mists.f: "Once, I looked to the mists for wisdom. Now I wish only for understanding."

BOK:Kitsune Palliator.f: "Who am I to judge who is deserving and who is not? That is a question for lords, not healers."

MMQ:Trap Runner.f: "How could I catch her when the trees conspired to stop me?"

ONS:Mistform Wall.f: Fellowship, the fourth myth of reality: As the tides of war shift, so do loyalties.

WTH:Merfolk Traders.f:
"As much as I hate water, I *do* love fish . . . ."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

ODY:Ashen Firebeast.f:
"I'm not sure which impresses me most, its thoroughness or its intensity."
—Matoc, lavamancer

MIR:Rashida Scalebane.f: It is not by the blood of dragons that Rashida measures victories, but by the sum of children who no longer wake from nightmares of scales and fire.

POR:Skeletal Crocodile.f: The less flesh there is, the more teeth there seem to be.

PTK:Wu Infantry.f: The first battle of Hefei was Sun Quan's last as a field general. From then on he let his generals command in the field while he directed battle from behind the front lines.

ATQ:The Rack.f: Invented in Mishra's earlier days, the Rack was once his most feared creation.

LEG:Psionic Entity.f: Creatures of the Æther are notorious for neglecting their own well-being.

LEG:Raging Bull.f:
"Sometimes the bulls win, and sometimes the bears win. But the bulls have more fun."
—Anonymous

SOK:Seed the Land.f: With a sadness and a sense of hope, Senka left the colony of her birth and, with her attendants, set out to serve as broodmistress, founder of a new colony.

P02:Steam Frigate.f:
"Is it merchants or is it pirates?"
"It's Talas—there's no difference."

PCY:Calming Verse.f: The chattering forest fell silent as the otherworldly song began.

INV:Capashen Unicorn.f: Capashen riders were stern and humorless even before their ancestral home was reduced to rubble.

MMQ:Erithizon.f: Unlike scorpions, the erithizon isn't immune to its own weaponry.

MRD:Trash for Treasure.f: Goblins generally have two possessions: one per hand.

MRD:Cobalt Golem.f: Centuries before the first tides of the Quicksilver Sea rose to meet each new sun, Mirrodin's light shone on the golems alone.

TOR:Invigorating Falls.f: Krosan druids do not fear death, for they know that nature will only prosper from their passing.

USG:Barrin, Master Wizard.f:
"Knowledge is no more expensive than ignorance, and at least as satisfying."
—Barrin, master wizard

NEM:Flowstone Slide.f: It may look like soil, but its nature is malice.

ONS:Airdrop Condor.f: It has two kinds of droppings, neither of which is particularly pleasant.

PCY:Diving Griffin.f:
To outrace the griffin
—Kipamu expression meaning "to do the impossible"

PCY:Entangler.f: "Tell me again," said Latulla, raising her fist, "how just one woman held back an entire Keldon platoon."

CHK:Ore Gorger.f:
"We've stumbled upon a network of caves not on our maps. We can only hope it is safe to spend the night."
—Lost Battalion, message to General Takeno

PLS:Slay.f: The elves had the edge in guile, skill, and valor. But in the end, only sheer numbers mattered.

CHK:Quiet Purity.f:
"When the Kami of Utter Silence passes, walls lose their secrets. Scrolls lose their lessons. Tapestries lose their beauty. Where there was meaning, there is only stillness."
—Sensei Hisoka

PLS:Horned Kavu.f: "That didn't happen naturally," said Multani. "Rath's overlay is interfering with the Æther itself."

ULG:Quicksilver Amulet.f: "Wonderful! You got a lion on your first try. Now put it back."

POR:Dread Charge.f:
"As equal were their souls, so equal was their fate."
—John Dryden, "Ode to Mrs. Anne Killigrew"

INV:Harrow.f: No spot in nature is truly barren.

ODY:Fervent Denial.f:
"Your tenacity is admirable. And futile."
—Emperor Aboshan

LEG:Indestructible Aura.f: Theodar strode the battle lines, snatching swords with his bare hands and casting them aside until all cowered before him.

EXO:Angelic Blessing.f: Only the warrior who can admit mortal weakness will be bolstered by immortal strength.

UDS:Voice of Reason.f:
"Next to Grace is Reason, and Reason must be retained. If the web of Reason comes unwoven, madness will escape."
—*Song of All*, canto 167

JUD:Balthor the Defiled.f: He remembers enough of his life to weep for what he has lost.

2ED:Wall of Bone.f: The Wall of Bone is said to be an aspect of the Great Wall in Hel, where the bones of all sinners wait for Ragnarok, when Hela will call them forth for the final battle.

INV:Salt Marsh.f:
Only death breeds in stagnant water.
—Urborg saying

USG:Winding Wurm.f: Entire trees were stripped of their bark and branches by the wurm's writhing path.

STH:Rabid Rats.f: Every sentence in Volrath's prisons ends the same way.

LEG:Touch of Darkness.f:
"Black spirits and white, red spirits and gray,/
Mingle, mingle, mingle, you that mingle may."
—Thomas Middleton, The Witch

ULG:Jhoira's Toolbox.f: It entertained Jhoira to craft a kit that could bring her the tools.

PTK:Shu Soldier-Farmers.f: During Kongming's campaigns against the Wei, his Shu troops rotated from the battlefront to the fields every hundred days.

TMP:Meditate.f:
"Part of me believes that Barrin taught me meditation simply to shut me up."
—Ertai, wizard adept

P02:Goblin Cavaliers.f: They get along so well with their goats because they're practically goats themselves.

MMQ:Tower of the Magistrate.f: Like the city, weakest at its foundation.

INV:Firebrand Ranger.f: A skilled ranger can glance at the mud on your boots and tell where you last camped.

SOK:Hand of Cruelty.f: "The sword is just a tool. It is the samurai's hand that delivers death."

ODY:Battle Strain.f: The pits swallow the weak as predators swallow prey.

ALL:Varchild's War-Riders.f:
"What tries to crush our spirit only strengthens our resolve."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian Chieftain

ULG:Planar Collapse.f: With heavy heart, Urza doused one world's light to rekindle another's.

ONS:Pacifism.f: Even those born to battle could only lay their blades at Akroma's feet.

DRK:Word of Binding.f: "That was the worst experience of my days, standing there helpless as they killed my whole troop." —Maeveen O'Donagh, *Memoirs of a Soldier*

VIS:Wicked Reward.f:
"The blood on my hands is merely proof of my ambition."
—Kaervek

APC:Penumbra Kavu.f:
"These kavu are so stubborn they even refuse to die."
—Tahngarth

MRD:Molder Slug.f: Fortunately for it, Mirrodin is a plane without salt.

APC:Glade Gnarr.f: Long thought merely a legend, the appearance of the gnarr was seen by the defenders as a sign of good luck.

USG:Disruptive Student.f:
"Teferi is a problem student. Always late for class. No appreciation for constructive use of time."
—Barrin, progress report

PCY:Veteran Brawlers.f: Death awaits them on both fronts.

PTK:Shu Defender.f: Confronting Cao Cao's army at Steepslope Bridge, Zhang Fei bellowed, "I am Zhang Fei of Yan! Who dares fight me to the death?" Cao Cao's army cowered and fled.

5DN:Tel-Jilad Lifebreather.f: "The Tangle loans you life. Spend it well."

LEG:Jacques le Vert.f: Abandoning his sword to return to the lush forest of Pendelhaven, Jacques le Vert devoted his life to protecting the creatures of his homeland.

SOK:Trusted Advisor.f: Some of Minamo's students claimed he was as old as the knowledge he dispensed.

MRD:Myr Retriever.f: Mephidross gives up treasure easily . . . as long as you take its place.

TMP:Flowstone Wyvern.f:
"Where I come from, stone stays on the ground."
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

TMP:Dauthi Marauder.f:
"The Dauthi came from beneath the Ruins one night, and the darkness cast them in the best possible light."
—Soltari *Tales of Life*

ODY:Kamahl, Pit Fighter.f: "I didn't come to play. I came to win."

CHK:Okina, Temple to the Grandfathers.f: If a land can be said to have a heart, Okina is the heart of Kamigawa.

ULG:Granite Grip.f: There's beauty in the desert—but it's best to view it from afar.

MMQ:Trade Routes.f: Like the price of goods, the value of the routes was renegotiated daily.

ICE:Wings of Aesthir.f:
"For those of courage, even the sky holds no limit."
—Arnjlot Olasson, Sky Mage

JUD:Flaring Pain.f:
"I don't rub salt in wounds. I use sulfur."
—Matoc, lavamancer

APC:Dragon Arch.f: In their hunger for the arch's power, mages often forget that it only makes dragons easier to summon. It doesn't make them easier to control.

TMP:Skyshroud Vampire.f:
"If it tastes one drop of elvish blood I will cast it from the shroud to see it burn."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

MRD:Myr Enforcer.f: Most myr monitor other species. Some myr monitor other myr.

PCY:Nakaya Shade.f: Made strong by reckless magic. Made horrid by reckless strife.

MRD:Tel-Jilad Chosen.f: "It is my honor to keep safe Tel-Jilad's secrets, not to know them."

MRD:Skeleton Shard.f: Metal permeates the marrow of every bone in Mephidross—except one.

MMQ:Port Inspector.f: "There may be a few minor additional fees, levies, duties, surtaxes, tariffs, imposts, tolls . . . ."

MMQ:Ramosian Sergeant.f: Her commands are part rallying cry, part sermon, and wholly undeniable.

LEG:Elder Land Wurm.f: Sometimes it's best to let sleeping dragons lie.

ONS:False Cure.f:
"I do unto others as others have done unto me."
—Phage the Untouchable

ICE:Balduvian Bears.f:
"They're a hardy bunch, but I'd still bet that they just slept through the worst of the cold times."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

2ED:Air Elemental.f: These spirits of the air are winsome and wild, and cannot be truly contained. Only marginally intelligent, they often substitute whimsy for strategy, delighting in mischief and mayhem.

DST:Eater of Days.f: When Mirrodin's varied civilizations developed ways to fight the levelers, Memnarch upped the stakes.

ULG:Fleeting Image.f: Horas swore off drinking, but after meeting the creature a second time he decided he'd better start again.

MIR:Circle of Despair.f:
"Life is a resource that should belong only to the strong."
—Shauku, Endbringer

ONS:Shieldmage Elder.f: "You may fight if I deem your cause worthy."

ICE:Fumarole.f:
"Too many of us have died in the explosions that wrack these hills."
—Klazina Jansdotter, Leader of the Order of the Sacred Torch

ICE:Orcish Farmer.f:
"Yes, the Farmers keep our soldiers fed. But why do they have to make every battlefield a pigpen?"
—Toothlicker Harj, Orcish Captain

HML:Grandmother Sengir.f:
"Rarely have power and madness been so delightfully wed as they have in our dear Grandmother."
—Baron Sengir

HML:Roots.f:
"That which nourishes can also bind."
—Gemma, Willow Priestess

MRD:Thoughtcast.f: Vedalken eyes don't see the beauty in things. They see only what those things can teach.

CHK:Akki Underminer.f:
"Deep inside the Sokenzan Mountains, a band of akki discovered a cache of ancient items of power. Their ensuing spree of destruction became known as 'The Three Days of Fun.'"
—*Observations of the Kami War*

TMP:Skyshroud Ranger.f:
"Just as you see the grave and remember the friend, I see this forest and remember Llanowar."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

ONS:Severed Legion.f: No one in Aphetto answers a knock at the door after sundown.

ICE:Balduvian Barbarians.f:
"Barbarian raids were a concern to those living in the northwest provinces, but the Skyknights never dealt with the problem in a systematic way. They thought of the Balduvians as an 'amusing model' of their forebears' culture."
—*Kjeldor: Ice Civilization*

NEM:Phyrexian Driver.f: Although the abuse was initially effective, the troops soon became numb to it.

HML:An-Havva Inn.f:
"The Inn was ever a steady source of good cheer and kindness. Greatly do I miss it, now that I am gone."
—Ihsan's Shade

MIR:Worldly Tutor.f:
"Aselbo soon had the rhino eating from his palm and the snake waiting at his heels."
—Afari, *Tales*

APC:Consume Strength.f: As Multani's troops invaded Urborg, the decay of the swamp became a feast for the living.

MRD:Troll Ascetic.f: It's no coincidence that the oldest trolls are also the angriest.

SOK:Kami of the Crescent Moon.f:
"He's a lot like me, that masterless little kami . . . unimpressed by grandeur and never at a loss for a trick."
—Toshiro Umezawa

SOK:Ayumi, the Last Visitor.f: Before Shinka's walls were built, before the torii at Okina stood, she was there, tall and proud against the sky, and she will be there long after they have fallen into dust.

USG:Eastern Paladin.f:
"Their fragile world. Their futile lives. They obstruct the Grand Evolution. In Yawgmoth's name, we shall excise them."
—Oath of the East

VIS:Relic Ward.f: Asmira's prayers alone should have freed Mangara from the amber prison . . .

PCY:Wintermoon Mesa.f: Dark is light and day is night When the winter moon shines.

MMQ:Skull of Ramos.f: Ramos fell, and there was night.

SOK:Molting Skin.f: "We have learned much from the orochi."

BOK:Ogre Marauder.f: Once freed, the oni demanded more and more sacrifices to appease them. The ogres happily obliged.

POR:Moon Sprite.f:
"I am that merry wanderer of the night."
—William Shakespeare,
*A Midsummer Night's Dream*

APC:Mystic Snake.f: Its fangs are in your flesh before its hiss leaves your ears.

VIS:Dragon Mask.f:
"With no further options, I was forced to don the mask."
—Rashida Scalebane

ARN:Island of Wak-Wak.f: The Isle of Wak-Wak, home to a tribe of winged folk, is named for a peculiar fruit that grows there. The fruit looks like a woman's head, and when ripe speaks the word "Wak."

DST:Genesis Chamber.f:
"As the experimental population grows, so do the number of myr. It's a perfect equilibrium."
—Memnarch

BOK:In the Web of War.f:
"In desperation, Konda sent warriors to parley with the ogre-magi. No one knows whether they were slaughtered at Shinka or if they even reached its bloodstained walls."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

MIR:Stalking Tiger.f: In the Jamuraan jungles, there is often no separating beauty from danger.

MMQ:High Seas.f:
Bend as the wave breaks or it will break you as well.
—Saprazzan saying

NEM:Murderous Betrayal.f: In darkness, the assassin sneaked into the village and destroyed what Eladamri loved most: his daughter.

MRD:Wurmskin Forger.f: It takes three weeks for a patrol of hunters to down a slagwurm. It takes just as long to make a single cut in its hide.

INV:Glimmering Angel.f:
"We turned to see where the blow came from and saw only a distant light."
—Capashen lord

SCG:Lingering Death.f:
"Looks bad. I don't know if he'll make it through the night."
—Cabal cleric

MIR:Jungle Wurm.f: Broad as a baobab—and about as smart.

USG:Crosswinds.f: Harbin's ornithopter had been trapped for two days within the currents of the storm. When the skies cleared, all he could see was a horizon of trees.

TMP:Talon Sliver.f: "Keep them at sword's length!" Gerrard's order fell flat as each sliver's talon suddenly grew longer. "Hold on—break out the polearms!"

UDS:Keldon Vandals.f: Keldons divide all their spoils into two groups: trophies and catapult ammunition.

PCY:Withdraw.f: "We outnumber them! Charge! Charge! Hey, where'd you guys go? Retreat! Retreat!"

LEG:Bartel Runeaxe.f: Thundering down from Hammerheim, no foe could slow Bartel's charge.

JUD:Sylvan Safekeeper.f:
"How could someone so small cause so much trouble?"
—Nomad sentry

SOK:Gnat Miser.f: Nezumi insect-shamans enjoyed solitary lives, which was fortunate since no other nezumi could stand to live within half a mile of their foul stench.

MMQ:Sizzle.f: Explosions ripped through the ship overhead, and those unfortunate enough to be directly below scrambled to find cover.

EXO:Treasure Trove.f: Karn and Hanna stood over the recovered Legacy artifacts like loving parents over sleeping children.

NEM:Mogg Alarm.f: They make mountains into mogg holes.

TOR:Krosan Constrictor.f:
"It's a slithering, coldblooded menace. I've gotta respect that."
—Braids, dementia summoner

P02:Goblin Lore.f:
"I done forgot more than you'll ever know, pipsqueak."
"Yeah—that's your problem."

APC:Llanowar Dead.f: Just as leaves fall from the branches of a living tree, so too do the dead leave the elfhame.

NEM:Laccolith Grunt.f: They leave a trail of ash and sorrow.

2ED:Plague Rats.f:
"Should you a Rat to madness tease
Why ev'n a Rat may plague you..."
—Samuel Coleridge, "Recantation"

POR:Lava Axe.f: Swing your axe as a broom, to sweep away the foe.

ONS:Standardize.f: At that point, the wizards' argument got a lot uglier.

TMP:Crown of Flames.f: It is the forge of kings.

POR:Deep-Sea Serpent.f: Sailors fear the deep-sea serpent; others thank the gods it has no legs.

ICE:Sea Spirit.f:
"It rose above our heads, above the ship, and still higher yet. No foggy, ice-laden sea in the world could frighten me more."
—General Jarkeld, the Arctic Fox

DST:Ageless Entity.f: Tel-Jilad's sworn protectors are the trolls, yet more fearsome protectors were created by the Tangle itself.

P02:Salvage.f:
"What was taken shall be restored."
—Arathel, elvish queen

LEG:Syphon Soul.f:
"Her lips suck forth; see, where it flies!"
—Christopher Marlowe, *The Tragical History of Doctor Faustus*

INV:Vodalian Zombie.f:
"Every last one of you will become my servant. It's a shame you won't live to see the irony."
—Tsabo Tavoc, Phyrexian general

MRD:Chromatic Sphere.f:
"As expected, this sphere's design reflects the colors of the four moons . . . plus another?"
—Pontifex, elder researcher

CHK:Humble Budoka.f: Each time wanderers entered the forest seeking enlightenment, Dosan was there, waiting for them to arrive.

ULG:Expendable Troops.f: No doubt in their minds, no fear in their hearts.

ATQ:Hurkyl's Recall.f: This spell, attributed to Drafna, was actually the work of his wife Hurkyl.

PCY:Silt Crawler.f: If they could replenish the land instead of draining it, Jamuraa would be teeming with them.

ICE:Infernal Darkness.f:
"I thought the day had brought enough horrors for our ragged band, but the night was far worse."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter, Leader of the Order of the White Shield

ATQ:Urza's Chalice.f: When sorely wounded or tired, Urza would often retreat to the workshops of his apprentices. They were greatly amazed at how much better he looked each time he took a sip of water.

MRD:Consume Spirit.f: Mephidross changes all who dwell there, taking their lives and adding them to its own.

MRD:Aether Spellbomb.f:
"Release that which was never caged."
—Spellbomb inscription

DRK:Elves of Deep Shadow.f: "They are aberrations who have turned on everything we hold sacred. Let them be cast out." —Ailheen, Speaker of the Council

ODY:Testament of Faith.f:
"Belief in the Ancestor is admirable, but our enemies often demand something more . . . tangible."
—Pianna, nomad captain

EXO:Maniacal Rage.f: Only by sacrificing any semblance of defense could Gerrard best Greven.

VIS:Coercion.f:
A rhino's bargain
—Femeref expression meaning "a situation with no choices"

SCG:Ark of Blight.f: When opened, it erases entire landscapes from minds and maps.

ODY:Iridescent Angel.f: She enraptures all, encompasses all, endures all.

TMP:Master Decoy.f:
"A skilled decoy can throw your enemies off your trail. A master decoy can survive to do it again."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

LEG:Lady Evangela.f: "When milady was young, the sight of a rainbow would fill her soul with peace. As she grew, she learned to share her rapture with others." —*Lady Gabriella*

ICE:Aggression.f: The star that burns twice as bright burns half as long.

MRD:Alpha Myr.f: First to charge, first to fight.

MRD:Terror.f:
"A simple trap in a dark corner of the mind, and their nightmares catch up with them."
—Geth, keeper of the Vault

P02:Nature's Lore.f:
"Every seed planted is another lesson the forest can teach us."
—Arathel, elvish queen

TMP:Grindstone.f:
"Memory is a burden that wears at the soul as weather wears at stone."
—Crovax

ICE:Brine Shaman.f:
"The Shamans of Marit Lage do her bidding in secret, but they do it gladly."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran Priest

MIR:Igneous Golem.f:
"The creature rose from the mountain, its body weeping fire."
—Afari, *Tales*

INV:Kavu Lair.f: As a dark rain of Phyrexians fell from the sky, fountains of kavu erupted from the ground.

P02:Dakmor Bat.f: The bat thrives on what underestimates it.

WTH:Soul Shepherd.f:
"The sidar who raised me had a saying: 'The first step into death is the hardest.'"
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

ODY:Metamorphic Wurm.f: Only a handful have seen it transform. Or, from the wurm's perspective, only a mouthful.

PTK:Pang Tong, \"Young Phoenix\".f: ". . . It was Pang Tong's boat-connecting scheme That let Zhou Yu accomplish his great deed."

TOR:Pardic Lancer.f: He gets to the point right away.

DRK:The Fallen.f: Magic often masters those who cannot master it.

PTK:Kongming, \"Sleeping Dragon\".f: "Such a lord as this—all virtues' height—Had never been, nor ever was again."

MIR:Misers' Cage.f:
"Let him be imprisoned while his possessions wander free."
—Suq'Ata legal decree

DRK:Rag Man.f: "Aw, he's just a silly, dirty little man. What's to be afraid of?"

VIS:Elephant Grass.f:
"How have I angered nature that she would imprison me in a labyrinth of grass?"
—Kasib ibn Naji, Letters

MMQ:High Market.f: If it can't be had here, it can't be had on any world.

INV:Shivan Zombie.f: Barbarians long for a glorious death in battle. Phyrexia was eager to grant that wish.

ODY:Peek.f: Sometimes you have to read between the minds.

USG:Angelic Page.f: If only every message were as perfect as its bearers.

LGN:Hundroog.f:
"New links are being added to the food chain on a daily basis."
—Riptide Project researcher

ONS:Treespring Lorian.f: No matter your strength, the Krosan Forest is stronger. No matter your speed, the Wirewood Forest is faster.

MRD:Tower of Champions.f: The ur-golem runes tell of the transformation of Mirrodin's warden from silent guardian to merciless god.

STH:Invasion Plans.f: Gerrard studied the globe as Mirri kept watch. Suddenly, his eyes widened. "This is Dominaria!"

CHK:Kitsune Riftwalker.f: The wake of his passage shoved aside the influence of the kami.

UDS:Flicker.f: Who is truer: you who are, or you who are to be?

EXO:Resuscitate.f:
"It is the art of convincing someone to live."
—Orim, Samite healer

LEG:Wall of Light.f: As many attackers were dazzled by the wall's beauty as were halted by its force.

USG:Venomous Fangs.f: All the pain of the shattered forest contained in a single drop.

MIR:Boomerang.f: A lie always returns; be careful how you catch it.

ODY:Primal Frenzy.f:
"Don't dismiss its anger as mindless fury. I assure you, it has purpose."
—Seton, centaur druid

USG:Lurking Evil.f:
"Ash is our air, darkness our flesh."
—*Phyrexian Scriptures*

P02:Cruel Edict.f:
"Such a fragile organ, the brain."
—Tojira, swamp queen

ODY:Entomb.f: A grave is the safest place to store ill-gotten treasures.

SCG:Spark Spray.f: It's the only kind of shower goblins will tolerate.

BOK:Yomiji, Who Bars the Way.f:
"As I died, I rejoiced. I would see my family again. But then I woke up back on the battlefield. Back in Kamigawa. Back in hell."
—Kenzo the Hardhearted

MMQ:Undertaker.f: The weight of death is heavy but not immovable.

ICE:Hydroblast.f:
"Heed the lessons of our time: the forms of water may move the land itself and hold captive the fires within."
—Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran Royal Mage

SOK:Moonwing Moth.f:
"Night wings sprinkled with dust Of a thousand soldiers dead And a thousand cities fallen."
—Snow-Fur, kitsune poet

5DN:Goblin Brawler.f: Perhaps he shuns technology. Perhaps he appreciates nature. Perhaps he doesn't know the difference.

USG:Attunement.f:
"The solution can hide for only so long."
—Urza

ODY:Spiritualize.f:
"There is purity in all things. Even hatred."
—Lieutenant Kirtar

ODY:Dusk Imp.f: It despises humans and squirrels and beasts and dwarves and cephalids . . . well, it despises just about everything.

TMP:Propaganda.f:
"You've failed Gerrard. You've failed the Legacy. You've failed yourself. I can do no more."
—Volrath, to Karn

PLS:Quirion Dryad.f:
"Never underestimate the ability of natural forces to adapt to unnatural influences."
—Molimo, maro-sorcerer

PTK:Spring of Eternal Peace.f: Bathing in this spring could cure ailments of body and mind alike.

MMQ:Tidal Bore.f: The dry riverbed became a raging torrent, and the Cho-Arrim claimed their prize.

POR:Starlight.f: Stars are like coins dropped into the night: their light buys safe passage.

5DN:Battered Golem.f: A dent marks every year of service, and it has as much rust as glory.

ODY:Divine Sacrament.f: Their whispered prayers rally the nomads better than any war cry could.

EXO:Skyshroud Elite.f:
"Civilization is a conspiracy to disguise the mutilation of nature."
—Skyshroud elite creed

SOK:Presence of the Wise.f: "Humbly I bow. Silently I wait. Deeply I listen."

5DN:Skyreach Manta.f: As the dawns break, the manta soars.

INV:Restrain.f:
"Hanna would give up her own life before she'd abandon the *Weatherlight*."
—Sisay

CHK:Orochi Leafcaller.f: "Only orochi hatched from eggs 'touched by the kami' may become shamans. These days, there are fewer and fewer new shamans being born."

ONS:Goblin Piledriver.f: Throw enough goblins at any problem and it should go away. At the very least, there'll be fewer goblins.

CHK:Reciprocate.f:
"Just as the noble soul calls virtue to itself, the evil soul summons harm."
—Teachings of Eight-and-a-Half-Tails

LEG:Holy Day.f:
"The day of spirits; my soul's calm retreat/ Which none disturb!"
—Henry Vaughan, "Silex Scintillans"

ODY:Diabolic Tutor.f: The best ideas often come from the worst minds.

SOK:Araba Mothrider.f:
"My finest creations are fashioned after the moths of Eiganjo. They fly higher, faster, and more gracefully than any of my own designs."
—Noboru, master kitemaker

WTH:Barrow Ghoul.f:
"They killed my family to deny me a future. They fed on my ancestors to deny me a past."
—Crovax

INV:Kavu Chameleon.f:
"They weren't part of my plan, but Gaea insisted."
—Urza

USG:Unnerve.f:
"If fear is the only tool you have left, then you'll never control me."
—Xantcha, to Gix

MMQ:Boa Constrictor.f: Its eyes are bigger than its stomach, but its mouth is larger still.

NEM:Parallax Inhibitor.f:
"The best I can offer is a temporary reprieve."
—Belbe

MRD:Goblin Striker.f: There's no word in the goblin language for "strategy." Then again, there's no word in the goblin language for "word."

ICE:Kjeldoran Skyknight.f:
"My Aesthir is my most trusted ally. We fight as one and live as one, and we will die as one."
—Arna Kennerüd, Skyknight

USG:Serra's Sanctum.f: A fragile cocoon of dreaming will.

ATQ:Battering Ram.f: By the time Mishra was defeated, no mage was foolish enough to rely heavily on walls.

SOK:Godo's Irregulars.f: Godo trained their muscles and honed their skills, but he left their hearts wild and empty.

ONS:Elven Riders.f: "Wirewood cannot hide great size. Only with speed and skill can we survive here."

ODY:Blazing Salvo.f: Barbarians equate courage with the ability to endure pain.

ICE:Dark Banishing.f:
"Will not the mountains quake and hills melt at the coming of the darkness? Share this vision with your enemies, Lim-Dûl, and they shall wither."
—Leshrac, Walker of Night

ICE:Wild Growth.f:
"Here in Fyndhorn, where Freyalise's power is strongest, the forest has its own opinion."
—Laina of the Elvish Council

ALL:Energy Arc.f:
"Relent, and you may transcend your situation."
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

WTH:Gerrard's Wisdom.f:
